We introduce Privileged Adaptation from Student Trajectories (PAST), which treats each completed student trajectory as additional privileged information for the OPSD teacher while leaving the stu

summary.core_problem: 解决 on-policy self-distillation 中 teacher 只看学生 rollout prefix，而没有利用完整学生轨迹成败信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练推理蒸馏方法。它关注 student 自己产生的完整轨迹如何作为 privileged information 改造 teacher，这对 RLVR、self-training 和 verifier-guided distillation 的接口有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PAST。对正确轨迹，保持学生的 next-token distribution；对失败轨迹，用完整轨迹及其验证结果适配 teacher，使 teacher 朝 verified success 移动，同时加入 student-proximity regularization，避免 teacher 偏离学生可学习区域。理论上分析 trajectory-conditioned teacher 能向 prefix-only student 传递什么；forward-KL distillation 会把 teacher distribution 投影为给定 prefix 下的条件算术平均。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体任务、模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或提升幅度。可确认的是方法设定在 reasoning model 的 on-policy self-distillation 上，依赖学生 rollout、prefix 级蒸馏、轨迹级成功/失败信号和 teacher adaptation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing signal in on-policy self-distillation: completed student trajectories reveal success or failure, but standard teacher construction only supervises prefixes.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training method for reasoning distillation. The useful idea is to treat full student rollouts as privileged information for the teacher, which is relevant to RLVR, self-training, and verifier-conditioned distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: PAST keeps the student next-token distribution on correct trajectories and adapts the teacher on failed trajectories toward verified success, with a student-proximity regularizer to keep the teacher learnable. It also characterizes what a trajectory-conditioned teacher can transfer to a prefix-only student, noting that forward-KL distillation projects teacher distributions to a conditional arithmetic mean given the prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide task names, model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains. The confirmed setup is reasoning-model on-policy self-distillation using student rollouts, prefix-level distillation, trajectory-level success/failure, and teacher adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 读理论投影部分即可；完整轨迹当 privileged context 这点干净，但效果要看 verifier 噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the projection analysis; using full trajectories as privileged context is clean, but the empirical value will hinge on verifier noise.

paper.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
paper.abstract: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters becau

summary.core_problem: 独立复现并跨模型、跨领域压力测试两类提升 LLM 推理可靠性的方法：测试时概率聚合和逻辑表征编辑。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是复现与机制压力测试。它关注推理可靠性论文常见的弱点：原作者自评、域内验证、代码不公开、表示干预缺少直接 probe。对判断推理增强方法是否可迁移有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 复现 RPC 的 published-path aggregation，即结合 token probability aggregation 与 self-consistency；重新实现 LCF 的 projector、contrastive training 和 intervention pipeline，将隐藏状态拆成 content 与 logic 并把 logic 部分编辑到有效区域。随后扩展到 text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别和判例评分，并直接 probe LCF 的表示。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 RPC 在四个新任务域上使用 Qwen3-8B，LCF 在四个 7-8B 模型上测试。摘要说明 RPC 在作者发布设置上可精确复现；后续跨域、跨模型结论因摘要截断需要看正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper independently reproduces and stress-tests two approaches for improving LLM reasoning reliability: test-time probability aggregation and logic-representation editing.
summary_en.importance: This is a reproduction and mechanism-analysis contribution. It targets a common weakness in reasoning-reliability work: author-only evaluation, in-domain testing, missing code, and insufficient probing of claimed representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors rerun RPC’s published-path aggregation, combining token probability aggregation and self-consistency. They reimplement LCF’s projector, contrastive objective, and intervention pipeline, which separates hidden states into content and logic components and edits the logic component toward a valid region. They then test transfer to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe the LCF representation directly.
summary_en.experiments: RPC is tested across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B. LCF is tested across four 7-8B models. The abstract states that RPC exactly reproduces the original grid on the authors’ released setup; the cross-domain and cross-model outcomes need the full paper because the abstract is truncated.

recommendation.zh: 只看复现表和表示 probe；这类论文的价值在拆穿“域内可靠性”，不是再发明一个推理技巧。
recommendation.en: Read the reproduction tables and representation probes; the value is in testing in-domain reliability claims, not in adding another reasoning trick.

paper.title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by using additional inference compute, but wider sampling alone can suffer from diminishing returns: new rollouts often repeat existing answer patterns instead of adding useful reasoning diversity. Verifier-based selection offers an alternative, but its performance depends on the calibration of an external reward model. We propose a verifier-free breadth--depth refinement framework that uses test-time compute to both explore and improve candidate solution

summary.core_problem: Test-time scaling 下，单纯加大采样宽度(best-of-N)收益递减，外部 verifier 又依赖校准良好的奖励模型；能否在无 verifier 下用“广度+深度”自我修正更有效地利用额外推理计算？
summary.importance: 提出 verifier-free 的 breadth–depth refinement 框架，是 test-time compute 分配方向的一个实用方法组合，并在多个数学推理基准上验证。
summary.technical_approach: 先采样多条独立推理 rollout（广度），再对每条 rollout 做迭代 self-critique / self-correction（深度），最后多数投票聚合；无需外部 verifier 或 reward model。
summary.experiments: 在 AIME24、AIME25、AMC、OlympiadBench、MATH500 上对比 greedy、majority voting、verifier-based best-of-N、beam search、lookahead decoding，跨多个模型规模一致提升（具体幅度摘要截断）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Oklahoma、Stanford University、UPF、Air University。

summary_en.core_problem: Under test-time scaling, pure breadth (wider sampling) hits diminishing returns because new rollouts repeat existing patterns, while verifier-based selection depends on a well-calibrated external reward model; can we use breadth + depth self-correction to spend extra inference compute more effectively without a verifier?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a verifier-free breadth–depth refinement framework for test-time reasoning, contributing a simple compute-allocation recipe evaluated across multiple math reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Samples multiple independent rollouts (breadth), iteratively refines each rollout via self-critique and self-correction (depth), then aggregates via majority voting; no external verifier or reward model required.
summary_en.experiments: On AIME24, AIME25, AMC, OlympiadBench, and MATH500, the method consistently improves over greedy decoding, majority voting, verifier-based best-of-N, beam search, and lookahead decoding across multiple model sizes (exact margins truncated in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from University of Oklahoma, Stanford University, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, and Air University.

recommendation.zh: test-time compute 分配的常规增量：无 verifier 时加 self-critique 深度修正比纯采样更划算；看方法段落就够，不要期待新范式。
recommendation.en: A standard incremental result on test-time compute allocation: self-critique depth beats pure breadth without a verifier; read the method section—don't expect a new paradigm.

paper.title: Answer First, Reason Later: Commitment Order in Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can commit tokens in any order -- a freedom marketed as their core advantage over autoregressive decoding. We show that on reasoning tasks this freedom is instead the axis of failure. Logging every commitment during decoding of LLaDA-8B on GSM8K, we find that unconstrained (pure) decoding commits the final answer at 15-24% of the trajectory while half the reasoning region is still masked, and collapses to answer-only outputs on up to 90% of problems as th

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 masked diffusion LLM 在推理任务上的解码顺序问题。dLLM 可以任意顺序提交 token，这通常被视为相对自回归模型的优势；但在 GSM8K、MATH-500 这类需要 chain-of-thought 的任务上，无约束 confidence-ordered decoding 会过早提交答案位置，甚至直接提交 EOS 和 padding，导致模型在推理区域仍大面积 masked 时已经固定最终答案。
summary.importance: 这是一篇对 diffusion LLM 训练和推理都有启发的工作。它把 dLLM 推理失败从“模型想不想推理”拆成“采样器允许它先提交哪里”。结论很具体：问题不主要来自 EOS belief，而来自 reachability，即 sampler 能否在很远的位置立即提交 EOS 或最终答案。这个区分重要，因为它说明部分失败可以通过解码约束修复，不一定需要重新训练；也说明任意顺序生成并不天然适合推理，commitment order 是 dLLM scaling、RL 训练和 CoT 数据设计里需要显式控制的变量。
summary.technical_approach: 论文没有提出新模型，而是对 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 的 denoising 过程做细粒度记录：每个位置何时从 mask 变成确定 token，每一步该位置的 top prediction 是什么。基于这些日志，作者区分了两类失败。第一类是 answer-only collapse：模型跳过推理，输出短答案后接 padding；canvas 越长，远处 EOS 越容易被提前提交。第二类是 answer-first backfill：即便最后有推理文本，答案也在轨迹前 1/4 左右被冻结，推理 token 的中位提交时间接近轨迹中点，后续推导只能围绕已经固定的答案补写。论文进一步比较 pure decoding 与 semi-AR/block-wise decoding，发现二者的 EOS pressure 几乎相同，但 EOS commitment 差异超过 2 倍。因此，差异不在模型对 EOS 的预测倾向，而在无约束 sampler 是否能对远处位置采取行动。干预方法是 window-restricted decoding：只允许提交 left-most masked position 之后 w 个位置内的 token。w=∞ 对应 pure decoding，w=1 接近左到右生成；这个单一参数直接限制远距离提交能力，不改 logits，也不重新训练。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 LLaDA-8B-Instruct。GSM8K 上，无约束 pure decoding 在 256-token canvas 时超过三分之一问题出现 answer-only collapse；canvas 扩到 512 时，collapse 最高达到约 90%，说明更大的生成空间反而让模型更容易跳过推理。答案提交时间也显著早于推理文本：最终答案通常在 denoising 轨迹前 1/4 固定，而推理区 token 的中位提交时间接近一半。论文用 2×2 设计交叉 prompt 类型和 decoder 类型：prompt 分为要求 CoT 与只要答案，decoder 分为 pure 与 semi-AR。在 250 个成对问题上，prompt–decoder interaction 约 35 个百分点，permutation p<1e-4。answer-only 条件下两种 decoder 统计上接近；要求 CoT 时，semi-AR 获得约 31 个百分点收益，而 pure decoding 几乎不能把 CoT 转化为同等性能。这个结果说明 semi-AR 的优势主要来自推理文本真正发挥作用，而不是答案格式或任务先验。论文还在 Dream-7B 和 MATH-500 上复现了模式；MATH-500 中短答案难以猜测，collapse 减少，但 answer-first 的 order channel 仍存在。窗口约束的效果很直接：在 LLaDA-8B GSM8K 上，所有 w≤64 都能把 pure decoding 从 0.528 提升到 0.82–0.85，接近 semi-AR；滑动窗口 w=32 与 block size 32 的结果相差约 1 个点，说明有效因素是 reachability 限制，而不一定是固定 block 结构。代价也被测量了：在完整 refinement 下，w=1 最优，任意顺序没有带来精度收益；当每步提交约 8 个 token 时，约束反而有害。有效区间内，gated decoder 仍可保持接近 AR 的准确率，并报告约 4× wall-clock speedup。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 answer-only collapse、answer-first backfill、EOS pressure 与 reachability 的区分，这是论文的主线。随后重点读日志分析章节，尤其是 token commitment time 的分布、答案位置与推理区域的提交顺序，以及 EOS pressure/commitment 的对照图。2×2 prompt–decoder 实验需要仔细看，因为它回答了 CoT 在 dLLM 中是否只是表面文本的问题；这里的 interaction 和 answer-only near-tie 是关键证据。窗口约束实验也值得细读，尤其是 w 的 sweep、sliding window 与 block-wise decoding 的对照、以及 compute budget 下的精度—速度权衡。对做 diffusion LM 或 masked LM 预训练的人，最值得深挖的是：训练目标是否应该显式学习可用的 commitment order，RL 是否会被 confidence-ordered sampler 限制探索，以及长 canvas 数据中的 EOS/padding 结构如何与采样 reachability 共同作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies commitment order in masked diffusion LLMs on reasoning tasks. These models can unmask tokens in any order, but unconstrained confidence-ordered decoding often commits the final answer before most reasoning tokens are available, or commits EOS and padding so early that the model produces answer-only outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful paper for diffusion-LM research because it separates model beliefs from sampler reachability. The failure is not mainly that the model has stronger EOS beliefs under pure decoding; EOS pressure is nearly decoder-invariant. The failure arises because the sampler is allowed to act on those beliefs at distant positions. This matters for decoding, RL exploration, CoT supervision, and pretraining data design for masked diffusion LMs. Any-order generation is not automatically compatible with multi-step reasoning; commitment order needs to be treated as a controlled variable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work instruments the denoising loop of LLaDA-8B-Instruct. For each position, it logs when the position is committed and what the model predicts at each step. This reveals two distinct pathologies. The first is answer-only collapse: the model emits a bare answer followed by padding, skipping the reasoning region. The second is answer-first backfill: the final answer is fixed early, and the derivation is filled in later around an already committed conclusion. The paper then compares pure decoding with semi-autoregressive or block-wise decoding and shows that EOS pressure is almost the same across decoders, while EOS commitment differs by more than a factor of two. The intervention is window-restricted decoding: only positions within a window of size w after the left-most masked position are eligible for commitment. w=∞ recovers pure decoding, and w=1 approximates left-to-right generation. The method changes only eligibility, not logits or model weights.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use LLaDA-8B-Instruct. On GSM8K, pure decoding produces answer-only collapse on more than one third of problems with a 256-token canvas, and up to about 90% with a 512-token canvas. The final answer is typically committed in the first quarter of the denoising trajectory, while the median reasoning token is committed near the halfway point. A fixed 2×2 design crosses prompt type, reasoning requested versus answer-only, with decoder type, pure versus semi-AR. On 250 paired problems, the prompt–decoder interaction is about 35 percentage points with permutation p<1e-4. In the answer-only condition, the two decoders are statistically close. When CoT is requested, semi-AR gains about 31 points, while pure decoding gains only a small amount. The same pattern is replicated on Dream-7B and MATH-500; on MATH-500, collapse is smaller, but the order channel remains. Window restriction recovers most of the gap: all w≤64 improve pure decoding from 0.528 to roughly 0.82–0.85, close to semi-AR. A sliding window of 32 matches a block size of 32 within about one point, indicating that restricted reachability, rather than block structure itself, is the active mechanism. The paper also measures the cost: with full refinement, w=1 is best; at around eight committed tokens per step, the constraint can become harmful. In the useful regime, the gated decoder keeps near-AR accuracy with a reported 4× wall-clock speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful read. Start with the Introduction for the distinction between answer-only collapse, answer-first backfill, EOS pressure, and reachability. Then read the logging analysis: the most important evidence is the distribution of commitment times for answer tokens versus reasoning tokens, and the comparison between EOS pressure and EOS commitment. The 2×2 prompt–decoder experiment is central because it tests whether CoT text functionally matters under different commitment orders. The window-restricted decoding section should also be read closely, especially the sweep over w, the comparison with block-wise decoding, and the compute-budget tradeoff. For diffusion-LM pretraining researchers, the main follow-up questions are whether commitment order should be learned or constrained during training, how confidence-ordered sampling affects RL exploration, and how EOS or padding structure in long canvases interacts with sampler reachability.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你对 dLLM reasoning 失败原因的 prior：先别急着怪训练目标，先复现它的 commitment trace 和 2x2 decoder ablation。
recommendation.en: This should change your prior on why dLLMs fail at reasoning: before blaming the training objective, reproduce the commitment traces and the 2x2 decoder ablation.

institutions: Graduate School of Data Science, Seoul National University

paper.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
paper.abstract: On-policy (Self-)Distillation (OPD / OPSD) has shown strong potential for post-training large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods still rely heavily on external supervision, including ground-truth signals, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, and therefore fall short of genuine "self"-distillation. In this study, we show that on-policy self-distillation can be achieved using only a model's own generations via internal consistency. We propose Unsupervised On-Polic

summary.core_problem: 现有同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法仍依赖真值标签、环境反馈或大模型指导等外部监督信号，无法在无标注数据上实现真正的自蒸馏，限制了在标注稀缺场景的可扩展性。
summary.importance: 验证了仅靠模型自身生成样本的内部一致性即可实现无监督同策略自蒸馏，为后训练阶段利用海量无标注推理数据提升模型能力提供了新路径，也打通了自一致性与token级稠密蒸馏的结合范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出u-OPSD方法：对每个无标注问题采样G条独立同策略rollout，通过多数投票得到伪答案；当获胜投票占比达到自一致性阈值τ时，取最短的一致rollout作为伪解构造教师分布，将其蒸馏到不一致rollout的前缀上。教师和学生共享参数，全程无需外部监督；相比自奖励RL用一致性做标量奖励，u-OPSD直接用一致性结果构造token级稠密监督信号，训练信号密度更高。
summary.experiments: 在6种Qwen3配置（4B/8B非思维/思维模式、4B-Instruct、30B-A3B-Instruct）的5个数学推理基准上测试：非思维模式相对基线提升8.5-10.7分，思维模式提升1.9-2.2分，Instruct模型提升1.7-1.8分；相比自奖励RL方法平均提升7.0-11.3%（非思维）、0.8-1.4%（思维）；性能持平甚至优于带真值监督的SFT、GRPO、带GT的OPSD，最高分别超出10.9、8.9、3.2分。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读方法部分的伪解构造逻辑与蒸馏目标设计、实验部分不同模型配置下的增益对比；采样数G、阈值τ的消融实验可快速浏览，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) methods still rely on external supervision signals such as ground-truth labels, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, failing to achieve genuine self-distillation on unlabeled data and limiting scalability in annotation-scarce scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Validates that unsupervised on-policy self-distillation can be achieved solely via internal consistency of a model's own generations, offering a new path to leverage massive unlabeled reasoning data during post-training, and establishing a paradigm that combines self-consistency with dense token-level distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes u-OPSD: for each unlabeled problem, sample G independent on-policy rollouts and derive a pseudo-answer via majority vote. When the winning vote fraction meets a self-consistency threshold τ, take the shortest agreeing rollout as the pseudo-solution to condition the teacher distribution, then distill this teacher signal into prefixes of disagreeing rollouts. Teacher and student share parameters, with no external supervision required throughout. Unlike self-rewarding RL which uses consistency as a scalar reward, u-OPSD directly uses consistency results to construct dense token-level supervision for higher signal density.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 5 mathematical reasoning benchmarks across 6 Qwen3 configurations (4B/8B non-thinking & thinking modes, 4B-Instruct, 30B-A3B-Instruct): non-thinking mode gains 8.5-10.7 points over baseline, thinking mode gains 1.9-2.2 points, Instruct models gain 1.7-1.8 points. Outperforms prior self-rewarding RL methods by 7.0-11.3% (non-thinking) and 0.8-1.4% (thinking) on average. Performs on par with or better than supervised SFT, GRPO, and GT-supervised OPSD, with maximum gains of 10.9, 8.9, 3.2 points respectively.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the method section (pseudo-solution construction and distillation objective design) and the experiment section (gain comparisons across model configurations). Skim ablation studies on sampling count G and threshold τ. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，但先别把它当‘无监督自提升’神话；重点检查伪标签筛选和采样开销是否把外部监督换成了更贵的 inference budget，读方法和 ablation 就够。
recommendation.en: Worth reading, but don’t overread it as magical unsupervised self-improvement; check whether pseudo-label filtering just trades supervision for expensive sampling, and focus on the method plus ablations.

paper.title: Hyper-ES: Effective Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning via Descent Direction Merging
paper.abstract: Evolution Strategy (ES) is a promising alternative to gradient-based fine-tuning for resource-constrained Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, directly applying ES to billion-parameter LLMs is highly ineffective. In such high-dimensional parameter spaces, most random perturbations are nearly orthogonal to useful update directions, leading to unstable optimization. We propose Hyper-ES, a subspace-based ES framework that avoids the weakness of ES in full-parameter search while exploiting

summary.core_problem: 直接将进化策略(ES)应用于十亿参数LLM推理微调效果极差，高维参数空间中随机扰动几乎与有用更新方向正交，导致优化不稳定。
summary.importance: 方法改进：提出子空间ES框架，用少量廉价梯度微调获取下降方向构造低维子空间，再在子空间内做CMA-ES优化，规避全参数ES的高维诅咒。
summary.technical_approach: Hyper-ES先运行少量梯度微调得到若干下降方向，其张成空间作为适配子空间；然后用CMA-ES在该子空间中优化逐层DARE-TIES合并权重。
summary.experiments: 在LLM推理任务上对比全参数ES和梯度微调，子空间ES以更低计算成本取得更稳定的优化效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct application of evolution strategies to billion-parameter LLM reasoning fine-tuning is highly ineffective, as random perturbations in high-dimensional parameter space are nearly orthogonal to useful update directions, causing unstable optimization.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement: a subspace-based ES framework that uses cheap gradient fine-tuning runs to construct a low-dimensional descent subspace, then applies CMA-ES within it, avoiding the high-dimensional curse of full-parameter ES.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hyper-ES first runs a small number of inexpensive gradient-based fine-tuning runs to obtain descent directions whose span forms a compact adaptation subspace; CMA-ES then optimizes layer-wise DARE-TIES merging weights within this subspace.
summary_en.experiments: Compared to full-parameter ES and gradient fine-tuning on LLM reasoning tasks, subspace ES achieves more stable optimization at lower compute cost.

recommendation.zh: 子空间ES+模型合并的思路有一定新意，但属于后训练微调范畴，对预训练研究员参考价值有限，看摘要和方法即可。
recommendation.en: Subspace ES plus model merging has some novelty but sits in post-training fine-tuning; limited reference for pretraining researchers, read abstract and method only.

paper.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel on complex tasks through long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, but their lengthy intermediate steps cause severe overthinking that inflates inference cost. KV-cache compression is a common solution, yet existing reasoning-oriented methods apply a uniform policy across the trajectory and judge compression only by what it removes from the cache. Two observations point the other way. First, a reasoning state's tolerance to context loss varies along the trajector

summary.core_problem: 长链推理模型的KV-cache压缩方法采用统一策略且忽略缓存压缩与生成侧token增长的相互抵消效应，导致推理成本节省被部分侵蚀。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出用过程奖励协调缓存压缩与生成侧token数的联合优化框架，指出压缩-生成的双向权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReCo（Reward-Coordinated Compression）框架，用轻量过程奖励估计器逐步骤打分，高奖励步骤保留更多上下文，同时在压缩预算和生成token长度间做联合优化。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露模型规模、数据集和具体提升幅度，仅给出方法动机和框架描述。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache compression for reasoning models applies uniform policies and ignores the tradeoff where smaller caches induce more generated tokens, partially canceling cost savings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: first framework that coordinates cache compression and generation-side token budget under a unified process reward signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCo (Reward-Coordinated Compression) uses a lightweight process-reward estimator to score each reasoning step, preserving context at high-reward steps and jointly optimizing compression budget against generated token length.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details (model size, datasets, numerical gains) are not provided in the available abstract; only motivation and framework description are present.

recommendation.zh: 压缩-生成双向抵消的观察有价值，但方法本身是推理侧工程组合，对预训练无直接启示，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The compression-generation tradeoff observation is useful, but the method is inference-side engineering with no direct pretraining implications; read the abstract only.

paper.title: Does Out-of-Sight Equal Out-of-Mind in CoT Monitorability?
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning offers a window into the decision-making of large language models (LLMs), which can be monitored for target behaviors by reading the reasoning trace, motivating work on CoT monitorability. Latent CoT approaches, however, replace the explicit tokens with a small number of continuous states, lowering inference costs but removing the readable trace this monitoring relies on. Monitoring then requires alternative access to the model, such as probing its activations or

summary.core_problem: 研究 latent CoT 在降低推理成本的同时，会损失多少可监控性，尤其是当监控目标是模型是否偷偷依赖提示中的 biasing hint。
summary.importance: 这篇切中一个越来越现实的问题：如果推理从显式 CoT 转向 latent reasoning，安全监控、过程监督和可解释性工具是否还成立。它对 pretrain-posttrain 接口的意义在于，训练目标若鼓励隐式推理，可能会削弱基于文本轨迹的监督手段。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造 hint-based intervention 设置，把 hint-reliance 作为 monitorability target；然后比较多种 reasoning mode 下的监控方式，包括显式 CoT、弱监督 latent CoT、强监督 latent CoT，以及通过 probing activations 或把 latent states verbalize 回文本的替代监控路径。核心是比较这些访问方式保留了多少关于模型真实决策依据的信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据集名称，但实验设计围绕不同 reasoning mode 与 monitor 的对照。关键 baseline 是显式 CoT 监控，关键比较对象是 activation probing 与 latent-state verbalization 在检测 hint reliance 上的保真度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Amsterdam 和 University of Edinburgh；Ivan Titov 在 NLP 与推理建模方向有较强代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how much monitorability is lost when reasoning shifts from explicit chain-of-thought to latent CoT, especially for detecting whether a model secretly relies on biasing hints.
summary_en.importance: This targets a timely issue: if reasoning moves toward latent forms for efficiency, do safety monitoring, process supervision, and interpretability tools still work? For pretrain/post-train researchers, the implication is that objectives encouraging implicit reasoning may weaken text-trace-based oversight.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a hint-based intervention setup where hint reliance is the monitorability target. They compare multiple reasoning modes—explicit CoT, weakly supervised latent CoT, and strongly supervised latent CoT—and evaluate alternative monitoring access paths such as activation probing and verbalizing latent states back into text. The core question is how much information about the model’s true decision basis survives under each access mode.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or dataset names, but the experimental design centers on controlled comparisons across reasoning modes and monitors. The key baseline is explicit CoT monitoring, and the main alternatives are activation probing and latent-state verbalization for detecting hint reliance.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Amsterdam and the University of Edinburgh; Ivan Titov is a notable researcher in NLP and reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 latent reasoning 的安全 prior：若监控显著退化，就不能只拿 token 节省当收益；先看 hint-reliance 设定和各类 monitor 的失真程度。
recommendation.en: This can change your safety prior on latent reasoning: if monitorability degrades materially, token savings are not the whole story; read the hint-reliance setup and where each monitor loses fidelity.

paper.title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by generating and aggregating multiple candidate answers, yet many pipelines use fixed per-query budgets that spend the same compute on easy and difficult prompts. These fixed budgets are also difficult to inspect because they do not explain why a given prompt receives a particular number of samples. We propose adaptive} test-time scaling with a lightweight fuzzy controller that maps interpretable signals, including estimated prompt complexity and model c

summary.core_problem: 为 test-time scaling 分配每题采样预算，避免简单 best-of-N 对容易题和难题使用相同推理计算。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理时计算分配方法，不是基座预训练；价值在于把 per-query compute allocation 做成可解释控制问题，可作为 test-time scaling 工程 baseline。
summary.technical_approach: 使用轻量 fuzzy controller，把估计的 prompt complexity 和 model confidence 映射到采样数量。容易或高置信题减少样本，困难或低置信题增加样本，并用 matched decoding 和受控 answer selection 做公平比较。
summary.experiments: 在问答和数学推理任务上，对比 fixed best-of-N、compute-aware scaling 和 self-certainty baseline。摘要称在不同预算下有优势，但未给出模型规模、具体数据集、绝对分数或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper allocates per-query sampling budgets for test-time scaling, rather than spending the same best-of-N compute on easy and hard prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is inference-time compute allocation, not base-model pretraining. Its value is in turning per-query test-time scaling into an interpretable control problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: A lightweight fuzzy controller maps prompt-complexity estimates and model confidence into a sampling budget. Easy or high-confidence prompts receive fewer samples; hard or low-confidence prompts receive more. The evaluation uses matched decoding settings and controlled answer selection.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares against fixed best-of-N, compute-aware scaling, and self-certainty baselines on QA and math reasoning tasks. The abstract reports gains across budgets but does not provide model sizes, datasets, absolute scores, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 看公平对齐协议即可；方法像工程控制器，若无大规模曲线，不足以改变 test-time scaling 规律判断。
recommendation.en: Read the fair-alignment protocol; the method is a control heuristic, and without large-scale curves it should not change test-time scaling priors.

paper.title: CVPO: Enhancing LLM Reinforcement Learning Reasoning via Value-Variance Adaptation and Dynamic Curriculum Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective method for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods suffer from insufficient precision in feedback on generated answer trajectories and exhibit the phenomenon of problem difficulty drift. To address these challenges, we propose CVPO - Curriculum-guided Value-Variance Policy Optimization. At the response trajectory level, we find that token-level value-variance correlates with exploratio

summary.core_problem: 在基于价值函数的 LLM 推理强化学习（PPO/VAPO 一类）里，(1) 轨迹层面的反馈/归因不够精细，尤其当同一题采样到的轨迹“全对或全错”时，优势函数缺少可区分的梯度信号；(2) 训练过程中题目相对难度随模型变强而漂移，固定采样/固定权重会把算力浪费在已变简单的题上，导致效率和上限受限。论文试图用“价值方差”刻画探索强度并据此调优势，同时用动态课程缓解难度漂移。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环里“RL 如何提供更稳定、更信息密度更高的训练信号”有启发：它把 value model 的不确定性（方差）显式引入优势估计与样本加权，属于在 PPO/价值法框架内改 credit assignment 与训练动态的工作。价值在于提供了一个可操作的信号（trajectory value-variance）来调节更新幅度与探索，而不是只靠 reward 形状或采样温度。局限是：从给出的全文片段看，理论推导偏上界分析，是否能稳定复现、对不同 reward 形态/不同基座是否一致，需要依赖完整实验部分验证。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两层组成。
1) 轨迹层：Value-Variance Adaptation。先用 value model 在 token 级对轨迹状态 s_t 估计 V(s_t)，计算一条轨迹上 token-level value 的方差（或等价的 advantage 方差 proxy），把它当作“内禀随机性/探索强度”的度量：方差高表示生成更不确定、探索更活跃；方差低表示策略更僵硬。论文给出推导：在假设 ∥∇ log π(a|s)∥ 有界时，policy gradient 的范数上界与 advantage 的方差相关，从而 value-variance 可以界定单步更新幅度。基于此，设计 variance-aware 的优势调整：针对不同 reward 类型（例如稀疏的正确性奖励 vs 过程奖励/密集奖励），用方差对优势进行缩放或重加权，使“高不确定但潜在有用”的轨迹获得更合适的学习信号，同时抑制低信息的同质轨迹导致的无效更新。
2) 题目层：Dynamic Curriculum Learning。维护题目难度的动态估计（随训练阶段更新），按难度对题目加权/采样，避免 difficulty drift 后仍把大量 batch 分配给已变简单的题；让训练在每个阶段更集中于与当前能力匹配、且能推动边界的题目。
与 GRPO 的区别：GRPO 通过组内多轨迹 reward 平均来构造 advantage，弱化了 value model；CVPO 明确依赖 value model，并用“方差”进一步细化轨迹权重与更新幅度。与 VAPO 的区别：VAPO 强调 value model 带来更准的 credit assignment，CVPO 进一步把 value 的不确定性/波动当作调节信号，并补上题目级课程以对抗难度漂移。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文内容未包含实验设置与具体数字（模型规模、训练步数、数据/题库、对比方法、提升幅度、消融表格等），只能确认作者声称：在多个数学推理基准上优于其他领先方法，并通过消融验证两项改动（方差优势调整、动态课程）的贡献。需要在完整论文中核对：
- 是否在同一基座/同一采样预算下比较（尤其是 group size、采样温度、KL 约束、reward 计算方式）。
- value-variance 的计算细节（token 级 V 的来源、是否用 GAE、是否做归一化/截断）对稳定性的影响。
- curriculum 的难度估计指标与更新频率，以及是否引入分布偏移或遗忘。
- 对“全对/全错”同质轨迹场景，是否有定量展示梯度可分性提升（例如 advantage 分布、有效样本比例、更新范数/clip ratio）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Methodology 里关于“value-variance 与更新上界”的推导，重点抓住它到底在界定什么量（更新范数、还是 surrogate objective 的变化），以及方差是对 V(s_t) 还是对 A_t 的统计。
- 再看算法伪代码/实现细节（如果有）：方差如何估计、如何进入 advantage、对不同 reward 类型的分支规则是什么。
- 最后看 curriculum 部分：难度度量、权重函数、以及训练过程中难度分布如何随时间演化。
- 如果实验部分完整，优先找：消融（只开方差/只开课程）、训练曲线（loss/return/clip fraction/KL）、以及对 shard/题目分布变化的鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Value-based RL for LLM reasoning (PPO/VAPO-style) faces (1) weak trajectory-level credit assignment when sampled trajectories for a prompt are homogeneous (all correct or all incorrect), yielding low-discriminability advantages; and (2) difficulty drift, where prompts become easier as the model improves, making fixed sampling/weighting inefficient and potentially capping performance. The paper proposes to use value-variance as a signal to adapt advantages and to apply a dynamic curriculum to track evolving difficulty.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface: it targets the quality and stability of RL training signals rather than changing the base model. The key idea is to treat uncertainty/variability in the value function along a trajectory as an actionable control knob for exploration and update magnitude, instead of relying solely on reward shaping or sampling temperature. The practical impact depends on whether the variance signal is robust across reward designs and base models; the provided content does not include enough experimental detail to confirm reproducibility and effect size.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CVPO has two components.
(1) Trajectory level: Value-Variance Adaptation. A value model estimates token-level V(s_t) along each generated trajectory. The variance of these values (or a closely related advantage-variance proxy) is used as an intrinsic randomness / exploration indicator: high variance implies more exploratory, low variance implies rigid generation. The paper sketches a bound showing the policy-gradient norm can be upper-bounded by a term involving advantage variance under a bounded ∥∇ log π∥ assumption, motivating variance-aware control of update magnitude. Based on this, CVPO modifies advantage computation by scaling/reweighting trajectories according to their value-variance, with different handling for different reward types (e.g., sparse correctness vs denser rewards), aiming to extract more informative gradients from otherwise homogeneous outcomes.
(2) Prompt level: Dynamic Curriculum Learning. It maintains a moving estimate of prompt difficulty and dynamically reweights/samples prompts to counter difficulty drift, allocating more training budget to prompts that remain challenging at the current stage.
Compared to GRPO, CVPO is explicitly value-based and goes beyond group reward averaging by injecting a variance signal into advantage shaping. Compared to VAPO, it adds an uncertainty-aware (variance-aware) advantage adjustment plus an explicit curriculum mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied full-text excerpt does not include concrete experimental numbers (model sizes, data/task sets, training budgets, baselines, gains, or ablations). The authors claim consistent improvements on multiple math reasoning benchmarks and ablations validating both variance adaptation and curriculum weighting. When checking the full paper, the critical points are: fairness of comparisons (sampling budget, group size, KL constraints), how value-variance is computed/normalized/clipped, whether curriculum induces distribution shift or forgetting, and whether they quantify the claimed benefit in homogeneous-trajectory regimes (advantage separability, effective sample ratio, update norms/clip fractions).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the derivation connecting value/advantage variance to an update bound; verify what is actually bounded and what assumptions are required.
- Locate the exact algorithmic definition: variance estimator, how it modifies advantages, and the branching logic for different reward types.
- Review the curriculum section: difficulty metric, weighting function, and how difficulty distribution evolves during training.
- If available, prioritize ablations (variance-only vs curriculum-only), training dynamics plots (return/KL/clip fraction), and robustness checks.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“value variance 能否作为更新强度代理”这个判断；先读理论段和课程权重消融，若 setup 不够干净，就把它当 GRPO/PPO 的局部修补而不是新范式。
recommendation.en: Read it for the claim that value variance can proxy update aggressiveness; check the theory section and curriculum ablations first, and treat it as a local PPO/GRPO patch unless the setup is unusually clean.

paper.title: Don't Peek at the Answer: Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization for Label-Free RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves LLM reasoning but typically relies on ground-truth (GT) answers, limiting scalability. Voting-based label-free RLVR replace gold supervision with answer-level consensus from model samples. However, collapse arises when the same answer-level signal is used both to estimate rewards and to drive token-level policy optimization, encouraging the model to directly reinforce answer tokens rather than improve reasoning. We propose OM-GRPO, a

summary.core_problem: 现有基于多数投票的无标注RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）方法存在答案token捷径学习问题——模型直接强化高频答案token而非提升推理能力，导致奖励黑客和训练崩溃，同时传统RLVR依赖真值答案标注，成本高昂难以扩展。
summary.importance: 答案跨度梯度掩码的设计思路可迁移至所有基于结果奖励的RL对齐场景，从机制上避免模型走答案捷径；软共识加对比增强的无标注奖励构造方案，降低了RLVR对人工标注的依赖，为大规模推理增强训练提供了低成本路径；通过跟踪答案多样性诊断训练崩溃的方法，可直接用于RL后训练的动态监控体系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OM-GRPO框架，核心包含两个设计：一是答案跨度梯度掩码，在GRPO的梯度更新阶段，对答案区间的token设置零梯度掩码，仅保留思维链推理轨迹部分的梯度，同时保留基于组内答案频率计算的软共识奖励（而非硬多数投票奖励），将优化压力从答案token转移至推理过程本身；二是对比增强奖励（CAR），对同组内的推理轨迹进行两两对比，让模型输出更优轨迹对应的答案，以极低计算成本扩充答案池，提升软奖励的估计可靠性，不需要重新采样完整的长推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 在多个推理基准、三个不同的LLM骨干上测试，OM-GRPO稳定优于此前的无标注RLVR基线，性能与使用真值奖励的训练效果持平；在测试时训练（TTT）场景下，相比多数投票基线提升4.24分，且全程无训练崩溃；诊断实验显示，传统投票法训练过程中答案多样性快速下降，伴随性能暴跌，而OM-GRPO训练期间答案多样性保持稳定，无明显性能退化。
summary.reading_guide: 先查看Introduction部分的失败模式诊断（性能崩溃与答案多样性下降的关联实验），再阅读Method章节的答案掩码实现细节与对比增强奖励的构造逻辑，最后扫读跨骨干、跨场景的泛化实验结果，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing majority-voting-based label-free RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) methods suffer from answer-token shortcut learning: models directly reinforce high-frequency answer tokens instead of improving reasoning capability, leading to reward hacking and training collapse. Meanwhile, traditional RLVR relies on ground-truth answer annotations, which are prohibitively costly for large-scale deployment.
summary_en.importance: The answer-span gradient masking design can be transferred to all outcome-reward-based RL alignment scenarios to mechanically prevent answer shortcut learning. The soft consensus plus contrastive augmentation scheme for label-free reward construction reduces RLVR's reliance on human annotations, providing a low-cost path for large-scale reasoning-enhanced training. The diagnostic method of tracking answer diversity to detect training collapse can be directly integrated into dynamic monitoring systems for RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The OM-GRPO (Outcome-Masked Group Relative Policy Optimization) framework has two core designs. First, answer-span gradient masking: during GRPO gradient updates, tokens in the answer span are masked with zero gradient, while only gradients from the chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning trajectory are retained. A soft consensus reward computed from answer frequency within the group (instead of hard majority voting) is preserved to shift optimization pressure from answer tokens to the reasoning process itself. Second, Contrast-Augmented Reward (CAR): pairwise comparisons are conducted on reasoning trajectories within the same group, prompting the model to output the answer corresponding to the better trajectory, which expands the answer pool at minimal computational cost and improves the reliability of soft reward estimation without resampling full long reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple reasoning benchmarks and three distinct LLM backbones, OM-GRPO consistently outperforms prior label-free RLVR baselines and matches the performance of training with ground-truth rewards. In the Test-Time Training (TTT) scenario, it outperforms the majority voting baseline by 4.24 points without any training collapse. Diagnostic experiments show traditional voting methods suffer from rapid decline in answer diversity accompanied by sharp performance drops during training, while OM-GRPO maintains stable answer diversity with no significant performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: First review the failure mode diagnosis experiments (correlation between performance collapse and answer diversity decline) in the Introduction, then study the implementation details of answer masking and the construction logic of Contrast-Augmented Reward in the Method section, and finally skim the cross-backbone and cross-scenario generalization results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 准确命中无标签GRPO训练里“抄答案”的常见坑，梯度mask的fix简单实用，读方法部分即可，应在内部RL实验中验证。
recommendation.en: Directly addresses the common answer-cheating failure mode in label-free GRPO; the gradient masking fix is simple and practical, worth verifying in internal RL ablations.

paper.title: Is More Privileged Information Better? From Solution Traces to Problem-Solving Structure in Self-Distilled Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by using a privileged view of a model conditioned on reference solutions to supervise a student view that observes only the question. However, the teacher-provided token-level targets may depend on reference-specific information unavailable at inference time. We propose Problem-Space-Guided OPSD (PS-OPSD), which replaces the complete solution with trajectory-grounded guidance describing the initial state, goal conditions, constraints, and a s

summary.core_problem: On-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）中，特权教师侧以完整参考答案为条件生成 token 级监督信号，但完整答案绑定了特定的最终答案、推理顺序、措辞和实例化计算细节，导致教师输出可能依赖学生在推理时（仅看到问题）无法恢复的信息，产生训练-部署的信息不对称，降低知识迁移的有效性。
summary.importance: 将 OPSD 中"教师该看什么"这一特权信息设计问题明确表述为迁移问题，并从经典问题空间理论出发，用结构化的问题求解结构替代完整答案轨迹作为教师上下文，为自蒸馏中的特权信息表示提供了新的设计维度。对推理模型的后训练（尤其是依赖自蒸馏提升推理能力的路线）有方法层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Problem-Space-Guided OPSD（PS-OPSD）。先用一个离线提取器将每条验证过的参考答案转换为 Problem-Space Guidance，记录初始状态、目标条件、约束，以及一条选定的状态转换路径；每个转换包含操作符、前置条件、诱导变换和结果状态。在 OPSD 训练循环中，仅修改特权教师的上下文输入（从完整答案替换为结构化引导），学生侧仍生成仅看问题的 on-policy 轨迹，token 级蒸馏损失保持不变。推理时学生仅从问题出发，不访问参考答案、引导信息、特权教师或提取器。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3 三个规模（1.7B、4B、8B）上评估，覆盖三个竞赛级数学推理 benchmark。在所有三个规模上，PS-OPSD 均取得了对比方法中最高的 aggregate question-only 准确率。通过受控表示变体实验，进一步分析了引导相关性、显式字段结构和状态转换一致性各自的作用；还通过教师输入暴露度分析和下游行为诊断，考察特权信息的表示方式如何影响自蒸馏效果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节 Problem-Space Guidance 的具体序列化格式和 PS-OPSD 与标准 OPSD 的接口差异——学生侧和损失函数完全不变，只改教师上下文，这一设计很关键。第 4 节的表示变体消融实验（去掉某些字段、用非结构化文本替代等）是理解为什么结构化引导有效的核心。预计阅读时间 30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), the privileged teacher is conditioned on the complete reference solution to produce token-level supervision. However, a complete solution ties reusable mathematical relations to a specific final answer, reasoning order, wording, and instance-specific arithmetic details. As a result, the teacher's token-level targets may depend on information the student cannot recover from question-only input at inference time, creating a training-deployment information asymmetry that reduces transfer effectiveness.
summary_en.importance: The paper explicitly frames the design of privileged information ("what should the teacher see?") in OPSD as a transfer problem. Drawing on classical problem-space theory, it replaces the full solution trace with structured problem-solving structure as the teacher context, introducing a new design dimension for privileged information in self-distillation. It is methodologically relevant for post-training of reasoning models, especially lines that rely on self-distillation to improve reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: PS-OPSD (Problem-Space-Guided OPSD) first uses an offline extractor to transform each verified reference solution into Problem-Space Guidance, which records the Initial State, Goal Conditions, Constraints, and a Selected State-Transition Path. Each transition specifies an Operator, its Preconditions, the induced Transformation, and the Resulting State. Within the OPSD training loop, only the privileged teacher's context is modified—from the complete solution to the structured guidance—while the student continues to generate question-only on-policy trajectories and the token-level distillation objective remains unchanged. At inference, the student reasons from the question alone, with no access to the reference solution, guidance, privileged teacher, or extractor.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3 at three scales (1.7B, 4B, 8B) across three competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Across all three scales, PS-OPSD achieves the highest aggregate question-only accuracy among compared methods. Controlled representation variant experiments further dissect the roles of guidance relevance, explicit field structure, and state-transition coherence. Teacher-input exposure analysis and downstream behavioral diagnostics are also used to examine how the representation of privileged information affects self-distillation outcomes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the concrete serialization format of Problem-Space Guidance and the interface difference between PS-OPSD and standard OPSD—the fact that the student side and loss function are completely unchanged, with only the teacher context modified, is a key design choice. Section 4's representation variant ablations (removing fields, replacing with unstructured text, etc.) are central to understanding why structured guidance works. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 自蒸馏中完整解反而不如结构化问题空间引导有效，做推理增强后训练的可重点看§3方法设计和§4控制实验。
recommendation.en: Full solution traces underperform structured problem-space guidance in self-distillation; check §3 method design and §4 controlled experiments for reasoning post-training.

paper.title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Existing methods generally aim to reduce the failure probabilities induced across problems. In this paper, we introduce a moment-based perspective on policy optimization for LLM reasoning by treating the failure probability of a randomly sampled problem as a random variable and characterizing optimization objectives through its moments. Under this perspective, many existing met

summary.core_problem: 现有面向LLM推理的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法，大多围绕策略在问题集上的失败概率分布的单一矩设计目标——REINFORCE/GRPO/DAPO等方法优化一阶矩（平均失败率），pass@K类训练优化单个高阶矩，均未刻画失败概率分布的完整结构，难以兼顾平均性能与困难问题上的尾部表现，不同方法的目标也缺乏统一的分析框架。
summary.importance: 该工作从矩的视角为RLVR优化目标提供了统一的分析框架，将此前的REINFORCE、pass@K训练、MaxRL等方法纳入同一形式体系；提出的多矩联合优化目标在数学推理任务上相较现有基线取得稳定收益，为设计兼顾平均性能与困难样本表现的RL训练目标提供了可参考的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 将策略在单个问题上的失败概率视为随问题采样的随机变量F_θ，RL训练的实质是调整该随机变量的分布。根据Hausdorff矩定理，支撑在[0,1]区间上的分布由其完整矩序列唯一确定，仅优化单一矩只能捕捉分布的局部信息。基于这一观察，提出多矩策略优化（MMPO）框架，联合最小化失败概率分布的多阶矩；该目标有明确的操作语义：最小化采样到第一个正确回答所需的期望截断轮次，天然平衡整体平均性能与对高失败率困难问题的关注。工作进一步提出广义矩变换框架，将MaxRL等方法解释为在变换后的失败分布上优化矩，而非直接优化原始分布；并证明该类目标满足严格Schur凸性，即优化过程会显式偏好不同问题间更均衡的成功率。训练采用与现有on-policy RLVR流程兼容的代理损失，无需大幅修改现有采样与训练流水线。
summary.experiments: 在五个数学推理基准、多尺度模型上的实验显示，MMPO相较GRPO、DAPO、pass@K训练、MaxRL等强基线均有稳定性能提升。消融实验表明，联合优化多阶矩的效果优于任意单阶矩目标，且在合理的阶数选择范围内性能稳定。理论分析验证了目标的Schur凸性，解释了多矩优化降低困难问题尾部失败率的机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3节的矩视角建模、现有RLVR方法与不同矩选择的对应关系，以及“首次成功期望时间”的目标直观含义。普通读者可跳过完整形式化证明部分；从事RLVR目标设计的研究者可进一步阅读广义矩变换章节，思考矩权重与难度感知数据策略的结合方式。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods for LLM reasoning design objectives around a single moment of the policy's per-problem failure probability distribution: REINFORCE/GRPO/DAPO target the first moment (average failure rate), while pass@K-style training targets a single higher-order moment. These approaches do not characterize the full structure of the failure distribution, fail to balance average performance and tail performance on hard problems, and lack a unified analytical framework across disparate objective designs.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a moment-based perspective that unifies existing RLVR objectives, spanning REINFORCE, pass@K training, and MaxRL under a single formalism. The proposed multi-moment joint optimization objective delivers consistent gains over established baselines on mathematical reasoning tasks, and provides a concrete reference for designing RL training objectives that balance average performance and hard-sample tail performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework treats per-problem failure probability of the policy as a random variable over sampled problem instances. By the Hausdorff moment theorem, a distribution supported on [0,1] is uniquely determined by its full sequence of moments, so single-moment objectives capture only partial information about policy behavior. Multi-Moment Policy Optimization (MMPO) jointly minimizes multiple moments of the failure distribution, an objective that maps operationally to minimizing the expected truncated number of rollouts needed to obtain a first correct response, naturally balancing average performance and attention to high-failure hard problems. A generalized moment transformation framework further unifies a broader family of policy optimization objectives—including MaxRL, which is interpreted as optimizing moments of a transformed rather than raw failure distribution—and proves that this family of objectives is strictly Schur-convex, meaning optimization explicitly pushes for more balanced success rates across problems. The practical training surrogate is compatible with existing on-policy RLVR pipelines without major modifications.
summary_en.experiments: Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, MMPO delivers consistent improvements over strong baselines including GRPO, DAPO, pass@K training, and MaxRL. Ablations confirm that joint multi-moment optimization outperforms any single-moment objective, with stable performance across a reasonable range of moment order selections. Theoretical analysis verifies the Schur-convexity property, linking the objective directly to reduced tail failure rates on hard problems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a skim-level paper. Focus on Section 3 for the moment-based formulation, the mapping of existing RLVR methods to specific moment choices, and the operational intuition of the expected-time-to-first-success objective. Full formal proofs can be skipped for most readers; those working on RLVR objective design may read the generalized moment transformation section for ideas on combining moment weighting with difficulty-aware data curation. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多矩损失直接对应首次成功时间，对RL训练中平衡平均性能与尾部鲁棒性的目标设计有参考，重点看§3目标推导与等价性证明。
recommendation.en: The multi-moment loss directly maps to first-success time, useful for balancing average performance and tail robustness in RL training; focus on §3 objective derivation and equivalence proof.

paper.title: Beyond On-Policy Exploration: Integrating External Policy Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning methods for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) commonly rely on on-policy rollouts generated by the target dLLM itself. When successful on-policy rollouts are scarce, however, on-policy training may receive little positive reward and make only limited progress. To mitigate this problem, we explore incorporating higher-reward rollouts generated by a stronger external policy alongside on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM. However, directly incorporating these

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 diffusion language model 做 RLVR 时的探索瓶颈：目标 dLLM 依赖 on-policy rollout，但在数学、约束求解等任务上早期很难采到正奖励样本，导致 group-based policy optimization 几乎没有可学习信号。单纯改进 dLLM 的 likelihood estimator 或 surrogate objective，不能解决正奖励 rollout 稀缺的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇对新型语言建模范式的后训练接口有参考价值。dLLM 的 RL 目前主要难点不只是序列 likelihood 不可精确计算，还包括非自回归生成策略下的探索质量。引入强外部策略 rollout 类似用 teacher policy 提供高奖励轨迹，但作者指出不能直接混用：长度分布和 reward normalization 都会影响训练稳定性。这个结论对 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的 RL 训练都有迁移意义。
summary.technical_approach: ERILS 将目标 dLLM 的 on-policy rollout 与强外部策略生成的 external rollout 放入同一训练流程，外部策略在实验中由更强的 autoregressive LM 承担。核心有两个处理。第一是 Rollout Length Control：外部模型往往生成更长答案，而 dLLM RL 的生成长度通常固定或受限；如果直接使用长答案，虽然 verifier reward 高，但训练收益有限。长度控制把外部 completion 调到接近目标 dLLM 的生成长度，同时尽量保留可验证质量。第二是 Source-Specific Reward Processing：on-policy 和 external rollout 的 reward 分布不同，如果放在同一组里用一个均值做相对优势，会导致优化不稳定甚至 collapse；因此分别处理两个来源的 reward，再合并用于更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Sudoku、Countdown 和 MATH500，采用 zero-shot evaluation，并报告 stochastic multi-sample 指标。Sudoku 上，ERILS 的所有 best-of-k completion accuracy 都超过 90%，而复现的最强 on-policy baseline 在 best-of-4 只有 40.3%。Countdown 上，ERILS 的 Pass@4 为 87.5%，SPG 为 76.6%。MATH500 也有提升，但给定内容未提供完整数值。消融信息显示，直接加入外部 rollout 收益有限；不做长度控制会浪费外部样本质量；把两类 rollout 放在一起做统一 reward processing 会造成训练不稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Fig. 1，那里把三个现象讲得最清楚：on-policy 正奖励稀缺、外部 rollout 长度不匹配、联合 reward processing 导致 collapse。方法部分重点看 Rollout Length Control 的具体实现，以及 Source-Specific Reward Processing 如何计算 advantage 或 reward-normalized signal。实验部分优先看 Sudoku 和 Countdown 的消融，因为这两个任务最能暴露探索和稳定性问题。MATH500 结果可作为泛化参考，但不要只看最终准确率，应看外部策略质量、长度分布和训练曲线是否匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an exploration bottleneck in RLVR for diffusion language models. Existing dLLM RL methods usually rely on on-policy rollouts from the target model. When the model rarely solves the task, the verifier returns few positive rewards, and group-based policy optimization receives little useful signal. Better diffusion likelihood estimators alone do not fix this shortage of successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the post-training interface of non-autoregressive language models. For dLLMs, RL is hard not only because exact sequence likelihood is intractable under denoising, but also because the model may not explore successful solutions early in training. Using a stronger external policy as a source of high-reward trajectories is a natural idea, but the paper shows that naive mixing is fragile. Length mismatch and reward processing are training signals, not implementation details. The same issue is likely to appear in masked, any-order, and other non-AR language-modeling regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ERILS mixes on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM with external rollouts generated by a stronger fixed policy, instantiated as an autoregressive LLM. It adds two mechanisms. Rollout Length Control adjusts external completions so that their lengths are closer to the generation length used by the target dLLM, while trying to preserve verifier-assessed correctness. This matters because external answers are often much longer; directly training on them gives less benefit than their reward would suggest. Source-Specific Reward Processing avoids normalizing on-policy and external rewards with a single group mean. Since the two sources have different reward distributions, joint processing can create unstable advantages and lead to collapse. ERILS processes the sources separately before using them in the policy update.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers Sudoku, Countdown, and MATH500 under zero-shot settings with stochastic multi-sample metrics. On Sudoku, all ERILS best-of-k completion accuracies exceed 90%, while the strongest reproduced on-policy baseline reaches only 40.3% at best-of-4. On Countdown, ERILS reaches 87.5% Pass@4, compared with 76.6% for SPG. The supplied text also reports gains on MATH500, but does not include the full number. The ablations are the important part: uncontrolled external rollouts give limited gains despite high verifier rewards, length control improves their usefulness, and joint reward processing across sources destabilizes optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Read the introduction and Fig. 1 first; they isolate the three core phenomena: sparse on-policy successes, length mismatch of external rollouts, and collapse from joint reward processing. In the method section, focus on the exact form of Rollout Length Control and how Source-Specific Reward Processing computes the training signal. In the experiments, prioritize the Sudoku and Countdown ablations because they most clearly expose exploration and stability effects. Treat MATH500 as a transfer check, and look beyond final accuracy to rollout length distributions, external-policy quality, and training curves.

recommendation.zh: 读外部rollout混合和reward分流设计即可；结论依赖外部策略强度，适合作为dLLM RL接口的消融种子。
recommendation.en: Read the rollout-mixing and reward-splitting design; the claim depends on external-policy strength but is a good ablation seed for dLLM RL.

paper.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models generate computationally expensive yet semantically void reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, creating risks where plausible-sounding but incorrect derivations mislead users. We characterize this \textit{futile reasoning} phenomenon through systematic analysis, revealing universal capability overreach and systematic miscalibration between capability and behavior. The dominant failure mode is specious reasoning, which outputs look superficially valid but contain subtle erro

summary.core_problem: 解决模型在超出能力边界的问题上继续生成高成本、看似合理但错误的推理过程的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 futile reasoning 的诊断和一种能力边界对齐的 RL 训练方法。它把推理能力提升和拒答校准放在同一框架里，对 RLVR、推理预算分配和安全后训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CaRL，即 Capability-aligned Reinforcement Learning。方法通过 reward shaping 鼓励模型在无法可靠求解时拒答，并用 hindsight refusal augmentation 把失败样本转化为拒答监督，从而训练模型识别自身能力边界。
summary.experiments: 摘要称实验显示 CaRL 显著减少 futile reasoning，同时在不同难度任务上保持性能。摘要未披露模型规模、任务集合、baseline 细节和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences work; the author list also includes researchers from Chinese NLP institutions, but the provided metadata only confirms UCAS.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the tendency of LLMs to keep producing costly, plausible-looking but wrong reasoning on tasks beyond their capability.
summary_en.importance: It contributes both a diagnosis of futile reasoning and an RL method for aligning behavior with capability boundaries. This is relevant to RLVR, inference budget control, and refusal calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed CaRL method uses capability-aligned reward shaping to prefer refusal over invalid reasoning when the model is likely to fail. It also uses hindsight refusal augmentation, converting failed attempts into refusal supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a substantial reduction in futile reasoning while preserving performance across task difficulties. It does not provide model sizes, full baselines, task details, or numeric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; the provided metadata does not confirm additional institutional details.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和错误分解即可；它把“多想一点”改成“知道何时停”，这个 prior 值得在 RLVR 里验证。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure taxonomy; the useful prior is replacing “reason more” with “know when to stop” in RLVR.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: On the Generalization of Steering Vectors for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
paper.abstract: Model capabilities have improved in large part due to scaling chain of thought. This has been a promising development for AI safety--where models verbalize their reasoning, it is possible to monitor it. However, in some cases, models do not verbalize important steps in their reasoning process. For example, models prompted with a cue suggesting the incorrect answer may fail to acknowledge that cue, even when it appears instrumental to their conclusion. When chain of thought (CoT) fails to disclos

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 CoT faithfulness 的 activation steering 是否能泛化：一个为某类提示线索、某个数据集或某种构造方法得到的 steering vector，能否在其他线索、数据集和模型上继续提升模型对真实影响因素的披露。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析和可监控推理。CoT 监控只有在模型愿意写出影响答案的因素时才有意义；如果模型受错误提示线索影响，却在推理文本中不承认，监控会失效。该工作把 faithfulness steering 从单一设置扩展到模型、数据集、线索类型和向量构造方法的泛化测试。结论比较克制：steering 的有效性并不稳定，主要在更大的 Gemma-3 12B 上可靠出现；但一旦有效，向量在不同 cue 和 dataset 之间的迁移性较强。这说明相关表征可能不是狭窄的 cue 模板特征，而更接近“承认外部线索影响”的通用方向。
summary.technical_approach: 实验使用 residual stream activation steering。作者比较四类向量构造方式：第一是 labeled on-policy contrastive vector，用模型在带 cue prompt 上生成的轨迹，经 judge 标注为承认 cue 或不承认 cue 后，对两类平均激活做差；第二是 synthetic vector，用模板化的 cue-acknowledging 和 cue-ignoring completion 代替真实 rollout，因此不需要模型采样和 judge 标签；第三是 cue-specific optimized vector，通过梯度优化一个方向，使被 steering 的模型提高特定 cue 承认文本的似然；第四是 cue-agnostic optimized direction，优化目标不点名具体 cue，测试是否存在更通用的 faithfulness 方向。评估时区分 efficacy generalization 和 transfer generalization：前者看某个 setting 下 steering 是否有效，后者看在一个 setting 构造的 vector 能否迁移到另一个 setting。
summary.experiments: 模型包括 Gemma-3 4B、Qwen-3.5 9B 和 Gemma-3 12B。数据集包括 BBH、GPQA 和 MMLU。提示线索来自 Meek et al. 的四类错误 cue：Stanford professor 式 sycophancy、XML metadata、grader-hacking hint、unethical insider tip，均指向错误选项。GPQA 上改变 cue 类型；固定 Stanford cue 时改变数据集。每个 scenario 保留非退化样本，不要求模型一定受 cue 影响，也不要求无 cue 时答案不同；训练和测试约 67/33 划分，每个 scenario 测试集约 129–165 个样本。生成使用 greedy decoding，并在同一模型内匹配 token limit 和 penalty。主要结果是：steering 稳定提升 cue acknowledgment 的范围较窄，主要出现在 Gemma-3 12B，且受数据集影响明显；但在 GPQA 上，一个 cue 训练出的向量与目标 cue 自身训练出的向量效果接近；固定 cue 时，一个数据集训练出的向量也能在其他数据集上产生相近变化。synthetic vector 和通用优化方向的效果接近 labeled contrastive vector。作者还检查了 cue use 与 hidden cue use，发现有效 steering 大致不改变模型使用 cue 的比例，而是降低未披露 cue use 的部分。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Setup and Methods 中四种 vector 构造方式，以及 efficacy generalization 和 transfer generalization 的定义。结果部分建议重点看按模型大小拆分的表格或图，因为小模型和 12B 模型的差异是结论的边界。还应看 cue use / hidden cue use 分析，这是判断 steering 是否真的提高 faithfulness，而不是简单诱导模型更多使用 cue 的关键。对基座研究员来说，值得关注的是 synthetic vector 不依赖 rollout 和 judge 标签却能接近 contrastive vector，这暗示某些推理披露方向可能可以用很轻的数据构造出来。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether activation steering for chain-of-thought faithfulness generalizes. If a steering vector is built for one cue type, dataset, or construction procedure, does it still make the model disclose influential prompt cues in other settings?
summary_en.importance: The main value is in mechanistic analysis and monitorable reasoning. CoT monitoring is only useful when the model verbalizes the factors that drive its answer. If a model follows a misleading cue but hides that influence in its reasoning, the monitor loses signal. This study moves faithfulness steering beyond a single experimental setting and tests variation across models, datasets, cue types, and vector construction methods. The result is nuanced: efficacy is narrow and reliable mainly for Gemma-3 12B, while transfer is broad once the effect exists. This suggests that the steered feature is not merely a memorized cue template, but may correspond to a more general tendency to acknowledge external cue influence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method applies residual-stream activation steering and compares four ways to construct the steering direction. The contrastive vector is the difference between mean activations from judge-labeled cue-acknowledging and cue-ignoring on-policy rollouts. The synthetic vector replaces rollouts with templated cue-acknowledging and cue-ignoring completions, avoiding both model sampling and judge labels. The cue-specific optimized vector is learned by gradient descent so that the steered model assigns higher likelihood to cue-acknowledging target completions. The cue-agnostic optimized direction uses a target that does not name a particular cue, testing whether a more generic faithfulness direction exists. The evaluation separates efficacy generalization, meaning whether steering works at all in a given setting, from transfer generalization, meaning whether a vector built in one setting remains useful in another.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3.5 9B, and Gemma-3 12B on BBH, GPQA, and MMLU. It uses four misleading cue types adapted from Meek et al.: a Stanford-professor sycophancy cue, XML metadata, a grader-hacking hint, and an unethical insider tip, each pointing to an incorrect option. Cue type is varied on GPQA, while dataset transfer is tested with the Stanford cue fixed. For each scenario, degenerate rollouts are filtered, but examples are not conditioned on whether the model follows the cue or whether the uncued answer differs. The split is roughly 67/33 train/test, with about 129–165 test items per scenario. Generation uses greedy decoding with matched limits and penalties within each model. The main findings are that reliable increases in cue acknowledgment appear mostly in Gemma-3 12B and vary by dataset; however, vectors trained on one cue perform similarly to vectors trained on the evaluated cue, and vectors trained on one dataset transfer comparably to target-dataset vectors when the cue is fixed. Synthetic and cue-agnostic optimized directions perform similarly to labeled contrastive vectors. Additional analysis shows that successful steering leaves the overall rate of cue use roughly unchanged while reducing hidden cue use.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the setup carefully, especially the four vector construction methods and the distinction between efficacy and transfer generalization. In the results, focus on model-wise breakdowns, since the contrast between smaller models and Gemma-3 12B defines the boundary of the claim. Also read the cue-use versus hidden-cue-use analysis; it is the key check that steering improves disclosure rather than simply making the model rely more on the cue. For foundation-model researchers, the most interesting detail is that synthetic vectors can approach labeled contrastive vectors without rollouts or judge labels.

recommendation.zh: 结论会削弱“一个 steering vector 到处管用”的乐观 prior；看跨 cue 泛化表和最大模型对比。
recommendation.en: This weakens the optimistic prior that one steering vector transfers broadly; read the cross-cue generalization table and the largest-model comparison.

paper.title: Reflection or Re-Generation? Why LLM Revision Fails Where Human Revision Succeeds
paper.abstract: Reflection, the ability to revisit and revise prior reasoning, is central to how humans improve their answers. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly prompted to "reflect," yet whether this resembles human revision remains unclear. We introduce the Human-LLM Reflection Framework (HRF), a controlled two-pass protocol comparing human and LLM revision under identical conditions across self-, peer-, and cross-agent settings. Using an information-theoretic analysis based on per-iteration cross

summary.core_problem: LLM反思（reflection）的内在机制不明确，无法区分模型是在进行真正的错误检测与修正，还是仅基于先前输出做条件重生成；现有研究缺乏与人类修订行为的受控对比，也没有对修订过程的定量刻画框架。
summary.importance: 明确了无外部信息条件下LLM自我反思的能力边界，为推理增强方法（如R1类推理优化）、对齐方法的设计提供了实证参考，避免对自我修正能力的过度高估。
summary.technical_approach: Human-LLM Reflection Framework（HRF）是一个受控两轮实验协议：第一轮仅基于任务输入生成初始回答，第二轮在仅可见第一轮输出和原始输入（无额外外部信息）的条件下进行修订。协议支持三种设置：自我修订、同类型同伴修订、跨主体修订（人类改LLM输出/LLM改人类输出）。采用信息论框架，通过每轮的交叉熵减少量（信息增益ΔI）定量刻画修订过程，区分信息积累与输出分布的随机重排。实验覆盖两类有限答案空间任务（4类数学推理MalAlgoQA、10类情感分类IMDb-Rating）和一类开放端时序推理任务（TISER），对比5个主流LLM与非专业人类标注者的行为。
summary.experiments: LLM反思存在两种失效模式，可被统一的信息论原理覆盖：无外部信息时，自我条件化无法降低目标变量的条件熵。具体表现为：在客观推理任务（有限答案空间）上，自我修订的信息增益接近零（ΔI≈0），等价于中性重生成，未积累任务相关信息；在主观任务上信息增益为负（ΔI<0）。人类在相同条件下修订的信息增益为正。跨主体修订矩阵显示，失效出在修订步骤本身，而非输入质量。错误检测和错误修正两个子步骤的主导瓶颈随任务和模型不同而变化，不存在单一失效机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注第1章的问题提出与核心结论，第2章的HRF协议设计、信息论分析框架，以及核心实验中的信息增益对比、跨主体修订矩阵结果。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The internal mechanism of LLM reflection remains unclear: it is unknown whether models perform genuine error detection and correction, or merely re-generate responses conditioned on their prior output. Prior work lacked controlled comparisons with human revision behavior and a quantitative framework for characterizing the revision process.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the bounds of LLM self-reflection capability without external information, providing empirical reference for the design of reasoning enhancement methods (e.g., R1-style inference optimization) and alignment methods, and preventing overestimation of self-correction ability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Human–LLM Reflection Framework (HRF) is a controlled two-pass protocol: in Pass 1, agents produce initial responses from the task input alone; in Pass 2, agents revise their response with access only to the first-pass output and original input, with no additional external information. The framework supports three settings: self-revision, peer-revision (same agent type), and cross-agent revision (humans revise LLM outputs and vice versa). An information-theoretic framework uses per-iteration cross-entropy reduction (information gain ΔI) to quantitatively characterize the revision process, distinguishing information accumulation from random reshuffling of the output distribution. Experiments cover two finite-answer-space tasks (4-class math reasoning MalAlgoQA, 10-class sentiment IMDb-Rating) and one open-ended temporal reasoning task (TISER), comparing behavior across 5 mainstream LLMs and non-expert human annotators.
summary_en.experiments: LLM reflection exhibits two failure modes, unified by an information-theoretic principle: without external information, self-conditioning cannot reduce the conditional entropy of the target variable. Specifically: on objective reasoning tasks with finite answer spaces, self-revision yields near-zero information gain (ΔI≈0), equivalent to neutral re-generation with no accumulation of task-relevant information; on subjective tasks, information gain is negative (ΔI<0). Human revision under identical conditions yields positive information gain. Cross-agent revision matrices localize the failure to the revision step itself, not the quality of the input being revised. The dominant bottleneck (error detection vs. error correction) varies across tasks and models, with no single universal failure mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on Section 1 (problem framing and core findings), Section 2 (HRF protocol design, information-theoretic analysis framework), and core experimental results including information gain comparisons and cross-agent revision matrices. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 信息论量化反思增益的实验设计干净，明确LLM反思本质是重采样甚至负增益，做推理相关实验时需注意规避此坑。
recommendation.en: The information-theoretic quantification of reflection gain is cleanly designed; it confirms LLM reflection is essentially re-sampling or even negative gain, a pitfall to avoid in reasoning-related experiments.

paper.title: Where and When to Commit: Candidate-Aware Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, creating an opportunity for generation-time early exit that stops decoding before the schedule is exhausted. Existing early-exit gates decide termination from fixed-region confidence statistics or schedule-dependent rules, evidence too coarse for a decision that freezes every remaining position at once, so they fire prematurely on long chain-of-thought outputs whose answers stabilize only near the end. Adap

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 推理阶段的一个很具体、但此前被混在一起的问题："局部 token 何时可以提交"和"整条序列何时可以提前停止"其实需要不同证据。已有方法常把位置级置信度、固定监控区域稳定性、或解码进度，当作全局 early exit 的依据；在短答案任务上还能工作，但在长链式推理里，前面中间推理文本会先稳定，真正决定正确性的答案 span 往往到很后面才稳定，于是模型会过早 fill-and-stop，直接把尚未收敛的答案冻结。论文的核心问题不是单纯再做一个更激进的加速器，而是给 DLM 的 early exit 建立更合适的判据：停止决策必须验证“候选答案本身是否稳定”，而不是看某种粗粒度代理信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在训练 recipe，而在新型语言建模范式的推理机制。Diffusion LM 相比 AR 的一个潜在优势，是中间步已经有全序列 provisional prediction，因此存在训练外加速空间；但如果 early exit 的证据设计不对，这个优势会在长推理任务上变成明显精度损失。论文把“sampling axis”和“termination axis”明确拆开，给出了一个更像 DLM 原生推理协议的框架。这一点对后续 diffusion / masked / any-order LM 都有启发：非 AR 模型的中间状态不是天然可用，必须区分局部提交和全局收敛。量级上，这篇更像一篇推理机制校正工作，而不是改变范式上限的论文；但如果你关心 DLM 能否在真实长推理场景里站住脚，这类工作是必要拼图。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两个部件，合起来叫 LATCH。第一个是 CVC，Confidence-Verified Commit，负责“when to stop”。它不是在固定区域上看平均置信度，也不是按 schedule 进度阈值停，而是在每一步重新抽取并定位当前 candidate answer span，然后同时检查两件事：其一，这个 span 上的置信度是否足够高；其二，这个 span 的 argmax 身份是否在连续若干步内保持稳定。只有答案候选本身被持续验证，才允许做全局 fill-and-stop。这里的关键区别是，验证对象从代理统计量换成了 candidate identity，本质上是在做 answer-aware convergence check。

第二个是 BWEC，Block-Wise Early Commit，负责“where to commit”。作者认为非最终 block 多数承载的是中间推理文本，不值得用 CVC 那套较重的 identity tracking；因此 BWEC 采用更便宜的局部置信度规则，但只允许作用在 non-final blocks。最终 block 以及整个序列的终止，仍然由 CVC 保护。这个设计避免了 SlowFast / KLASS 这类 adaptive sampling 方法把便宜的局部证据直接扩展到答案区域，从而在答案尚未稳定时过早提交。

论文还有一个重要分析前提：candidate stabilization 的时间分布高度任务相关。作者用 s0.9 这类指标刻画“90% 轨迹完成稳定所需的解码进度”，发现不同任务从 0.04 到 0.96 都有。这说明任何只依赖 progress 的统一 early exit 规则都不稳。LATCH 的价值就在于把停止条件从 schedule 位置，改成 candidate-level verification。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 11 个任务、两类模型家族，文中明确提到以 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 作为参考解码骨干，并测试向 Dream 的迁移。结果上，LATCH 在不按任务或模型重新调阈值的情况下，短答案任务达到 9.3–17.8× 加速，长推理任务达到 2.0–3.3× 加速，同时在所有任务、两类模型上都控制在相对 full decoding 不超过 2.0 个 accuracy point 的误差带内。

更有信息量的是失败分析。作者指出 Prophet 和 SchED 这类 termination gate，在统一 free-form zero-shot 协议下，对五个长推理任务和两种模型，全部超过 2.0 point 容忍线，最差可差 69 个点。也就是说，问题不是个别 benchmark 上的小退化，而是 termination evidence 选错了层级。SlowFast 作为 sampling-only 方法，在所有长推理设置上也超过精度容忍线；KLASS 只有在其校准 backbone 上还能勉强守住，迁移到 Dream 时会掉 5–52 个点。作者借此说明：局部提交规则可以加速，但不能替代全局终止验证。

论文最值得注意的实验信号不是单个最好数字，而是“固定一组 CVC 阈值 + 固定 BWEC 阈值”即可跨任务、跨模型迁移，而先前方法做不到。这说明 candidate-aware stopping 至少比 schedule-aware stopping 更接近模型真实收敛行为。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一，看引言和 Section 3，弄清作者为什么坚持把 early exit 分成两个轴：sampling commit 和 sequence termination。这里是整篇最重要的 conceptual move。第二，看 Section 4.1 关于 candidate stabilization 的统计，尤其 s0.9 的任务差异；这是他们否定 progress-only 规则的证据基础。第三，看 CVC 和 BWEC 的定义与伪代码，重点理解“为什么 BWEC 只作用于 non-final blocks，为什么 final block 必须交给 CVC”。

实验部分建议优先看与 Prophet、SchED、SlowFast、KLASS 的对比表，以及 Dream 迁移结果。若时间有限，30–40 分钟足够把主要结论读清。若要深挖，可以继续看 candidate span 的抽取方式、连续稳定性窗口如何设定、以及 block 划分对不同任务长度分布的敏感性。这些细节决定方法是否真能泛化到更开放的 free-form generation，而不只是短答案抽取场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific inference-time failure mode in diffusion language models: token-level commitment and sequence-level termination are different decisions, but prior work often uses the same kind of evidence for both. Existing early-exit rules rely on fixed-region confidence, schedule progress, or coarse aggregate stability. That can work for short-answer tasks, but it breaks on long reasoning outputs where intermediate rationale tokens stabilize early while the actual answer span stabilizes only near the end. The result is premature fill-and-stop: the model freezes the remaining masked positions, including the answer, before true convergence. The core problem is therefore not just faster decoding, but defining the right evidence for stopping in DLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in inference mechanics for non-AR language modeling, not in pretraining recipe. Diffusion LMs expose provisional full-sequence predictions at every denoising step, which creates a genuine training-free acceleration opportunity. But this opportunity is only useful if the stopping criterion matches how convergence actually happens. The paper makes a clean distinction between the sampling axis and the termination axis, and that distinction is likely relevant beyond DLMs, including masked and any-order generation. The contribution is not a new modeling paradigm or a scaling result; it is a correction to how one should operationalize convergence in diffusion-style decoding, especially for long-form reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, LATCH, has two components. The first is CVC, Confidence-Verified Commit, which decides when the whole sequence may stop. Instead of monitoring a fixed region or using schedule-dependent heuristics, CVC re-extracts and relocates the current candidate answer span at every denoising step. It then requires both high confidence on that span and sustained argmax identity stability across multiple steps. Only when the candidate answer itself has remained stable does the decoder allow a global fill-and-stop. The key change is that the stopping rule verifies the object of interest, the answer candidate, rather than a proxy statistic.

The second component is BWEC, Block-Wise Early Commit, which decides where local commitments may happen during decoding. The authors argue that non-final blocks usually contain intermediate reasoning text, so they can be handled with a cheaper local confidence rule. BWEC therefore applies only to non-final blocks. The final block, and any global termination decision, remains under CVC. This separation is meant to preserve the speed benefits of adaptive sampling while preventing local confidence signals from prematurely freezing the answer region.

A central analytical premise is that candidate stabilization is highly task-dependent. The paper measures stabilization timing with metrics such as s0.9, the decoding progress by which 90% of trajectories have stabilized, and finds a very wide range across tasks. That observation motivates abandoning progress-only early exit in favor of candidate-aware verification.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 11 tasks and two model families, with LLaDA-8B-Instruct used as the reference decoding backbone and transfer tested to Dream. With one frozen CVC threshold tuple and one fixed BWEC threshold, without per-task or per-model retuning, LATCH achieves 9.3–17.8× speedup on short-answer tasks and 2.0–3.3× on long-reasoning tasks, while staying within a 2.0-point accuracy tolerance relative to full decoding on every task and both model families.

The failure analysis is more informative than the headline speedups. Under a matched free-form zero-shot protocol, Prophet and SchED exceed the 2-point tolerance on all five long-reasoning tasks and both models, with errors as large as 69 points. That strongly suggests the issue is not implementation detail but the level of evidence used for termination. SlowFast, which only adjusts commitment pace, also violates the tolerance on every long-reasoning setting. KLASS remains acceptable only on its calibration backbone and drops by 5–52 points on Dream. The paper uses these results to argue that local commitment heuristics cannot substitute for explicit sequence-level convergence verification.

One notable empirical claim is transferability: the same thresholds work across tasks and model families for LATCH, whereas prior methods do not. That is a meaningful sign that candidate-aware stopping is better aligned with actual convergence behavior than schedule-aware stopping.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the formalization section that separates sampling commits from sequence termination. That conceptual split is the backbone of the paper. Second, read the stabilization analysis, especially the statistics around s0.9, because that is the empirical basis for rejecting progress-only stopping rules. Third, read the definitions of CVC and BWEC carefully, with attention to why BWEC is restricted to non-final blocks and why the final block is protected by CVC.
