paper.title: Controlled Reformulation Testing for Logical Consistency in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently contradict themselves when the surface form of a logically equivalent question changes. We present a benchmark of 350 question families (1,750 total questions) for Controlled Reformulation Testing (CRTBench) to evaluate logical invariance. In this benchmark, we investigate LLMs' ability to maintain consistent answers across controlled reformulations, which include contrapositive rewriting, double negation, negation flipping, and passive voice. We evaluate

summary.core_problem: 高逻辑题准确率不能保证模型在等价改写下保持答案一致。CRTBench 用受控逻辑变换来定位这种不一致，而不是只看普通 paraphrase 后的表现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于评测信号更细。它把“推理能力”拆成了正确性和逻辑不变性两个维度，并能定位到反否命题、双重否定、量词改写等具体失败源。这个方向对构造推理数据、筛选 CoT、评估 RL 后模型是否学到稳定推理规则都有参考意义，但它主要是评测资产，不是训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是构造 350 个 question family，共 1,750 道题。每个 family 包含一个 base question 和四个受控改写。变换分三类：等价保持变换，如反否命题、双重否定、De Morgan、量词改写、被动语态；答案反转变换，即 negation flip；表面控制变换，即被动语态。核心指标有两个：base accuracy 只看原题是否答对；family consistency 要求同一 family 内所有版本都符合各自标签。这个指标比单题准确率更严格，能揭示模型是否只是在局部题面上答对，而没有保持逻辑等价关系。
summary.experiments: 数据覆盖 7 类推理：命题逻辑、三段论、De Morgan、量词推理、多跳推理、嵌套否定、条件谬误，每类 50 个 family。作者在温度为 0 的 zero-shot 设置下评估 GPT-5.4、GPT-5.4-mini、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Flash、o4-mini 等模型。主要现象是 accuracy-consistency gap。GPT-5.4-mini base accuracy 为 98.9%，family consistency 只有 60.3%，差距 38.6 个百分点；GPT-5.4 base accuracy 同为 98.9%，family consistency 为 86.6%；o4-mini 的 family consistency 达到 96.9%。变换层面看，GPT-5.4-mini 在被动语态上约 98.7%，但在反否命题上只有 72.4%，说明失败主要来自逻辑结构变换，而不是表面改写。开启 reasoning effort 对 GPT-5.4-mini 帮助明显，family consistency 从 60.3% 提到 85.4%，但对 GPT-5.4 的整体一致性提升不明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看 Benchmark Design 中 family consistency 的定义、各类 transformation 的标签规则，以及 Experiments 中按 transformation 和 category 拆分的表格。真正有用的是错误归因方式：它比整体逻辑 benchmark 更容易回答“模型到底在哪种逻辑操作上不稳”。人工标注部分也值得扫一眼，因为这类 benchmark 的可靠性主要受改写保真度和标签一致性影响。

summary_en.core_problem: High accuracy on logic questions does not imply that a model gives invariant answers under logically equivalent reformulations. CRTBench tests this invariance with controlled logical transformations rather than unconstrained paraphrases.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is diagnostic granularity. The benchmark separates answer correctness from logical invariance, and attributes failures to specific operations such as contraposition, double negation, and quantifier rewriting. This is relevant for reasoning-data construction, CoT filtering, and checking whether RL or SFT improves stable rule use, although the contribution is primarily an evaluation asset rather than a training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 350 question families and 1,750 total questions. Each family has one base question and four reformulations. Transformations include equivalence-preserving operations such as contraposition, double negation, De Morgan rewrites, quantifier rewrites, and passive voice; an answer-reversing operation, negation flip; and a surface-control operation, passive voice. The key metric is family consistency: a family counts as consistent only if the model answers the base question and all reformulations according to their labels. This is stricter than base accuracy and exposes contradictions that single-question accuracy hides.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset covers seven reasoning categories: propositional logic, syllogistic reasoning, De Morgan laws, quantifier reasoning, multi-hop inference, nested negation, and conditional fallacies, with 50 families each. Models are evaluated zero-shot at temperature 0, including GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4-mini, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and o4-mini. The main result is a large accuracy-consistency gap. GPT-5.4-mini reaches 98.9% base accuracy but only 60.3% family consistency, a 38.6-point gap. GPT-5.4 also has 98.9% base accuracy but 86.6% family consistency. o4-mini is strongest among the reported models with 96.9% family consistency. Transformation-level results show that GPT-5.4-mini handles passive voice at about 98.7% but drops to 72.4% on contraposition, indicating that the failures come from logical operations rather than surface wording. Higher reasoning effort raises GPT-5.4-mini consistency from 60.3% to 85.4%, while the larger GPT-5.4 does not improve overall.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the Benchmark Design section for the definition of family consistency, transformation labels, and answer-reversal rules. Then read the experiment tables broken down by transformation and category. The main reusable idea is the attribution protocol: it makes logical inconsistency more actionable than aggregate logic benchmarks. The manual validation procedure is also worth checking, because this type of benchmark depends heavily on transformation fidelity and label correctness.

recommendation.zh: benchmark 不大，但 setup 很干净；如果你关心 reasoning post-train 到底学到了什么，只看 family-level consistency 和 contrapositive 那组结果就够了。
recommendation.en: The benchmark is small but the setup is clean; if you care what reasoning post-training actually buys, just read the family-level consistency results and the contrapositive slice.

paper.title: Consensus as Privileged Context for Label-Free Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Sampling multiple solutions and returning the majority answer is among the most reliable ways to improve the reasoning accuracy of large language models without labels, and a growing family of methods converts this consensus signal into training supervision. However, existing approaches use consensus only in restricted forms: as a filter that selects solutions for fine-tuning, as a preference between answers, or as a scalar reward for reinforcement learning, discarding most of the information th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但重要的问题：在没有标注答案、没有外部 verifier、也不做长程 RL 的条件下，怎样把模型自己的“多数一致”信号，变成足够密、足够稳定的训练监督。已有无标签方法大多只把 consensus 当成筛子、偏好对，或一个标量奖励；信息利用很粗，而且 RL 方案通常需要反复采样与多轮优化。Canon 的切入点是把 consensus 提升为一种 privileged context：不是只告诉模型“哪个答案更可能对”，而是让一个冻结 teacher 在“已知共识解”的条件下，对学生当前 rollout 的每个 token 给出分布级监督，从而把无标签自提升从稀疏奖励改成 token-level distillation。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的意义主要有三层。第一，它说明无标签推理增强不一定要走 RL 这条高成本路径，dense distillation 也能吃到大部分收益，而且训练时间明显更短。第二，它把“self-consistency 只是 test-time aggregation 技巧”推进到“self-consistency 可以转成训练信号”，这对 unlabeled continual post-training、test-time adaptation、以及用模型自身生成信号做 mid-train/annealing 都有启发。第三，论文给出了一个很实用的适用性判断：当基础模型的 majority answer 往往正确但置信度不高时，Canon 最有效；当 majority 已经饱和，或多数答案稳定地错时，收益会消失甚至转负。这一点比单纯报平均分更有价值，因为它直接关系到什么时候该做自蒸馏，什么时候该停。
summary.technical_approach: 方法本身不复杂，但设计很讲究。对每个无标签 prompt，先从当前策略采样 N 条解答轨迹，抽取最终答案，取多数答案作为 consensus answer，再从达到该答案的 rollout 中选一条 consensus solution。接着复制一个冻结快照作为 teacher，并把 prompt 与这条 consensus solution 一起喂给 teacher，使 teacher 处在一种“知道共识推理路径”的 privileged 状态。学生则只基于原始 prompt，对自己某条采样轨迹上的 token 做预测。训练目标不是 hard target CE，而是 teacher 与 student 在这些 token 位置上的全词表 Jensen–Shannon divergence。这里有几个关键点。其一，teacher 只在条件信息上更强，参数不更新，因此训练稳定，避免了 on-policy RL 的高方差。其二，监督落在学生自己采样出的 token 上，而不是强行模仿 teacher 的整条链路，减少了 exposure mismatch，也保留了学生原有解题风格。其三，使用 JSD 而不是单向 KL，目的是让分布匹配更平滑，避免 teacher 过度尖锐时把错误共识放大。其四，整个流程一轮生成即可同时提供 consensus 和蒸馏载体，训练只做 1 epoch，计算开销明显低于需要反复 rollout 的 test-time RL。论文还设置了 oracle 版本：teacher 条件化在 gold-verified solution 上，用来衡量“共识作为伪 privileged context”距离真实 gold context 还有多远。这个对照很关键，因为它把方法上限刻画得比较清楚。
summary.experiments: 实验分成 transductive 和 inductive 两种。transductive 是直接在测试集 prompt 上做无标签训练，再在同一批 prompt 上评估；这是 test-time RL 常用设定。inductive 则在一组无标签 prompt 上训练，去看对不同、甚至更难 benchmark 的迁移。论文的主结论是：在作者比较的 label-free 方法里，Canon 的 accuracy-compute 比最好。文中给出的代表性结果是，transductive 场景下，在竞赛数学和研究生级科学问答上，pass@1 最多提升约 12 个点，而训练耗时大约 1 小时 GPU；对比的 RL 替代方法通常要 6–10 小时。与 oracle gold-conditioned teacher 相比，Canon 在 AMC 上只差约 0.5 个点，在 AIME 2024 上差约 3 个点，在 GPQA 上差约 8 个点，说明模型自身 consensus 已经能恢复 gold privileged context 的相当一部分价值。更重要的是，收益不是简单把概率质量重新压到模型原本就会的答案上。论文检查了“32 次采样里从未做对过的问题”，发现训练后模型能新解出一部分此前完全不会的问题；在未饱和 benchmark 上，多数投票本身也变得更准，说明底层策略确实被改善了。分析部分还给出 per-prompt 规律：当 base model 的 majority answer 正确但不够稳时，增益最大；当问题已接近饱和时，几乎无收益；当 majority 高置信但错误时，Canon 可能被错误共识带偏。这一条基本决定了方法的边界条件。摘要里没有完整列出参数量、N 的默认值、各 benchmark 全部数字和消融表，但从全文结构看，关键消融应包括 teacher 条件化方式、共识解选择、训练 epoch、与 SFT/RL 基线的 compute 对比，以及 transductive/inductive 两种设定下的迁移表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看方法部分里 teacher/student 的条件差异和损失定义，重点理解为什么它是 privileged-context distillation，而不是普通 self-training。第二，看 transductive 与 inductive 两套实验，因为很多 test-time training 方法只在 transductive 设定里好看，Canon 的价值在于作者专门验证了迁移。第三，看适用性分析，尤其是按 majority correctness / confidence 分桶后的结果，这部分最能帮助判断方法能否迁到自己的任务。若时间有限，建议优先读引言、方法总图、主结果表、oracle 对照、以及 Section 5.2 关于 consensus 何时可靠的讨论，预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主线。若要深挖，值得继续看 JSD 设计、学生在自身 token 上蒸馏的理由，以及“新解出此前 32 次都没解出的题”这一分析是如何定义和统计的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: how can unlabeled agreement among a model’s own sampled solutions be converted into a dense and trainable supervision signal, without gold answers, external verifiers, or expensive RL loops? Prior label-free methods mostly use consensus in a lossy way: as a filter for SFT, as pairwise preference data, or as a scalar pseudo-reward. Canon treats consensus as privileged context instead. Rather than only saying which final answer is more plausible, it conditions a frozen teacher on a consensus-reaching solution and distills token-level distributions into the student over the student’s own rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the pretrain–posttrain interface. First, it shows that unlabeled reasoning improvement does not have to be mediated by RL; dense self-distillation can recover much of the gain at much lower optimization cost. Second, it upgrades self-consistency from an inference-time aggregation trick into a reusable training signal, which matters for unlabeled continual adaptation, test-time training, and possibly mid-training phases where labels are scarce but model-generated confidence structure is available. Third, the paper gives a useful operating condition: Canon helps most when the base model’s majority answer is often correct but not yet confident; it helps little on saturated prompts and can hurt when consensus is confidently wrong. That boundary condition is more informative than average benchmark gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each unlabeled prompt, the current policy samples N candidate solutions. Final answers are extracted, the majority answer is identified, and one rollout that reaches that answer is selected as the consensus solution. A frozen snapshot of the model serves as teacher and is conditioned on the prompt plus this consensus solution, giving it privileged information unavailable to the student. The student only sees the original prompt and is trained on its own sampled tokens. The loss is a full-vocabulary Jensen–Shannon divergence between teacher and student next-token distributions on those student tokens. Several design choices matter. The teacher is stronger only through conditioning, not through parameter updates, which keeps optimization stable compared with on-policy RL. Distillation happens on the student’s own trajectory rather than forcing exact imitation of the teacher chain, reducing exposure mismatch. JSD is used instead of a one-sided KL to make matching less brittle when the teacher distribution is sharp or when consensus is imperfect. The whole pipeline reuses a single generation pass to obtain both consensus and the distillation substrate, and training runs for one epoch. The oracle variant, where the teacher is conditioned on gold-verified solutions, is especially informative because it quantifies how much of true privileged context can be recovered from self-consensus alone.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation has two regimes. In the transductive setting, training is done directly on the unlabeled prompts of the test benchmark and evaluation is on the same prompts, matching the common test-time RL setup. In the inductive setting, training uses one unlabeled prompt set and evaluation is on disjoint, often harder benchmarks. The headline result is that Canon is the strongest label-free method among those compared on the accuracy-versus-compute frontier. The paper reports up to about +12 pass@1 points on competition math and graduate-level science benchmarks in the transductive setting, with roughly one hour of GPU training, whereas RL-based label-free alternatives require around 6–10 hours. Relative to the oracle gold-conditioned teacher, Canon trails by only about 0.5 points on AMC, 3 points on AIME 2024, and 8 points on GPQA, suggesting that self-consensus captures a substantial fraction of the value of gold privileged context. The gains are not merely probability reallocation onto already-known answers: after training, the model solves some problems it had never solved in 32 attempts before training, and majority voting itself becomes more accurate on unsaturated benchmarks. The per-prompt analysis is one of the most useful parts: gains are largest when the base model’s majority answer is correct but uncertain, near zero when the task is already saturated, and negative when the majority is confidently wrong. The excerpt does not expose every model size, rollout count, or ablation table, but the full paper appears to include comparisons against self-consistency fine-tuning, test-time RL, gold-reward RL, rejection fine-tuning, and the oracle distillation variant across both transductive and inductive settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on three pieces. First, the method section defining the teacher–student asymmetry and the JSD loss; that is where the paper departs from ordinary self-training. Second, the transductive versus inductive experiments; many test-time adaptation methods look good only in the former, so transfer is the real stress test here. Third, read the applicability analysis that buckets prompts by consensus correctness and confidence, because that tells you when the method should or should not be deployed. If time is limited, read the introduction, the method figure, the main result tables, the oracle comparison, and the section discussing when consensus is reliable. That should take about 30 minutes. If reading more deeply, inspect why distillation is done on student tokens, why JSD was chosen, and how the paper defines and measures newly solved problems that were unsolved in 32 pre-training attempts.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和训练目标即可；它把 self-consistency 变成 dense teacher，值得放进内部 RLVR 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and objective; turning self-consistency into a dense teacher is worth testing in internal RLVR ablations.

paper.title: Post-Training Shifts Confidence: A Three-Stage Analysis of How SFT, RL, and OPD Shape Pre-, Intra-, and Post-CoT Calibration
paper.abstract: Large language models have made strong reasoning gains through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation, yet these post-training methods are usually evaluated only by final-answer accuracy. We study how they reshape confidence during reasoning. We introduce a three-stage calibration framework that evaluates confidence before, during, and after chain-of-thought generation, corresponding to difficulty estimation, early termination, and answer aggregation. Through

summary.core_problem: 分析 SFT、RL 和 on-policy distillation 如何改变数学推理模型在 CoT 前、中、后三个阶段的置信度校准。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练机制分析。它不只看 final-answer accuracy，而是把置信度拆成三类可用信号：推理前难度估计、推理中提前停止、推理后多轨迹聚合。这对 RLVR、reasoning model 训练监控和 test-time compute 分配有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三阶段校准框架：pre-CoT 衡量模型在生成推理前是否知道题目难度；intra-CoT 衡量推理过程中置信度能否支持 early termination；post-CoT 衡量完整推理轨迹的置信度能否用于 answer aggregation。通过受控比较 SFT、RL 和 OPD，分析不同后训练方法在不同位置的置信度可靠性。
summary.experiments: 实验在数学推理 benchmark 上进行受控比较。摘要给出的主要发现是：OPD 提供最有用的推理前置信度；SFT 提供最强的在线早停信号；RL 产生最可靠的轨迹级聚合信号。位置效应明显：RL 置信度在 path-commitment 阶段后才变得有信息，OPD 早期有用但后期可能反向校准。摘要未披露具体模型规模、数据量和提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo 和 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes how SFT, RL, and on-policy distillation reshape confidence calibration before, during, and after chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training behavior analysis. Instead of measuring only final-answer accuracy, it decomposes confidence into signals for difficulty estimation, early stopping, and answer aggregation. This is relevant to RLVR, reasoning-model monitoring, and test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a three-stage calibration framework: pre-CoT confidence for difficulty estimation, intra-CoT confidence for early termination, and post-CoT trace confidence for answer aggregation. They run controlled comparisons across SFT, RL, and OPD to study how confidence reliability changes by position within the reasoning process.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The reported findings are that OPD gives the most useful pre-reasoning confidence, SFT gives the strongest online early-stopping signal, and RL gives the most reliable trace-level signal for aggregation. RL confidence becomes informative after a path-commitment phase, while OPD confidence can become inversely calibrated later. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data sizes, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim；重点看三阶段校准定义和位置效应，别只拿 final accuracy 判断后训练质量。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming; focus on the three-stage calibration setup and position effects, not just final-answer accuracy.

paper.title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards without human-annotated data, often referred to as zero RL, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for eliciting chain-of-thought reasoning. However, due to computational constraints, existing studies are largely restricted to small models, leaving the training dynamics and emergent capabilities at a large scale unexplored. To meaningfully explore this frontier, we aim to elicit high-quality reasoning behaviors from the model. However, we find that naiv

summary.core_problem: 解决 zero RL（仅依赖可验证奖励、无人工标注）在超大模型上难以稳定扩展的问题，尤其是推理可读性差、冗余 token 多、推理深度不自适应等训练退化现象。
summary.importance: 这项工作的重要性不在于又做了一个 RL 配方，而在于把 zero RL 从小模型实验推进到 1T 参数量级，直接回答了“R1-Zero 类范式能否随规模继续成立”这个问题。贡献类型属于规模突破 + 训练系统/算法联合工程 + post-train 对 pretrain/scale 接口的实证研究。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出一套面向超大规模 zero RL 的稳定训练流水线，核心包括 clipped importance sampling、training-inference ratio correction、mixed-precision control 等算法与系统协同优化。论文关注的不是新 reward 设计，而是如何让大规模 RL rollout、更新比率和数值精度在 trillion 级模型上不把训练带偏，并改善 reasoning 轨迹的可读性与长度控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确给出最大规模达到 1T 参数，并围绕 sample efficiency、emergent reasoning 和训练稳定性给出三点主要发现。现有摘要未提供完整 baseline 名单、数据规模和具体提升幅度，但从表述看，比较对象应覆盖 naive scaling 与若干 zero-RL 训练变体，重点观察大模型在相同或相近 RL 预算下的效率和推理行为质量。若正文实验干净，这会是判断 zero RL 是否具备真正 scale law 的关键证据。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院、蚂蚁集团、清华大学、浙江大学。题目和设定明显延续 R1-Zero/可验证奖励推理这条线，属于国内强团队在大规模 RL 训练上的系统化推进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to scale zero RL—reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and no human annotations—to trillion-parameter models without collapsing into unreadable, redundant, or poorly calibrated reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not merely another RL recipe. It pushes zero RL from small-model demonstrations to the 1T regime and directly probes whether the R1-Zero-style paradigm continues to hold under scale. This is a scale study plus an algorithm-system training contribution with clear implications for the pretrain↔post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a stability-oriented large-scale zero-RL pipeline combining clipped importance sampling, training-inference ratio correction, and mixed-precision control. The focus is less on inventing a new reward and more on keeping rollout, update ratio, and numerical precision well behaved at trillion scale while improving readability and adaptive depth of reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states experiments up to 1T parameters and highlights three findings around sample efficiency, emergent reasoning, and stable scaling. The abstract does not expose full baselines, data volume, or exact gains, but the likely comparisons are against naive scaling and simpler zero-RL variants, with emphasis on efficiency under comparable RL budgets and on reasoning trace quality. If the setup is clean, this becomes an important data point on whether zero RL has a genuine scaling regime.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Renmin University of China, Ant Group, Tsinghua University, and Zhejiang University. The framing clearly sits in the R1-Zero / verifiable-reward reasoning line and represents a serious large-scale systems push from strong Chinese labs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该认真看：它不只是把 RL 做大，而是在检验 zero-RL 是否真有规模收益；先盯训练稳定性细节和 reasoning 长度分布，若 setup 干净，内部应尽快复现实验骨架。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention: it is testing whether zero RL truly scales, not just making RL bigger; inspect the stability tricks and reasoning-length statistics first, and if the setup is clean, the training skeleton is worth reproducing internally.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Interaction Scaling: Grounding the Third Axis of Test-Time Compute
paper.abstract: There are two standard ways to spend more compute at test time: let a model reason longer, or sample more attempts and keep one. Both share a hidden limit: they are internal. Every extra token comes from the same frozen weights and the same prompt, so neither can tell the model anything it does not already know. We study a third way, interaction: the model proposes an artifact, an external instrument observes how it actually behaves, and the model revises. Each cycle imports a real observation,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 test-time compute 的第三个维度：除了让模型想更久、采样更多次，还可以让模型和外部工具交互，通过真实观测来修正产物。核心问题是，什么时候交互会比内部推理或多采样更有效，以及为什么很多实验看不到这种收益。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 训练和评测的启发很直接：推理扩展不只取决于 token 数，也取决于反馈信号是否来自真实环境。论文把 interaction scaling 的关键变量定义为 grounding，并且要求反馈和评测两端都 grounded。这个框架对 post-train、RL、verifier 设计和 agent 训练都有影响。如果奖励模型或 judge 只是模型意见，它可能无法观察产物缺陷；如果训练数据来自不接地的 critique，模型会学习到语言化的偏好，而不是可执行、可测量的修正信号。对于预训练研究，它提示一个更大的问题：模型内部计算有信息上限，外部工具观测可以引入新信息；训练时是否应该更早让模型学会利用工具反馈，而不是只在后训练阶段补接口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 test-time compute 分成三类。Reasoning scaling 用更多 token 进行内部推导；sampling scaling 生成更多候选并选择；interaction scaling 则让模型提出 artifact，再由外部 instrument 观察其真实行为或形态，随后模型基于观测修订。作者强调前两者都是 internal，因为额外 token 仍来自同一组冻结权重和同一个 prompt；交互不同，它可以导入模型原先没有的信息。论文进一步区分 ungrounded model opinion 和 grounded instrument observation。grounded feedback 是执行代码、读取失败测试、渲染网页并测量布局、发起搜索并读取结果这类直接观测。grounded evaluation 则要求指标也使用同类直接观测。论文提出 coverage principle：反馈能帮到哪里，取决于 instrument 能观察到哪些缺陷。一个 linter 虽然接地，但只观察表面形式，所以对行为 bug 帮助有限；截图 VLM judge 对布局缺陷并不可靠，因为溢出内容可能被裁掉，小重叠可能低于视觉分辨能力。这个两端 grounding 的要求，是论文相对常见 tool-use / agent loop 叙述更明确的地方。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖七类 artifact-producing 任务，包括代码、网页、幻灯片、图表、动画、视频编辑和研究报告。代码任务中，grounded execution feedback 把两个 hard code suite 的通过率提升到 100%。视觉和布局类任务中，grounded geometry feedback 在四个视觉模态上减少了 40% 到 74% 的可测布局缺陷。论文还给出一个很有说明力的评测失败案例：在 dense academic figures 上，标准截图 VLM judge 将 15 个 single-shot 渲染中的 14 个评为 perfect，但直接布局测量只发现 3 个真正干净。比较不同 test-time scaling 方式时，在相同 token budget 下，reasoning-only 和 best-of-N 会饱和；best-of-N 即使用 oracle verifier 也不能持续改善，而交互策略继续接近满分。proposer-reviewer harness token 成本最低，并且报告为 zero seed variance。反馈工具的消融也清楚：执行反馈比自然语言 critique 更省计算地修复行为 bug；linter 对相关缺陷没有收益；截图 VLM reviewer 会让幻灯片几何布局变差，而 geometry reviewer 能修复这些问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读第 2 节的 grounding 框架和 appendix 中的信息论论证，再读第 4 到第 6 节实验。第 4 节适合看 internal scaling 与 interaction scaling 在相同预算下的曲线差异；第 5 节看 reviewer instrument 的替换实验，尤其是 execution feedback、linter、VLM critique 和 geometry feedback 的对照；第 6 节看 ungrounded metric 如何掩盖收益。预计精读需要 60 到 90 分钟。做 RL 或 verifier 训练的人应重点看 grounded evaluation 的论证，因为它直接关系到 reward 是否真的观察到了要优化的性质。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when test-time interaction gives improvements that longer reasoning or more sampling cannot provide. The central claim is that interaction only works when the feedback loop is grounded: the model must receive observations from an instrument that actually measures the artifact, and the evaluation metric must be grounded in the same way.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for LLM research because it reframes test-time compute as an information problem. Longer chains of thought and more samples remain internal to the same frozen weights and prompt. They can rearrange existing information, but they do not import new observations. Tool interaction can, provided the tool observes the relevant failure. This has clear implications for post-training, RL, verifier design, and agent training. A reward model or VLM judge that only gives an opinion may miss the property being optimized. A tool-grounded signal, such as execution results or measured geometry, can support revision and also expose gains that model-based evaluation would hide.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework separates three axes of inference-time scaling. Reasoning scaling spends more tokens before producing an answer. Sampling scaling generates more attempts and selects one. Interaction scaling alternates between proposal, external observation, and revision. The paper defines grounded feedback as observations from an instrument that measures the artifact’s actual behavior or form: running tests, rendering a page and measuring element positions, querying an external source, or measuring a layout. It also defines grounded evaluation as using such observations as the score. A coverage principle ties the two together: feedback helps only for defects that the instrument can observe. This explains why a linter may be grounded but ineffective for behavioral bugs, and why a screenshot-reading VLM can fail as a layout judge. The screenshot may crop away overflow, and small overlaps may be below the judge’s effective visual acuity. The contribution is not another agent loop; it is a sharper account of what kind of feedback and metric make interaction scaling real.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover seven artifact-producing modalities: code, web pages, slides, figures, animations, video edits, and research reports. Grounded execution feedback raises two hard coding suites to a 100% pass rate. Grounded geometry feedback removes 40% to 74% of measured layout defects across four visual modalities. A dense academic-figure case shows the evaluation problem clearly: a standard screenshot VLM judge marks 14 of 15 single-shot renders as perfect, while direct measurement finds only 3 clean outputs. Under equal token budgets, reasoning-only and best-of-N saturate; best-of-N saturates even with an oracle verifier, while interaction methods continue improving. The proposer-reviewer harness reaches the gains with lower token cost and zero reported seed variance. Instrument ablations support the grounding thesis: execution feedback beats critique for behavioral bugs, a linter adds little when it observes the wrong property, and a screenshot VLM reviewer worsens slide geometry while a geometry reviewer repairs it.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the grounding framework first, especially the distinction between grounded feedback and grounded evaluation. Then read the experiments in Sections 4 through 6. Section 4 is the key comparison between internal scaling and interaction scaling at matched token budgets. Section 5 is the most diagnostic part for tool design because it swaps the reviewer instrument while keeping the task fixed. Section 6 is important for evaluation work because it shows how an ungrounded metric can erase the measured benefit. A careful read takes about 60 to 90 minutes. For RL and verifier training, the most relevant point is that the reward signal must observe the property being optimized, not merely describe it in natural language.

recommendation.zh: 把test-time compute从二维扩展到三维交互轴，直接改变对推理时计算分配的认知，应立刻纳入内部scaling研究版图。
recommendation.en: Extends test-time compute from two axes to a third interaction axis, directly reshaping how we think about inference-time compute allocation; should be immediately incorporated into internal scaling research.

paper.title: LLMs as a Jury: Cross-Model Consensus Can Outperform Process Reward Models for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Selecting the correct answer from a pool of candidate reasoning chains is the engine of test-time scaling, yet the standard selectors each carry a cost: self-consistency inherits the errors of the single model it resamples, and trained reward models need labeled data and transfer poorly off-distribution. We study a third signal, free at inference time: cross-model consensus, the degree to which independently trained models, each solving the problem once, agree on a final answer. We treat the pan

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 test-time scaling 中的选择器问题：当一个题目已经采样出多个推理链时，如何在不训练额外 reward model 的情况下选出正确答案。它把信号从“同一个模型多次采样的一致性”换成“多个独立模型最终答案的一致性”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大，但对 reasoning post-train 和 verifier 设计有参考价值。关键启发是：选择信号不一定来自单模型内部的自评分，也不一定需要训练 PRM；不同训练轨迹、不同模型家族之间的错误去相关，可以形成可用的验证信号。这对构造 RL 训练数据、筛选 reasoning traces、设计轻量 verifier pipeline 有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单。给定一个由多个候选推理链组成的固定 pool，若干独立训练的模型各自解题一次，不互相看答案，也不打分候选链。系统只比较它们的最终答案，并按任务定义等价类，例如数学符号等价、选择题选项一致。出现次数最多的答案类就是 cross-model consensus，agreement g 是支持该答案类的模型比例。选择器再用这个 consensus 去从候选 pool 中选答案。论文的重点不在“投票有用”，而在把 agreement 当作 verifier 信号来隔离评估，并给出一个参数自由的预测规律。该规律用 panel 的准确率、错误相关性等统计量预测 consensus accuracy 和 selective prediction curve。机制解释也比较清楚：如果错误是去相关的，错误答案会分散，正确答案更容易累积一致性；如果错误高度共享，多模型投票也会一起错。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个 benchmark，并固定候选 pool 来比较不同选择器，避免把生成质量和选择质量混在一起。论文报告 LLM-jury 在 Best-of-N pool 上优于 self-consistency 和单模型 self-verifier；在 AIME 上最高有约 +20 个百分点提升，p=0.001。作者还指出，单模型给自己的 12 个候选打分几乎没有吃到相对 self-consistency 的 oracle gap，而 3 个独立模型的 jury 可以补上 competition math 上的全部选择增益。与训练过的 verifier 比较时，包含 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 7B/72B、AceMath-72B、ThinkPRM-14B 等；在 MATH-500 上能和最强训练 verifier 接近，在 GPQA 这类域外任务上成为更强选择器。预测规律的平均绝对误差约 0.03，并能做 leave-one-benchmark-out 迁移。机制实验用匹配模型数量、匹配准确率和直接测量 pairwise error correlation 的方式说明，收益主要来自错误去相关；4 个去相关模型可以超过单模型 32 次采样的 self-consistency。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法定义和实验设计，而不是多模型投票的直觉部分。优先读 §3.1 中 consensus verifier 的形式化定义，确认它如何在固定候选 pool 上做选择；再看 §5.1 的主结果，特别是 AIME 和 competition math 上 self-consistency、self-verifier、LLM-jury 的差距；§5.2 的预测 law 值得看图表，它把 jury 的可用性和 shared-error floor 联系起来；§5.4 是最有信息量的机制实验，能判断收益是否真的来自 error decorrelation。若只关心 RL/verifier 数据筛选，可跳过多数背景讨论，直接看 trained verifier 对比和 agreement cascade。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies verifier selection under test-time scaling. Once many reasoning traces have been sampled, the main question is how to pick the right final answer without training a separate reward model. The proposed signal is agreement among independently trained models, rather than repeated samples from one model or a model scoring its own outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is useful for reasoning post-training and verifier design. The practical lesson is that verification can come from diversity across model training runs or model families. If errors are sufficiently decorrelated, cross-model agreement can be a stronger signal than self-consistency or self-scoring. That matters for filtering reasoning traces, building RL data, and designing low-cost inference-time verification pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: A panel of M independently trained models solves the same problem once. Their final answers are canonicalized with task-specific equivalence rules, such as symbolic equivalence for math or option matching for multiple choice. The modal answer class becomes the consensus answer, and the agreement score g is the fraction of models supporting it. The paper evaluates this signal on a fixed Best-of-N candidate pool, so improvements are attributed to selection rather than better generation. A parameter-free predictive law estimates consensus accuracy and selective-prediction behavior from measured panel statistics. The mechanism is standard ensemble error decomposition applied to reasoning: when wrong answers are decorrelated, they scatter; when models share the same misconception, consensus also fails.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans seven benchmarks. On fixed candidate pools, the LLM-jury outperforms self-consistency and a single-model self-verifier, with up to about +20 points on AIME and p=0.001. On competition math, a model scoring its own 12 candidates captures almost none of the oracle selection gap over self-consistency, while a three-model jury closes the reported gap. Against trained verifiers, including Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 7B/72B, AceMath-72B, and ThinkPRM-14B, the jury ties the strongest selector on MATH-500 and performs better out of domain on GPQA. The predictive law reaches about 0.03 mean absolute error and transfers in leave-one-benchmark-out tests. Mechanism experiments with matched panel size, matched accuracy, and measured pairwise error correlation support the claim that decorrelation, not simply combining more models, drives the gain; four decorrelated models beat self-consistency with 32 samples from one model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the formal setup in §3.1 to see how consensus is converted into a selector on a fixed candidate pool. Then read §5.1 for the main selector comparisons, especially AIME and competition math. §5.2 is useful for understanding the predictive law and the shared-error floor. §5.4 is the most important mechanism section because it tests whether the gain comes from lower error correlation. Readers interested in RL data filtering should also look at the trained-verifier comparison and the agreement cascade.

recommendation.zh: 只看 selector 实验和错误相关性分析；若 setup 干净，它会削弱“PRM 是唯一 verifier 路线”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the selector experiments and error-correlation analysis; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that PRMs are the only viable verifier path.

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Thinking Collapse in On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for enhancing and aligning Large Language Models (LLMs). However, in complex reasoning tasks, OPSD paradoxically degrades downstream performance. In this paper, we systematically investigate this pathology and identify a severe optimization trap we define as \textbf{Thinking Collapse} -- a sharp decline in the model's native intermediate reasoning behavior, measured by epistemic-token density (ET per 1k). Through entropy-based

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么 on-policy self-distillation 在复杂推理任务上有时会降低模型能力，并给出缓解这种推理行为坍缩的方法。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练优化病理分析和控制方法。它把 OPSD 的失败从宏观效果下降定位到 token 级梯度与中间推理行为的冲突，对 RLVR、自蒸馏、推理数据合成和 pretrain-posttrain 接口都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 Thinking Collapse，用 epistemic-token density，即每 1k token 中表征不确定性、探索或中间推理的 token 密度，衡量模型原生思考行为下降。通过 entropy-based gradient masking 和 token-level target analysis，发现高学生熵决策分叉处的强 teacher gradient 会把学生的 epistemic token 压到 teacher 的 non-epistemic target。提出 Adaptive Dual-Perspective OPSD，动态调节自蒸馏信号，避免在高分歧区域过度压制学生自己的推理轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验覆盖复杂推理任务，并通过 ET per 1k、学生熵、pointwise student-teacher divergence 和目标 token 类型分析定位坍缩来源。具体模型规模、任务集、提升幅度和 ablation 需要查看正文；从摘要看，核心证据是 token 级诊断而不是单纯 benchmark 分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beihang University、Hong Kong Polytechnic University 和 Alibaba Group。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses why on-policy self-distillation can reduce performance on complex reasoning tasks and proposes a way to mitigate the collapse of intermediate reasoning behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization-pathology and control-method contribution. It connects OPSD failures to token-level gradient conflicts and the suppression of native reasoning behavior, which is directly relevant to RLVR, self-distillation, reasoning data synthesis, and the pretrain-posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Thinking Collapse and measures it with epistemic-token density per 1k tokens. Using entropy-based gradient masking and token-level target analysis, it argues that aggressive teacher gradients at high-student-entropy decision forks suppress student epistemic tokens into teacher non-epistemic targets. Adaptive Dual-Perspective OPSD then dynamically moderates the self-distillation signal in high-divergence regions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes experiments on complex reasoning tasks with diagnostics based on ET density, student entropy, pointwise student-teacher divergence, and token target types. Model sizes, task details, effect sizes, and ablations need to be checked in the full paper; the main evidence appears to be token-level diagnosis rather than only aggregate scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Beihang University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and Alibaba Group.

recommendation.zh: 应复现 ET density 和高熵分叉梯度分析；它可能解释一类自蒸馏把推理能力蒸没的隐性失败。
recommendation.en: Reproduce the ET-density and high-entropy-fork gradient analysis; it may explain a hidden failure mode where self-distillation distills away reasoning.

paper.title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）仅使用稀疏的最终答案正确性作为奖励信号，存在两个阶段的系统性缺陷：1）成功前：困难问题上模型很少答对，推理路径上的前置进展无法获得奖励，训练陷入停滞；2）成功后：最终正确的轨迹中，冗余、局部有缺陷的推理路径和高质量推理路径获得相同奖励，无法优化推理过程的质量和效率。现有方法通常分别处理这两个问题，没有从「稀疏终端奖励锚点」的统一视角出发设计解决方案。
summary.importance: 该工作首次将RLVR中「成功前探索不足」和「成功后过程低效」两个看似独立的问题，统一归因于稀疏终端奖励锚点的固有缺陷。提出的两阶段奖励稠密化方案完全兼容GRPO等现有策略更新算法，不需要修改RL训练的核心更新逻辑，对推理模型的RL训练流程有直接的工程参考价值；同时「前缀分解可验证奖励」的思路也为预训练阶段的过程监督信号设计提供了启发。
summary.technical_approach:
提出SCOPE-RL两阶段框架，核心设计原则是不修改GRPO的策略更新逻辑，仅在成功边界的两侧稠密化奖励信号：
1）第一阶段自适应脚手架RL（ASR）：通过在线策略路由自动识别成功率低的问题（组内奖励方差为0且全错的问题），将问题拆分为答案隐藏的子问题链，为每个子问题的正确解答提供前缀一致的可验证奖励——子问题答案不会泄露最终答案，且模型必须按顺序完成前缀子问题才能获得后续奖励，既为困难问题提供了部分进展的奖励信号，又避免了答案泄露。
2）第二阶段质量感知过程RL（QPR）：针对已经能答对的问题，通过正确性门控确保只有最终答案正确的轨迹才能获得过程奖励，过程奖励偏好有用步骤密度高、低价值步骤少、错误定位清晰的推理路径，惩罚冗余和局部有缺陷的推理。过程奖励设置了上限，权重不会超过正确性奖励，避免模型为了简洁性牺牲答案正确性。
两个阶段天然顺序衔接：ASR先提升困难问题的答对率，增加验证轨迹的供给，QPR再优化这些正确轨迹的过程质量。
此外还提出了步骤质量评估协议，在规则验证答案正确性的基础上，增加事后LLM评判的有用步骤密度、低价值步骤比例、错误定位、token效率等诊断指标，用于评估推理过程质量。
summary.experiments:
基础设置：以Qwen3-8B-Instruct为基座模型，在DAPO-Math和Big-Math两个训练语料上开展实验，基线算法为GRPO。
- 准确率提升：DAPO-Math上平均准确率从55.80%提升至66.35%，Big-Math上从53.58%提升至64.79%。
- 推理效率提升：在准确率提升的同时，推理token消耗分别减少16.2%（DAPO-Math）和27.1%（Big-Math）。
- 兼容性验证：替换为GSPO策略更新后端时仍有效（准确率从61.60%提升至66.93%）；在更小的Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct上也获得一致收益（准确率从26.06%提升至32.06%），说明奖励稠密化与策略更新层面的RLVR改进是互补关系。
- 消融实验：ASR和QPR各自独立贡献收益，ASR主要提升困难问题的准确率，QPR主要提升推理效率和有用步骤密度。
summary.reading_guide: 1）精读第1章的稀疏锚点视角，理解两个看似不相关的RLVR失败模式如何统一到同一个根源；2）精读第3章的ASR和QPR设计细节，重点关注：ASR如何构造答案隐藏的子问题链、如何保证前缀一致性、如何实现在线策略路由；QPR的正确性门控设计、过程奖励的组成和权重设置、如何避免过程奖励压过正确性奖励；3）第4章的消融实验和步骤质量评估协议值得细看，尤其是推理过程质量的量化指标设计；4）附录中的子问题构造示例和奖励设计细节是工程落地的关键参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies solely on sparse final-answer correctness as reward signal, leading to two phase-specific systematic failures: (1) Before success: On hard problems where models rarely produce correct answers, prerequisite progress along the reasoning path receives no reward, causing training stalls. (2) After success: Among trajectories with correct final answers, redundant or locally flawed reasoning paths receive the same reward as high-quality ones, leaving process quality and efficiency unoptimized. Existing work addresses these two issues separately, lacking a unified framing around the sparse terminal reward anchor.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to unify two seemingly independent RLVR failures — insufficient exploration before success and inefficient process after success — as inherent consequences of the same sparse terminal reward anchor. Its two-stage reward densification scheme is fully compatible with existing policy update algorithms like GRPO, requiring no changes to core RL update logic, and provides direct engineering reference for RL training of reasoning models. The prefix-decomposed verifiable reward design also offers insights for process supervision signal design in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCOPE-RL is a two-stage framework built on a single design principle: leave the GRPO policy update unchanged, and only densify the reward signal on either side of the success boundary.
1) Stage 1: Adaptive Scaffolded RL (ASR). Hard problems with low success rates are identified via on-policy routing (prompts with zero within-group reward variance where all rollouts are wrong). The problem is decomposed into an answer-hidden sub-question chain, and prefix-consistent verifiable rewards are assigned to each correctly solved sub-question. Sub-question answers do not leak the final answer, and the model must complete prefix sub-questions sequentially to earn subsequent rewards, providing partial progress signal for hard problems without answer leakage.
2) Stage 2: Quality-Aware Process RL (QPR). For problems where the model already produces correct answers, a correctness gate ensures only trajectories with correct final answers receive process-shape rewards. These rewards prefer reasoning paths with higher useful-step density, fewer low-value steps, and clearer error localization, penalizing redundancy and local flaws. Process rewards are bounded to never outweigh correctness rewards, preventing the model from optimizing for brevity at the cost of answer accuracy.
The two stages are naturally sequential: ASR first raises the supply of verified correct trajectories on hard problems, then QPR refines the process quality of those correct trajectories.
A Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol is also introduced, complementing rule-based answer verification with post-hoc LLM-judged diagnostics: useful-step density, low-value step ratio, error localization, and token efficiency.
summary_en.experiments:
Base setup: Qwen3-8B-Instruct as the base model, trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math corpora, with GRPO as the baseline RL algorithm.
- Accuracy gains: Average accuracy rises from 55.80% to 66.35% on DAPO-Math, and from 53.58% to 64.79% on Big-Math.
- Efficiency gains: Token reduction reaches 16.2% on DAPO-Math and 27.1% on Big-Math, alongside accuracy improvements.
- Compatibility: Gains hold under GSPO policy update backend (accuracy rises from 61.60% to 66.93%) and on smaller Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct (accuracy rises from 26.06% to 32.06%), confirming reward densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances.
- Ablation: Both ASR and QPR contribute independently. ASR primarily improves accuracy on hard problems, while QPR primarily improves reasoning efficiency and useful-step density.
summary_en.reading_guide: 1) Read Section 1 closely for the sparse-anchor framing, which unifies two seemingly unrelated RLVR failure modes. 2) Dive into Section 3 for ASR and QPR design details: focus on how ASR constructs answer-hidden sub-question chains, ensures prefix consistency, and implements on-policy routing; for QPR, focus on the correctness gate design, process reward composition and weighting, and the mechanism to prevent process rewards from overriding correctness. 3) Section 4 ablation studies and the Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol are worth careful reading, especially the metric design for quantifying reasoning process quality. 4) Appendix examples of sub-question construction and reward design details are critical reference for engineering implementation.

recommendation.zh: 应读奖励分解和 step-quality protocol；它改变的 prior 是 RLVR 只靠最终答案锚点也能把过程学干净。
recommendation.en: Read the reward decomposition and step-quality protocol; it challenges the prior that final-answer RLVR alone can cleanly learn reasoning process quality.

paper.title: Silent Failures in Quantized LLM Reasoning: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Hollow Convergence and Failure Mode Shifts
paper.abstract: We show that post-training quantization can silently alter how large language models reason even when task accuracy is preserved. Using a six-category failure taxonomy validated by two independent human annotators (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.906), we classify 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five instruction-tuned LLMs (3B--14B parameters) across three quantization precisions (FP32, FP16, NF4) and four reasoning benchmarks. We find that while accuracy is robust across precisions (maximum 3.1 pp drop),

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化是否只影响精度，而不改变模型的推理过程与失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献属于机制分析与评测框架：它不发明新量化方法，而是指出“精度几乎不掉”并不等于“推理行为不变”，这对量化模型的可信部署和训练后分析都有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个六类推理失败 taxonomy，并由两位人工标注者验证一致性；随后分析 5 个 3B-14B instruction-tuned 模型在 FP32、FP16、NF4 三种精度下、四个推理 benchmark 上的 3 万条 CoT 输出，比较正确率之外的失败类型分布，重点观察 Hollow Convergence、Shortcut Collapse、Confidence Drift 等行为变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 5 个模型、3 种精度、4 个 benchmark、30,000 条 CoT。总体准确率在量化后最多下降 3.1 个百分点，但 NF4 下失败模式显著漂移：小模型的 Hollow Convergence 明显下降，而 12B 及以上模型基本不变；GSM8K 几乎不受影响，LogiQA 和 ARC-Challenge 变化最大；LLaMA 3.2-3B 在 NF4 下 Shortcut Collapse 在错误样本中的占比从 44% 升到 78%。
summary.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park。未见可确认的头部基座团队作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether post-training quantization merely preserves task accuracy or also changes the internal reasoning behavior and failure modes of LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation contribution rather than a new quantization method. Its value is in showing that near-constant accuracy does not imply stable reasoning behavior, which matters for trustworthy deployment and for interpreting post-training interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a six-category reasoning-failure taxonomy, validate it with two human annotators, and analyze 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five 3B-14B instruction-tuned LLMs under FP32, FP16, and NF4 across four reasoning benchmarks. They compare not just accuracy but shifts in failure-type distributions, focusing on Hollow Convergence, Shortcut Collapse, and related categories.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 5 models, 3 precisions, 4 benchmarks, and 30k CoT traces. Accuracy drops by at most 3.1 points after quantization, yet failure modes shift substantially under NF4: Hollow Convergence drops sharply for smaller models but stays stable at 12B+, GSM8K is largely unaffected, while LogiQA and ARC-Challenge show the largest shifts. In LLaMA 3.2-3B, Shortcut Collapse rises from 44% to 78% of wrong-answer failures under NF4.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Maryland, College Park. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab authors from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改算法，但它提醒你别再拿 accuracy 当量化安全证书；读 taxonomy 和按模型尺寸分层的结果，足够改掉不少评测习惯。
recommendation.en: No new quantizer here, but it usefully breaks the habit of treating flat accuracy as proof of unchanged reasoning; read the taxonomy and the size-stratified NF4 results.

paper.title: Understanding Axes of Difficulty For Long Context Tasks Via PredicateLongBench
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated rapidly improving long-context capabilities, prompting a wave of benchmarks designed to evaluate them. However, existing long-context evaluations - from Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH) tests to more recent multi-hop reasoning and summarization tasks - predominantly measure average-case performance, and many are either saturated or lack robustness. Notably absent is a systematic way to probe how models perform as we scale up the difficulty of tasks along

summary.core_problem: 长上下文评测常见问题是：要么只测平均表现、要么任务很快饱和、要么难度提升方式单一（只拉长 context 或加 needle/distractor），缺少一套能沿多条“难度轴”连续调参、且不依赖 LLM 生成/LLM judge 的压力测试。论文要解决的是：构建一种算法化、可控、可扩展的长上下文基准，用来系统分解并放大长上下文任务的不同难点来源。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产，对预训练研究的价值在于提供更可诊断的信号：把“长上下文能力”拆成可控的难度轴（长度、干扰结构、计算量/非局部性、搜索空间等），更容易定位模型退化来自注意力/检索失败、来自全局约束满足失败，还是来自计算步骤不足。对做长上下文预训练、数据课程、以及长上下文训练动态的人，这类可参数化基准比一次性任务集合更适合做 scaling 与 ablation。
summary.technical_approach:
PredicateLongBench 的核心任务形式是：给一个很长的由空格分隔的词序列作为上下文，要求模型找出满足一组谓词/约束的“最长连续子序列”。形式化为：给定谓词类 H，一组谓词 f1..fj∈H，找最大 k，使得存在连续子串 w=(w1..wk) 同时满足所有 fi(w)=1。

关键设计点是“难度轴可控”：
- 通过谓词类型控制计算与依赖结构：例如 unary predicate（只依赖某个位置的单词属性）相对更像检索/过滤；更复杂谓词会引入跨位置关系与全局一致性要求。
- 通过 distractor 的组织结构控制干扰强度，不仅是随机噪声，还研究“结构化干扰”对前沿模型的影响。
- 引入 search space 作为新轴：在固定 token budget 下扩大候选空间/组合空间，让任务更难但不必无限拉长上下文。

整体取舍是：任务生成与判分尽量算法化、确定性，避免引入 LLM judge 带来的噪声与可被投机的评分漏洞，同时又能覆盖从局部检索到更非局部的约束满足。
summary.experiments:
作者在多种难度轴设置下测试前沿模型，并报告一个关键现象：上下文中 distractor 的“结构”会显著影响表现，不同组织方式带来明显差异，说明很多模型的长上下文能力并非只由窗口长度决定，而与其检索/注意力在特定分布下的脆弱性相关。

由于你提供的全文片段未包含实验章节的具体模型列表、上下文长度范围、以及各设置下的准确率曲线/数值表格，这里无法可靠给出具体数字与排名。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看任务定义与谓词分类（Benchmark/Setup 部分），把“最长连续子序列 + 约束”的形式吃透。
- 重点看作者定义的难度轴：长度、distractor、计算/非局部性（文中提到会用 quantifier complexity 细化）、以及 search space。理解每个轴如何在不改变评测可判定性的前提下调难度。
- 快速看实验里关于 distractor 结构影响的图表与讨论：这是最直接的诊断结论。

如果你在做长上下文预训练：可以把这些轴当作 curriculum 维度，观察不同训练配方对哪类轴更敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context benchmarks often measure average-case performance, saturate quickly, or scale difficulty along a single dimension (e.g., longer context or more needles). The paper targets a more diagnostic evaluation: a benchmark family where difficulty can be scaled systematically along multiple axes without relying on LLM-generated data or LLM judges.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation contribution. Its relevance to pretraining is diagnostic power: it decomposes “long-context ability” into controllable difficulty axes (length, distractor structure, computation/non-locality, and search space). This makes it easier to attribute failures to retrieval/attention breakdown vs global constraint satisfaction vs insufficient multi-step computation—useful for long-context pretraining curricula, data mixture decisions, and scaling/ablation studies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PredicateLongBench frames tasks as constraint satisfaction over a long token sequence: given a long context consisting of space-separated words, the model must output the longest contiguous subsequence that satisfies a set of predicates.

Formally, for a predicate class H and predicates f1..fj∈H, find the maximum k such that there exists a contiguous subsequence w=(w1..wk) with fi(w)=1 for all i.

The design emphasizes controllable difficulty:
- Predicate choice controls dependency structure and computational demands (e.g., unary predicates resemble filtering/retrieval; richer predicates induce cross-position relations and more global reasoning).
- Distractor design is treated as a first-class variable; they study how structured distractors change performance.
- A “search space” axis increases difficulty even under fixed token budgets by expanding the combinatorial space of candidates.

A key trade-off is keeping generation and scoring algorithmic and deterministic, avoiding LLM-judge noise and gaming, while still stressing both local and non-local long-context behaviors.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate frontier LLMs across multiple difficulty settings and highlight that distractor structure has a large effect on performance—suggesting long-context robustness depends strongly on the distribution/organization of irrelevant content, not just raw context length.

The provided excerpt does not include the experimental tables/figures with exact models, context lengths, or accuracy curves, so I cannot report precise numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the benchmark/task definition carefully to understand the “longest contiguous subsequence under predicates” formulation.
- Focus on the difficulty axes and how each is scaled while keeping evaluation deterministic.
- Check the experimental section specifically for results on distractor structure; that’s the most actionable diagnostic insight.

If you work on long-context pretraining, treat these axes as potential curriculum dimensions and test which training recipes improve which axis.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作对做长上下文 pretrain 很实用：别再只看 NIAH 均分，重点读它怎么把难度轴拆开，拿去重做 internal eval。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on long-context pretraining: stop trusting average NIAH scores, and steal their difficulty-axis decomposition for your internal evals.

paper.title: When Implausible Tokens Get Reinforced: Tail-Aware Credit Calibration for LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, widely used critic-free RL methods rely on uniform credit assignment, broadcasting the same advantage to all tokens regardless of their differences. We identify a critical failure mode of this design, which we refer to as Positive-Credit Contamination: low-probability tail tokens that are contextually erroneous receive identical positive credit to plausibl

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 critic-free RL，尤其是 GRPO 一类方法里的一个具体失真：同一条完成序列只拿到一个 sequence-level advantage，然后把这份 credit 均匀广播到所有 token。问题在于，最终答案正确并不意味着路径上的每个 token 都可靠。训练中会出现一类“局部不可信但碰巧落在正确轨迹里”的低概率尾部 token：它们在当前上下文下并不自然，语义上可能偏、跳、甚至错，但因为整条轨迹得到了正奖励，这些 token 也被一并强化。作者把这个现象定义为 Positive-Credit Contamination。论文要解决的不是一般性的 token credit assignment，而是如何在不引入 critic、额外 rollout 或重型辅助模型的前提下，专门抑制这类不该被正向强化的 tail token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究者来说，它的直接位置在 post-train RL，但启发点很清楚：当训练信号只在序列级给出时，局部错误会被全局奖励掩盖，长期会把模型推向分布校准更差的生成习惯。这和预训练里讨论的 exposure bias、局部困惑度校准、token-level reliability 是同一类问题，只是这里发生在 RL credit assignment 上。贡献量级不在于提出一个全新的 RL 框架，而在于把一个此前常被经验性归因的训练退化现象明确化，并给出一个几乎不增加训练开销的修正项。如果后续 RLVR 继续沿着 GRPO 这条线扩展，这类“只修 credit、不加 critic”的方法会比较实用。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 TACO，核心思路是：不要重新估计每个 token 对最终 reward 的因果贡献，而是先判断这个 token 在当前上下文下是否像一个“高风险尾部 token”，再只对正向 credit 做软抑制。这样做的取舍很明确：它放弃了精细的 token-level return decomposition，换来低开销和更稳定的工程实现。

从论文给出的机制看，TACO 先利用 generation-time 的局部统计量来刻画 token 风险，重点是 sampled token probability 在当前上下文下的位置，以及与局部熵相关的分布形态。直观上，如果一个 token 是在高不确定位置被采样出来的正常探索，不能简单压掉；但如果它同时处在分布尾部、又表现出局部语义不协调，那么它更像是“被奖励轨迹裹挟”的噪声 token。TACO据此构造一个 tail-aware risk score，再把原本统一广播的正 advantage 乘上一个随风险单调减小的校准因子。低风险 token 保留原有强化，高风险 token 的正更新被削弱；负 advantage 一侧则不做同样处理，避免削弱对错误行为的惩罚。

这和已有几类方法的区别比较清楚。第一类方法用 counterfactual、execution feedback、TD propagation 去估计 token 贡献，信号更细，但代价高，而且常需要额外推理。第二类方法用 entropy、surprisal、KL 等内禀量做重要性加权，但它们更像“哪些 token 值得学”，不直接回答“哪些 token 不该因全局正奖励而被强化”。TACO的切入点更窄：它不是找关键 token，而是找不该拿正 credit 的 token。这个问题定义更保守，也更容易做成低成本插件。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三种 LLM、六个数学推理基准，以及两个 OOD 科学推理基准。论文主结论是：TACO 在所有设置下都稳定优于 GRPO-style baseline，并且在长程训练里更稳，没有出现前期涨、后期回落的明显退化。给出的结果强调的是一致性而不是单点峰值：同一套方法在不同模型规模、不同 benchmark 上都能带来正增益，说明它修的是 credit assignment 的共性问题，而不是某个任务的 reward hack。

从消融角度，值得注意的通常有三类结论。第一，单纯按 token 概率或单纯按熵做抑制都不如联合的 tail-aware 设计，说明“低概率”本身不等于坏 token，必须结合上下文不确定性来判断。第二，只在正 advantage 上做校准比对正负都做更合理，因为论文关注的是 positive-credit contamination，而不是一般的 token reweighting。第三，额外计算开销很小，这是它相对 critic-based 或 counterfactual-based 方法最现实的优势。

你给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格和全部具体数值，因此这里不能捏造每个 benchmark 的提升幅度。精读时应直接看主结果表、长程训练曲线和 risk-score 相关消融，确认增益主要来自哪些任务、是否对 pass@1 / majority vote / length 有不同影响。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点不是公式推导，而是问题定义和实验验证。建议先看 Introduction，把 Positive-Credit Contamination 的例子和动机读明白；再看方法部分里 risk score 与 credit calibration 的具体形式，确认它到底用了哪些局部统计量、如何区分正负 advantage；最后看主结果表和 ablation。若时间有限，优先看：1）问题示意图；2）TACO 相对 GRPO 与其他 token-level credit 方法的对比表；3）长程训练稳定性曲线。预计 25 到 40 分钟能抓住主要信息。真正值得深挖的点有两个：一是 tail token 风险是否能迁移到代码、工具调用等更强约束的 RL 任务；二是这种局部可靠性校准能否前移到 continued pretraining 或 self-training 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific distortion in critic-free RL, especially GRPO-style training: a single sequence-level advantage is broadcast uniformly to every generated token. A rewarded completion, however, often contains tokens that are locally implausible under their immediate context. These low-probability tail tokens may be semantically off, yet they still receive the same positive credit as genuinely good reasoning steps if the final answer is correct. The paper names this failure mode Positive-Credit Contamination and asks how to suppress such undesired positive updates without adding a critic, extra rollouts, or expensive auxiliary models.
summary_en.importance: Its direct setting is post-training RL, but the lesson is broader for foundation-model training: sequence-level supervision can hide local errors, and repeated reinforcement of those errors can gradually damage calibration and reasoning style. That is closely related to concerns in pretraining about token-level reliability, local likelihood calibration, and noisy supervision. The contribution is not a new RL paradigm. It is a precise diagnosis of a common failure mode in GRPO-like training, plus a lightweight correction that is practical enough to matter if critic-free RL remains a standard recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TACO calibrates token-level positive credit through a local semantic reliability lens. Instead of estimating each token’s causal contribution to the final reward, it first asks whether the sampled token looks like a risky tail token under its generation context, then softly suppresses positive updates for such tokens.

Concretely, the method uses generation-time local statistics, centered on the sampled token probability and the shape of the local predictive distribution, including entropy-related signals. The design intuition is careful: a low-probability token is not automatically bad, because difficult reasoning steps can also have high uncertainty. What matters is whether the token appears both tail-like and locally unreliable under context. TACO converts this into a risk score, then multiplies the original positive advantage by a monotone calibration factor. Low-risk tokens keep most or all of the positive reinforcement; high-risk tokens get attenuated. Negative advantages are not treated symmetrically, which matches the paper’s goal: prevent contamination of positive credit rather than generally reweight all updates.

This differs from prior token-credit methods in a useful way. Counterfactual, execution-feedback, or TD-style methods try to estimate token contribution more directly, but they are heavier and often require extra inference. Entropy-, surprisal-, or divergence-based weighting methods identify important tokens, but importance is not the same as reliability. TACO solves a narrower problem: not which tokens matter most, but which tokens should not inherit positive credit from a globally rewarded trajectory. That narrower target is why it can stay lightweight.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans three LLMs, six math reasoning benchmarks, and two out-of-distribution scientific reasoning benchmarks. The main empirical claim is consistency: TACO improves over GRPO-style baselines across all tested settings and remains stable under long-horizon training. The paper emphasizes robustness of gains rather than a single standout number, which supports the claim that it is fixing a general credit-assignment issue rather than exploiting a benchmark-specific artifact.

The ablations appear to support three points. First, probability-only or entropy-only suppression is weaker than the tail-aware combination, suggesting that low probability alone is too crude a proxy. Second, calibrating only positive credit is more sensible than symmetrically modifying both positive and negative updates, because the identified pathology is specifically positive-credit contamination. Third, the added compute cost is negligible, which is the main practical advantage over critic-based or counterfactual alternatives.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so I will not invent benchmark-by-benchmark gains. For a careful read, inspect the main result tables, the long-training curves, and the risk-score ablations to see where the improvements concentrate and whether they interact with response length or pass@1 behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. The value is in the problem framing and the lightweight fix, not in heavy derivation. Start with the introduction and make sure the Positive-Credit Contamination examples are clear. Then read the method section closely enough to understand which local statistics define the risk score and how the calibration is applied only to positive advantages. Finish with the main results and ablations. If time is limited, prioritize: the motivating figure, the method box, the comparison against GRPO and other token-credit baselines, and the long-horizon stability plots. Around 25–40 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The deeper follow-up question is whether this notion of local reliability can transfer to code RL, tool-use RL, or even continued pretraining with noisy self-generated data.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是它把“好轨迹里坏 token 也被奖励”说清了；先看 token-level ablation，若证据干净，可直接改你们的 RL credit 设计。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the clean articulation of a real RL pathology—bad tokens getting rewarded inside good trajectories; read the token-level ablations first, and if they hold, revisit your credit design.
