paper.title: HIVE: Understanding Post-Hallucination Reasoning in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Hallucinations in vision language models (VLMs) are commonly treated as semantic errors, yet they often arise from partial or ambiguous visual evidence. Prior work mainly focuses on detecting or suppressing hallucinations at generation time, leaving the subsequent reasoning stage largely unexplored. In this work, we study Post Hallucination Reasoning (PHR), the stage in which hallucinated semantics enter the model's inference context and influence downstream predictions. To systematically invest

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在生成幻觉内容之后，幻觉语义进入推理上下文并影响后续预测的过程。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测与机制分析。它把幻觉从“生成时错误”扩展到“后续推理变量”，并提出 HIVE 来控制比较忠实 caption 与幻觉 caption 对不同任务的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hallucination Inference and Verification Engine，通过构造或选择 faithful 与 hallucinated captions，在相同下游输入条件下观察模型推理变化。方法重点不是抑制幻觉，而是隔离幻觉线索进入上下文后的因果影响。
summary.experiments: 在九类任务和九个 VLM 上做对照实验。摘要称 hallucinated captions 在视觉-语言任务上经常提升准确率，而在纯文本任务上效果有限或不稳定；进一步分析显示幻觉线索会扩展语义覆盖并改变推理动态。具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies what happens after a VLM has produced a hallucinated semantic cue and that cue becomes part of the reasoning context.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation and analysis setup. It reframes hallucination not only as a generation-time error, but also as a downstream reasoning variable that can alter predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce HIVE, the Hallucination Inference and Verification Engine, to run controlled comparisons between faithful and hallucinated captions. The setup isolates how hallucinated cues affect later inference rather than trying to suppress them during decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers nine tasks and nine models. The abstract reports that hallucinated captions often improve accuracy on vision-language tasks, while text-only tasks show limited or unstable effects. Model sizes, datasets, and exact gains are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点反直觉：幻觉不总是坏信号；只看实验设置和按任务拆分的结果即可。
recommendation.en: The useful bit is the counter-prior result: hallucinations are not uniformly harmful; read the setup and task-wise breakdown.

paper.title: RL Post-Training Builds Compositional Reasoning Strategies
paper.abstract: Does RL post-training merely amplify primitive skills already latent in a base model, or can it compose primitive skills into new higher-level strategies? We study this question in a fully observable rewrite-grammar environment where the pretraining distribution is known and every generated rewrite can be audited. A Transformer is pretrained on primitive symbol-rewrite chains and post-trained on a Trace-based reasoning task with only a binary final-answer reward. RL solves held-out problems that

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RL post-training 到底只是在放大 base model 已有的低概率行为，还是能把预训练中学到的原子能力组合成新的高层推理策略。该工作把这个问题放到一个完全可观测的 rewrite-grammar 环境里，避免真实 LLM 中常见的混淆：不知道行为是否出现在预训练数据里，不知道采样能否早已覆盖，不知道轨迹里的步骤是有效推理还是偶然拼接。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口有较强信息量。它不是用自然语言 benchmark 证明 RL 有效，而是构造了一个可审计环境来观察机制：预训练提供 primitive rewrite competence，RL 在只有二值 final-answer reward 的条件下，把这些 primitive 重新组织成 sequential macro 和 parallel composition。贡献不在任务本身，而在给出了一个较干净的证据链：RL 的收益可以来自程序性 chunking，而不仅是提高已有答案的采样概率。对预训练研究的启发是，预训练分布如何组织局部能力，会影响后续 RL 能否压缩、复用并外推这些能力。
summary.technical_approach:
环境定义在符号 alphabet 上。每个 source symbol 映射到一个或多个全局唯一的多字符 RHS string；全局唯一性保证 contraction 是无歧义的，即任何匹配 RHS 的 substring 都能唯一映射回 source symbol。模型支持两类 primitive inverse operations：expansion 把一个 symbol 替换为 RHS，contraction 把一个匹配 substring 收缩回 source symbol。每一步都序列化为带位置、span 和 rule 的动作，因此生成轨迹可以逐步审计。

预训练从零开始，在 primitive rewrite chains 上训练 Transformer。数据生成器从初始 word 出发，反复采样合法 primitive expansion 或 contraction，并把 resulting word 作为下一步输入。预训练只暴露局部 grammar-consistent dynamics，不包含后续分析中的非 primitive shortcut。作者用 contraction weight ρ 控制预训练分布；默认 ρ=4，它局部提高 contraction move 的采样倾向，但不直接指定最终 contraction frequency 或 chaining length。

post-training 任务是 goal-directed contraction。prompt 由目标 symbol c* 经多次 primitive expansion 得到较长 word，模型只看到 w_prompt，需要生成逐步 contraction trace，最后输出 c*。reward 只有最终答案是否正确的二值信号。由于语法完全可审计，每条轨迹可分成 primitive rule use、valid non-primitive composition 和 invalid rewrite。valid composition 又分为 sequential composition，即把有序 primitive contraction chain 合成一个 macro step；以及 parallel composition，即在一个 emitted step 中合并彼此独立的 primitive contractions。这个 taxonomy 是全文的关键，它把“RL 学到新策略”从 pass rate 变化变成可检查的轨迹结构变化。

方法比较上，RL 与 rejection fine-tuning 形成了清晰对照。RFT 会选择成功样本，也会复制一些 shortcut-like 行为，但其中相当一部分是 spurious rewrite。RL，特别是 GRPO 的 same-prompt contrast，会在同一 prompt 的候选组内相对提高有效结构、压低无效 passenger actions。作者给出 finite-group view 来解释这种选择效应：RL 的优势不只是探索更多，而是把探索质量集中到可复用的合法组合上。
summary.experiments:
实验设计围绕 difficulty 和轨迹分类展开。Difficulty 由 optimal primitive contraction solution 在 256-token generation budget 下的长度定义：Difficulty 1 的 primitive 最优解能放进预算；Difficulty 2 比预算多一个 primitive contraction step；Difficulty 3 多两个 step。RL 训练 mixture 为 60% Difficulty 1、20% Difficulty 2、20% Difficulty 3。评估覆盖 held-out Difficulty 1–6，其中包含训练分布之外的更难 bucket。

关键结果有四点。第一，RL 能解决一些 pretrained model 即使用更大 sampling budget 也很少解决的 held-out problems，且收益在训练后期更明显，并随难度上升而扩大。这支持 finite-budget frontier expansion，而不只是小 k 下的重排序。第二，RFT 早期提升明显，但较快 plateau；它会保留成功轨迹中的 shortcut-like 行为，却无法稳定区分 valid composition 和 spurious rewrite。第三，轨迹分析显示 RL 有阶段性：先增强 primitive reductions，再发现和复用 valid compositions，最后把 sequential macro 与 parallel composition 固化为更稳定的策略。第四，预训练分布会影响后续策略可达性。ρ=4 的默认设置提供了更偏 contraction 的 procedural substrate；第 7 节进一步消融 ρ，检验预训练中 contraction chaining 的组织方式是否影响 RL 后续能否压缩为 macro。

提供内容中没有给出 Transformer 参数量、预训练 token 数、训练步数或具体 pass-rate 数字。因此最可靠的数字是环境和训练设置：256-token generation budget、ρ=4、RL 训练难度配比 60/20/20、评估 Difficulty 1–6，以及 pretraining 只含 primitive chains 而不含非 primitive shortcuts。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读。先看 rewrite grammar 和 primitive actions 的定义，尤其是 global uniqueness、expansion/contraction 序列化，以及为什么这让每个生成步骤都可审计。再看 post-training task 的 difficulty 设计，因为 256-token budget 与 Difficulty 1–3 的定义直接决定了为什么 macro composition 是必要的，而不是可有可无的捷径。

第二个重点是轨迹 taxonomy：primitive、macro、parallel、spurious。这里是判断 RL 是否产生组合策略的核心证据。只看 pass@k 容易把 valid macro 和 invalid shortcut 混在一起。第三个重点是 RL 与 RFT 的比较，特别是 RFT 为什么会 plateau，以及 GRPO 的 same-prompt contrast 如何抑制 spurious passenger actions。第四个重点是第 7 节的 pretraining distribution 消融。它连接到预训练研究最关心的问题：什么样的预训练分布会形成可被 RL 压缩和复用的程序性结构。

值得深挖的是两个方向。第一，把 rewrite grammar 中的 procedural substrate 对应到真实 LLM 的预训练数据，例如代码、数学推导、工具调用轨迹、可验证合成数据。第二，把 final-answer binary reward 下的策略形成过程与自然语言 RL 中的 CoT 格式化、捷径、reward hacking 区分开。这个环境虽然抽象，但提供了一套比自然语言任务更干净的诊断工具。

summary_en.core_problem: The central question is whether RL post-training only amplifies low-probability behaviors already present in the base model, or whether it can compose primitive pretrained skills into new higher-level reasoning strategies. The paper studies this in a fully observable rewrite-grammar environment, where the pretraining distribution is known and every generated rewrite can be audited. This removes several confounders that are hard to control in real LLMs: whether a behavior appeared in pretraining, whether it was already reachable by larger sampling, and whether intermediate steps are valid reasoning or accidental shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to the interface between pretraining and post-training. Its value is not the symbolic task itself, but the controlled evidence it provides. Pretraining gives the model local primitive rewrite competence. RL, trained only with a binary final-answer reward, reorganizes that competence into reusable sequential and parallel compositions. This supports a mechanism stronger than simple probability reweighting: RL can induce procedural chunking when the pretrained model contains the right local substrate. For pretraining research, the key implication is that the organization of primitive competence in the pretraining distribution can determine which strategies later become reachable under RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The environment is defined over a symbolic alphabet. Each source symbol maps to one or more globally unique multi-character right-hand-side strings. Global uniqueness makes primitive contraction unambiguous: any substring matching a right-hand side maps back to exactly one source symbol. The environment supports two inverse primitive operations. Expansion replaces a symbol with one of its right-hand sides. Contraction replaces a matching substring with its source symbol. Each step is serialized with the relevant position, span, and rule, which makes trajectory-level auditing possible.

A Transformer is pretrained from scratch on primitive rewrite chains. The generator starts from an initial word, repeatedly samples valid primitive expansions or contractions, appends the serialized action, and uses the resulting word as the next input. Pretraining exposes the model to local grammar-consistent dynamics, but not to the non-primitive shortcuts analyzed later. A contraction weight ρ controls the pretraining distribution; the default is ρ=4. This locally upweights contraction moves when both directions are available, without directly fixing the realized contraction frequency or chain length.

Post-training uses a goal-directed contraction task. A prompt is produced by expanding a target symbol c* into a longer word w_prompt. The model sees only w_prompt and must generate a contraction trace whose final emitted symbol is c*. The reward is binary and depends only on the final answer. Since the grammar is exactly known, each generated trajectory can be classified into primitive rule use, valid non-primitive composition, and invalid rewrite. Valid composition has two forms: sequential composition, which collapses an ordered chain of primitive contractions into a macro step, and parallel composition, which combines independent primitive contractions in one emitted step. This taxonomy is the technical core of the paper because it turns the vague claim of “new reasoning strategy” into an auditable trajectory property.

The comparison with rejection fine-tuning is important. RFT selects successful samples and can copy shortcut-like rewrites, but many of these are spurious. RL, especially with GRPO-style same-prompt contrast, concentrates probability mass on valid reusable structure and suppresses invalid passenger actions. The finite-group view explains why the advantage is not merely larger exploration volume, but better selection among behaviors produced for the same prompt.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around difficulty and trajectory structure. Difficulty is defined by the length of the optimal primitive contraction solution under a 256-token generation budget. Difficulty 1 problems have an optimal primitive solution that fits within the budget. Difficulty 2 requires one extra primitive contraction step beyond the budget. Difficulty 3 requires two extra steps. The RL training mixture contains 60% Difficulty 1, 20% Difficulty 2, and 20% Difficulty 3 examples. Evaluation covers held-out Difficulty 1–6, including difficulties beyond the training distribution.

The main findings are clear. First, RL solves held-out problems that the pretrained model rarely solves even with much larger sampling budgets. The gains emerge late in training and become larger as difficulty increases, which supports finite-budget frontier expansion rather than only small-k reranking. Second, RFT improves early but plateaus. It imitates successful traces, including shortcut-like behavior, but does not reliably separate valid compositions from spurious rewrites. Third, trace analysis shows a phased mechanism: RL first strengthens primitive reductions, then discovers and reuses valid compositions, and eventually consolidates sequential macros and parallel compositions into stable strategies. Fourth, the pretraining distribution matters. The default ρ=4 setting creates a contraction-biased procedural substrate, and the ablation in Section 7 tests whether the organization of contraction chaining affects which strategies RL can later compress and reuse.

The provided content does not specify model parameter count, pretraining token count, training steps, or exact pass-rate values. The reliable numerical details are the 256-token generation budget, ρ=4, the RL training mixture of 60/20/20 over Difficulties 1–3, and held-out evaluation over Difficulties 1–6.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This paper is worth a careful read. Start with the rewrite grammar and primitive action definitions, especially global uniqueness, serialized expansion and contraction actions, and the reason these choices make every generated step auditable. Then read the post-training task setup and difficulty definition. The 256-token budget and the Difficulty 1–3 construction explain why macro composition is required rather than merely convenient.

The second key part is the trajectory taxonomy: primitive, macro, parallel, and spurious. This is where the paper provides evidence about strategy formation rather than relying only on pass@k. The third key part is the RL-versus-RFT comparison, especially why RFT plateaus and how GRPO-style same-prompt contrast suppresses spurious passenger actions. The fourth key part is the pretraining-distribution ablation in Section 7, which is the most directly relevant part for pretraining researchers.

Two follow-up directions are worth considering. One is mapping the procedural substrate in this symbolic environment to real pretraining data, such as code, mathematical derivations, tool-use traces, or verifiable synthetic trajectories. The other is using this kind of trace audit to separate genuine strategy formation from formatting gains, shortcuts, and reward hacking in natural-language RL.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“RL 只是把 base model 里已有能力采样出来”的 prior；先复现它的合成环境，再拿内部 reasoning traces 检查是否也有同样的分阶段组合现象。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that RL only samples out latent base-model skills; replicate the synthetic setup first, then inspect your own reasoning traces for the same phased compositional transition.

paper.title: Geometric Self-Distillation for Reasoning Generalization
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation is a practical post-training recipe for large language models, supplying dense teacher supervision on the student's own trajectories. In privileged-context self-distillation, teacher and student are the same model conditioned on the same prefix, but the teacher also sees a hint or the full solution trace. This makes supervision abundant but harder to trust: the teacher can be confident about continuations its privileged view makes obvious but the student cannot yet justify

summary.core_problem: 特权上下文的 on-policy self-distillation（同一模型当 teacher，但 teacher 看到 hint/解题轨迹）在推理任务上容易出现“漂移”：teacher 在额外信息下对某些 continuation 极度自信，而 student 在原始上下文下无法支撑这种自信；标准 KL 类蒸馏在 teacher/student 分歧最大的状态给出最大梯度，长期累积把 student 推向过度自信的分布，导致 OOD 推理退化。论文要解决的是：在不丢掉密集监督信号的前提下，如何系统性地控制这种由蒸馏更新幅度累积导致的分布漂移。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 阶段的“蒸馏/自蒸馏如何稳定泛化”给出一个更偏几何与优化视角的答案：问题不只是 teacher 信号是否可靠（selection/filtering），还在于更新把 student 的预测分布推得有多远（movement control）。这对推理类 mid-train / OPD recipe 有直接启发：当 teacher 处于 privileged view、或 reward/teacher 诱导模型过早收敛到尖锐分布时，用“重叠感知的局部蒸馏 + 全局漂移约束”能在保留 ID 收益的同时显著缓解 OOD 崩坏。方法本身不依赖特定模型结构，属于可迁移的训练目标设计。
summary.technical_approach:
GeoSD 用同一套“下一 token 分布的几何”同时处理两件事：
1) 局部：用 Hellinger loss 替换标准 KL 蒸馏。直觉是让梯度按 teacher-student 的概率重叠来加权：teacher 很确定但 student 几乎不给概率的 token，不再产生巨大拉力；两者已有共识的部分更容易被强化。与常见的 clipping/filtering 不同，这种衰减写进了损失的梯度结构里，监督强度会随着重叠增加而自然变强。
2) 全局：加入一个到“最近 checkpoint”的 Fisher–Rao 距离惩罚（proximal term），约束训练过程中预测分布累计位移，直接针对文中定义的 drift。
3) 优化：因为两项都在同一几何下定义，作者主张用 natural-gradient 风格的更新，使每一步在提升目标的同时对预测分布做“最小必要改变”。
机制层面的关键判断：标准 KL 匹配在高熵/低重叠状态会通过“抽干替代选项的概率”来快速对齐 teacher top-1，导致 student 过早变尖锐；GeoSD 更像是把 top-1 做强但不把其他备选完全压扁，从而在 OOD 时仍保留可恢复的概率质量。
summary.experiments:
从引言给出的全文级结论：在三类模型家族上，GeoSD 在数学推理 OOD 基准的平均准确率提升 5.7–8.6（avg@16）相对 base model；而标准 KL 目标在相同设置下会让 OOD 退化。GeoSD 同时“保住”ID 收益，并在所有测试的 OOD benchmark 上取得最好结果；OOD 增益在 1.7B–32B 五个规模上保持一致。论文还声称通过分析展示：标准匹配在高熵状态更倾向于概率质量集中，导致对错误答案的自信一致；GeoSD 的对齐路径不同（更温和地重分配概率）。
注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格与每个 benchmark 的逐项数字、训练步数/数据量、以及 natural gradient 的实现细节（是否近似、是否额外开销）。这些需要在正文实验与附录表格中核对。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“失败机制→目标设计→证据链”读：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 privileged-context mismatch 与 drift 的因果链条描述，以及 Figure 1（A：重叠加权的局部蒸馏；B：到 checkpoint 的漂移约束）。
- Method 重点抓两处：Hellinger loss 的梯度形式（它如何把 overlap 写进梯度权重），以及 Fisher–Rao 距离/自然梯度更新在实现上如何近似（是否用 FIM 对角/低秩、是否等价于某种 trust-region）。
- 实验部分优先看：ID vs OOD 的分解结果、不同 KL 变体对照、以及“概率质量如何被抽干/保留”的分析图（文中提到的高熵状态与错误自信）。如果要复现或迁移到自家 recipe，最值得深挖的是：checkpoint 间隔/惩罚系数的敏感性、以及 Hellinger 与常见 JS/TV/Reverse-KL 的差异是否主要来自梯度加权还是数值稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: Privileged-context on-policy self-distillation (teacher sees hints/solution traces while the student only sees the original prompt) tends to induce distributional drift: the teacher becomes highly confident about continuations that are obvious under extra information, and standard KL-style distillation applies the strongest gradients exactly where teacher–student overlap is smallest. Repeating such updates pushes the student toward unjustified overconfidence, which hurts out-of-distribution (OOD) reasoning. The paper targets how to keep dense on-policy supervision without letting cumulative update magnitude distort the student’s predictive behavior.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is less about selecting “reliable” teacher tokens and more about controlling how far distillation moves the model in prediction space. That framing is useful for reasoning-focused post-training and mid-training recipes where privileged teachers, verifiers, or reward models can create sharp targets that the student cannot yet justify. GeoSD suggests a practical objective-level fix—overlap-aware local distillation plus an explicit drift penalty—that preserves in-distribution gains while improving OOD robustness, and is largely architecture-agnostic.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GeoSD combines two terms defined in a shared geometry over next-token distributions:
1) Local control via Hellinger distillation: gradients are implicitly weighted by teacher–student probability overlap. Tokens that the teacher assigns high probability to but the student assigns near-zero probability no longer dominate the update; shared mass transfers strongly and grows as agreement increases.
2) Global control via a proximal penalty: a Fisher–Rao distance to a recent checkpoint constrains accumulated movement (drift) in predictive distributions over training.
3) Optimization alignment: since both terms live in the same geometry, the paper motivates natural-gradient-style updates to make each step the smallest necessary change in prediction space while improving the objective.
Mechanistically, the paper argues KL matching often achieves agreement by collapsing alternatives (draining probability mass), producing brittle, overconfident policies; GeoSD strengthens the teacher’s top choice while keeping plausible alternatives “within reach,” which matters under distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt: across three model families, GeoSD improves average OOD math-reasoning accuracy by 5.7–8.6 points (avg@16) over the base model, while standard KL objectives degrade OOD performance under the same privileged-context self-distillation setting. The OOD gains are reported to hold consistently across five scales (1.7B–32B), while retaining in-distribution improvements. The paper also reports diagnostic analyses showing KL-style objectives concentrate probability mass in high-entropy states, leading to confident agreement on wrong answers, whereas GeoSD follows a different agreement path.
Note: the excerpt does not include per-benchmark tables, training budgets, or implementation details of the natural-gradient approximation; those should be verified in the main experiment section and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as: failure mode → objective geometry → empirical evidence.
- Start with the introduction’s causal story about low-overlap states and drift, plus Figure 1 for the two design levers.
- In the method, focus on (i) the exact gradient form of the Hellinger loss and how overlap enters, and (ii) how Fisher–Rao distance and natural-gradient updates are approximated in practice (trust-region interpretation, computational overhead).
- In experiments, prioritize ID vs OOD breakdowns, KL-variant baselines, and the probability-mass/entropy analyses that support the “overconfidence via mass draining” claim. For adoption, the most actionable details are hyperparameter sensitivity (checkpoint interval, penalty weight) and whether the gains persist without expensive second-order machinery.

recommendation.zh: 做 reasoning distillation 的值得看：它把“teacher 太强反而带偏学生”讲得很具体；先看 loss 设计和 OOD 结果，若 setup 干净可直接进内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth your time if you do reasoning distillation: it makes the 'teacher is too privileged and drags the student off-manifold' failure mode concrete; check the loss and OOD tables first.

paper.title: Agon: Competitive Cross-Model RL with Implicit Rival Grading of Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (e.g. GRPO) is the engine behind today's reasoning models, yet it grades only the final answer. On hard problems this trains models to write more rather than to think better, since the trace itself is never graded and no label for good thinking exists. We introduce Agon, which makes two competing models each other's graders. Both attempt the same problem; in alternating roles, one drafts a solution and the other reads it while solving, and each is r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决的是 outcome-only reasoning RL 的一个老问题：奖励只看最终答案，不看推理过程，于是模型在难题上更容易学会“写得更长”而不是“想得更好”。只要更长的链条能增加偶然撞对答案的概率，GRPO 就会给这种行为正反馈，结果是 trace 充满回退、犹豫和冗余文字，但单位 token 的推理质量没有同步提升。直接给过程打标签又很难，因为没有可靠、可验证的“好推理”标注。作者提出的切入点是，不去显式标注过程，而是让另一个模型在竞争中隐式评价你的推理：如果对手看了你的解题过程后还能把你击败，说明你的过程没有真正形成优势；反之，能在对手可见的条件下仍然赢，才说明过程里有有效推理成分。
summary.importance: 对后训练和 reasoning research 的启发在于，它试图把“过程奖励”从显式监督问题改写成博弈问题。不是训练一个 reward model 去判断哪一步推理好，而是设计一个竞争环境，让过程质量通过对手的可利用性间接显现。这条路如果成立，意义不在于替代所有 outcome reward，而在于给 reasoning RL 增加一个更接近“思维质量”的训练信号，而且不依赖人工过程标注。另一个值得注意的点是，它明确反对单模型自我审查的闭环。作者认为 self-generated signal 容易强化原有盲点，而异构对手能提供不同错误模式，从而打破自我强化的局部最优。这个思路和 self-play 有亲缘关系，但这里的博弈对象不是环境，而是另一个会读你推理痕迹的策略。对基座预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 如何塑造 reasoning trace 的分布有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 Agon。核心机制是双模型、轮换角色、带信息交换的竞争式 GRPO。每个问题上，两套策略都参与：一方先作为 drafter 产出解题过程和答案，另一方作为 challenger 在读到对手草稿后再尝试求解。奖励不只看自己是否答对，还看是否“击败”对手，也就是在对手已有工作可见的情况下仍然比对方更成功。角色在每个训练 step 轮换，使两边都学会起草和挑战。

作者强调两个条件缺一不可。第一是信息交换：挑战者必须能看到对手的推理文本，否则就谈不上“你的过程是否经得起对手利用”。第二是竞争而不是合作：如果只是互相参考、追求一致，容易退化成共识平均，尤其当两模型能力不完全对齐时，强者会被弱者拖低，或者双方都学会输出更安全但不更强的轨迹。文中专门设计了一个 2×2 实验矩阵，把 competition 与 information exchange 两个因素拆开验证，并指出其中“竞争但不交换信息”的一个单元在 group-relative normalization 下按构造是 inert 的，因此真正有意义的比较是 adversarial exchange 对 cooperative exchange 的增益。

实现上，作者没有真的训练两套完整模型，而是用一个冻结 base 上挂两组 LoRA/adapter，额外内存约 2%，通过不同初始化和不同更新流保持差异性。这样做的原因很现实：如果每次都用两套全参模型做 head-to-head RL，成本太高，也很难作为常规 recipe 复用。文本交换是当前版本的通信通道，作者提到 latent-space exchange 可能更高效，但留到后续工作。

从优化角度看，Agon 仍然建立在 stock GRPO trainer 上，没有改动核心优化器，只是改变 rollout 结构和 reward 设计。这一点和很多“新 RL 算法”不同，它更像是在采样与奖励层重新组织训练信号。作者还加入了 self-refinement control、zero-training orchestration control，以及 budget-matched 的 self-cascade GRPO control，用来区分“只是多一次推理/多一个模型串联”与“竞争式共同训练”之间的差别。
summary.experiments:
实验同样聚焦 hard math，并且强调 matched generation budget。主结论有三层。第一，带信息交换的双模型训练优于单模型 vanilla GRPO。第二，在有信息交换的前提下，竞争式训练优于合作式训练，支持“对抗压力比互助平均更能逼出有效推理”的假设。第三，收益在小模型上更明显，说明当单模型 reasoning ceiling 较低时，异构对手提供的额外信号更有用。

摘要给出的一个直观结果是：在相同的双倍推理预算下，训练后的 draft-and-challenge cascade 几乎把未训练的 Mixture-of-Agents 编排准确率翻倍，而后者相对普通 GRPO 几乎没有明显提升。这说明收益不只是来自 inference-time orchestration，而是来自训练过程中形成的互相适应与竞争。文中还提到 accuracy 的提升明显快于长度膨胀，对应它想解决的核心病灶：不是单纯让模型写更多。

从实验设计看，最关键的是 2×2：competition × exchange。作者还加入 self-refinement 作为“同一模型看自己草稿再改”的对照，用来支撑“自我闭环容易平台化”的论点。另一个重要细节是，他们把某个 cell 说明为在 group-relative normalization 下理论上不产生有效竞争信号，这种先验分析有助于避免把无意义对照读成负结果。全文片段没有暴露完整参数规模、训练步数和所有绝对分数，但可以确认作者关注的是 pass@1、长度变化、以及在相同生成预算下的公平比较，而不是只报一个最好看的终点数。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction，尤其是作者对“unscored trace”问题的表述：为什么 outcome reward 会鼓励更长而非更好的推理。然后直接看方法部分，抓住 Agon 的三个关键词：draft-and-challenge、role rotation、competitive reward。接着看 2×2 实验设计，理解为什么必须把 competition 和 exchange 拆开，以及为什么其中一个对照按构造是 inert。

图表上，优先看主结果表和长度/准确率关系图。如果论文给出了 trace length 的分布变化或 token-normalized gain，那些图比单纯 pass@1 更能说明方法是否真的改善了 reasoning quality。再看 self-refinement、cooperative exchange、untrained orchestration 这些控制组，判断收益究竟来自哪里。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若要深挖，建议重点想三件事。第一，双 adapter 是否真的能维持足够的策略差异，还是训练后会逐渐同质化。第二，竞争奖励会不会诱导“误导对手”的策略，而不一定提升对外部任务的真实可迁移推理能力。第三，文本级交换是否只是把更多上下文塞给第二个模型，收益里有多少来自额外条件信息，有多少来自竞争本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar pathology of outcome-only RL for reasoning: the reward grades only the final answer, not the reasoning trace, so on hard problems the model is often incentivized to write longer rather than think better. If a longer chain increases the chance of stumbling into the correct answer, GRPO reinforces that behavior. The result is inflated traces full of hedging, retries, and filler, with much weaker gains in reasoning quality per token. Direct process supervision is unattractive because there is no reliable, verifiable label for “good thinking.” The paper’s alternative is to let another model implicitly grade the usefulness of a trace through competition: if an opponent can read your work and still beat you, your reasoning did not create a robust advantage.
summary_en.importance: The interesting idea is to recast process reward as a game rather than a labeling problem. Instead of training a reward model to score intermediate reasoning steps, the method creates a competitive setting in which reasoning quality is revealed indirectly by whether a peer can exploit or overcome your trace. If that works, it offers a way to add a more process-sensitive signal without human process labels. A second important claim is that single-model self-improvement is structurally limited because it reinforces its own blind spots. A rival with different failure modes can break that loop. This is closer to self-play than to standard RLHF-style post-training, but the opponent here is another policy that can inspect your reasoning. The direct relevance to pretraining is limited; the stronger relevance is to post-training recipes that shape the distribution and quality of reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Agon trains two policies head-to-head with competitive GRPO. On each problem, one policy acts as a drafter and produces a worked solution; the other acts as a challenger, reads the opponent’s draft, and then attempts the same problem. Reward depends not only on correctness but also on out-solving the rival. Roles alternate across training steps so both policies learn both drafting and challenging.

The paper argues that two ingredients are necessary. First, there must be information exchange: the challenger needs access to the opponent’s reasoning, otherwise the setup cannot say anything about whether the trace itself is useful or exploitable. Second, the interaction must be competitive rather than cooperative. Pure cooperation or agreement-seeking tends to regress toward consensus and can dilute quality when the two models differ in strength. Competitive pressure instead rewards reasoning that remains strong even when exposed to a peer.

To isolate these effects, the paper uses a 2×2 design over competition versus cooperation and exchange versus no exchange. One cell, competition without exchange, is argued to be inert under group-relative normalization, so the meaningful comparison is adversarial exchange versus cooperative exchange. That analytical point matters because it prevents over-interpreting a control that is structurally unable to carry the intended signal.

Implementation is deliberately lightweight. Rather than training two full models, the authors instantiate the pair as two LoRA-style adapters on top of one frozen base, with roughly 2% extra memory overhead instead of 2× model cost. Different initialization and separate update streams are used to keep the two policies divergent. The communication channel is plain text in this version; latent-space exchange is mentioned as a future direction. Importantly, the optimization core remains a stock GRPO trainer. The novelty is in rollout structure and reward shaping, not in a new optimizer.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on hard math under matched generation budgets. The main findings are threefold. First, dual-model training with information exchange outperforms single-model vanilla GRPO. Second, given exchange, competitive training outperforms cooperative training, supporting the claim that adversarial pressure is more effective than mutual assistance for improving reasoning. Third, the gains are larger for smaller models, which is plausible because smaller models have lower reasoning ceilings and benefit more from an external source of signal.

A particularly useful result from the abstract is that, at the same doubled inference budget, the trained draft-and-challenge cascade nearly doubles the accuracy of an untrained Mixture-of-Agents orchestration over the same base, while the untrained orchestration itself barely improves over GRPO. That suggests the gain is not merely from adding another pass or another model at inference time; it comes from the co-training dynamics and the induced specialization under competition.

The evaluation design includes self-refinement as a control, which is important for the paper’s argument that self-auditing tends to plateau. It also includes zero-training orchestration and a budget-matched self-cascade GRPO control, helping separate “more inference structure” from “competitive joint training.” The excerpt does not expose the full parameter scales, training lengths, or all absolute scores, but it is clear that the paper tracks pass@1, reasoning length, and fairness under matched generation budgets rather than relying on a single cherry-picked endpoint.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction, especially the framing of the “unscored trace” problem. That section explains clearly why outcome-only reward can favor longer traces without improving reasoning quality. Then read the method section with three keywords in mind: draft-and-challenge, role rotation, and competitive reward. After that, go straight to the 2×2 experiment design to understand why competition and exchange must be disentangled, and why one control cell is structurally inert.

For figures and tables, prioritize the main results and any plots relating trace length to accuracy. If the paper reports token-normalized gains or changes in length distribution, those are more informative than pass@1 alone because they speak directly to the claimed mechanism. Then inspect the controls: self-refinement, cooperative exchange, and untrained orchestration. Those comparisons determine whether the method is learning better reasoning or merely exploiting extra context and extra passes.

Estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Three deeper questions are worth probing. First, do the two adapters remain meaningfully different over training, or do they gradually collapse toward similar policies? Second, can the competitive reward induce adversarially misleading traces that help beat the rival without improving true task-general reasoning? Third, since the challenger reads the draft in text, how much of the gain comes from extra conditional information versus competition itself?

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation：想法值得试，但双模型竞争很容易把 compute gain 伪装成训练信号改进。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only: the idea is worth testing, but two-model competition can easily confuse extra compute with a better training signal.

paper.title: Search, Fail, Recover: A Training Framework for Correction-Aware Reasoning
paper.abstract: Many reasoning tasks are not well described by a single left-to-right chain: a solver may need to pursue a plausible branch, observe delayed failure, and return to the latest prefix that can still be completed. We introduce Pyligent, a training and inference framework inspired by the Diligent Learner formulation that represents reasoning as validated search over partial solution chains. A task validator labels generated continuations and failures, and the resulting search trees are converted int

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：很多推理任务不是一条干净的从左到右 chain-of-thought，而是需要尝试分支、在延迟反馈后发现失败、再回到仍可修复的前缀。常规 SFT 只学习成功轨迹，几乎不教模型如何识别失败和恢复。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与推理数据构造有启发。它把“失败分支”也转成监督信号，训练模型显式执行 continue、finish、backtrack 三类动作。这个方向值得关注的原因是，它把搜索过程中的负样本、验证器反馈和恢复动作纳入训练目标，而不是只依赖更长的 CoT 或 test-time branching。对基座研究的间接价值在于：可用于构造更接近真实问题求解过程的 reasoning traces，也可帮助分析模型是否学会可恢复的搜索策略。
summary.technical_approach: 框架名为 Pyligent，受到 Diligent Learner 形式化的启发。系统维护一棵 ChainTree，每个节点是一个部分推理前缀。模型一次生成一个动作：<node> 表示继续写一步，<done> 表示给出最终答案，<backtrack> 表示回退到较早节点。训练分三阶段：先用金标准解法做 SFT-A，让模型掌握动作格式并具备非零概率生成有效下一步；再用模型从不同前缀采样，配合任务 validator 标注合法 continuation、失败叶子和失败原因；最后把搜索树转成 SFT-B 数据，包括成功 continuation、失败后的 backtrack target，以及可选的 traced recovery。reverse curriculum 从接近解尾部的前缀开始，再逐步移到根节点，降低早期学习难度。推理时 runtime 会检查 backtrack target，截断上下文并恢复到对应节点。为避免模型重复犯同一个错误，traced recovery 在回退后插入短 trace，记录失败原因和被放弃分支摘要；trace 不是模型预测目标，而是运行时提供的紧凑记忆。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖一个 hidden directed graph 任务，以及带精确 validator 的结构化推理任务，如 Sudoku 和 Blocksworld。hidden graph 用来隔离 delayed-failure recovery：局部合法动作可能在之后进入死路，因此模型必须学会在失败后回到正确分叉点。论文还比较 plain backtracking 与 traced recovery，后者用于减少重复探索同一失败分支。提供内容没有给出完整结果表、模型规模、训练样本量或提升百分比，因此不能确认具体增益幅度。可提取的实验洞察是：框架把 recovery 质量细分为是否回到可修复前缀，而不是只检查模型是否输出了 backtrack 语法。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看方法部分的 ChainTree 数据结构、SFT-A / exploration / SFT-B 三阶段流程、failure pair 的构造、reverse curriculum，以及 traced recovery 的设计。实验部分优先看 hidden directed graph，因为它最清楚地隔离了“延迟失败后恢复”这个能力；Sudoku 和 Blocksworld 更适合判断该框架能否迁移到有真实约束结构的任务。若关注训练数据合成，重点看 validator 如何把失败分支转成监督目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets reasoning tasks where a solution is not a single clean left-to-right chain. A solver may need to explore a plausible branch, observe delayed failure, and return to the latest prefix that can still be completed. Standard chain-of-thought supervision hides this process because it usually trains only on polished successful trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training and reasoning-data construction than to base pretraining itself. Its useful contribution is to turn failed branches into supervised learning signals. Instead of only teaching longer CoT or relying on test-time branching, it trains explicit continue, finish, and backtrack actions. For pretraining-oriented researchers, the indirect value is in how validator feedback, negative trajectories, and recovery behavior can be converted into structured reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pyligent implements a validated-search view of reasoning inspired by the Diligent Learner formulation. It maintains a ChainTree of partial reasoning states. The model emits one action at a time: <node> appends an intermediate step, <done> proposes a final answer, and <backtrack> returns control to an earlier node. Training has three stages. SFT-A teaches the action format and gives the model a nonzero probability of producing valid next steps. Validator-guided exploration samples continuations from selected prefixes and labels both successful continuations and failed leaves. SFT-B then trains on examples extracted from the resulting tree: success pairs, failure pairs with validator-derived backtrack targets, and optional continuation-after-trace pairs. A reverse curriculum starts exploration near the end of a gold chain and gradually moves toward the root. At inference time, the runtime validates backtrack targets and truncates the context accordingly. Traced recovery adds a compact trace after truncation, summarizing the abandoned branch and validator reason, so the model is less likely to repeat the same mistake.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include a hidden directed graph task and structured reasoning domains with exact validators, including Sudoku and Blocksworld. The hidden graph setting isolates delayed-failure recovery: locally legal moves can later reveal dead ends, so success requires returning to the right earlier decision point. The work also studies plain backtracking versus traced recovery, where traces preserve compact information about abandoned branches. The supplied content does not include full result tables, model sizes, data scale, or numeric improvements, so the empirical claims should be read as design-level evidence rather than quantified performance conclusions. A useful measurement detail is that recovery is evaluated by whether it returns to a repairable prefix, not merely by whether the model emits the backtrack token.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Prioritize the ChainTree construction, the three-stage SFT-A / exploration / SFT-B pipeline, failure-pair generation, reverse curriculum, and traced recovery. The hidden directed graph experiment is the cleanest test of delayed-failure recovery. Sudoku and Blocksworld are useful for judging whether the method extends to structured domains with exact validators. For reasoning-data work, the most relevant part is how validator-labeled failures are converted into supervised targets.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和数据构造，不是因为任务强，而是它把“失败分支”变成可监督对象；§训练目标最该复现。
recommendation.en: Read the training-target design, not the toy tasks; the useful move is turning failed branches into supervised recovery signals.

paper.title: MILES: Modular Instruction Memory with Learnable Selection for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly improve their reasoning at test time via additional computation, yet most existing works treat each problem in isolation. When problems arrive sequentially, accumulating reusable experience across them can further improve performance. Existing memory-based methods either store whole-solution templates that generalize poorly to novel problems or use heuristic step-level selection that is not optimized for final-answer correctness. Learning selection polic

summary.core_problem: 解决顺序到达问题场景下，LLM 如何在测试时积累并复用可迁移经验，以持续改进推理表现的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 test-time self-improvement / memory-augmented reasoning 方向的方法工作。对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对理解测试时计算、经验复用和 post-train 信号设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MILES：把历史经验拆成模块化 instruction memory 单元，而不是存整条解题模板；再通过可学习的选择机制，从不断扩张的记忆库中组合出对当前问题有帮助的步骤级指令。其设计目标是在固定动作空间、外部标注语料和额外微调都受限的现实 test-time 条件下，仍能根据最终答案正确性优化记忆选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模和训练数据规模。实验重点应是与整题模板记忆、启发式 step-level 选择、以及需要额外训练数据的选择策略比较，验证在顺序问题流中能更稳定提升最终答案正确率。由于缺少具体数字和 setup 细节，当前只能视作中等强度证据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)。未见该方向头部实验室或广为人知的代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how an LLM can accumulate and reuse experience across sequentially arriving problems to improve reasoning at test time.
summary_en.importance: This is a method paper in test-time self-improvement and memory-augmented reasoning. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may inform how reusable experience and post-train signals interact with inference-time compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: MILES stores modular instruction-memory units instead of full solution templates, then learns to compose useful step-level memory pieces under realistic test-time constraints. The selection mechanism is optimized toward final-answer correctness without assuming a fixed action space, external labeled corpora, or additional fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or training data. The likely comparisons are against whole-solution memory, heuristic step-level retrieval, and methods requiring extra supervision, showing better answer accuracy over sequential problem streams. Without concrete numbers or setup details, the evidence should be treated as moderate rather than decisive.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney). No clearly identifiable top-lab affiliation or widely known authors in this niche are evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系偏间接，但若你关心 inference-time learning，可只看 memory 单元设计与选择目标；别先被“self-improving”这个词带跑。
recommendation.en: Only indirectly relevant to pretraining, but worth a skim if you care about inference-time learning; focus on the memory-unit design and selection objective, not the 'self-improving' branding.

paper.title: Most LLM Conformity Needs No Speaker: Measuring the Speaker-Free Floor in Peer-Pressure Benchmarks
paper.abstract: LLM conformity is often used to describe cases where a model changes a correct answer toward a peer or group response. We show that most of this apparent conformity survives even after the peer is removed. The reason is a confound: standard conformity prompts mix two cues at once, the presence of a speaker and the repeated wrong answer itself. Existing benchmarks vary these cues together, so they cannot tell how much of the revision actually depends on the speaker. We introduce a no-source condi

summary.core_problem: 重新测量 LLM 在 peer-pressure benchmark 中的从众现象，区分“有说话者”与“重复错误答案本身”两个混杂因素。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析和评测诊断：指出很多所谓 LLM conformity 可能不是社会性从众，而是模型对重复答案断言的顺从或锚定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 no-source condition：保留同一个被断言的答案，但去掉明确说话者；再与普通 re-ask、有来源 framing、paraphrase 和开放式回答条件比较。
summary.experiments: 在 6 个开源 LLM 和 7 个 QA / reasoning 数据集上测试。no-source 条件在最初答对的样本中造成 66.5% harmful revision，而普通 re-ask 只有 10.3%；重复答案改写、隐藏选项后的开放式设置中效应仍存在。expert-panel framing 会提高该 floor，简单 person label 影响有限。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Illinois Institute of Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures whether apparent LLM conformity in peer-pressure prompts actually requires a peer speaker.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanism and evaluation-confound analysis: much of the measured conformity may come from repeated wrong-answer assertions rather than social pressure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a no-source condition that keeps the asserted answer but removes the explicit speaker, then compare it with plain re-asking, source framing, paraphrasing, and open-ended variants.
summary_en.experiments: Across six open-weight LLMs and seven QA/reasoning datasets, the no-source condition causes harmful revision in 66.5% of initially correct cases, compared with 10.3% under a plain re-ask. The effect remains under paraphrasing and when answer options are hidden; expert-panel framing increases it, while minimal person labels do not.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Illinois Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 结论对行为评测很有用：看 no-source 对照即可，别把重复错误答案误读成社会从众。
recommendation.en: Useful for behavioral evaluation: inspect the no-source control, and do not mistake repeated wrong answers for social conformity.

paper.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a powerful recipe for improving language-model reasoning, but it is expensive to repeat on every new strong model because the target model must generate many rollouts during training. As models scale, post-training itself becomes a bottleneck. We study a weak-to-strong alternative: run RL on a smaller model where rollouts are cheaper, then reuse what that RL run learned to improve a stronger target model. Directly distilling the post-RL we

summary.core_problem: RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）已成为提升LLM推理能力的主流后训练方案，但其训练成本与目标模型规模绑定：每次更新都需要当前策略生成大量rollout，模型越大每轮RL越昂贵。当推理模型持续扩展时，从零开始为每个新强模型重复RLVR会使后训练本身成为瓶颈。直接蒸馏小模型RL后的最终策略效果很差，因为小模型的最终策略混合了RL带来的有用改进与小模型本身的能力上限，会覆盖学生模型已有的更强行为。
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的弱到强后训练范式：把小模型RL当作可迁移监督信号的廉价生成器，而非要模仿的最终教师。该范式将后训练成本与目标模型规模部分解耦，显著降低了大模型推理增强的计算开销。对预训练研究的核心启示是：RL学到的改进可以以「策略偏移量」的形式在模型间传递，不必依赖显式奖励模型，也不必在大模型上重跑完整RL流程；这为预训练-后训练闭环中的信号复用与跨模型知识迁移提供了新机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Direct On-Policy Distillation（Direct-OPD），核心是不蒸馏小模型RL后的最终策略π_T，而是蒸馏其RL前后的策略偏移量Δ_T = log π_T - log π_{T_ref}，其中π_{T_ref}是RL前的小模型参考策略。这个偏移量只保留RL引起的概率变化，丢弃小模型原有的偏好，从而避免把小模型的能力上限传递给学生。数学上证明：在KL正则化的RL目标下，该策略偏移量等价于训练小模型的奖励信号，对其优化可恢复与原RL相同的目标形式。训练时学生在自身的on-policy状态上采样，用偏移量作为隐式奖励，并以学生初始模型为锚点加KL约束，无需训练显式奖励模型，也无需在目标模型上执行稀疏奖励RL。
summary.experiments: 使用两组教师对（R1-Distill-1.5B→JustRL-1.5B、Nemotron-1.5B→QuestA-Nemotron-1.5B）和三个不同家族的学生模型（R1-Distill-7B、Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B），所有学生均获得提升，包括初始能力已超过RL后小教师的R1-Distill-7B和Qwen3-4B。Qwen3-1.7B在AIME 2024上从48.3提升至62.4，仅需8张A100运行约4小时，效果与Polaris用32张A100在Qwen3-1.7B上直接跑RL一周相当。在相同RL步数下，先在1.5B模型跑RL再用Direct-OPD迁移，在准确率和计算效率上均优于直接在R1-Distill-7B上跑RL。分析表明该方法不依赖师生间的top-k重叠，可跨思维模式迁移，并识别出了隐式奖励与验证准确率保持一致的响应长度和KL条件。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第2.2节的数学证明，理解策略偏移量与KL正则化RL目标的等价性，这是整个方法成立的核心；第1节图1的失败案例（vanilla OPD拉低学生性能）与成功案例对照阅读，建立直观认识；第3节实验部分重点看跨模型家族、跨师生能力关系的迁移结果，以及4小时vs一周的成本对比；第4节分析部分关注响应长度、KL阈值与信号可靠性的关系，这是实际落地时的关键调参依据。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) has become the dominant post-training recipe for improving LLM reasoning, but its cost scales with the target model size: each update requires the current policy to generate many rollouts, and larger models make each RL iteration more expensive. As reasoning models continue to scale, re-running RLVR from scratch for every new strong model risks turning post-training itself into a bottleneck. Directly distilling the final post-RL policy of a small model performs poorly, because the final policy entangles useful RL-induced improvements with the intrinsic capacity limits of the smaller model, and can overwrite stronger behavior already present in the student.
summary_en.importance: It introduces a new weak-to-strong post-training paradigm that treats small-model RL as a cheap generator of transferable supervision rather than a final teacher to imitate. The paradigm partially decouples post-training cost from target model size, substantially reducing the compute overhead of reasoning enhancement for large models. The core implication for pretraining research is that RL-learned improvements can be transferred across models in the form of a policy shift, without requiring an explicit reward model or a full RL rerun on the large model; this opens a new mechanism for signal reuse and cross-model knowledge transfer in the pretrain-posttrain loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) does not distill the final post-RL small-model policy π_T, but instead distills the policy shift Δ_T = log π_T - log π_{T_ref}, where π_{T_ref} is the small-model reference policy before RL. This shift retains only the probability changes caused by RL and discards the small model's original preferences, avoiding the transfer of the teacher's capacity limits to the student. It is mathematically proven that under a KL-regularized RL objective, this policy shift is equivalent to the reward signal that trained the small model: optimizing against it recovers the same objective form as the original RL. During training, the student samples on its own on-policy states, uses the shift as an implicit reward, and is anchored to its own initialization via a KL term — no explicit reward model training or sparse-reward RL on the target model is required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with two teacher pairs (R1-Distill-1.5B→JustRL-1.5B, Nemotron-1.5B→QuestA-Nemotron-1.5B) and three students from two families (R1-Distill-7B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B). All students improve, including R1-Distill-7B and Qwen3-4B whose initial performance already exceeds the post-RL weak teacher. Qwen3-1.7B improves from 48.3 to 62.4 on AIME 2024 in roughly 4 hours on 8 A100 GPUs, on par with Polaris running RL directly on Qwen3-1.7B for at least a week on 32 A100 GPUs. At matched RL steps, running RL on a 1.5B model plus Direct-OPD transfer outperforms running RL directly on R1-Distill-7B in both accuracy and compute efficiency. Analysis shows the method does not rely on teacher-student top-k overlap and transfers across thinking patterns; response-length and KL conditions under which the implicit reward stays aligned with validation accuracy are identified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2.2 carefully for the mathematical proof that policy shift is equivalent to the KL-regularized RL reward — this is the theoretical foundation of the entire method. Contrast the vanilla-OPD failure case and Direct-OPD success case in Figure 1 (Section 1) to build intuition. In Section 3, focus on transfer results across model families and across teacher-student ability relationships, as well as the 4-hour-vs-one-week cost comparison. Section 4 analysis on response length, KL thresholds and signal reliability is critical for practical tuning and deployment.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；log-ratio policy shift 比蒸馏弱教师输出更干净，适合内测 RLVR 复用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the log-ratio policy-shift signal is cleaner than distilling weak-teacher outputs and is worth testing for RLVR reuse.

paper.title: ACPO: Adaptive Credit Policy Optimization via Fine-Grained Surrogate Entropy
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but sparse outcome rewards still make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing scalable RL methods typically assign trajectory-level rewards uniformly across tokens, while recent entropy-aware approaches either rely on coarse detached heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, which can introduce non-local gradient components misaligned with sampled-token policy updates. We p

summary.core_problem: 在基于结果奖励的强化学习（如 GRPO）中，稀疏的标量奖励导致 token 级别的信用分配（credit assignment）困难，而现有的基于熵的分配方法要么依赖粗糙的启发式规则，要么直接优化真实熵，这会引入与采样 token 策略更新不一致的梯度噪声。
summary.importance: 提出了一种细粒度的自适应信用分配框架 ACPO，在不依赖昂贵的过程奖励模型（PRM）的情况下，通过代理熵有效地解决了稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题，提升了 RL 在推理任务中的训练稳定性和性能。
summary.technical_approach: ACPO 引入了基于“局部模式代理熵”（mode-local surrogate entropy）的 token 级权重方案，动态调节优势估计（advantage estimates）。核心机制是不对称处理：在成功的轨迹中，放大高不确定性（高熵）决策的权重，认为这些是关键的推理分叉点；在失败的轨迹中，惩罚过度自信（低熵）的错误 token。通过使用代理熵，ACPO 避免了直接优化真实熵带来的全分布梯度噪声，确保了策略梯度的方向一致性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 三个基座模型上进行了实验。在多个推理基准测试中，ACPO 稳定超越了 GRPO、DAPO 和 SAPO 等强 RL 基线，证明了在稀疏结果监督下，基于代理熵的信用分配的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4.3 对真实熵梯度不一致性的理论分析，以及代理熵的数学推导。实验部分关注 ACPO 与 GRPO 在不同模型规模下的性能对比。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In outcome-based reinforcement learning (e.g., GRPO), sparse scalar rewards make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing entropy-based methods either rely on coarse heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, introducing gradient noise misaligned with sampled-token policy updates.
summary_en.importance: Proposes ACPO, a fine-grained adaptive credit assignment framework that effectively solves the credit assignment problem under sparse rewards without relying on expensive Process Reward Models (PRMs), improving RL training stability and performance in reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACPO introduces a token-level weighting scheme based on a 'mode-local surrogate entropy' to dynamically modulate advantage estimates. The core mechanism is asymmetric: in successful trajectories, it emphasizes highly uncertain (high-entropy) decisions, treating them as critical reasoning forks; in failed trajectories, it penalizes overconfident (low-entropy) incorrect tokens. By using surrogate entropy, ACPO avoids the full-distribution gradient noise of true entropy, preserving the intended policy-gradient direction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill, and Qwen3-8B-Base. ACPO consistently outperformed strong RL baselines like GRPO, DAPO, and SAPO across multiple reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of surrogate-entropy-based credit assignment under sparse outcome supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.3 for the theoretical analysis of true entropy gradient misalignment and the derivation of surrogate entropy. In the experiments, compare ACPO's performance with GRPO across different model scales. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；它抓住了 RLVR 的真问题，但 surrogate entropy 的假设要等完整实验验证。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; it targets a real RLVR bottleneck, but the surrogate-entropy assumptions need cleaner empirical support.

paper.title: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation is a powerful way to transfer reasoning ability from a strong teacher to a smaller student: the student samples trajectories from its own policy, and the teacher provides dense token-level supervision on the states the student actually visits. However, this supervision is not always reliable: a teacher can assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions that follow different reasoning paths. Unconditionally distil

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（在线策略蒸馏）将大模型教师的推理能力迁移到学生模型时，教师信号并非总是可靠：教师可能给似是而非的错误解分配高似然，也可能给学生探索出的正确新路分配低似然；无条件蒸馏会强化错误模式或抹掉学生有用的行为，而稀疏验证器奖励又无法提供逐token的密集学习信号。
summary.importance: 提出了一种简单有效的门控机制，将稀疏验证器奖励与密集教师logits直接桥接，在保留逐token蒸馏密度的同时避免了无条件蒸馏的核心失效模式。对后训练阶段的推理能力蒸馏、RLVR与知识蒸馏的结合有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是奖励-教师似然门（Reward-Teacher Likelihood Gate）。对每条学生采样轨迹，同时获取轨迹级奖励（实验中使用GRPO优势）和轨迹级教师-学生对数似然差。门控规则：奖励为正的轨迹，仅当教师似然高于学生时才参与蒸馏损失；奖励为负的轨迹，仅当教师似然低于学生时才参与蒸馏损失。其余轨迹从蒸馏损失中剔除。蒸馏损失本身沿用top-k reverse-KL形式不变，仅通过改变参与损失的轨迹集合实现筛选。
summary.experiments: 使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/14B-Instruct作为师生对，在UltraInteract子集上训练3轮。RG-OPD平均得分46.94，优于vanilla Reverse-KL基线（44.02）高2.9分，优于TSD-KD（42.03）。数学和编码任务上提升一致；例外是IFEval任务，TSD-KD得分54.68，RG-OPD为48.60，作者归因于TSD-KD以学生为中心的设计结合了偏好间接反馈与token选择性蒸馏等机制。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章方法部分的门控规则定义与两种失效模式分析；第3章实验结果与不同任务的差异表现。泛读预计15-20分钟。值得关注的点：门控机制与GRPO优势结合的细节，以及在不同任务上表现差异的深层原因。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy distillation for reasoning transfer, teacher supervision is not always reliable: a teacher may assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions following different reasoning paths. Unconditional distillation can either reinforces bad modes or erases useful student behaviors, while sparse verifier rewards cannot provide dense token-level learning signals.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a simple yet effective gating mechanism that bridges sparse verifier rewards and dense teacher logits, retaining the density of token-level distillation while avoiding the central failure mode of unconditional distillation. It has direct reference value for reasoning capability distillation during post-training and the combination of RLVR and knowledge distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is the Reward-Teacher Likelihood Gate. For each student-sampled trajectory, both trajectory-level reward (GRPO advantage in experiments) and trajectory-level teacher-student log-likelihood gap are computed. The gating rule: for reward-positive trajectories, only distill when teacher likelihood is higher than student; for reward-negative trajectories, only distill when teacher likelihood is lower than student. All other trajectories are dropped from the distillation loss. The distillation loss itself remains top-k reverse-KL; only the set of trajectories contributing to the loss is filtered.
summary_en.experiments: Uses Qwen2.5-1.5B/14B-Instruct as teacher-student pair, trained for 3 epochs on a subset of UltraInteract. RG-OPD achieves average score 46.94, 2.9 points above vanilla Reverse-KL baseline (44.02) and above TSD-KD (42.03). Gains are consistent across math and coding tasks. An exception is IFEval where TSD-KD scores 54.68 vs RG-OPD's 48.60, attributed to TSD-KD's student-centric design combining preference-based indirect feedback and token-selective distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the gating rule definition and analysis of two failure modes; Section 3 for experimental results and task-wise performance differences. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes for skim. Worth noting: details of gating combined with GRPO advantage, and root causes of performance differences across tasks.

recommendation.zh: 结合了 verifier reward 和 teacher logits 的蒸馏方法，解决了 teacher 强行纠正 student 正确但不同 reasoning path 的问题，对 post-training 数据合成有启发。
recommendation.en: Combines verifier reward and teacher logits for distillation, solving the issue of teachers penalizing correct but alternative reasoning paths; inspiring for post-training data synthesis.

paper.title: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is effective when the current policy already samples useful reasoning trajectories, but it stalls on hard prompts whose correct solution modes lie outside the student's on-policy support. We propose TREK (Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL), a simple staged procedure that uses distillation not for imitation but for exploration support expansion. A key advantage of TREK is its generality: because it only consumes verified output trajectories, it ca

summary.core_problem: GRPO 在困难推理提示上会遇到 on-policy 探索覆盖不足的问题：当学生策略几乎抽不到任何正确轨迹时，加大采样组规模或调整优势函数都只是在当前策略支撑集内搜索，奖励信号无法到达真正的解题模式。论文要解决的是如何在不依赖教师内部参数/logits 的前提下，为 on-policy RL 安全、可控地扩展可采样的解空间。
summary.importance: 这是 post-train/RL 推理训练方向上一个有实际工程价值的 recipe 观察：把蒸馏从“模仿教师”重新定位为“探索支持集扩展”，并给出一个与黑盒教师、白盒教师、同模型带额外上下文推理（执行反馈、反思、更长思考预算）都兼容的接口。对预训练研究的直接启发在于：它明确区分了“把已有高概率行为学精”和“把之前根本采不到的行为拉进策略支撑集”这两个训练阶段，对理解 annealing、mid-training 往 RL 的接口也有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: TREK 是一个分阶段流程：先用无辅助学生的 pass rate 识别 hard prompts，只对这些 prompt 调用 proposal 源（可以是外部黑盒强模型，也可以是同模型加 reflection/执行反馈/长 rollout），用 verifier 过滤出正确轨迹，再按当前学生策略下的似然选出最接近学生当前分布的 top-r 条样本，对这些轨迹做一小段 forward KL(q_prop || π_θ) 的 warm-start 蒸馏，最后回到标准 GRPO 流里继续 on-policy 精炼。关键设计选择是用 forward KL 而不是 reverse KL：目标是把学生没覆盖到的新解模式往策略里注入概率质量，而不是让学生在已有模式上精确拟合教师；同时只选“学生当前可达”的 proposal，避免把过于远端、与当前策略脱节的轨迹硬塞进来导致训练不稳。
summary.experiments: 在 agentic 推理任务上，TREK 相比纯 GRPO 显著加速早期训练，尤其在最难任务类型上收益明显：通过在 RL 开始前注入经过验证的解模式，学生更快达到高成功率，而纯 GRPO 需要多得多的训练步才能到达同等水平。论文给出的 ablation 要点包括：prompt 级路由（只在 hard prompts 上调教师）优于全量蒸馏；按学生似然筛选 proposal 比随机/贪心选更好；forward KL warm-start 作为探索注入比直接 imitation/reverse KL 更适合后续 GRPO 衔接；黑盒教师和同模型上下文增强两种 proposal 源都有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Introduction 里对 GRPO 失效模式的刻画、Method 里 forward-KL proposal learning 的推导动机，以及 experiments 中关于 hard prompt 筛选率 r 和 warm-start 步数的消融。预计阅读 25–35 分钟。不需要逐行跟 RL 目标公式推导，抓三件事即可：为什么 on-policy 在 hard prompt 上失效、为什么蒸馏应该作为 proposal 而不是 imitation、为什么用 forward KL 与学生似然筛选来控制注入的“距离”。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO stalls on hard prompts when the student policy puts too little mass on any correct reasoning trajectory. The bottleneck is not reward sparsity on sampled trajectories, but lack of exploration beyond the student’s current on-policy support. The paper asks how to expand that support safely without requiring white-box access to a teacher.
summary_en.importance: The useful reframing is to treat distillation as exploration support expansion rather than imitation or token-level credit shaping. The proposed staged recipe is compatible with black-box teachers, white-box teachers, and same-model context augmentation (execution feedback, reflection, longer reasoning budgets). For pretraining researchers, this matters as a clean case study of the distinction between sharpening behaviors already inside the model’s support and pulling new modes into that support before RL refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: TREK proceeds in stages. It first identifies hard prompts using unaided student pass rate, invokes a proposal source only on those prompts, filters proposals with a verifier, keeps the top-r verified trajectories by current student likelihood, runs a short forward-KL(q_prop || π_θ) warm-start on those trajectories, and then returns control to ordinary GRPO. The central design choice is forward KL rather than reverse KL: the objective is to add probability mass to newly discovered solution modes that are still reachable from the current student, not to precisely clone teacher behavior. The student-likelihood filter explicitly avoids forcing in trajectories too far from the current policy.
summary_en.experiments: On agentic tasks, TREK improves final success rate and materially accelerates early training, especially on the hardest task types. Injecting verified solution modes before GRPO lets the student reach high success rates much earlier than unaided GRPO. Reported ablations support the main design choices: routing proposals only to hard prompts is better than blanket distillation, ranking proposals by student likelihood outperforms alternative selection rules, and forward-KL warm-start integrates better with subsequent on-policy GRPO than imitation-style objectives. Both black-box teachers and same-model context augmentation work as proposal sources.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a methods/recipe paper rather than a theory paper. Focus on the introduction’s diagnosis of GRPO’s support-coverage failure mode, the justification for forward-KL proposal learning in Method, and ablations on routing, proposal selection, and warm-start length. Skip the detailed GRPO formula rewrites if you already know the algorithm. Time estimate: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对GRPO探索不足的核心痛点，蒸馏做探索的思路可迁移到预训练数据课程设计，重点看前向KL阶段的实现细节
recommendation.en: Targets GRPO's core exploration bottleneck; the distillation-for-exploration idea transfers to pretraining data curriculum design, focus on forward-KL phase implementation

paper.title: Purified OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation Without Losing How to Think
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher with access to reference solutions provides token-level supervision on the student's own generated trajectories. However, we find that OPSD consistently fails on long chain-of-thought (long-CoT) reasoning models, yielding at best marginal gains while destabilizing the reflective reasoning capability these models depend on. Through a novel decomposition of the teacher's s

summary.core_problem: 现有在线自蒸馏（OPSD）方法应用于长链思考（long-CoT）推理模型时，仅能带来边际短期收益，甚至会破坏模型原生的反思推理能力，导致性能退化、反思类认知标记（如Wait、Let me think等不确定性外化token）出现异常波动。
summary.importance: 明确诊断了OPSD在长思考模型上失效的核心机制，给出了可无缝接入现有OPSD框架的修正方案，对推理模型蒸馏、后训练阶段的监督信号提纯有直接工程参考价值，也解释了行业内普遍观察到的“蒸馏把模型变笨”现象的成因。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将教师的监督信号拆解为两个独立分量：一是仅输入参考答案就能产生的参考诱导分量，驱动学生死记硬背参考路径的专属捷径，属于非可迁移的有害信号；二是结合问题语境产生的问题条件分量，承载可泛化的推理校正，是真正有价值的训练信号。实验验证训练过程中参考诱导分量占据了更新方向和模长的主导，有价值的可迁移分量甚至与总更新方向正交或反向。基于点互信息（PMI）构造提纯后的蒸馏目标：用全条件教师分布的log概率减去仅看答案的参考教师分布的log概率，滤除捷径信号后保留可迁移的推理校正，直接替换原有OPSD的教师分布即可使用，单个超参数β控制校正强度。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-8B、R1-Distill-Qwen-7B等4个长CoT模型上的系统评估显示，标准OPSD训练会引发反思认知标记的病态波动（Qwen3上反思token总数暴跌，R1蒸馏版上Wait单token数量异常暴涨），性能无稳定提升；提纯后的OPSD可获得稳定的性能增益，同时保留基座模型原生的反思行为模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注信号分解部分的分析逻辑和Figure 3的更新方向对齐可视化，这是整篇工作的核心洞察；方法实现部分篇幅很短，10分钟即可理清落地逻辑，无需过度纠结公式推导。总预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) pipelines deliver at best marginal short-term gains when applied to long chain-of-thought reasoning models, and often actively destabilize the reflective reasoning behaviors that underpin these models' generalization, causing consistent performance degradation and pathological fluctuations in epistemic reflection markers (e.g. tokens indicating uncertainty and self-correction such as Wait, Let me think).
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the concrete root cause of OPSD failure on long-CoT models, and provides a drop-in fix fully compatible with standard OPSD implementations. The diagnosis of shortcut-dominated supervision also offers a general analytical lens for evaluating distillation and alignment training pipelines for reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The teacher supervision signal is decomposed into two separate components: a reference-induced component that activates even when the teacher only sees the gold answer, which drives rote memorization of reference-specific reasoning shortcuts and is non-transferable; and a question-conditioned component that depends on the problem context, which carries transferable reasoning corrections and is the only useful training signal. Measurements across training checkpoints show the reference-induced component dominates both the direction and magnitude of parameter updates, while the useful transferable component is often nearly orthogonal or even anti-aligned with the total update. The purified distillation target is constructed via a pointwise mutual information adjustment: subtracting the log-probability of a reference-only teacher (conditioned solely on the answer, not the question) from the full teacher log-probability to strip shortcut signals, leaving only transferable corrections. This target directly replaces the raw teacher distribution in standard OPSD, with a single hyperparameter β controlling correction strength.
summary_en.experiments: Across four long-CoT models including Qwen3-8B and R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, standard OPSD causes pathological fluctuation of epistemic markers (collapse of total reflection token counts on Qwen3-8B, explosion of the single token Wait on R1-Distill-Qwen-7B) with no stable performance gain. Purified OPSD delivers consistent performance improvements across testbeds, while preserving the native reflective behavior of the base model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the supervision signal decomposition logic and the update direction alignment visualization in Figure 3, which forms the core diagnostic insight of the paper. The method implementation section is concise and takes ~10 minutes to parse; no need to dwell on formal derivations. Total expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: OPSD失效根因的诊断很扎实，监督信号分解的思路对后训练数据/损失设计有直接启发，重点看§3的信号分解部分。
recommendation.en: Solid diagnosis of OPSD failure; the supervision signal decomposition idea directly informs post-training data/loss design. Focus on §3.

paper.title: DemoPSD: Disagreement-Modulated Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a practical method for training large language models (LLMs) to reason, where a single model acts as both the teacher and the student with different levels of information access. However, recent studies have found that the teacher's dense token-level supervision, conditioned on privileged information, can lead to overfitting to in-domain patterns, suppress exploration, and hurt cross-domain generalization, while also introducing a more fundamenta

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 OPSD 中的 privileged information leakage：教师看到答案、验证轨迹或其他测试时不可见的信息后，会在 token 级分布里携带答案相关捷径；学生如果逐 token 拟合这个教师分布，短期可能涨分，但会过拟合域内模式、压制探索，并损害跨域推理能力。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。它指出密集蒸馏信号并不总是比标量奖励更安全；如果教师条件信息和测试条件不一致，token-level supervision 也会变成泄漏通道。对基座训练来说，这提醒数据合成、拒绝采样、过程监督和自蒸馏都要区分“可迁移推理信号”和“答案条件化信号”。方法贡献的量级属于目标函数修正和 token-level gating，不是训练范式重做。
summary.technical_approach: DemoPSD 的核心是 selective adoption of teacher guidance。标准 OPSD 让学生在每个 token 上拟合带 privileged information 的教师分布；DemoPSD 改为构造 reverse-KL barycenter target，也就是教师分布和学生分布的加权几何组合。每个 token 有一个 leakage attenuation coefficient α_t，由教师和学生分布之间的 disagreement 决定。当两者分布接近时，说明 privileged information 没有明显改变教师预测，目标更接近教师，学生可以吸收教师指导；当两者分歧大时，说明教师可能被答案或解题轨迹强烈条件化，目标向学生自身分布回退，减少对不可用信息的拟合。它和 teacher entropy、student entropy、sample correctness、多教师一致性等代理信号的区别在于：它直接看教师相对学生发生了多大分布偏移，而不是只判断教师是否自信或样本是否答对。
summary.experiments: 给定内容主要包含问题设定和方法动机，没有给出完整实验表格、模型规模、数据规模、训练步数或具体分数。可确认的实验主张是：DemoPSD 面向标准 OPSD 中早期提升、后期退化的泄漏问题，预期通过分歧调制的蒸馏目标改善跨域泛化，并降低教师 privileged information 对学生的负迁移。精读时需要核对三类证据：与 GRPO、标准 OPSD、entropy-gated distillation 的对比；训练曲线是否缓解 late-stage degradation；高 disagreement token 是否确实集中在答案泄漏、数值结果或 solution-revealing steps 上。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟，若实验完整可再花 20 分钟看消融。方法部分重点看 reverse-KL barycenter target 的推导、α_t 的具体函数形式、disagreement 用 KL 还是其他距离度量，以及是否 stop-gradient 到学生分布。实验部分优先找 token-level 分析，而不只看最终准确率。关键问题是：DemoPSD 是否只是降低蒸馏强度，还是能选择性保留有迁移性的教师信号；这需要看 disagreement 分桶、跨域结果和长期训练曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses privileged-information leakage in on-policy self-distillation. In OPSD, the teacher is the same model conditioned on information unavailable at test time, such as the answer or a verified reasoning trace. Matching this teacher at every token can make the student learn answer-dependent shortcuts, yielding early gains but weaker exploration, in-domain overfitting, and poorer transfer.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to the interface between post-training and base-model training. It makes a useful point: dense token-level supervision is not automatically safer than scalar rewards. If the teacher has access to information that the student will not see at inference time, token-level distillation can become a leakage channel. This matters for self-distillation, synthetic reasoning data, process supervision, and RL-style reasoning training. The contribution is best viewed as an objective-level correction for OPSD, not as a new large-scale training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: DemoPSD introduces selective adoption of teacher guidance. Instead of forcing the student to match the privileged teacher distribution at every token, it trains the student toward a reverse-KL barycenter target: a weighted geometric combination of the teacher and student distributions. The per-token coefficient, denoted as α_t in the provided text, is determined by teacher-student disagreement. When the two distributions are close, the privileged context has not shifted the teacher much, so the target remains near the teacher. When disagreement is large, the teacher is likely influenced by privileged information, and the target moves back toward the student distribution. This differs from entropy gates, correctness-based routing, or multi-teacher consensus because it measures the distributional shift caused by the privileged teacher relative to the student, rather than using confidence or final outcome as an indirect proxy.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not include the full experimental section, exact model sizes, data scale, training budget, or numerical results. The evaluative claim is that DemoPSD is designed to reduce the early-improvement-then-degradation pattern observed in standard OPSD and to improve cross-domain generalization by attenuating leakage-heavy tokens. The key evidence to check in the full experiments would be comparisons against GRPO, vanilla OPSD, entropy-gated distillation, and other leakage-aware variants; long training curves showing whether late-stage degradation is mitigated; and token-level diagnostics showing that high-disagreement positions align with answer-revealing or solution-specific tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim should cover the core idea. Spend most of the time on the derivation of the reverse-KL barycenter target, the exact form of α_t, the disagreement metric, and whether gradients are stopped through the student distribution used in the target. If the experimental section is available, inspect token-level analyses rather than only final accuracy. The central question is whether DemoPSD selectively preserves transferable teacher guidance, or merely weakens distillation overall; disagreement buckets, out-of-domain results, and long-horizon training curves are the right places to verify this.

recommendation.zh: 反向KL重心的思路对理解自蒸馏与RL的边界有启发，重点看方法部分的目标分布构造，实验部分待验证。
recommendation.en: The reverse-KL barycenter idea is insightful for understanding the boundary between self-distillation and RL; focus on the target distribution construction in the method section, experimental claims need verification.

paper.title: Revisiting Chain-of-Thought Reasoning under Limited Supervision: Semi-supervised Chain-of-Thought Learning
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has emerged as an effective approach for activating latent reasoning capabilities in large language models. However, most existing CoT methods use reasoning chains mainly as inference-time prompts, while the generated reasoning traces are rarely reused as semi-supervised learning signals. In this report, we define \textbf{Semi-supervised Chain-of-Thought Learning} and propose \textbf{Semi-CoT}, a simple framework that uses unlabeled questions to construct pseudo

summary.core_problem: 现有CoT方法多将推理链用作推理时提示，生成的推理轨迹很少被复用为半监督学习信号，限制了未标注数据的利用效率
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出半监督CoT学习框架，将CoT的自训练视图从推理时优化扩展至半监督伪监督
summary.technical_approach: 提出Semi-CoT框架，对每个未标注问题采样多个伪CoT，计算答案级语义熵，选择低熵推理链作为可靠伪监督信号用于模型训练
summary.experiments: 在AQuA、SVAMP、GSM8K、MultiArith数据集上开展初步实验，熵门控筛选的伪答案精度达91.36%及以上

summary_en.core_problem: Existing CoT methods mostly use reasoning chains as inference-time prompts, while generated reasoning traces are rarely reused as semi-supervised learning signals, limiting unlabeled data utilization.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first proposes a semi-supervised CoT learning framework, extending the self-training view of CoT from inference-time refinement to semi-supervised pseudo-supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Semi-CoT framework: samples multiple pseudo-CoTs for each unlabeled question, estimates answer-level semantic entropy, and selects low-entropy reasoning chains as reliable pseudo-supervision for training.
summary_en.experiments: Pilot experiments on AQuA, SVAMP, GSM8K, and MultiArith show the entropy gate selects high-precision pseudo-CoTs, with pseudo-answer precision ranging from 91.36% upward.

recommendation.zh: 半监督伪标签的熵筛选思路对预训练数据质量过滤有一定借鉴意义，但仅为初步实验，结论有限。
recommendation.en: The entropy-based pseudo-label filtering idea offers minor inspiration for pretraining data quality filtering, but only includes pilot experiments with limited conclusions.

paper.title: CheckRLM: Effective Knowledge-Thought Coherence Checking in Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) have significantly improved performance on complex tasks by extending the reasoning chain. However, these chains are prone to containing factual errors, particularly in knowledge-intensive tasks. To address this issue, we propose CheckRLM, a framework that improves the reliability of the reasoning process through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by timely checking and correcting factual errors. Specifically, CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning

summary.core_problem: 在检索增强推理中，及时发现并修正 reasoning chain 里的事实性错误，减少长链推理中的错误累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 推理流程改进。它不直接影响基座预训练，但对长链推理中“知识一致性”和 verifier/checker 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CheckRLM 从推理链中抽取 factual claims，用检索到的外部知识检查 claim 与知识之间的不一致；一旦发现错误，通过 refinement 机制进行低成本、局部化修正，而不是重写整条推理链。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在知识密集型和长程推理任务上进行了 extensive experiments，并显著优于现有 baseline，同时降低纠错成本；但摘要未给出模型参数、数据集名称、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Normal University、Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、Tsinghua University、Northeastern University 等机构。Xu Han 是清华大学 NLP/知识增强与大模型方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to detect and repair factual errors inside reasoning chains during retrieval-augmented reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time RAG reasoning framework. It is not a base-pretraining paper, but it is relevant to verifier-style control of long reasoning and knowledge consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning chain, checks them against retrieved external knowledge, localizes subtle inconsistencies, and applies a refinement mechanism that makes minimal targeted corrections instead of regenerating the full chain.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive long-horizon reasoning and claims substantial improvements over existing baselines with lower cost. It does not provide model sizes, dataset names, baseline details, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Beijing Normal University, Institute of Information Engineering CAS, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, and Northeastern University. Xu Han is a known researcher in NLP, knowledge-enhanced modeling, and LLMs at Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RAG 推理纠错备查即可；预训练研究员只需看 claim 抽取与局部修正是否可复用。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a RAG correction reference; a pretraining reader only needs to inspect whether claim extraction and local repair are reusable.

paper.title: Theoria: Rewrite-Acceptability Verification over Informal Reasoning States
paper.abstract: When should an AI system's answer be trusted? Formal proof assistants offer certainty but cannot reach most of the problem distribution; scalar LLM judges offer coverage but produce opaque scores that cannot be audited after the fact and are subject to the same coherence issues as any LLM. We present Theoria, a verification architecture that closes this gap. A candidate solution is rewritten into a sequence of typed state transitions, each licensed by an explicit justification, whether that be a

summary.core_problem: 现有 AI 推理可信度验证方法两极分化：形式证明助手确定性高但覆盖范围有限，LLM 标量评委覆盖广但不透明、不可审计，易受一致性问题影响。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于重写-可接受性的验证架构，兼具广泛覆盖与可审计性，填补了非正式推理场景下高可信验证的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Theoria 验证架构，将候选解重写为带类型的状态转换序列，每个转换由显式理由（引用、计算、题目给定事实）支撑，所有转换独立可审计；核心不变量为「变化完整性」——连续状态间的所有差异都必须被解释，隐藏前提会表现为未授权突变。
summary.experiments: 在 HLE-Verified Gold 数据集（185 个纯文本专家问题）上，Theoria 验证通过 105 个问题，严格精确率达 91.4%（Wilson 95% CI [84.5%, 95.4%]），每个验证结果均生成人类可读的证明轨迹。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者，作者曾任职于 Cohere。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI reasoning credibility verification methods are polarized: formal proof assistants offer high certainty but limited coverage, while LLM scalar judges have broad coverage but are opaque, unauditable, and prone to consistency issues.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a rewrite-acceptability verification architecture that combines broad coverage with auditability, filling the gap in high-confidence verification for informal reasoning scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents Theoria, a verification architecture that rewrites candidate solutions into sequences of typed state transitions, each licensed by explicit justifications (citations, computations, problem-given facts); every transition is independently auditable, with a foundational invariant of completeness of change — all differences between consecutive states must be accounted for, so hidden premises surface as unlicensed mutations.
summary_en.experiments: On the HLE-Verified Gold dataset (185 text-only expert problems), Theoria certifies 105 problems with 91.4% strict precision (Wilson 95% CI [84.5%, 95.4%]); every certification produces a human-readable proof trace.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researchers; authors previously worked at Cohere.

recommendation.zh: 基于状态转换的可审计验证思路可用于推理轨迹质量检查，作为后训练奖励信号的补充，仅看摘要和实验结果即可。
recommendation.en: State-transition based auditable verification can supplement post-training reward signals for reasoning trace quality checks; read abstract and results only.

paper.title: CAT: Confidence-Adaptive Thinking for Efficient Reasoning of Large Reasoning Models
