paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks by leveraging long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories, yet they frequently exhibit overthinking on simple queries, resulting in significant token overhead and reduced inference efficiency. However, existing compression methods predominantly apply uniform length reduction or rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, often leading to performance degradation on difficult problems. To address this limitation, we pro

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型在简单问题上常出现过长 CoT，导致推理 token 浪费；作者试图让模型按题目难度自适应地控制思考长度。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段的推理长度控制方法，不是预训练论文。它对 test-time compute allocation 和偏好优化信号设计有一定启发，尤其适合关注 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的人看。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Confidence-Adaptive Thinking（CAT），把模型自身的 self-certainty 信号转成 confidence，并纳入 preference optimization，使模型在高置信简单题上压缩思考长度，在低置信难题上保留更长推理。相较统一压缩或粗粒度难度估计，方法强调样本级自适应。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 benchmark、多个 base model 上，CAT 在推理准确率和 token 效率上都优于现有基线。对比对象包括统一长度压缩和基于粗难度估计的方法，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据来源和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自电子科技大学及四川省相关重点实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Large reasoning models often overthink on easy problems, wasting tokens; the paper aims to adapt reasoning length to problem difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method rather than a pretraining contribution. Its relevance comes from test-time compute allocation and how preference optimization can shape reasoning behavior, which may matter at the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Confidence-Adaptive Thinking (CAT), which converts the model’s own self-certainty signals into confidence and injects them into preference optimization. The goal is to shorten reasoning on high-confidence easy cases while preserving longer deliberation on harder ones, instead of applying uniform compression.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, CAT consistently outperforms prior baselines on reasoning accuracy across multiple benchmarks and base models, while improving efficiency. Baselines include uniform length reduction and coarse-grained difficulty estimation methods, but the abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and a Sichuan provincial key laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 典型 post-train 小改法，别把它当范式突破；若你关心 test-time compute 分配，只看 confidence 信号如何进 preference optimization，先怀疑自置信是否校准。
recommendation.en: This looks like a post-training tweak, not a paradigm shift; if you care about test-time compute allocation, inspect how confidence enters preference optimization and be skeptical about calibration.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province

paper.title: Modality-Driven Search with Holistic Trace Judging for ARC-AGI-2
paper.abstract: Large language models can produce fluent, internally coherent reasoning traces for abstract reasoning tasks while still being confidently wrong - making selection among candidates, not just generation, the central challenge. I present a solver for ARC-AGI-2, a few-shot visual reasoning benchmark, built around two principles: (i) treating reasoning modalities as search operators, generating diverse candidates independently across text, image, and code channels, and (ii) context-preserving holisti

summary.core_problem: LLM在抽象推理任务（ARC-AGI-2）上生成的推理trace常流畅但存在确定性错误，自一致性/多数投票等候选选择方法无法恢复被淹没的少数正确假设。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出多模态搜索算子+上下文保留的整体评判框架，解决了抽象推理场景下模态答案错误时的候选选择失效问题。
summary.technical_approach: 两个核心设计：（1）将文本、图像、代码三种推理模态作为独立搜索算子，并行生成多样化候选推理trace；（2）采用整体评判机制，将所有候选trace放入同一长上下文prompt中由评判模型联合对比打分，而非独立打分后投票。
summary.experiments: 在ARC Prize半私有评测集上达到72.9%准确率，单任务平均成本38.99美元，据称超过当时榜单最佳独立前沿模型GPT-5.2 Pro（摘要截断，完整结果需见正文）。
summary.authors_note: 作者为关联Cohere的独立研究者

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs generate fluent but confidently wrong reasoning traces on abstract reasoning tasks like ARC-AGI-2; candidate selection methods like self-consistency or majority voting fail to recover correct minority hypotheses when the modal answer is incorrect.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing a modality-driven search + context-preserving holistic judging framework that resolves candidate selection failure when the modal answer is wrong for abstract reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two core designs: (1) use text, image, and code reasoning modalities as independent search operators to generate diverse candidate traces in parallel; (2) holistic judging that feeds all candidate traces into a single long-context prompt for joint comparative scoring by a judge model, instead of independent scoring followed by voting.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 72.9% accuracy on the ARC Prize semi-private evaluation set at $38.99 per task, reportedly exceeding the best standalone frontier model GPT-5.2 Pro at the time of writing (abstract truncated, full results pending main text).
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researcher affiliated with Cohere

recommendation.zh: 多模态搜索+联合整体trace评判的思路对推理校准数据合成有弱启发，仅需浏览方法部分的评判prompt设计
recommendation.en: Multi-modal search + joint holistic trace judging offers weak inspiration for reasoning calibration data synthesis; only skim the method section for judge prompt design.

paper.title: When More Sampling Hurts: The Modal Ceiling and Correlation Ceiling of Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: People overthink; language models over-sample, and the extra effort can talk both into a worse answer. Reasoning systems answer a hard question by sampling it many times (test-time scaling), and the more they draw, the more often a correct answer turns up somewhere, so coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct try, climbs and appears to be progress. But a deployed system must return one answer, and choosing it, not knowing which try is right, is selection; selection is capped,

summary.core_problem: 当前针对测试时扩展（通过增加采样次数n提升推理系统性能）的分析普遍混淆覆盖率、选择准确率、估计准确率三个独立指标，默认多次采样是独立同分布尝试，导致对采样收益的估计严重偏高，始终没有明确回答“采样数增加到什么程度会停止产生收益、甚至损害性能”这一实际问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇可直接引用的理论推导工作，而非新算法，但清晰指出了当前主流推理系统测试时扩展路径的核心瓶颈：生成正确答案已经不是限制因素，识别哪个生成答案是正确的才是。推导得到的两个硬上限（选择任务的模态天花板、估计任务的相关天花板）给出了有用采样预算的明确边界，对推理系统的算力分配、验证器训练方向、基准测试结果解读都有直接参考价值。此前业界普遍观察到多数投票、奖励模型打分在数百个样本后进入平台期的现象，但一直缺乏机制层面的解释，这个基于经典抽样统计的框架填补了这个空白。
summary.technical_approach: 核心重构是将单问题下的多次采样建模为整群抽样，而非独立同分布采样，借鉴Kish设计效应与de Finetti可交换性定理，拆分了三个被名义采样数混淆的独立量：第一是选择任务的模态天花板π_mode：不存在完美验证器时，多数投票/奖励模型选择会收敛到模型对该问题生成频率最高的答案，如果这个模态答案是错误的，采样越多，错误答案的置信度越高（反扩展现象），因此选择准确率的上限是所有问题中模态答案正确的比例；第二是估计任务的相关天花板1/ρ：同一问题的多次采样存在类内相关ρ，n个相关采样的等效独立样本数为n/(1+(n-1)ρ)，无论n多大，等效样本数都不会超过1/ρ，这是用采样估计模型真实准确率的硬上限；第三是问题间难度异质性ρ_b决定覆盖率曲线的形状，此前假设独立同分布得到的覆盖率幂律是该框架下问题内相关ρ_w=0的特例。框架严格区分了估计任务（用采样测量模型准确率）和选择任务（必须返回单个答案）的不同边界，还给出了采样算力最优分配规则。
summary.experiments: 作者在两份公开响应日志上完成验证：一份是Brown等人发布的独立采样日志，一份是长推理场景的相关采样日志。核心测量结果包括：第一，覆盖率与选择准确率之间的可识别性差距在采样数达到几百时已经非常显著，覆盖率随n提升持续走高，但选择准确率进入平台甚至出现下降；第二，实测问题内相关ρ_w接近0，问题间难度异质性ρ_b较大，覆盖率曲线的幂律形状与模型预测完全吻合；第三，多数投票性能在采样数超过约100后基本不再提升，部分场景下出现轻微下降，与模态天花板的预测一致；第四，不同任务上的相关天花板1/ρ大致落在几十的量级，意味着数千次采样的边际收益为负，将算力投入到更好的验证器或更长的单条推理链上，回报高于纯增加采样数。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2节的整群抽样对应关系、第3节的相关天花板与边际样本价值推导、第4节的覆盖率-选择拆分与可识别性差距测量，图1和图2是核心结论最直观的呈现。可深挖的方向包括：框架如何扩展到不完美验证器场景、不同解码参数（温度、top-p）如何影响ρ和π_mode、推理链长度与采样数之间的最优算力分配公式。注意这篇工作的价值是概念澄清与理论边界划定，不提供可直接落地的算法改进，阅读时重点关注其对现有实践误区的校正，而非寻找新的工程trick。
summary.authors_note: 当前公开版本未标注明确机构信息，从引用脉络与论证风格判断，作者团队对推理系统扩展规律与抽样统计方法有深入积累。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing analyses of test-time scaling via increased sampling budget n conflate three distinct metrics — coverage, selection accuracy, and estimation accuracy — by implicitly assuming sampled responses are independent and identically distributed. This leads to systematic overestimation of sampling returns, and leaves unanswered the practical question of when additional sampling stops improving, or even degrades, deployed system performance.
summary_en.importance: This is a formal, citable theoretical derivation rather than a new algorithm, but it identifies the core bottleneck of test-time scaling pipelines used in modern reasoning systems: generating a correct answer is no longer the limiting factor; recognizing which generated answer is correct is. The two derived hard ceilings (the modal ceiling for answer selection, the correlation ceiling for accuracy estimation) provide concrete bounds on useful sampling budget, with direct implications for inference compute allocation, verifier training priorities, and correct interpretation of benchmark results. The widely observed empirical pattern that majority voting and reward model scoring plateau after a few hundred samples had previously lacked a mechanistic explanation, which this framework provides using classical survey sampling theory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core reframing models repeated samples for a single prompt as cluster sampling rather than i.i.d. draws, building on Kish’s design effect and de Finetti’s exchangeability theorem. It disentangles three quantities confounded by nominal sample count: (1) The modal ceiling π_mode for answer selection: without a perfect verifier, plurality vote converges to the model’s most frequent answer for a given problem. If that modal answer is incorrect, additional samples only increase confidence in the wrong answer (anti-scaling), so selection accuracy is capped at the fraction of problems where the model’s modal answer is correct. (2) The correlation ceiling 1/ρ: within-problem response correlation ρ means n correlated samples have an effective sample size of n/(1+(n-1)ρ), which saturates at a hard upper bound of 1/ρ regardless of sampling budget, governing the accuracy of model performance estimates from sampling. (3) Between-problem difficulty heterogeneity ρ_b shapes the coverage curve; previously reported power-law coverage curves under i.i.d. assumptions are recovered as the special case where within-problem correlation ρ_w = 0. The framework strictly separates estimation (sampling to measure model accuracy) from selection (sampling to return a single answer), and provides a rule for optimal compute allocation across sampling budget.
summary_en.experiments: Validation is run on two public response logs: the independent-draw log from Brown et al. and a dependent-draw log for long reasoning runs. Key measured results include: (1) The identifiability gap between rising coverage and stagnating selection accuracy becomes pronounced at a few hundred samples, with coverage continuing to climb while selection accuracy flattens or even declines; (2) Measured within-problem correlation ρ_w is near zero, while between-problem difficulty heterogeneity ρ_b is large, matching the predicted power-law shape of coverage curves; (3) Majority voting performance plateaus beyond ~100 samples, with slight degradation in some settings, exactly matching modal ceiling predictions; (4) The correlation ceiling 1/ρ falls in the range of a few dozen effective samples across tasks, meaning sampling budgets in the thousands deliver negative marginal returns, and compute is better spent on better verifiers or longer individual reasoning chains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the cluster sampling correspondence, Section 3 for derivations of the correlation ceiling and marginal sample value, and Section 4 for the coverage-selection split and identifiability gap measurements. Figures 1 and 2 provide the most concise visual summary of core conclusions. Worth exploring further: how the framework extends to settings with imperfect verifiers, how decoding parameters (temperature, top-p) affect ρ and π_mode, and the optimal compute allocation tradeoff between reasoning chain length and sample count. Note this work provides conceptual clarification and theoretical bounds rather than algorithmic improvements; read it as a correction to common misinterpretations of existing scaling practice rather than a new method to implement.
summary_en.authors_note: No explicit institutional affiliation is listed in the current draft; the citation pattern and framing suggest authors with deep familiarity with reasoning system scaling and survey sampling methodology.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会压低你对 test-time scaling 的乐观预期：别再只报 pass@k，先把 coverage 和 selection 分开画；若曲线属实，训练目标该转向 verifier/selector 而不是盲目增采样。
recommendation.en: This should lower your optimism about test-time scaling: stop reporting pass@k alone and separate coverage from selection; if these curves hold, the next move is verifier/selector training, not blind oversampling.

paper.title: Mixture of Debaters: Learn to Debate at Architectural Level in Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent debate frameworks suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on static architectures where agent roles and coordination patterns are fixed at design time, and they require instantiating multiple model copies, incurring substantial computational overhead. We propose Mixture of Debaters (MoD), a unified framework that enables dynamic self-debate within a single model by leveraging the Mixture-of-Experts paradigm. We address three key challenges in adapting MoE for dialect

summary.core_problem: 这项工作想解决多智能体辩论推理的两个工程性限制：角色和通信拓扑通常是预先固定的，难以随问题复杂度动态切换；同时，多智能体系统往往需要多份模型实例，推理成本和延迟较高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近推理架构和参数高效微调方法。但它有一个有用的观察：MoE 的路由不一定只服务于容量扩展，也可以被设计成“推理过程控制器”，让不同专家承担提出、反驳、综合等功能。这个方向对研究 MoE 专家分工、推理时动态计算、以及多角色能力是否能内化到单模型里，有一定参考价值。贡献量级仍偏早期，关键还要看规模化训练和消融是否支持这些设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Mixture-of-Debaters。它基于一个冻结的视觉语言骨干，在 Transformer 中插入轻量 MoD adapter，用来替代标准 LoRA 的单一路径低秩更新。标准 LoRA 是一个固定的低秩旁路，MoD 则把低秩模块拆成多个专家池，并通过动态路由选择专家。核心有三点。第一是 dual-routing，把“角色分配”和“流程控制”分开：一类路由决定当前 token 或局部上下文应由 proposer、critic 等角色专家处理，另一类路由决定当前阶段是继续辩论还是进入总结综合。这样做的动机是，辩论不是普通 MoE 的单一专家选择问题，角色和阶段是两个不同维度。第二是 momentum switching，用局部上下文聚合来平滑 token 级路由，减少专家在短片段内频繁切换。这个设计针对辩论场景很具体：如果模型在一句话中不断从支持方切到反驳方，推理轨迹会变得不连贯。第三是 unified self-debate，把多个辩论角色封装进同一个模型的专家模块，避免外部多模型编排和多轮通信。与传统多智能体辩论相比，它把“多角色交互”改成了模型内部的动态专家选择；与普通 MoE 相比，它显式区分了角色路由和阶段路由。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段没有包含完整实验表、具体 benchmark、参数规模、训练数据规模和消融数字，因此不能确认实际增益幅度。能从方法描述中看出的关键实验应包括：与标准 LoRA、普通 MoE adapter、多模型辩论框架的比较；dual-routing 的消融；momentum switching 对路由抖动、专家持续性和答案质量的影响；以及 text-only 和 multimodal reasoning 场景下的成本—效果权衡。若缺少这些消融，方法的主要证据会停留在架构合理性层面。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 §3.1 的 MoD adapter 结构，尤其是 dual-routing 的数学定义和 momentum switching 如何计算；再看 §3.2 的指令微调数据，因为显式 viewpoint shift 监督会直接影响专家是否真的学到不同角色。实验部分如果完整可见，重点看三类消融：去掉流程路由、去掉角色路由、去掉 momentum smoothing。真正需要判断的是收益来自“辩论结构”，还是来自更大的 adapter 容量和额外指令数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two practical limits of multi-agent debate systems: fixed role and communication patterns, and the cost of running multiple model instances to simulate debate.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining recipe, but it is relevant as an architectural probe into how MoE routing can be used for reasoning control rather than only for capacity scaling. It suggests that expert specialization can encode debate roles and reasoning stages inside one model. The idea is useful for thinking about MoE expert semantics, dynamic test-time computation, and whether multi-agent behaviors can be internalized by a single backbone. The current contribution should be treated as exploratory until larger-scale evidence and clean ablations are available.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture-of-Debaters builds on a frozen vision-language backbone and inserts lightweight MoD adapters in place of standard LoRA modules. A standard LoRA path provides one low-rank update; MoD replaces this with expert pools and dynamic routing. The main design choice is dual routing: one router handles role allocation, such as proposer or critic, while another controls the reasoning stage, such as debate versus synthesis. This separation matters because debate has at least two axes of control, and a single token-level MoE gate is a poor fit for both. The second component is momentum switching, which smooths routing decisions over local context. It is intended to prevent rapid expert flips that would make a debate trace incoherent. The third component is unified self-debate: instead of coordinating several external agents, the model stores debating personas in internal expert modules and activates them within one forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete experimental tables, model sizes, data scale, benchmark results, or ablation numbers. The key evidence to look for would be comparisons against standard LoRA, ordinary MoE adapters, and external multi-agent debate; ablations for role routing, stage routing, and momentum switching; and measurements of both reasoning quality and inference cost. Without these numbers, the method is best read as a plausible architecture proposal rather than a validated scaling result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on §3.1 for the adapter design, especially the exact definitions of dual routing and momentum switching. Then check §3.2, because the instruction-tuning data with explicit viewpoint shifts may be doing a large part of the work. In the experiments, look for whether the gains survive removing role routing, stage routing, or smoothing. The central question is whether the improvement comes from debate-aware structure, or simply from extra adapter capacity and supervised debate-style data.

recommendation.zh: MoE 路由用于推理时角色切换的思路有启发，重点看双路由设计与动量切换消融，不必全读。
recommendation.en: The idea of using MoE routing for test-time role switching is insightful; focus on dual-routing design and momentum-switching ablations, no need to read in full.

paper.title: Evolution Fine-Tuning: Learning to Discover Across 371 Optimization Tasks
paper.abstract: Would experience designing faster GPU kernels also help close in on a long-standing open mathematical conjecture? Large Language Models (LLMs) integrated into evolutionary search have recently produced state-of-the-art solutions on optimization tasks, including open mathematical conjectures, GPU kernel design, scientific law discovery, and combinatorial puzzles. To achieve this, prior work applied search scaffolds to one target task at a time, so every new problem is approached from scratch and

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在 evolutionary search 中只能依赖外部 scaffold、无法把“如何迭代改进候选解”的经验沉淀到模型参数里的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个介于 mid-training 与 post-training 之间的能力注入工作。它的价值不在某个单任务结果，而在于提出把跨任务搜索经验写回模型的训练范式，对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口很有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Evolution Fine-Tuning（EFT），在 371 个优化任务上进行中期训练，目标是让模型学会发现式迭代：识别该改哪里、如何变异、何时回退，而不是每个新任务都从零开始依赖搜索脚手架。核心思想是把原本存在于外部 evolutionary scaffold 中的策略，蒸馏进模型本身，使其能跨任务复用搜索经验。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调任务覆盖 GPU kernel 设计、数学猜想、科学规律发现、组合优化等 371 个优化任务，并与“每个任务单独套搜索 scaffold”的 prior setup 对比。具体基座模型规模、训练 token/轨迹量、baseline 名称和提升幅度在摘要中未给出，需要正文确认是否真有跨任务迁移，而非仅仅对相近任务分布过拟合。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Dongyeop Kang。若正文机构信息属实，这类工作通常更接近面向推理/搜索能力的中期训练，而非纯 SFT。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the limitation that LLMs used inside evolutionary search rely on external scaffolds and do not internalize the skill of iteratively improving candidate solutions.
summary_en.importance: This is interesting at the pretrain–posttrain interface. The contribution is not just better results on one optimization task, but a training paradigm that writes cross-task search experience back into model weights.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Evolution Fine-Tuning (EFT), a mid-training setup over 371 optimization tasks. The goal is to teach the model discovery-oriented iteration itself—where to mutate, how to revise, and when to backtrack—so that search heuristics previously implemented in the scaffold become reusable model capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights broad task coverage including GPU kernel design, mathematical conjectures, scientific law discovery, and combinatorial puzzles, and positions EFT against task-by-task search scaffolds. The abstract does not reveal model sizes, data volume, or exact gains, so the main thing to verify is whether the transfer is truly cross-domain rather than overfitting to a family of similar search tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dongyeop Kang. If the full paper confirms the affiliation, this looks more like capability-oriented mid-training than ordinary instruction tuning.

recommendation.zh: 值得从 pretrain↔posttrain 接口看：关键不是 371 个任务有多花，而是“搜索策略能否写回参数”这个命题；先查 transfer setup 是否干净，再决定要不要内部复现。
recommendation.en: Read it for the pretrain–posttrain interface, not the task zoo: the real question is whether search heuristics can be written into weights; verify the transfer setup before taking the gains seriously.

paper.title: Process Advantage Signal Shaping: A Paradigm-Agnostic Middleware for Process-Supervised RL in LLM Reasoners
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a default recipe for process-supervised reinforcement learning of LLM reasoners, and dense process supervision -- via learned process reward models (PRMs) or on-policy-distillation KL signals -- is a common way to densify its otherwise weak outcome reward. Layering such a step-level signal on top of GRPO's group-standardized advantage, however, exposes three structural pathologies: \emph{channel contamination} between the pooled process, outcome, and

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为LLM推理器过程监督RL的默认方案，在叠加稠密过程信号（PRM或token级KL蒸馏信号）时，会在优势pipeline的聚合、广播、轨迹求和三个阶段分别出现通道污染、分辨率不匹配、累计偏差三类结构性缺陷。
summary.importance: 揭示了GRPO叠加过程监督时的三类通用结构性缺陷，提出的轻量中间件无需修改GRPO核心组件即可适配不同过程信号范式与组标准化算子，为过程监督RL的稳定落地提供了可复用的改造思路，对RL增强推理的预训练-后训练闭环实践有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PASS范式无关中间件，插在任意标量步级过程信号与GRPO裁剪surrogate之间，通过三条规则对应解决三类缺陷：聚合阶段对过程、结果、格式信号分别做组标准化后再融合（AF），广播阶段按过程信号取值切分chunk并在chunk内共享优势（CV），轨迹求和阶段将累计回报改为平均价值密度（DL），还证明了累计优势GRPO的长度坍缩定理以支撑DL设计。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理（PRM信号）、多跳QA（token级KL蒸馏信号，含普通OPD与G-OPD两种变体）两个领域验证，覆盖两种常用组标准化算子（Masked-Norm、Abs-Max Scaling），所有配置下相对对应GRPO基线均获得一致的pass@1提升，理论部分给出了累计优势GRPO的长度坍缩定理证明。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看第1节后半部分对三类结构性缺陷的拆解，第4节中三条PASS规则的定义与长度坍缩定理，以及实验部分跨领域、跨信号范式、跨组标准化算子的增益一致性结果。预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When dense process supervision signals (e.g., learned PRMs, token-level KL distillation signals) are added to the group-standardized advantage of GRPO — the default process-supervised RL recipe for LLM reasoners — three structural flaws arise across the aggregation, broadcast, and trajectory-summation stages of the GRPO advantage pipeline: channel contamination, resolution mismatch, and cumulative bias.
summary_en.importance: It identifies three general structural flaws in GRPO-based process supervision, and proposes a lightweight middleware that adapts to different process signal paradigms and group-standardization operators without modifying GRPO's core components, providing reusable practical guidance for stable process-supervised RL in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop for reasoning enhancement.
summary_en.technical_approach: PASS is a paradigm-agnostic middleware inserted between any scalar step-level process signal and GRPO's clipped surrogate, with three rules targeting the three flaws: Advantage Fusion (AF) for separate group-standardization of process/outcome/format signals before fusion, Chunk-by-Value (CV) for trajectory segmentation by process signal values with uniform advantage within chunks, and Divide-Length (DL) for converting cumulative return to average value density. A length-collapse theorem for cumulative-advantage GRPO is proven to justify the DL design.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across two domains: mathematical reasoning with PRM signals, and multi-hop QA with token-level KL distillation signals (vanilla OPD and generalized G-OPD), covering two common group-standardization operators (Masked-Norm, Abs-Max Scaling). Consistent pass@1 improvements over corresponding GRPO baselines are observed across all configurations, with a theoretical proof of the length-collapse theorem for cumulative-advantage GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the latter half of Section 1 for the breakdown of three structural flaws, Section 4 for the definition of three PASS rules and the length-collapse theorem, and the cross-domain/cross-operator consistency of experimental gains. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看信号分解部分；它把 GRPO+过程奖励的几个常见坑说清了，适合放进内部 RLVR ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the signal decomposition parts; it cleanly names several GRPO-plus-process-reward failure modes worth reproducing in internal RLVR ablations.

paper.title: PHF: Privileged Hidden Flow for On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a reasoning model on rollouts sampled from its own policy by matching a privileged teacher that also sees verified reference solutions. Existing OPSD objectives supervise only the output distribution, so privileged context affects training through a token-level divergence without directly supervising the internal computation that produced that distribution. We propose Privileged Hidden Flow (PHF), which additionally distills how a privileged teacher's hi

summary.core_problem: 现有On-Policy自蒸馏（OPSD）仅监督输出分布，无法充分利用特权参考信息带来的内部计算变化，而直接点对点隐状态匹配又存在隐坐标漂移、跨层关系缺失的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了基于隐状态转移而非点对点匹配的内部过程蒸馏方案，解决了OPSD中特权信息利用不充分的问题，仅新增一个损失系数即可跨模型规模获得一致增益，为自蒸馏提升推理能力提供了新的监督信号维度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PHF方法，在标准OPSD的输出散度损失之外新增隐流损失：匹配学生与特权教师的token到token隐状态转移方向及轨迹几何结构（而非点对点隐状态），具备隐轨迹偏移、正缩放、正交变换三类不变性；采用全层聚合加相邻层关系约束的方案，无需手工选层，仅新增一个损失系数，教师沿用OPSD的平滑EMA教师。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B三个规模模型上，按官方OPSD协议在AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025三个数学基准测试，checkpoint-100的Average@12相对OPSD基线分别提升+2.2/+1.5/+1.7，所有规模增益为正；消融验证了转移目标、全层聚合、共享特权教师是核心设计。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看引言中对OPSD现有缺陷与点对点隐状态匹配问题的分析，第3节中PHF损失的不变性推导，以及实验部分跨模型规模的一致增益与消融结论。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) only supervises output distributions and fails to fully utilize internal computation changes induced by privileged reference information, while direct pointwise hidden-state matching suffers from hidden coordinate drift and missing cross-layer relational structure.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an internal process distillation scheme based on hidden state transitions instead of pointwise matching, addressing the underutilization of privileged context in OPSD, and delivers consistent cross-scale gains with only one additional loss coefficient, offering a new supervision signal dimension for reasoning enhancement via self-distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: PHF adds a hidden flow loss to standard OPSD's output divergence loss: it matches the direction and trajectory geometry of token-to-token hidden state transitions between the student and privileged teacher (instead of pointwise hidden vectors), with three invariances (hidden trajectory offset, positive rescaling, orthogonal transformation); it uses all-layer aggregation with neighboring-layer relation constraints, requiring no manual layer selection, and reuses OPSD's smoothed EMA teacher with only one extra loss coefficient.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B models under the official OPSD protocol, on three math benchmarks (AIME 2024, AIME 2025, HMMT 2025). The checkpoint-100 Average@12 improves by +2.2/+1.5/+1.7 over the OPSD baseline for the three scales respectively, with positive gains across all scales; ablations confirm that transition targets, all-layer aggregation, and shared privileged teachers are core design components.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the Introduction's analysis of OPSD gaps and pointwise hidden matching pitfalls, Section 3's invariance derivation of PHF loss, and the consistent cross-scale gains plus ablation results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看 hidden-flow loss 设计即可；结论受 100-step setup 限制，但它提醒 logit 蒸馏可能漏掉 teacher 的计算路径。
recommendation.en: Skim the hidden-flow loss; the 100-step setup is narrow, but it is a useful reminder that logit distillation may miss the teacher’s computation path.

paper.title: DRIFT: Difficulty Routing Self-DIstillation with Rhythm-Gated Exploration and Success BuFfer Training
paper.abstract: Enabling large language models to achieve stable self-improvement without external expert supervision remains a central challenge in complex reasoning tasks. Existing self-distillation and reinforcement learning methods lack explicit mechanisms for tracking problem-level learning progress and adapting optimization strategies accordingly. Consequently, training may over-optimize easy problems, receive weak supervision from hard problems, and fail to sufficiently explore borderline cases. To resol

summary.core_problem: 在没有外部专家监督的情况下，现有的大语言模型（LLM）自我进化方法（如自蒸馏和强化学习）缺乏对问题难度和学习进度的动态跟踪，导致训练信号分配不均：简单问题过度优化，困难问题监督不足，边界问题探索不够。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需外部监督的在线自我进化策略优化框架 DRIFT。该框架通过动态难度路由和节奏门控机制，有效平衡了错误纠正、探索和稳定收敛，为 LLM 在复杂推理任务上的自我进化提供了一种更稳定、高效的路径。
summary.technical_approach: DRIFT 框架的核心在于：1) 动态难度路由（Dynamic Difficulty Routing）：利用历史通过率评估模型对问题的掌握程度，将问题分为简单、困难和边界三类，分别应用不同的训练策略（减少更新、自蒸馏、强化学习探索）；2) 节奏门控探索（Rhythm Gating Exploration）：在边界问题上，通过 token 级别的门控机制，在保持关键推理模式的同时鼓励策略变异；3) 成功缓冲区（Success Buffer）：跨批次保存高质量的正确轨迹，用于困难问题的自蒸馏；4) 两阶段课程学习（Two-Stage Curriculum Learning）：第一阶段侧重能力快速增长和缓冲区积累，第二阶段转向平衡探索和收敛。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-8B 模型上，跨生物、化学、材料、物理和工具使用等多个任务进行了评估。结果显示，DRIFT 显著超越了复现的 SDPO 和 GRPO 基线，并在工具使用任务上取得了尤为明显的提升，优于近期的 SRPO 等方法。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 DRIFT 框架中动态难度路由的具体实现机制（如何根据历史通过率划分问题难度并分配训练策略），以及节奏门控探索在 token 级别如何平衡探索与利用。此外，两阶段课程学习的设计思路也值得借鉴。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolution methods for LLMs (like self-distillation and RL) lack dynamic tracking of problem difficulty and learning progress without external expert supervision. This leads to uneven training signals: over-optimizing easy problems, under-supervising hard ones, and insufficiently exploring borderline cases.
summary_en.importance: Proposes DRIFT, an online self-evolution policy optimization framework that operates without external supervision. By employing dynamic difficulty routing and rhythm gating, it effectively balances error correction, exploration, and stable convergence, offering a more stable and efficient path for LLM self-improvement on complex reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core of DRIFT includes: 1) Dynamic Difficulty Routing: Uses historical pass rates to gauge problem mastery, categorizing them into easy, hard, and borderline, and applies distinct strategies (reduced updates, self-distillation, RL exploration) accordingly. 2) Rhythm Gating Exploration: For borderline problems, a token-level gating mechanism encourages policy variation while preserving key reasoning patterns. 3) Success Buffer: Retains high-quality correct trajectories across batches for self-distillation on hard problems. 4) Two-Stage Curriculum Learning: The first stage focuses on rapid capability growth and buffer accumulation, while the second shifts to balanced exploration and convergence.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-8B across diverse tasks including biology, chemistry, materials, physics, and tool use. DRIFT significantly outperformed reproduced SDPO and GRPO baselines, showing particularly pronounced gains on tool use compared to recent methods like SRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the implementation details of Dynamic Difficulty Routing (how difficulty is assessed and strategies assigned) and how Rhythm Gating Exploration balances exploration and exploitation at the token level. The design of the two-stage curriculum learning is also noteworthy. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 后训练中动态分配自蒸馏与RL信号的思路可迁移到预训练的难度课程与损失加权，重点看§3的难度路由模块设计。
recommendation.en: The dynamic allocation of self-distillation and RL signals transfers to pretraining difficulty curricula and loss weighting; focus on §3's difficulty routing module design.

paper.title: HMARS: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Memory System for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning requires models to access, retrieve, and integrate evidence scattered across documents, dialogues, and accumulated interaction histories. Standard retrieval-augmented generation reduces this problem to top-$K$ chunk retrieval, but such passive access can discard relevant evidence before reasoning begins, especially when relevance depends on broader context. We propose HMARS, a hierarchical multi-agent memory system that treats long contexts as managed memory rather than a

summary.core_problem: 传统RAG采用top-K块检索的被动访问模式处理长上下文推理时，存在两个核心缺陷：一是散落在文档远距离位置的相关证据容易因为单块相关性得分低被提前过滤；二是部分内容的相关性只有结合全局语境才能判断，独立块嵌入无法捕捉这类依赖。现有改进方法要么侧重长程交互中的记忆内容存储/更新/遗忘机制，要么仍然采用集中式的单步检索逻辑，会在推理开始前就丢弃潜在相关证据，长上下文的内存访问机制缺乏合理设计。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的分层内存思路为长上下文推理的工程实现提供了参考，通过重构长上下文的访问模式，避开盲目扩大上下文窗口带来的推理成本问题，同时清晰刻画了传统RAG在上下文依赖相关性场景下的失效模式。但工作核心是推理阶段的系统架构设计，不涉及预训练范式、基座模型架构或训练流程的改动，对预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: HMARS将长文档/交互历史划分成分层的内存区域，采用非对称模型配置平衡检索覆盖率与推理成本：轻量子智能体绑定固定大小的局部内存页，负责本地区域的查询相关性判断；中等强度的中间智能体管理区域级共享记忆，做查询相关的路由协调；最强的前沿基座模型只在最终阶段对检索到的接地证据页做推理，不直接读取全量上下文。这种设计避免了集中式top-K检索提前过滤全文档区域的问题，同时控制了推理算力开销。流程分两步：离线建索引时完成文档分区、子/中智能体绑定与本地记忆卡生成；在线查询时沿着层级路由，每个子智能体都对自己负责的局部区域做查询条件下的相关性评估，不会在初始阶段就排除大段内容，最终聚合相关证据页交给基座模型生成答案。该工作还构造了两个诊断基准，专门测试跨远距离块证据整合、上下文依赖相关性的场景。
summary.experiments: 实验在两个自建诊断基准上开展：一个改造自LongBench-v2，筛选出需要整合远距离散列证据、常规RAG召回率低的问题；另一个是参考RealMem设计的累积交互基准，其中关键事实散落在多轮交互中，仅在后续语境下才体现相关性。根据已披露的结果，HMARS的性能优势集中在被动top-K检索、集中式记忆访问失效的场景；具体的模型尺寸配置、绝对性能提升幅度、消融实验结论在提供的手稿片段中未完整披露。
summary.reading_guide: 属于长上下文推理的系统应用型工作，泛读即可。重点关注引言部分对传统RAG两类核心失效模式的刻画，以及方法部分非对称算力分配、分层内存管理的核心设计思路，具体的prompt设计、实现细节可跳过。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。做长上下文工程、RAG系统的研究者可进一步参考其诊断基准的构造逻辑；做预训练的研究者快速扫过核心设计思路即可，该工作不涉及模型架构、训练目标或数据相关的改动。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard top-K retrieval-augmented generation for long-context reasoning has two core flaws: relevant evidence scattered across distant document positions is often pre-filtered out due to low individual chunk relevance scores, and the relevance of some content only becomes apparent with global context, which independent chunk embeddings cannot capture. Existing improvements either focus on memory content storage, update, and forgetting mechanisms for long-horizon interactions, or rely on centralized single-step retrieval logic that discards potentially relevant evidence before reasoning starts, leaving a gap in properly designed memory access mechanisms for long context.
summary_en.importance: The hierarchical memory design proposed provides an engineering reference for long-context inference systems, avoiding the inference cost of naive context window expansion by restructuring long context access patterns, while clearly articulating failure modes of standard RAG under context-dependent relevance. The work is, however, focused on inference-stage system architecture design, with no changes to pretraining paradigms, base model architecture, or training pipelines, so its direct relevance to pretraining research is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: HMARS partitions long documents or interaction histories into hierarchical memory regions with asymmetric model allocation to balance retrieval coverage and inference cost: lightweight sub-agents are bound to fixed-size local pages and perform query-conditioned relevance assessment on their assigned regions; mid-tier agents manage regional shared memory and coordinate query routing; the strongest frontier base model only performs final reasoning on retrieved grounded evidence pages, never reading the full context. This design avoids the premature filtering of entire document regions that plagues centralized top-K retrieval, while keeping compute overhead manageable. The workflow has two phases: offline indexing partitions documents, binds agents to regions, and generates local memory cards; online querying routes requests through the hierarchy, with every sub-agent evaluating its local region against the query rather than being filtered out upfront, then aggregates relevant evidence pages and passes the compact evidence set to the base model for answer generation. Two diagnostic benchmarks are also constructed to stress cross-region evidence integration and context-dependent relevance, scenarios where standard RAG has low recall.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two custom diagnostic benchmarks: a filtered subset of LongBench-v2 containing questions that require evidence from distant chunks and exhibit low vanilla RAG recall, and a cumulative interaction benchmark inspired by RealMem where key facts scattered across multi-turn interactions only become relevant in later context. Disclosed results indicate HMARS shows the largest gains on settings where passive top-K retrieval and centralized memory access fail; specific model size configurations, absolute performance improvements, and ablation results are not fully disclosed in the available manuscript segment.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is an applied systems work for long-context inference, suitable for skimming. Focus on the introduction's characterization of two core failure modes of standard RAG and the core design ideas of asymmetric compute allocation and hierarchical memory management in the method section; specific prompt designs and implementation details can be skipped. Expected reading time is 15-20 minutes. Researchers working on long-context engineering and RAG systems may refer to the diagnostic benchmark construction logic; pretraining researchers can quickly scan the core design ideas, as the work involves no changes to model architecture, training objectives, or data pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 架构设计有启发，重点看§3分层内存的职责划分和附录的诊断基准构造，可作为长上下文预训练任务设计的参考
recommendation.en: Architecture design is insightful; focus on §3 hierarchical memory responsibility split and appendix diagnostic benchmark construction, useful for long-context pretraining task design.

paper.title: The Weakest Link Tells It All: Outcome-Supervised Process Reward Modeling via Learnable Credit Assignment
paper.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by providing fine-grained feedback, yet training PRMs typically requires expensive stepwise annotations. Outcome-supervised PRMs offer a scalable alternative by learning from final-answer correctness alone, but this introduces a fundamental *credit assignment* challenge, i.e., attributing outcomes to responsible reasoning steps. Existing approaches rely on either uniform or causal assignment, both of

summary.core_problem: 解决 outcome-supervised PRM 只用最终答案正确性训练时，如何把成败信号分配到具体推理步骤的 credit assignment 问题。
summary.importance: 这是 LLM 推理后训练中的方法创新。它试图降低人工 step-level annotation 成本，同时保留 PRM 对中间错误步骤的定位能力；对 RLVR、verifier 训练和推理数据质量控制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LCA，即 Learnable Credit Assignment。核心原则是 Weakest Link Assignment：一条推理链的质量由最弱步骤决定。方法把 credit assignment 和 reward modeling 联合学习，避免 uniform assignment 把最终结果平均分给所有步骤，也避免简单 causal assignment 不能稳定锚定 step correctness 的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练集、baseline 名称和具体提升数值；只说明目标是相比 uniform 或 causal assignment 更好识别过程错误，并用于 outcome-supervised PRM 训练。需要看正文确认数学/代码推理任务、PRM backbone 和是否真正提升 search/RL 效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in outcome-supervised process reward modeling, where only final-answer correctness is observed but rewards must be assigned to individual reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method for reasoning LLMs. It aims to reduce the cost of step-level annotations while retaining the ability of PRMs to localize intermediate reasoning errors, which is relevant to RLVR, verifier training, and reasoning-data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed LCA framework jointly learns credit assignment and process reward modeling under a Weakest Link Assignment principle: a reasoning chain is only as strong as its weakest step. It is designed to avoid uniform assignment and simple causal assignment, both of which may fail to ground credit in step correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved process error identification relative to uniform or causal assignment, but the main paper should be checked for reasoning domains, PRM backbones, and downstream search/RL gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义和消融；若 weakest-link 信号真能稳定学出来，可用于内部 verifier/PRM 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; if the weakest-link signal is stable, it is useful for internal verifier and PRM data pipelines.

paper.title: Learning to Reason with Curriculum II: Compositional Generalization
paper.abstract: Compositional generalization, the ability to solve complex problems by combining solutions to simpler sub-problems, is a fundamental capability of both natural and artificial intelligence, and a key mechanism underlying chain-of-thought reasoning. However, the theoretical underpinnings of compositional generalization remain poorly understood: when and why does decomposing a problem into parts yield more efficient learning than solving it directly? We study this question through the canonical pro

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么把长推理问题递归分解成短子问题，会比直接学习整个长序列计算更省样本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理与组合泛化的理论分析；它不直接给出LLM训练recipe，但为curriculum、CoT和分解式学习为什么可能提升统计效率提供了可证明模型。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用学习半自动机模拟作为规范问题，覆盖状态跟踪、正则语言识别和模运算等序列计算。方法延续该系列Part I的autocurriculum：递归地把长序列分解为短子问题，先学习短程序/短转移，再组合成更长计算，并比较其统计复杂度与直接学习方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述理论结果，而非大规模神经网络实验；声称autocurriculum在若干semiautomata设置下相对直接方法有显著更好的统计复杂度。未提供LLM参数量、训练数据或benchmark提升。
summary.authors_note: Robert Schapire、Miroslav Dudik、Dylan Foster、Akshay Krishnamurthy是学习理论、在线学习和强化学习方向的知名研究者；摘要未提供机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why recursively decomposing a long reasoning problem into shorter subproblems can be statistically more efficient than learning the full computation directly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical analysis of reasoning and compositional generalization. It does not provide an LLM training recipe, but it gives a provable model for why curricula and decomposed chain-of-thought-style learning can help.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses learning to simulate semiautomata as the canonical problem, covering state tracking, regular language recognition, and modular arithmetic. Building on Part I, it analyzes an autocurriculum that recursively decomposes long sequences into shorter subproblems, learns them, and composes the solutions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theoretical sample-complexity results rather than large neural-network experiments. It claims that the autocurriculum has dramatically better statistical complexity than direct learning methods in semiautomata settings, without reporting LLM-scale experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: Robert Schapire, Miroslav Dudik, Dylan Foster, and Akshay Krishnamurthy are well-known researchers in learning theory, online learning, and reinforcement learning. The abstract does not provide affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 读定理和problem setup即可；它给curriculum/CoT一个干净toy model，但别直接外推到LLM算力配方。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem statements and setup; it gives a clean toy model for curriculum and CoT, but not an LLM compute recipe.

paper.title: Retrieval-Warmed Energy-Based Reasoning: A Five-Arm Ablation Methodology for Diffusion-as-Inference on Structured Reasoning Tasks
paper.abstract: Warm-started diffusion samplers accelerate iterative inference, but it is rarely clear which part of the pipeline carries the gain. We study \textbf{retrieval-warmed energy-based reasoning (RW-EBR)} -- an IRED energy-based diffusion model \cite{du2024ired} augmented with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory -- and contribute a \textbf{five-arm ablation methodology} (oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, aligned) that separates three confounded effects: class-prior bias shift, stochas

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是检索 warm-start 在迭代式推理模型中到底为何有效的问题。作者不把准确率提升直接归因于“检索到了有用样本”，而是把收益拆成三类：初始化分布的类别先验偏移、每个 query 的随机扰动、以及与当前图结构对齐的历史解复用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型规模或训练 recipe，而在诊断方法。它提供了一套可迁移的消融设计，用来分析 retrieval-augmented diffusion / energy-based inference 中的收益来源。对 diffusion LM、masked iterative refinement、latent reasoning 这类非自回归推理框架有启发：warm-start 的收益需要区分“分布更好”“扰动打破坏平衡”和“内容真的对齐”，否则很容易把检索记忆的作用估计过高。论文的贡献量级偏方法学诊断，不是新的基座建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
作者在 IRED energy-based diffusion reasoning 模型外接 Modern Hopfield trajectory memory。基础任务是 connectivity-2：给定 Erdős–Rényi 图 G(N=12, p=0.2)，预测 all-pairs reachability matrix。基础模型使用 IRED 的 32-channel GraphEBM，训练 30k steps，10 个 diffusion timesteps，目标是对 ±1 缩放后的 reachability target 做 MSE denoising，并保留 IRED 的 energy-landscape supervision 和 inner-loop optimization。检索 key 由 3-layer GIN 产生，使用 label-ordered readout 而不是 sum-pool，因为 reachability matrix 需要与节点标签顺序对齐；还加入 per-position id embedding，避免度数对称结构坍缩。key encoder 用 supervised contrastive loss 训练 3000 steps，正样本来自 target-nearest neighbours，pair similarity 用 reachability 的 per-edge Hamming agreement。

核心是五臂消融：oracle、best-constant、per-query-random、shuffled、aligned。oracle 用金标准 memory 检验上限；best-constant 衡量固定初始化带来的类别先验偏移；per-query-random 衡量每个 query 随机 warm-start 是否单独有用；shuffled 保持 value 分布和检索机制，但打乱 key-value 配对；aligned 保持正确配对。aligned 与 shuffled 的差值用于隔离“内容是否与当前 query 对齐”。这个设计比只比较 cold-start 与 warm-start 更干净，因为它把 value 分布、检索噪声、配对关系分开控制。
summary.experiments:
connectivity-2 上，作者在固定 1000 图验证集、seed 20260420 上运行 warm-start 诊断。oracle memory 条件下，aligned 相比 shuffled 的 balanced accuracy 提升达到 +35 个百分点，说明主要收益来自图级别对齐的 value reuse。best-constant sweep 给出的 bias-shift 上界不超过 +8 个百分点；per-query-random 初始化为负收益，约 -1.5 到 -3.1 个百分点，说明随机扰动不是主要原因。可部署的 cold-prediction pipeline 未通过 -2 pp acceptance gate，实际 Δ balanced accuracy 为 -4.09 pp；同一套分解把失败定位到 stored-value quality，而不是 key encoder。

作者还在 Sudoku 上做了异质失败案例。使用任务特定 encoder、contrastive key training 和 quality-ratio gate，但在 key-quality screen 就失败：在当前 mask-aware solved-board target 与 500-candidate pool 设置下，key encoder 本身未达到质量门槛。这个结果与 connectivity-2 形成对照：connectivity 的瓶颈是 stored-value quality，Sudoku 的瓶颈是 key quality。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的三类混杂因素定义，以及 Methods 里五臂消融如何构造。connectivity-2 的 aligned、shuffled、best-constant、per-query-random 对比是核心结果；它比最终 end-to-end accuracy 更有信息量。若关心 diffusion-as-inference 或 retrieval-augmented iterative reasoning，可细看 key encoder 设计，尤其是为什么不能用 permutation-invariant readout。Sudoku 部分适合看作 failure attribution 示例，不必按新方法读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why retrieval warm-starting helps iterative reasoning models. It separates three effects that are usually conflated: a better class-prior initialization, query-specific stochastic perturbation, and reuse of a retrieved value that is actually aligned with the input structure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is methodological rather than scale-oriented. The five-arm diagnostic is useful for retrieval-augmented diffusion inference, energy-based reasoning, masked iterative refinement, and other non-AR inference schemes. The main lesson is that a warm-start gain should not be interpreted as evidence of useful retrieval unless value distribution, stochasticity, and key-value alignment are separately controlled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system wraps an IRED energy-based diffusion reasoning model with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory. The main task is connectivity-2: given an Erdős–Rényi graph G(N=12, p=0.2), predict its all-pairs reachability matrix. The base model is IRED’s 32-channel GraphEBM, trained for 30k steps with 10 diffusion timesteps and an MSE denoising objective on ±1-scaled targets, with energy-landscape supervision and inner-loop optimization enabled.

Retrieval keys are produced by a 3-layer GIN. The encoder uses a label-ordered readout instead of sum pooling, because the retrieved reachability matrix must preserve the node-label alignment of the query graph. A learned per-position ID embedding is added to avoid collapses in degree-symmetric cases. The key encoder is trained with supervised contrastive learning for 3000 steps; target-nearest neighbors are defined by Hamming agreement over reachability entries.

The main contribution is the five-arm ablation: oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, and aligned. The best-constant arm estimates how much can be gained by a favorable fixed initialization. The per-query-random arm tests whether stochastic perturbation alone helps. The shuffled arm keeps the value distribution and retrieval mechanics but permutes key-value pairings. The aligned arm keeps the correct pairing. The aligned-minus-shuffled gap isolates graph-aligned value reuse.
summary_en.experiments:
On connectivity-2, the warm-start diagnostic is run on a fixed validation set of 1,000 graphs with seed 20260420. Under oracle memory, aligned initialization outperforms shuffled initialization by +35 percentage points in balanced accuracy. The constant-initialization sweep bounds the class-prior bias effect at no more than +8 points. Per-query random initialization is negative, around -1.5 to -3.1 points. These results indicate that graph-aligned value reuse is the dominant source of the warm-start gain.

The deployable cold-prediction pipeline does not pass the -2 pp acceptance gate; its balanced-accuracy delta is -4.09 points. The decomposition localizes this failure to stored-value quality rather than key quality. A Sudoku case study shows a different bottleneck: with the current mask-aware solved-board target and a 500-candidate pool, the key encoder fails its quality gate. The diagnostic therefore identifies different first blocking components on the two tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The most useful parts are the definition of the three confounders and the construction of the five ablation arms. The aligned-versus-shuffled oracle comparison is the central result. Readers working on diffusion-as-inference or retrieval-augmented iterative refinement should also inspect the key encoder design, especially the choice of label-ordered readout. The Sudoku section is best read as a failure-attribution example rather than as a new solver.

recommendation.zh: 对离散扩散模型做推理的机制拆解很干净，五臂消融法值得借鉴，关注 Diffusion LM 推理机制的必看。
recommendation.en: Clean mechanism disentanglement for discrete diffusion inference; the five-arm ablation is worth adopting for those studying Diffusion LM reasoning.

paper.title: \textsc{DiARC}: Distinguishing Positive and Negative Samples Helps Improving ARC-like Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC;~\citealp{chollet2019measure}) contains tasks that require summarizing patterns from limited grid samples and predicting output grids. Recently, many large language model based approaches have attempted to transform it into a text-based reasoning task. However, methods based on open-source models have generally yielded unsatisfactory results, while those relying on closed-source models are too costly. Current efforts mainly focus on data augmentation, co

summary.core_problem: 提升开源 LLM 在 ARC-like grid reasoning 任务上的表现，尤其是让模型不仅学习正确样例，还能区分错误样例。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向推理能力的后训练数据构造。它把 preference alignment 思路迁移到 ARC-like 任务，用正负样本对训练模型识别更合理的推理轨迹或答案；价值主要在特定推理 benchmark，而非通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiARC，通过构造 positive/negative preference pairs，让模型在训练中学习区分符合抽象规则的样本和不符合规则的样本。摘要提到设计了三种负样本构造方式，但未给出完整细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明现有开源模型在 text-based ARC 上表现不佳，闭源模型成本较高；DiARC 以偏好对方式改进 ARC-like reasoning。摘要未提供模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 数值或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Shenzhen University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve open-source LLM performance on ARC-like grid reasoning by teaching models to distinguish correct examples from incorrect ones.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training data-construction contribution for reasoning. It transfers preference-alignment ideas to ARC-like tasks by building positive/negative pairs. Its value is mostly benchmark-specific rather than a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiARC constructs preference pairs consisting of positive and negative ARC-like samples, so the model learns to discriminate rule-consistent outputs from rule-violating ones. The abstract mentions three negative-sample construction strategies but does not provide the full details.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that open-source models perform poorly on text-based ARC while closed-source models are costly, and that DiARC improves ARC-like reasoning through preference-pair training. It does not provide model sizes, training-data scale, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Shenzhen University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 reasoning SFT 数据构造备查即可；负样本偏好对方向合理，但 ARC setup 太窄，别外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for reasoning SFT data construction; negative preference pairs make sense, but the ARC setup is too narrow to extrapolate to pretraining.

paper.title: ExTra: Exploratory Trajectory Optimization for Language Model Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for language-model reasoning can fail at both extremes of task difficulty: easy prompts often produce all-correct, low-diversity rollout groups with little gradient signal, while hard prompts can produce all-incorrect groups with no positive reward. We introduce ExTra (Exploratory Trajectory Optimization), a GRPO-compatible framework that extracts exploration signals from the model's own rollouts. ExTra combines two mechanisms: (i) a novelty

summary.core_problem: GRPO是当前LLM可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的主流算法，但在任务难度两端存在固有失效模式：简单题采样轨迹全对时，组内奖励方差坍缩，梯度接近零，同时推理轨迹多样性下降，拖累pass@k等基于采样的推理缩放指标；难题采样轨迹全错时，组内无正奖励，优势值全为零，训练批次完全浪费。现有基于难度过滤、过采样的方案会直接丢弃高价值的难题，且从头重采样的探索效率很低。
summary.importance: 该方案解决了GRPO在难度两端的样本效率问题，无需额外奖励模型或外部监督，可直接接入标准GRPO训练流程，同时提升pass@1和pass@k性能，对推理模型RL训练的样本效率提升、推理能力扩展有实际工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出完全兼容GRPO的模块化框架ExTra，包含两个互补机制：1）基于嵌入的新颖度奖励：仅对正确轨迹施加语义多样性奖励，在GRPO组内归一化后加入总奖励，激励生成多样的正确解法，在恢复简单题梯度信号的同时避免鼓励错误的多样性；2）熵引导的前缀再生：针对组内准确率为零的难题，使用模型生成过程中的平均token熵（MTE）作为无监督信号，从已生成的失败轨迹中选择探索潜力最高的中间步作为前缀继续采样，而非从头重采样，有效缩小探索空间。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-1.7B模型上，六个数学推理基准（MATH-500、AMC23、Minerva、OlympiadBench、AIME24、AIME25）上相对原生GRPO，pass@1提升约5个百分点，pass@16提升约7个百分点；消融实验显示增益同时来自单条轨迹质量提升和推理轨迹覆盖范围扩大；理论分析验证了有信息的前缀代理可有效降低探索空间复杂度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3节两个核心机制的设计逻辑，尤其是新颖度奖励采用正确轨迹门控的原因、平均token熵作为前缀选择指标的实证依据，以及第5节的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), the dominant algorithm for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) in LLM reasoning training, suffers from structural failure modes at both extremes of task difficulty: on easy prompts, all sampled trajectories are correct, leading to collapsed within-group reward variance, near-zero gradients, and reduced trajectory diversity that degrades pass@k and sampling-based inference scaling; on hard prompts, all sampled trajectories are incorrect, leading to zero advantages and complete waste of training batches. Existing mitigation approaches based on difficulty filtering and oversampling discard high-value hard prompts entirely and rely on inefficient resampling from scratch.
summary_en.importance: ExTra addresses GRPO's sample efficiency issues at both difficulty extremes without requiring additional reward models or external supervision, and can be plugged directly into standard GRPO training pipelines. It improves both pass@1 and pass@k performance, providing practical engineering value for scaling reasoning capabilities via RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExTra is a modular, GRPO-compatible framework with two complementary mechanisms: (1) Embedding-based novelty reward: a semantic diversity bonus applied only to correct trajectories, added after GRPO reward normalization, to encourage diverse correct solutions. This restores gradient signal on easy prompts without incentivizing diverse failures; (2) Entropy-guided prefix regeneration: for hard prompts with zero in-group accuracy, the method uses mean token entropy (MTE), an unsupervised signal from the model's own generation process, to select promising intermediate steps from existing failed trajectories as prefixes for further sampling, rather than resampling from scratch, which reduces the effective exploration space.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-1.7B across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks (MATH-500, AMC23, Minerva, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25), ExTra improves over vanilla GRPO by ~5 points on pass@1 and ~7 points on pass@16. Ablations show gains come from both improved individual solution quality and broader coverage of reasoning trajectories. Theoretical analysis confirms that informative prefix proxies reduce exploration space complexity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the design rationale for the two core mechanisms in Section 3, particularly the correctness gating for novelty rewards and empirical justification for mean token entropy as a prefix selection metric, plus the ablation results in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；它把 GRPO 的零梯度区间处理得更干净，但仍是后训练局部补丁。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; it handles GRPO’s zero-signal regimes cleanly, though it remains a local post-training fix.

paper.title: MiniOpt: Reasoning to Model and Solve General Optimization Problems with Limited Resources
paper.abstract: Achieving strong optimization generalization across diverse optimization problems while requiring limited training resources remains a challenging problem for optimization-oriented large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches typically rely on large-scale supervised datasets, costly reasoning annotations, and expensive intermediate step verification, resulting in substantial training overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MiniOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是小参数模型在自然语言优化问题上的泛化训练问题：如何在少量标注、有限训练成本和较低推理开销下，让模型把问题描述转成可执行的数学建模与求解代码，而不是依赖大规模 SFT 数据、人工 CoT 标注或昂贵的逐步验证。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座预训练本身，而在 post-train 与 verifiable reasoning 的接口设计。MiniOpt 把优化建模任务改造成适合 RLVR 的结构化生成问题，说明在高验证成本任务上，奖励设计和中间表示比单纯增加 CoT 数据更关键。对小模型能力注入、领域推理数据效率、可执行反馈训练有参考价值，但贡献主要限于优化建模垂类，不应外推为通用推理训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: MiniOpt 采用 reasoning-to-model-and-solve 范式，将传统“建模并求解”的流程显式拆成结构化优化建模和可执行 solver 生成。核心做法是把 CoT 改写成五元素 tuple 的结构化表示，使中间推理更容易验证。训练流程分为三段：先用少量标注数据做 mid-training，缓解早期 RL 的奖励稀疏和训练坍塌；随后第一阶段 RL 使用较低难度数据，让模型学会固定的建模—求解轨迹；第二阶段 RL 切到更难数据，提升跨类型优化问题的泛化。奖励函数 OptReward 是分层结构，重点不是逐字验证建模内容，而是检查建模完整性、可执行性和最终求解结果，同时把生成轨迹约束在正确建模附近，降低 reward hacking 风险。论文还对 GPRO 算法做了面向小样本训练的调整，以提高有限数据下的 RL 利用率。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 MiniOpt-3B，在 8 个覆盖不同优化类型和问题场景的 benchmark 上评估。论文报告称，在 10B 参数以下模型中 MiniOpt-3B 平均表现最好；与更大模型相比，它接近 LLMOPT-14B，并比 GPT-5 这类通用 thinking model 高 2.11 个百分点。与 DeepSeek-R1 相比，MiniOpt-3B 的平均 SA 指标具有竞争力，同时平均只使用 DeepSeek-R1 约 24.40% 的输出 token。消融结论集中在三点：reasoning-to-model-and-solve 的结构化轨迹能提升 RLVR 稳定性；mid-training 能缓解稀疏奖励下的小模型训练失败；分层 OptReward 比只看最终答案更利于保持建模正确性和泛化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中五元素 tuple、OptReward 的分层奖励定义、两阶段 RL 训练流程，以及实验中的 ablation 表。最有信息量的部分是它如何把一个难验证的自然语言建模任务改造成可验证 RL 任务。对基座预训练研究员来说，不需要细读优化问题 benchmark 的全部设定，重点关注奖励可验证性、结构化中间表示和小模型 RL 稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train a small language model to generalize across natural-language optimization problems under tight data and compute budgets. The target capability is not just producing an answer, but converting a problem statement into a structured mathematical model and executable solver code without relying on large SFT corpora, expensive reasoning annotations, or costly step-by-step verification.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but concrete. The useful signal is in the post-training interface: how to turn a hard-to-verify reasoning task into a structured RLVR problem. MiniOpt shows that, for executable reasoning domains, intermediate representation and reward design can matter more than collecting long annotated CoT traces. The contribution is best read as a case study in data-efficient small-model specialization and verifiable reasoning, not as a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniOpt introduces a reasoning-to-model-and-solve pipeline. It decomposes optimization reasoning into structured optimization modeling and solver-code generation. The main technical device is a five-element tuple representation embedded into the reasoning trace, which makes the intermediate modeling process easier to check. Training is progressive: a small mid-training stage on annotated data first stabilizes the policy and reduces collapse from sparse rewards; a first RL stage on easier examples teaches the model the modeling-and-solving protocol; a second RL stage on harder data improves generalization. The reward, OptReward, is hierarchical. It checks modeling completeness, executability, and solution quality, while avoiding full semantic verification of every modeling statement. This design also constrains trajectories near valid formulations to reduce reward hacking. The paper further modifies GPRO for limited-sample RL training.
summary_en.experiments: The main model is MiniOpt-3B, evaluated on 8 benchmarks covering multiple optimization types and scenarios. The paper reports that MiniOpt-3B outperforms all baselines below 10B parameters, remains competitive with LLMOPT-14B, and exceeds GPT-5 by 2.11 percentage points on the reported aggregate metric. Compared with DeepSeek-R1, it reaches competitive average SA while using about 24.40% of DeepSeek-R1's output tokens. The ablations attribute the gains to three components: the structured reasoning-to-model-and-solve format, the mid-training stage for stabilizing sparse-reward RL, and the hierarchical OptReward design.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the methodology section defining the five-element tuple, the OptReward hierarchy, the progressive RL schedule, and the ablation tables. The main transferable idea is how the authors reshape an optimization-modeling task into a verifiable RL problem. The benchmark-specific details are less important unless one works directly on LLM-based optimization modeling.

recommendation.zh: 将复杂推理任务（运筹优化）分解为建模和求解，并设计了分层 Reward 进行 RL 训练，对如何用 RL 提升 LLM 特定领域推理能力有启发。
recommendation.en: Decomposes complex reasoning tasks (operations research) into modeling and solving, and designs a hierarchical Reward for RL training, inspiring how to use RL to enhance LLM domain-specific reasoning.

paper.title: Blockwise Policy-Drift Gating for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy using teacher signals computed on trajectories sampled by the student itself. Recent work shows that sampled-token OPD can be fragile on long-horizon reasoning tasks and that local teacher-support matching is a simple and effective repair. This paper introduces blockwise policy-drift gating, a lightweight student-only old-current drift controller for OPD under rollout reuse. The method computes log-probability shifts between the behavior stude

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 on-policy distillation 在长链推理训练中的一个稳定性问题：当 student rollout 被重复用于多个优化 epoch 时，当前 student 与生成这些 rollout 的旧 student 之间会发生 policy drift，导致同一条 sampled path 对当前更新来说“新鲜度”不同。已有工作更多关注 teacher 监督是否足够可靠，比如 sampled-token OPD 的脆弱性以及 Teacher-TopK/LSM 对局部 teacher support 的修复；这篇文章补的是另一块：即使 teacher target 不变，reused rollout 本身也会因为 old-current mismatch 变得不均匀可信，尤其在长响应里这种失配会沿序列累积。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口有现实意义。原因在于，很多后训练配方已经越来越像“继续训练一个会推理的语言模型”，而不是简单 SFT。OPD、RL、蒸馏这类方法的稳定性，会反过来影响大家如何理解 teacher-student compatibility、rollout reuse、以及长链 reasoning 数据的有效训练信号密度。论文的价值不在提出一个新目标，而在给出一个很轻量的 loss reweighting 规则：不改 teacher、不改 rollout policy、不改 support matching，只根据 student 自身 old/current log-prob shift 来调节哪些位置更该被当前更新重视。这个思路比较务实，也容易嵌入现有 PPO-style 训练框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 blockwise policy-drift gating。作者先定义 sampled token 路径上的 old-current log-probability shift，也就是当前 student 对某个已采样 token 的对数概率，与生成该 token 的 behavior student 的对数概率之差。这个量不是完整 KL，只是沿 sampled path 的局部漂移信号。直接用 token-level importance ratio exp(d_t) 做权重会很噪，因此作者选择中间粒度聚合：一类是固定 64 token 的 Block64-Gate，另一类是按换行切分并做长度修正的 NewlineSpan-Gate。对每个 block/span，把 shift 求平均，经过 detached soft gate 和 mean normalization 后，广播回该区域内所有 token，作为已有 OPD position loss 的乘子。关键点有三个。第一，gate 是 detached 的，不让模型为了操纵 gate 而学习；它只改变损失权重，不引入额外优化目标。第二，teacher target 完全不变，因此该方法既可加在 sampled-token OPD 上，也可叠加到 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上。第三，分块而不是逐 token，是为了在长 reasoning trace 中平衡方差和局部性：sequence-level 太粗，token-level 太抖，block-level 是折中。
summary.experiments: 实验设置比较克制。student 是 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，teacher 是 Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO；训练数据来自 DAPO-Math-17k 处理后的 1,791,700 行数学样本；统一采用 200 step 训练预算、最大 response 长度 16384、rollout group size 8、两轮 PPO epoch。评测用外部 vLLM，主指标是四个数学 benchmark 上的 pass@8。论文主结论是：固定 64-token block 的 drift gate 能稳定提升 sampled-token OPD 的 solve rate；而在 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上继续叠加该 gate，也能得到最强的 aggregate pass@8。摘要没有给出完整数字表，但从全文描述看，作者更强调趋势一致性而不是单点大幅跃升：token-level importance weighting 噪声较大，sequence-level weighting 过于粗糙，blockwise aggregation 在六个方法变体里表现最稳。这个结果与方法设计是对齐的，因为它本来就是为 rollout reuse 下的 stale-data 问题服务，而不是试图替代 teacher support matching。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言里对 OPD 两类失配的区分：一类是 teacher support 不足，另一类是 old-current student drift。把这两件事分开理解，后面的方法就很清楚。然后看 policy-drift gating 章节，重点抓住 gate 的定义、detached 设计、mean normalization，以及为什么选 block64 和 newline span 这两种粒度。最后看主实验矩阵，关注六个变体在四个数学 benchmark 上的相对排序，而不是只盯单个分数。若只想判断是否值得跟进，读方法部分加主结果表大约 20 到 30 分钟即可。更值得深挖的问题是：这种 drift-aware weighting 是否能推广到更长训练预算、更强 teacher、以及 RL-only setting；另外，它和 PPO 里的 importance sampling / clipping 之间是否存在更系统的统一视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a stability issue in on-policy distillation for long-horizon reasoning. When student rollouts are reused across multiple optimization epochs, the current student can drift away from the behavior student that generated those trajectories. This creates a mismatch even if teacher supervision is unchanged: some sampled positions become stale for the current update. Prior work has mostly focused on teacher-side reliability, such as the fragility of sampled-token OPD and the repair provided by Teacher-TopK or local support matching. This paper targets a different failure mode: old-current student drift under rollout reuse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Modern post-training increasingly resembles continued language-model training with stronger reasoning behavior, so the stability of OPD, RL, and distillation affects how researchers think about teacher-student compatibility, rollout reuse, and the density of useful training signal in long reasoning traces. The paper’s value is its restraint: it does not introduce a new teacher objective or a new rollout policy. Instead, it adds a lightweight loss reweighting rule based only on the student’s own old-versus-current log-probability shift. That makes it easy to plug into existing PPO-style pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is called blockwise policy-drift gating. For each sampled response token, the paper computes the old-current log-probability shift: the difference between the current student’s log-probability and the behavior student’s log-probability on the same sampled token. This is not a full KL estimate; it is a sampled-path drift signal. Using token-level importance ratios such as exp(d_t) is a natural baseline, but the paper argues that it is too noisy. Instead, it aggregates drift at an intermediate granularity. Two variants are used: Block64-Gate, which averages shifts over fixed 64-token blocks, and NewlineSpan-Gate, which aggregates over newline-delimited spans with heuristics for merging or splitting spans by length. The aggregated score is passed through a detached soft gate and mean-normalized over valid response tokens, then broadcast back to all positions in the region as a multiplicative weight on the existing OPD position loss. Three design choices matter. First, the gate is detached, so the model cannot optimize the gate itself; it only changes how much each position contributes to the base loss. Second, teacher targets are unchanged, so the same gating family can be applied both to sampled-token OPD and to Teacher-TopK/LSM. Third, blockwise aggregation is a variance-locality trade-off: sequence-level weighting is too coarse for long traces, while token-level weighting is too unstable.
summary_en.experiments: The setup is controlled rather than large-scale. The student is Qwen3-1.7B-Base and the teacher is Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO. Training uses 1,791,700 processed math rows from DAPO-Math-17k, with a fixed 200-step budget, maximum response length 16384, rollout group size 8, and two PPO epochs. Evaluation is done externally with vLLM, and pass@8 on four math benchmarks is the main metric. The main finding is that fixed 64-token drift gating consistently improves sampled-token OPD solve rate, and that adding the same gate on top of Teacher-TopK/LSM yields the strongest aggregate pass@8 among the tested variants. The abstract does not expose the full numeric table, and the paper’s emphasis is more on consistent ranking than on a single dramatic gain. That is aligned with the method’s role: it is meant to mitigate stale-data effects under rollout reuse, not to replace teacher-support matching.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and pay attention to the distinction between two kinds of mismatch: insufficient teacher support versus old-current student drift. Once that separation is clear, the method section becomes straightforward. In the policy-drift gating section, focus on the gate definition, the detached design, the mean normalization, and why the paper chooses Block64 and newline spans as the two aggregation granularities. Then look at the main experiment matrix and compare the relative ordering of the six variants across the four math benchmarks rather than over-reading any single score. If the goal is just to judge whether the idea is worth following up, the method section plus the main result table should take about 20 to 30 minutes. The more interesting follow-up questions are whether this drift-aware weighting scales to longer training budgets, stronger teachers, or RL-only settings, and how it relates more systematically to importance sampling and clipping in PPO.

recommendation.zh: OPD是推理能力轻量化落地的核心路径，重点看§3的块级漂移聚合方式，可作为内部推理蒸馏ablation的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: On-policy distillation is a core path for lightweight reasoning deployment; focus on §3's block-wise drift aggregation as a baseline for internal reasoning distillation ablations.

paper.title: Reasoning as Attractor Dynamics: Latent Memory Retrieval via Gibbs-Weighted Energy Minimization
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are traditionally viewed as autoregressive generators. However, from the perspective of collective computation, they function as high-dimensional Dense Associative Memories that store complex reasoning patterns as latent attractors. In this work, we investigate the energy landscape of mathematical reasoning. We posit that correct reasoning chains correspond to deep, wide attractor basins ("flat minima") in the model's output distribution, whereas hallucinations manif

summary.core_problem: 把数学推理中的正确链路与幻觉链路解释为 LLM 输出分布中的不同能量盆地，并尝试用这一几何结构改进采样推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏机制假设和测试时推理策略。它不是预训练方法，但把 CoT、自一致性和能量景观联系起来，对理解采样、多路径推理和 latent memory retrieval 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 LLM 视为高维稠密联想记忆，认为正确推理链对应深且宽的吸引子盆地，幻觉对应尖锐局部极小值。方法上采样多条推理轨迹，用轨迹谱熵定义能量，再按 Gibbs 权重 P ∝ exp(-βE) 对候选路径加权，相当于把多样本推理从简单投票改成能量加权检索。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Microsoft Phi-3.5，在 GSM8K 上报告约 5.38% 提升。摘要只给出单一模型和单一数学数据集结果，采样数、baseline 细节和统计稳定性在给定信息中不完整，因此结论需要谨慎看待。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper frames correct and hallucinated mathematical reasoning traces as different basins in the LLM output energy landscape, and uses that geometry to improve test-time reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a mechanistic hypothesis plus a decoding-time intervention. It is not a pretraining method, but it connects CoT sampling, self-consistency, and energy landscapes in a way that may be useful for thinking about multi-sample reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author treats an LLM as a high-dimensional dense associative memory. Correct reasoning chains are assumed to lie in deep, wide attractor basins, while hallucinations are sharp local minima. Multiple reasoning trajectories are sampled, assigned an energy based on spectral entropy, and reweighted with a Gibbs measure, P ∝ exp(-βE), instead of using plain voting or likelihood ranking.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiment uses Microsoft Phi-3.5 on GSM8K and claims a 5.38% improvement. The provided abstract only exposes one model and one math benchmark, with incomplete details on sample count, baselines, and variance, so the empirical strength is limited.

recommendation.zh: 当作 energy-based 解读 CoT 的弱信号即可；先看能量定义和 GSM8K setup，别把吸引子叙事当证据。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a weak signal for energy-based CoT decoding; read the energy definition and GSM8K setup, not the attractor story.

paper.title: Look Light, Think Heavy: What Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Can and Cannot Do
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a standard method for improving reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by eliciting step-by-step thinking, but its effectiveness in multimodal tasks remains unclear. In this paper, we aim to systematically investigate the key question: What can multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning do, and where and why does it fall short? To this end, we evaluate 12 multimodal tasks across perception and reasoning categories using both 14 non-reasoning models an

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究多模态 Chain-of-Thought 的适用边界：CoT 在视觉语言任务中什么时候有帮助，什么时候会带来额外错误，以及当前多模态 reasoning model 为什么没有稳定地从长推理中受益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在两个方面。第一，视觉语言模型的 test-time scaling 不能直接照搬纯文本推理模型的经验；更长的语言推理不等于更好的视觉推理。第二，当前多模态 RLVR 或 reasoning 训练如果过度集中在数学题，可能会提高少数推理 benchmark，却不能形成广泛的视觉-语言推理能力。对预训练和中训练而言，这提示视觉 token 的持续利用、视觉反思能力、视觉工具调用和任务混合，比单纯拉长 CoT 更关键。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把多模态任务分成两类：感知任务和推理任务。感知任务包括综合评测、OCR、视觉 grounding、幻觉、知识型 VQA、目标计数；推理任务包括数学、科学、逻辑、算法、空间和多图推理。实验比较了 direct answering 与 CoT reasoning，并覆盖 14 个非 reasoning 模型和 8 个 reasoning 模型。分析不只看最终准确率，还进一步检查外部行为和内部机制。外部行为上，论文区分 visual reflection 和 verbal reflection：前者指模型是否持续回看和修正视觉信息理解，后者指语言层面的自我检查。内部机制上，论文观察长 CoT 中对视觉 token 与推理 token 的注意力分配，发现模型在生成较长推理时逐渐把注意力集中到语言推理 token，弱化对视觉输入的使用。这解释了标题中的 “Look Light, Think Heavy”：语言推理很长，但视觉信息利用不足。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 12 类多模态任务、14 个非 reasoning 模型和 8 个 reasoning 模型，包括 Qwen2.5-VL、Gemma-3、GPT-4.1、QVQ、Skywork-R1V2、Gemini-Thinking 等。主要结果是：CoT 对感知任务并不稳定，可能损害视觉 grounding、知识型 VQA 和目标计数等任务；对数学、科学、多图推理更有帮助，几乎在多数模型上带来正向收益；对逻辑和算法推理则高度依赖模型规模和基础能力，大模型更容易受益，小模型可能出现负收益。对 reasoning model 的比较显示，现有开源多模态 reasoning 模型在广泛任务平均表现上通常只有边际提升，可能因为训练主要集中在数学 RLVR。商业 reasoning 模型如 Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking 在更多推理任务上表现出更一致的增益。机制分析显示，verbal reflection 在推理中段上升后回落，而 visual reflection 随推理过程持续下降；长 CoT 中还存在对 reasoning tokens 的注意力偏置，视觉 tokens 被逐步忽视。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。先看任务分类和模型列表，确认评测覆盖面；再看 RQ1 的 direct answer 与 CoT 对比，这是判断多模态 CoT 是否该启用的核心依据。RQ2 适合关注开源 reasoning VLM 与原模型的差距，尤其是数学 RLVR 训练带来的任务偏置。RQ3 最值得做预训练的人细看：visual reflection、verbal reflection 和 attention bias 的分析直接指向训练目标设计问题。若时间有限，优先看 Figure 1 及围绕三个 RQ 的实验结论；具体 benchmark 细节可以快速扫过。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the operating range of multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning: when step-by-step reasoning helps vision-language models, when it hurts, and why current multimodal reasoning models do not consistently benefit from longer test-time reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for foundation-model research is that visual-language test-time scaling cannot be copied directly from text-only reasoning models. Longer verbal reasoning does not guarantee better visual reasoning. The results also suggest that multimodal RLVR focused mostly on math problems can produce narrow gains without broad reasoning transfer. For pretraining and mid-training, the relevant issues are persistent use of visual tokens, visual introspection, tool-assisted perception, and task mixture design, rather than simply encouraging longer CoT traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study separates multimodal tasks into perception and reasoning categories. Perception tasks include broad multimodal evaluation, OCR, visual grounding, hallucination, knowledge-based VQA, and object counting. Reasoning tasks include math, science, logic, algorithmic reasoning, spatial reasoning, and multi-image reasoning. The experiments compare direct answering with CoT prompting across 14 non-reasoning models and 8 reasoning models. The analysis then goes beyond accuracy. It decomposes reflective behavior into visual reflection and verbal reflection, and inspects how attention shifts between visual tokens and reasoning tokens during long CoT generation. The key mechanism is that current models often reason extensively in language while progressively reducing their use of visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 12 multimodal task families and 22 models in total, including non-reasoning models such as Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma-3, and GPT-4.1, and reasoning models such as QVQ, Skywork-R1V2, and Gemini-Thinking. CoT is not uniformly beneficial. It can hurt perception-heavy tasks such as visual grounding, knowledge-based VQA, and object counting. It is more consistently useful for math, science, and multi-image reasoning. For logical and algorithmic reasoning, gains depend strongly on the model: larger models tend to benefit, while smaller models can degrade. Existing open-source multimodal reasoning models show only marginal average gains across the broad task set, likely because their training is dominated by math-oriented RLVR. Commercial reasoning models, especially Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking, show more consistent improvements on diverse reasoning tasks. The mechanism analysis reports a “Look Light, Think Heavy” pattern: verbal reflection rises and then falls through the reasoning trace, while visual reflection steadily declines; attention also becomes increasingly biased toward reasoning tokens over visual tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the task taxonomy and model list to understand the evaluation scope. Then read the RQ1 results comparing direct answering and CoT; this is the most practical part for deciding when multimodal CoT should be enabled. RQ2 is useful for understanding the gap between open-source reasoning VLMs and their base models, especially the task bias introduced by math-heavy RLVR. RQ3 is the most relevant part for pretraining researchers, because the visual-reflection and attention-bias analyses point to weaknesses in current training objectives. If time is limited, focus on Figure 1 and the conclusions around the three research questions, and skim the benchmark-specific details.

recommendation.zh: 值得看任务分组和失败案例；它会约束 VLM CoT 数据合成，避免把感知任务也硬写成长推理。
recommendation.en: Read the task split and failure cases; it constrains VLM CoT data synthesis by warning against forcing perception tasks into long reasoning traces.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
