The Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems

paper.title: What are Key Factors for Updates in RL for LLM Reasoning?
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising framework for enhancing the reasoning ability of large language models. However, much of the existing work is guided by heuristic intuition, leading to divergent algorithmic choices, even contradictory ones that nevertheless report empirical gains. To better understand this phenomenon, we conduct a theoretical analysis of RLVR updates. Our study reveals that differences in off-policy degree, determined by the number

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“RLVR 有没有用”，而是一个更基础的问题：在基于可验证奖励的 LLM 推理强化学习里，真正决定一次参数更新长什么样的因素是什么。已有做法里，很多 token 级启发彼此相反：有的强调高熵 token，有的强调高概率 token，但都能得到增益。全文给出的解释是，这类表面矛盾往往不是来自 token 本身，而是来自 rollout 复用带来的 off-policy 程度不同。GRPO/DAPO 这类方法依赖 importance sampling ratio 和 clipping；当同一批 rollout 被重复更新多次后，当前策略与采样策略逐渐偏离，不同 token 的 IS ratio 分布会发生系统性变化，进而改变哪些 token 真正主导梯度、以及更新方向相对 on-policy 理想梯度偏了多少。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的意义都很直接。第一，它把当前 reasoning RL 里大量经验性 recipe 拉回到一个更可分析的量上：effective gradient expectation，而不是停留在“哪些 token 更重要”的局部直觉。第二，它说明 update-to-rollout ratio 不是训练工程细节，而是会改变优化对象近似方式的核心变量；这对大规模 RL 训练的 sample reuse、throughput 设计、以及 mid-train/RL 阶段的稳定性判断都有参考价值。第三，论文指出固定全局 clip window 与不同 token 组、不同 off-policy regime 下高度异质的 ratio dispersion 并不匹配，这个结论不只适用于 GRPO，也会影响更广泛的 clipped policy gradient 设计。贡献量级上，理论部分主要是澄清机制，方法部分 ACPO 属于有针对性的改进，不是另起范式，但它把“为什么改 clip”讲得比较完整。
summary.technical_approach:
技术主线分两层。第一层是理论分析。作者从 clipped policy-gradient 形式出发，把 RLVR 中单 token 更新写成 advantage、token 概率、IS ratio 与 clipping 的组合，并把关注点放在条件梯度期望上，而不是未裁剪的瞬时梯度。关键分析对象是 off-policy degree 对 ratio 方差的影响：随着每个 rollout 上执行更多 gradient steps，当前策略相对 behavior policy 漂移增大，低概率 token 的 ratio 更分散，更容易落到 clipping 区间外。由此得到一个核心现象：gradient dominance reversal。接近 on-policy 时，低概率 token 因为 1/p 型放大效应更容易主导更新；但在更 off-policy 的 regime 下，它们先被更强烈地裁剪，反而是高概率 token 留下更多有效梯度。这个结论用来统一此前“高熵优先”和“高概率优先”两类经验做法。

第二层是分解更新的 magnitude 和 direction。论文不只看谁贡献大，还看 clipping 如何让更新方向偏离 on-policy 梯度。作者按 token probability、advantage 符号与大小、以及 ratio clipping 的交互来分析：正 advantage 与负 advantage 在上下界裁剪下受到的影响并不对称；不同 token 组的 ratio dispersion 不同，意味着同一个全局 [1-ε_l, 1+ε_h] 会对某些组过紧、对另一些组过松，结果既改变梯度大小，也引入方向旋转。

基于这个诊断，作者提出 ACPO（Adaptive Clip Policy Optimization）。核心不是再设计一个新 advantage，而是把固定全局 clipping 改成按 token bin 自适应的 clipping threshold。bin 的划分围绕 token 组的异质性来做，目标是让不同组面对更匹配的裁剪范围，减少某一类 token 因 ratio 方差更大而被系统性压制。ACPO 还显式面向 variance-aware clipping：根据各 bin 的 ratio dispersion 调整上下界，从而同时缓解 uneven clipping 和 clipping-induced bias。与 DAPO、CISPO 这类方法相比，它不是直接偏向高概率或高熵 token，而是把“该保留谁”交给 ratio 分布本身决定。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的重点不是单一榜单提升，而是验证理论预测是否真的对应训练现象。论文在三类 reasoning 任务上比较 ACPO 与强基线，包括 DAPO 和 CISPO，并同时覆盖 near on-policy 与明显 off-policy 两种训练设置。摘要和正文给出的主结论是：ACPO 在不同模型规模、不同任务、不同 off-policy 程度下都更稳定且整体更优，说明 adaptive clipping 不是只在某个特定 recipe 下有效。

更值得看的是几类分析实验。第一类是 ratio 分布与 clipping 行为统计：随着每 rollout 的更新步数增加，低概率 token 的 IS ratio 方差显著增大，被裁剪比例上升，验证了 dominance reversal 的前提。第二类是 token-group contribution 分析：在近 on-policy 设置里，低概率 token 对有效梯度贡献更大；当 off-policy 程度升高后，贡献峰值向高概率 token 迁移。第三类是方向偏差分析：作者比较 clipped gradient 与 on-policy reference gradient 的夹角或相似度，显示固定全局 clip 会带来可观的方向偏移，而 ACPO 能减轻这种偏移。第四类是消融：去掉 bin-wise 自适应、只做简单非对称 clip、或不考虑 ratio dispersion 时，收益会回落，说明改进不只是“多调了几个阈值”。

从全文可提炼出的实用信息是：如果训练系统里 rollout 便宜、update 昂贵，导致 sample reuse 很高，那么你看到的 token-level heuristic 效果，很可能首先是在响应 off-policy/clipping 机制，而不是在捕捉某种更深的 reasoning token 语义。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“现象—理论—方法—验证”顺序读。先看引言和 Figure 1，明确作者要解释的是哪两类相反启发。然后重点读 Section 2：这里给出 off-policy degree、IS ratio dispersion 与 conditional gradient expectation 的关系，是全文最关键的理论支点。读这一节时要盯住两个问题：为什么低概率 token 在近 on-policy 时会放大，为什么一旦 ratio 方差变大又会先被 clipping 吃掉。

接着读 Section 3。这里的价值在于把“更新变小了”与“更新方向歪了”分开分析。很多实现只盯 reward 或 win rate，不看 gradient bias；这一节解释了为什么同样的 clip 既可能稳定训练，也可能悄悄改了优化目标。若只想抓核心，优先看关于 token probability、advantage sign、clip asymmetry 的分解图表。

Section 4 的 ACPO 读法要带着前面的诊断去看：它不是经验 trick，而是针对 heterogeneous ratio dispersion 的修补。重点看 bin 如何定义、阈值如何自适应、训练时是否引入额外不稳定因素。

实验部分优先看三类图表：1）不同 off-policy 程度下各 token 组的 ratio 方差和 clipping rate；2）effective gradient contribution 的迁移；3）ACPO 对 gradient bias 和最终任务指标的影响。如果时间有限，先读理论图和主要消融，再看主结果表。精读时间大约 60–90 分钟，若要复现思路，建议顺手把 GRPO/DAPO/CISPO 的目标函数并排写一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more fundamental question than whether RLVR helps reasoning: what actually determines the update in reasoning-oriented RL for LLMs. Prior token-level heuristics look contradictory—some prioritize high-entropy tokens, others high-probability tokens—yet both report gains. The full paper argues that the missing variable is the degree of off-policyness induced by rollout reuse. In GRPO-style training, updates are shaped by importance-sampling ratios and clipping. As the number of gradient steps per rollout increases, the current policy drifts away from the behavior policy, the ratio distribution changes across token groups, and this changes both which tokens dominate the effective gradient and how far the update direction rotates away from the on-policy target.
summary_en.importance: This matters beyond a narrow RLVR recipe discussion. First, it reframes reasoning RL analysis around expected effective gradient under clipping, rather than local intuitions about “important tokens.” That is a cleaner object for understanding training dynamics. Second, it shows that update-to-rollout ratio is not a mere systems knob; it changes the optimization regime itself. That is relevant for large-scale RL where rollout generation and parameter updates have very different costs. Third, the paper makes a strong case that a single global clipping window is structurally mismatched to heterogeneous ratio dispersion across token groups and training regimes. The theoretical contribution is mainly explanatory, but it is useful explanatory work. ACPO is an incremental algorithmic extension, yet it is tightly coupled to the diagnosis and therefore more informative than a generic heuristic tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical layers. The first is a theoretical analysis of clipped policy-gradient updates in RLVR. Starting from the GRPO-style objective, the authors write token-level updates as a function of token probability, advantage, importance ratio, and clipping. The key quantity is the conditional expectation of the effective gradient after clipping, not the raw unclipped gradient. They then connect off-policy degree to the variance of the importance ratio: with more gradient steps per rollout, policy drift increases; low-probability tokens develop more dispersed ratios and are clipped more often. This yields the central phenomenon of gradient dominance reversal. In near on-policy regimes, low-probability tokens can dominate because of stronger amplification. In sufficiently off-policy regimes, those same tokens are disproportionately clipped, and higher-probability tokens end up dominating the surviving update. This is the mechanism used to reconcile prior empirical heuristics.

The second layer analyzes not only update magnitude but also directional bias. The paper decomposes how token probability, advantage sign and magnitude, and asymmetric clipping interact. Positive- and negative-advantage tokens are affected differently by upper and lower clipping bounds. Because ratio dispersion differs across token groups, a single global clipping interval over-regularizes some groups and under-regularizes others. The result is not just uneven gradient magnitude, but also a rotation of the update direction relative to the on-policy gradient.

Motivated by this, the authors propose ACPO, Adaptive Clip Policy Optimization. The main idea is simple but targeted: replace one global clipping range with bin-wise adaptive thresholds. Bins are constructed to reflect heterogeneous token groups, and the clipping thresholds are adjusted according to ratio dispersion. The goal is to reduce uneven clipping and mitigate clipping-induced gradient bias. Compared with methods such as DAPO or CISPO, ACPO does not hard-code a preference for high-probability or high-entropy tokens; it adapts clipping to the observed ratio statistics.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is more about validating the mechanism than chasing a single benchmark number. ACPO is compared against strong baselines, including DAPO and CISPO, on three reasoning tasks, under both near on-policy and more off-policy training regimes. The headline result is consistency: ACPO performs better overall and is more stable across model scales, tasks, and rollout-reuse settings.

The most informative experiments are the diagnostic ones. First, the paper measures ratio distributions and clipping rates across token groups. As the number of updates per rollout increases, low-probability tokens show substantially larger ratio variance and higher clipping frequency, matching the theoretical prediction. Second, the authors analyze effective gradient contribution by token group. In near on-policy settings, low-probability tokens contribute more; as off-policyness increases, the dominant contribution shifts toward higher-probability tokens. Third, they quantify directional bias by comparing clipped gradients with an on-policy reference, showing that fixed global clipping can induce a meaningful directional deviation, while ACPO reduces that deviation. Fourth, ablations show that the gain is not explained by simply adding more thresholds: removing bin-wise adaptation or ignoring ratio dispersion weakens the effect.

The practical takeaway is clear: if rollout generation is cheap and updates are expensive, leading to heavy sample reuse, many token-level heuristics are likely responding first to off-policy clipping dynamics rather than to some deeper notion of reasoning-token importance.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, theory, method, and validation. Start with the introduction and the first motivating figure to understand which empirical contradiction the paper is trying to resolve. Then spend most of the time on Section 2. That section contains the main theoretical hinge: how off-policy degree changes importance-ratio dispersion and therefore the conditional expected gradient. While reading, keep two questions in mind: why low-probability tokens dominate near on-policy, and why they are the first to be suppressed once ratio variance grows.

Section 3 is the next important stop. Its value is that it separates two effects that are often conflated in practice: shrinking the update and rotating the update. Many implementations monitor reward and stability but do not inspect gradient bias. This section explains why clipping can stabilize training while silently changing the optimization direction. Focus on the decomposition by token probability, advantage sign, and clipping asymmetry.

Read Section 4 with the diagnosis in mind. ACPO is not presented as a generic trick; it is a repair for heterogeneous ratio dispersion. Check how bins are defined, how thresholds are adapted, and whether the method adds extra instability or complexity.

In the experiments, prioritize three kinds of figures: ratio variance and clipping rate by token group under different off-policy degrees; shifts in effective gradient contribution; and the effect of ACPO on gradient bias and final task metrics. If time is limited, read the theory figures and the main ablations before the full result tables. A careful read takes about 60–90 minutes. For implementation-oriented readers, it helps to write the GRPO, DAPO, and CISPO objectives side by side while reading.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对“多跑几步 PPO 只是省 rollout”的看法，应优先看梯度期望和 clip 命中分析。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior that extra PPO steps are just rollout amortization; read the expected-gradient and clipping analysis first.

paper.title: Provable Benefits of RLVR over SFT for Reasoning Models: Learning to Backtrack Efficiently
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that reinforcement fine-tuning of pretrained base models can lead to significant gains in reasoning performance at inference time. In this work, we theoretically analyze why reinforcement fine-tuning induces better reasoning ability than purely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We model chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning as a pathfinding problem on graphs and compare the popular method of reinforcement learning with verifiable r

summary.core_problem: 后训练阶段中，带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务上显著优于监督微调（SFT），但缺乏对二者性能差异的原则性理论解释；尤其针对复杂推理核心的回溯能力，尚无正式框架区分两类方法的学习效果。
summary.importance: 1. 首次从回溯能力维度给出SFT与RLVR的严格理论对比，填补了后训练方法性能差异的理论解释空白；2. 证明纯金路径SFT的固有缺陷——无法学习回溯策略，直接解释了SFT易产生伪推理、过拟合金示范的经验现象；3. 推导两类方法推理时计算量的指数级分离结论，同时证明RLVR轨迹蒸馏可转移回溯能力，为当前主流的「RL探索→SFT蒸馏」流程提供了理论支撑；4. 为预训练-后训练闭环的信号设计提供明确指导：仅靠金示范数据不足以支撑复杂推理，必须引入探索产生的失败路径或回退信号（通过RL或显式合成回溯数据均可）。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 任务建模：将思维链（CoT）推理抽象为有向多图上的寻路问题，构造带分支的路径-星型多图（源节点→分叉节点→W条深度为K的分支，每条分支含K个菱形子图，每个菱形子图有L条多重边，仅金路径可到达目标叶子节点）；推理模型被建模为边级linear-softmax二元组或节点级三元组的预训练世界模型。2. 分析框架：采用梯度流（对应SFT）和符号策略梯度流（对应RLVR）做动力学特征分析。3. 核心理论推导：① 严格证明仅在金最短路径上训练的SFT，梯度流不会收敛到任何回溯策略——训练数据完全不包含死端或回退状态的梯度信号，模型仅会学习沿金路径前进的行为；② 证明仅带长度惩罚的结果级奖励的RLVR，会通过on-policy探索产生的失败rollout获得回溯动作的梯度信号，在有限时间内收敛到一致的回溯策略；③ 定量复杂度分离：收敛后RLVR模型到达任意目标的期望时间为Θ(WK)，SFT模型需要Θ(WL^K)（L>1时为指数级差距）；④ 进一步证明将RLVR生成的含回溯过程的推理轨迹，用监督学习蒸馏到基座模型，可转移高效回溯能力，恢复到Θ(WK)的推理时计算效率。
summary.experiments: 所有结论均附严格数学证明（置于附录）；通过构造的图寻路玩具任务的动力学仿真，验证了理论预测的正确性：SFT训练的模型遇到死端时无法有效回退，会反复尝试无效路径，而RLVR训练的模型会快速回溯到分叉节点，二者的推理步数差距随分支深度K和多重边数L的增大呈指数级扩大。
summary.reading_guide: 1. 先读第2节问题建模部分，结合图1重点理解路径-星型多图的构造逻辑，确保掌握推理任务的抽象方式；2. 第3节是核心，重点读3.1节SFT的梯度流分析、3.2节RLVR的符号策略梯度流分析的推导过程，关注两类方法的梯度信号来源差异；3. 第4节的复杂度分离结论和蒸馏有效性证明是延伸核心，需理解为什么包含回溯过程的轨迹蒸馏可以转移能力而非仅做行为克隆；4. 附录的完整证明可根据数学背景选读，重点关注引理3.1（SFT回溯动作梯度为零的条件）和引理3.5（RLVR回溯动作的梯度下界）；5. 值得深挖的方向：如何将玩具图的结论迁移到真实CoT的高维状态空间，预训练阶段能否通过合成回溯数据提前注入回溯能力，RLVR奖励设计的最小充分条件是什么。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) consistently outperforms Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on reasoning tasks during post-training, but there is no principled theoretical explanation for this performance gap; specifically, no formal framework distinguishes the learning effects of the two methods on backtracking — a core capability for complex chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_en.importance: 1. Provides the first rigorous theoretical comparison between SFT and RLVR along the backtracking capability dimension, filling the gap in explaining post-training method performance differences. 2. Proves the inherent limitation of pure golden-path SFT: it cannot learn backtracking strategies, directly explaining empirical observations of SFT being prone to pseudo-reasoning and overfitting to expert demonstrations. 3. Derives an exponential separation of test-time compute between the two methods, and proves that RLVR trajectory distillation can transfer backtracking capability — offering formal support for the mainstream "RL exploration → SFT distillation" workflow. 4. Delivers explicit guidance for signal design in the pretrain-posttrain closed loop: golden demonstrations alone are insufficient for complex reasoning, and failure path or rollback signals generated via exploration (either via RL or explicit synthetic backtracking data) are mandatory.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Task modeling: Abstracts CoT reasoning as a pathfinding problem on a directed multigraph, constructing a branched path-star multigraph (source node → fork node → W branches of depth K, each branch containing K diamond subgraphs with L multiedges per diamond; only the golden path reaches the target leaf node). The reasoning model is formalized as a pretrained world model, either an edge-level linear-softmax bigram or node-level trigram. 2. Analysis framework: Uses gradient flow (for SFT) and sign policy gradient flow (for RLVR) for dynamical characterization. 3. Core theoretical derivation: ① Rigorously proves that SFT trained only on golden shortest paths has gradient flow that never converges to any backtracking strategy — training data contains no gradient signals for dead-end or rollback states, so the model only learns to advance along the golden path. ② Proves that RLVR with only outcome-level reward (plus length penalty) obtains gradient signals for backtracking actions via on-policy failed rollouts, and converges to a consistent backtracking policy in finite time. ③ Quantitative complexity separation: After convergence, the RLVR model reaches any target in Θ(WK) expected time, while the SFT model requires Θ(WL^K) (exponential gap when L>1). ④ Further proves that distilling RLVR-generated reasoning traces (including backtracking steps) into the base model via supervised learning transfers efficient backtracking, recovering Θ(WK) test-time compute efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: All conclusions are supported by rigorous mathematical proofs (deferred to the appendix). Dynamical simulations on the constructed graph pathfinding toy task validate theoretical predictions: SFT-trained models fail to roll back effectively when hitting dead ends and repeatedly attempt invalid paths, while RLVR-trained models quickly backtrack to the fork node. The gap in inference steps between the two methods grows exponentially with branch depth K and multiedge count L.
summary_en.reading_guide: 1. Start with Section 2 (problem formulation), combine with Figure 1 to grasp the construction logic of the path-star multigraph and fully understand how reasoning tasks are abstracted. 2. Section 3 is the core: prioritize the gradient flow analysis of SFT (Section 3.1) and sign policy gradient flow analysis of RLVR (Section 3.2), focusing on the difference in gradient signal sources between the two methods. 3. Section 4 covers the extended core conclusions: the complexity separation result and the proof of distillation effectiveness — understand why trajectory distillation with backtracking steps transfers capability instead of just performing behavior cloning. 4. Selectively read full proofs in the appendix based on mathematical background, especially Lemma 3.1 (condition for zero gradient of SFT backtracking actions) and Lemma 3.5 (gradient lower bound for RLVR backtracking actions). 5. Worth deeper investigation: how to migrate conclusions from toy graphs to the high-dimensional state space of real CoT, whether backtracking capability can be injected during pretraining via synthetic backtracking data, and the minimal sufficient conditions for RLVR reward design.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对“多给金标 CoT 就够了”的 prior；应检查证明假设，并在 RLVR ablation 里测 backtracking 行为。
recommendation.en: This challenges the prior that more gold CoT traces are enough; check the assumptions and add backtracking diagnostics to RLVR ablations.

paper.title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
paper.abstract: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理模型训练和测试时 compute 使用方式不一致的问题。现有 RL 主要训练模型生成一条高质量 reasoning trace，但实际部署时常用并行采样、多候选搜索、候选聚合、验证和修订。模型在训练中没有见过这些 compute primitive，因此不会主动分配顺序计算、并行探索和聚合计算。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练的关系不在数据或模型结构，而在 pretrain-posttrain 接口。它把 test-time scaling 中常见的并行采样和聚合纳入 RL 训练目标，试图让模型学会使用推理预算，而不是靠外部 scaffold 手写调度。对基座研究的启发在于：模型能力不只由单条轨迹的 token-level reasoning 决定，还受训练时暴露的 compute topology 影响。若结果成立，后续 reasoning pretrain、RL pretrain 或长思维训练需要考虑把多样化搜索、候选互补性和聚合能力作为训练对象，而不是只奖励单个 final answer。
summary.technical_approach: SPIRAL 即 Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning。它同时训练三类推理计算：单条 trace 内的顺序计算，例如 reasoning tokens 和工具调用；同一 prompt 下多条独立 trace 的并行计算；以及把多条候选 trace 合成为最终答案的聚合计算。聚合 trace 可用标准 RL 算法训练，例如 GRPO，因为它仍然是生成一个最终输出并接受 reward。并行 trace 的训练更难，因为单条 trace 可能本身不正确，却包含对聚合有用的局部思路。论文用 set reinforcement learning 处理这种 credit assignment：把同一 prompt 下采样得到的一组 generations 当成集合，用集合级 reward 对它们联合赋分，并通过低方差 marginal advantage 给每条 trace 分配学习信号。这个设计区别于常规 GRPO：GRPO 优化单条响应的相对优势，SPIRAL 优化一组候选和一个聚合器共同产生最终正确答案的能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理上微调 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，并与标准 GRPO 在相同训练 compute 预算下比较。测试时扩展不同维度的 inference compute。给出的结果包括：在 parallel compute scaling 下，pass@k 的 scaling efficiency 最高提升到 11 倍；在同时扩展 parallel 和 aggregative compute 时，测试集性能最高高出 15%。这些数字说明改进主要来自更有效地使用多样本和聚合，而不只是单条 chain-of-thought 变强。实验最需要关注的是等训练预算是否严格、parallel sample 数和 aggregator 调用数如何计费、以及提升是否集中在需要搜索的题目而非普通算术题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。先看 introduction 中对 sequential、parallel、aggregative compute 三类瓶颈的定义。然后看 set RL preliminaries 和 SPIRAL objective，重点理解集合级 reward 为什么不能退化成单样本 reward，以及 marginal advantage 如何给并行 trace 做 credit assignment。实验部分优先看训练 compute 对齐、test-time compute scaling 曲线、pass@k scaling efficiency 的定义，以及 GRPO 对照。若时间有限，可以跳过一般 RL 背景，集中读算法目标和 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch between how reasoning models are trained and how they are used at inference time. Standard RL trains a model to produce one strong reasoning trace. In deployment, however, practitioners often use parallel sampling, search over multiple candidates, aggregation, verification, and revision. The model is not trained to coordinate these compute primitives, so additional inference compute is often wasted on redundant traces or weak aggregation.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than to tokenizer, data mixture, or architecture. It treats test-time scaling behavior as a trainable object. The key implication is that reasoning ability depends not only on the quality of a single chain of thought, but also on whether the model has learned the topology of inference compute: sequential thinking, parallel exploration, and cross-trace aggregation. This is a useful direction for RL pretraining and reasoning-oriented mid-training, especially if future training recipes aim to optimize models for the way they will actually be served.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPIRAL stands for Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning. It exposes the model to three forms of inference compute during training: sequential compute inside one trace, parallel compute across independently sampled traces, and aggregative compute that synthesizes a set of traces into a final output. Aggregation traces can be optimized with standard RL algorithms such as GRPO because they generate a final answer that receives a reward. Parallel traces require a different credit assignment scheme: an individual trace may be wrong, but still contain an idea that helps the aggregator solve the problem. SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning, where a set of generations from the same prompt receives a joint learning signal. A low-variance marginal advantage is then used to assign credit to individual traces under the set-level objective. This differs from standard GRPO, which optimizes the relative advantage of individual responses rather than the utility of a candidate set plus an aggregator.
summary_en.experiments: The paper fine-tunes Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on mathematical reasoning and compares SPIRAL against GRPO under an equal training compute budget. At test time, it scales different axes of inference compute. The reported results include up to 11x higher scaling efficiency for pass@k under parallel compute scaling, and up to 15% higher performance when both parallel and aggregative compute are scaled. The main empirical claim is that SPIRAL improves the model’s ability to use multiple samples and aggregation, rather than only improving single-trace reasoning. The most important details to inspect are the compute accounting, the number of sampled traces, the aggregation budget, and whether gains are concentrated on problems that genuinely require search.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the definitions of sequential, parallel, and aggregative compute in the introduction. Then read the set RL preliminaries and the SPIRAL objective carefully, especially why the set-level reward cannot be reduced to a single-sample reward and how marginal advantage handles credit assignment. In the experiments, focus on the test-time compute scaling curves, the definition of pass@k scaling efficiency, compute-matched GRPO comparisons, and ablations over aggregation and parallel sampling.

recommendation.zh: 训练-测试推理范式对齐的新思路，集合RL的目标设计值得在内部后训练ablation中参考，重点看§3的损失定义。
recommendation.en: Novel alignment between training and test-time reasoning paradigms; the set RL objective design in §3 is worth referencing in internal post-training ablations.

paper.title: ReNIO: Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance for LLM On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves LLM reasoning by training a student model on its own generated outputs, but standard OPD treats all student-generated outputs (SGOs) equally regardless of their informativeness. We observe a consistent asymmetry in controlled filtering experiments: in both OPD and on-policy self distillation (OPSD), training only on incorrect SGOs outperforms training only on correct ones. Our further analysis suggests that models trained on correct-only SGOs tend to generat

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）及其自蒸馏变体 OPSD 在推理后训练中默认对学生自己生成的轨迹等权训练，但不同轨迹的信息量不对称：错误轨迹比正确轨迹更能提供靠近模型能力边界的纠错信号，而现有方法缺乏一种不依赖完整 rollout 到最终答案、可在 prefix 上计算的重加权方案。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对后训练（尤其是低成本 reasoning post-training）有直接价值，对预训练研究的启发在于两点：第一，它再次说明“正样本/高回报样本不一定是最有信息量的训练样本”，这和 pretrain 中 hard negative、near-miss、capability boundary 附近样本的数据选择问题相通；第二，它展示了用 student-teacher 概率比在局部 token 上定位错误分支的方法，这种 prefix-computable 信号有潜力迁移到 on-policy pretrain / continual pretrain 的样本筛选或课程设计。
summary.technical_approach: ReNIO 的核心发现来自控制实验：在 OPD 和 OPSD 下，只用错误 SGO（student-generated outputs）训练，一致好于只用正确 SGO 训练。行为分析显示，仅用正确样本训练会导致推理链更短、反思标记更少，而错误样本保留了更多探索和自我修正痕迹。为了在不等到最终答案的前提下强调这类负样本，ReNIO 利用 prefix 上的 student/teacher 概率比定位关键 token：学生给高概率但教师给低概率的 token，视为学生偏好但教师拒绝的分支决策。方法对这类 token 的 log ratio 做截断，按几何平均聚合到样本级别，并在 batch 内归一化作为样本权重，从而把训练重心重新分配到包含强纠错信号的轨迹，同时保留 OPD 使用短 prefix 训练的效率优势。
summary.experiments: 控制实验在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行：OPD 下 incorrect-only 相比 correct-only 在 AIME24、AIME25、平均 benchmark 上分别高 3.60、3.89、2.59 个 Avg@12 点；OPSD 下对应增益为 1.94、3.34、2.50 点。完整 ReNIO 在数学推理和代码生成任务上同时提升 OPD 和 OPSD，代表性结果为 Qwen3-1.7B 数学推理相对提升最高 8.90%，R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 最高 10.00%。论文还记录了推理长度和反思类标记（如 wait/actually/however/check 等）的变化，说明负样本加权有助于维持探索性推理行为，而非简单压缩到短而“看起来正确”的答案。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点看前期控制实验和行为分析部分（figure 1 及相关文字），这是全文最有价值的观察；方法部分看清楚关键 token 判定、log ratio 截断和几何平均聚合即可。需要带着怀疑看的点是：这种信号是否真的足够接近“错误轨迹”，还是在强 teacher/弱 student 设定下更有效；以及这种重加权在长推理、长上下文和自蒸馏 teacher 不够强时是否稳定。预计阅读时间 15–25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) weight all student-generated trajectories equally, ignoring substantial variation in informativeness. The paper identifies a clear asymmetry: incorrect student-generated outputs often provide stronger learning signal than correct ones, yet there was no efficient way to upweight them without rolling out trajectories to the final answer.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly a post-training method, but it carries two lessons relevant to pretrain research. First, it reinforces that high-reward or already-correct samples are not necessarily the most useful training data; samples near the model’s capability boundary, including failures, can drive more robust improvement. Second, its prefix-computable teacher-student disagreement signal offers a practical way to locate informative mistakes locally, which is conceptually close to hard-negative mining and adaptive data weighting in pretraining and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReNIO starts from controlled filtering experiments showing that training only on incorrect student-generated outputs consistently outperforms training only on correct ones in both OPD and OPSD. Behavioral analysis suggests that correct-only training produces shorter traces with fewer reflection markers, while incorrect trajectories preserve exploratory and self-corrective reasoning near the model’s frontier. To exploit this without waiting for final-answer labels, ReNIO identifies pivotal tokens using the student-to-teacher probability ratio: tokens with high student probability but low teacher probability indicate student-preferred, teacher-rejected branch decisions. These clipped log ratios are aggregated by geometric mean to the sample level and normalized within each batch, producing a prefix-computable sample weight that emphasizes likely negative and highly informative trajectories while preserving the short-prefix efficiency advantage of OPD.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled studies on Qwen3-1.7B show that incorrect-only training beats correct-only training by 3.60, 3.89, and 2.59 Avg@12 points on AIME24, AIME25, and benchmark average under OPD, and by 1.94, 3.34, and 2.50 points under OPSD. Full ReNIO improves both OPD and OPSD on mathematical reasoning and code generation, with reported relative gains up to 8.90% for Qwen3-1.7B and 10.00% for R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on math reasoning. The paper also reports response-length and reflection-marker statistics, showing that emphasizing negative trajectories helps preserve exploratory reasoning rather than collapsing into short, overconfident answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the controlled filtering experiments and behavioral analysis in Figure 1, which contain the most transferable insight. Then read the ReNIO weighting formula to understand how pivotal tokens are detected from prefixes only. A useful point to scrutinize is whether the method mainly works when the teacher is already strong enough, and whether the same disagreement signal remains reliable in self-distillation or weaker-teacher regimes. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 负轨迹优于正轨迹这个结果值得复现实验；先看 filtering ablation，方法本身可作为 RL 数据加权弱基线。
recommendation.en: The negative-trajectory result is worth reproducing; read the filtering ablation first, and treat ReNIO as a weak baseline for RL data weighting.

paper.title: Learning at the Right Pace: Adaptive Data Scheduling Improves LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve remarkable reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. However, existing RL post-training commonly relies on uniform data sampling, which ignores the semantic structure of the training data and the changing capability of the training policy. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Data Scheduling (ADS), a dual-level data scheduling framework for pacing RL post-training that replaces uniform sampling with an adaptive dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 RL 后训练里一个常被忽略的问题：GRPO 一类方法通常默认对训练样本做均匀采样，但不同 prompt 的语义结构和当前策略可学性差异很大，均匀采样会让大量 rollout 落在“太容易”或“太难”的区域，导致 advantage 信号弱、训练节奏混乱。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口有现实启发。它说明数据配比和课程学习不只在预训练阶段重要，在 RL 阶段同样决定训练信号质量。尤其是 verifiable reward 场景里，真正有用的样本往往是位于当前能力边界附近的样本，这和预训练里强调高信息密度 token/样本的思路是相通的。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ADS，做两级调度。第一级是 cluster-level scheduling：先按语义模式把训练集聚成若干簇，再动态调整簇级采样分布，让训练在当前可达的语义簇上多停留一段时间，避免在不同模式之间来回切换。第二级是 sample-level scheduling：在选中的簇内，再根据当前策略的能力边界挑样本，优先选择那些 rollout 结果会出现对错混合、能产生有效相对优势的 prompt。方法不改 RL objective，本质上只改 data sampler，因此可以插到 GRPO 及相近框架里。全文的关键点不是复杂建模，而是把“语义相近”和“边界附近”两个维度同时纳入采样策略。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个 LLM、7 个数学与 OOD 科学推理 benchmark。摘要给出的主结果是平均准确率比 GRPO 提升 5.2%。从全文描述看，作者还比较了不同 RL 目标下 ADS 的兼容性，强调它是 objective-agnostic 的；同时通过消融说明，只有簇级调度或只有样本级调度都不如两者结合。阅读时应重点看：语义聚类是如何构造的，边界样本是用什么在线统计量估计的，以及收益是否主要来自减少 easy/hard 样本比例失衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看引言和方法图，理解 ADS 的两级结构；再看实验主表和消融表，确认收益是否稳定、是否依赖特定模型或数据集。若只想抓住要点，20–30 分钟足够。若关心对基座训练的启发，可额外看作者如何定义 policy boundary，以及这种定义能否迁移到 continual pretrain 或 self-training 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a neglected issue in RL post-training: GRPO-style methods usually sample training prompts uniformly, even though prompts differ widely in semantic structure and in how informative they are for the current policy. Uniform sampling wastes updates on prompts that are either too easy or too hard, which weakens the advantage signal and disrupts learning pace.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface. The paper reinforces a familiar lesson from pretraining: data mixture and curriculum matter because they shape signal quality. In verifiable-reward RL, the most useful prompts are often those near the policy’s current capability boundary, which parallels the broader idea of prioritizing high-information examples rather than treating the dataset as a flat pool.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Adaptive Data Scheduling (ADS), introduces a two-level sampler. At the cluster level, the training set is grouped into semantic clusters, and the inter-cluster sampling distribution is adjusted over time so the policy can consolidate progress within currently reachable semantic regions instead of constantly jumping across unrelated patterns. At the sample level, ADS selects prompts within a chosen cluster that lie near the policy boundary—cases likely to produce mixed correct/incorrect rollouts and therefore informative relative advantages under GRPO-style optimization. The method does not modify the RL objective itself; it changes only the sampling distribution, which makes it easy to combine with existing RL post-training pipelines. The main contribution is the joint use of semantic structure and boundary-aware sampling.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers three LLMs and seven math plus out-of-distribution scientific reasoning benchmarks. The headline number in the paper is a 5.2% average accuracy gain over GRPO. The full paper also emphasizes objective-agnostic compatibility, suggesting ADS can improve multiple RL formulations rather than one specific loss. Ablations indicate that cluster-level pacing alone or sample-level boundary tracking alone is weaker than combining both. When reading, the most important details to check are how semantic clusters are built, how the policy boundary is estimated online, and whether the gains mainly come from avoiding an excess of trivially easy or impossibly hard prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the method overview figure to understand the two-level scheduling design. Then read the main result tables and ablations to see whether the gains are stable across models and benchmarks. That should take about 20–30 minutes. If you are interested in implications for foundation-model training, spend extra time on the definition of the policy boundary and ask whether a similar notion could transfer to continual pretraining, self-training, or synthetic-data filtering.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融；若边界样本定义干净，值得在内部 RLVR 训练里复现采样策略。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the boundary-sample definition is clean, this sampling policy is worth reproducing in internal RLVR runs.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

paper.title: A Verifiable Search Is Not a Learnable Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: It is tempting to assume any task solvable by a short program can be taught to a model as its chain-of-thought: write the steps out, fine-tune, and the model follows. This paper shows the assumption fails for an identifiable class of procedures. The testbed is nine reasoning tasks, each from a deterministic generator; public and hidden splits share generators, so held-out data proxies test accuracy. I reverse-engineer the generators into Python solvers, render them as chain-of-thought, and disti

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个容易被默认接受、但并不总成立的假设：只要一个任务能被短程序可靠求解，就可以把程序轨迹改写成自然语言 chain-of-thought，并通过 SFT、RLVR 或自训练让模型学会。作者用一组生成式推理任务说明，问题不在于有没有可验证求解器，而在于求解过程是否存在可从左到右忠实展开的前向推导。对于需要在信息不足结构上做回溯搜索的任务，搜索轨迹可以被写出来，但不等于模型能按这个轨迹学习可泛化的推理过程。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接启发。它提醒我们，verifiable reward、程序化 solver、合成 CoT 并不自动给出可学习的推理信号。可验证性和可蒸馏性是两件事。对于 reasoning distillation、STaR、RLVR/GRPO 以及用程序生成推理数据的路线，这篇论文给出一个清晰的负例：如果任务的有效信息只在搜索后的筛选结果中出现，而中间搜索分支本身没有可前向归纳的依据，模型容易学到模板化的“判定词”，而不是搜索逻辑。这对构造推理 SFT 数据尤其重要：训练信号要能让模型在生成时逐步获得约束，而不是把不可学习的后验搜索写成看似合理的 CoT。
summary.technical_approach: 作者选择九个由确定性生成器产生的推理任务，包括罗马数字、线性单位换算、自由落体、单表替换密码、8-bit 布尔程序、两个方程归纳族和两个 cryptarithm 族。公共训练集和隐藏测试集来自同一生成器，因此训练集留出切片可以直接作为测试精度代理，减少了评测分布漂移的干扰。作者先反向工程这些生成器，写出 Python solver，再把 solver 过程渲染成合成 CoT，用于训练 rank 不超过 32 的 LoRA，底座是 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B，一个 30B 总参数、约 3.5B active 的 hybrid Mamba-2/MoE 模型，推理时使用 greedy decoding 和 7680 token 预算。训练从 SFT 开始，遇到平台期后尝试 RLVR/GRPO 和 STaR。核心区分是 faithful forward CoT：模型生成的每一步是否能在当前上下文中前向推出下一步，而不是依赖搜索完成后的全局信息。对 cryptarithm-deduce 这类任务，backtracking solver 可以验证答案，但隐藏映射中的 digit-glyph 关系几乎没有局部互信息，搜索分支本身缺少可学习的前向线索。模型于是学会了搜索文本的外形，而不是每个 elimination verdict 的条件逻辑。
summary.experiments: 实验结果的关键信号很一致。五个任务的 Python solver 达到至少 98% 准确率，但 solver 覆盖率不能预测 CoT 可学习性。四类前向可计算任务中，solver 准确率和 LoRA 后模型准确率差距很小；cryptarithm 上差距超过 0.65。cryptarithm 的 backtracking solver 约能回答 71% 实例，其余部分存在信息论歧义，但经过 11 轮 CoT 工程和 3 轮 RL/self-training 升级后，cryptarithm-deduce 仍未超过 0.07。作者用多种诊断定位瓶颈：生成-验证重构下 hit@8=0.71，说明候选空间内能出现正确答案，ranking 不是主约束；但前向推导覆盖只有 1/659，说明模型无法逐步推出有效分支。hidden map 的 MI(digit; glyph)=0.021 nats，接近无信息。逐行执行分析显示，算术行正确率可达 97% 到 100%，但 elimination verdict 的忠实度只有 16% 到 57%，对应作者称为 verdict-as-token 的现象：模型把“可消去/不可消去”当模板输出，而不是按条件计算。一个受控干预把同样实例从 0.03 提升到 0.57，支持瓶颈来自 forward-derivability。另一个实际逃逸路线是把组合搜索的有限结构预计算成 catalog，让模型做记忆和有限验证，而不是蒸馏搜索过程本身。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读但要细看机制诊断部分，预计 35 到 45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的三个研究问题和 Figure 1，理解 solver coverage 与 learnability gap 的定义。再看实验设置，尤其是任务生成器、train=test 分布假设、LoRA 训练和零泄漏合成 CoT 的构造。重点读 Section 5.2 附近关于 verdict-as-token 的分析、Table 3 的五类独立证据、Figure 4 的训练升级失败曲线、Table 7 的 forward-derivability 干预。最后看 Section 9：它说明同一任务并非不可学，而是不能按“搜索 CoT”这一路径学。对做推理数据合成的人，最值得深挖的是作者提出的三段式筛查 heuristic：在投入大规模合成 CoT 前，先判断任务是否存在忠实的前向推导轨迹。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a tempting assumption in reasoning distillation: if a short program can solve a task, its execution trace can be rendered as natural-language chain-of-thought and learned by a model. The answer is negative for a specific class of procedures. The key condition is not verifiability, but whether the procedure admits a faithful left-to-right derivation. Backtracking over information-free structure can be executable and verifiable, yet still fail as learnable CoT.
summary_en.importance: The result is useful for researchers working on reasoning SFT, synthetic rationales, STaR, and RL from verifiable rewards. It separates three notions that are often conflated: a task can be solvable by search, its answer can be verifiable, and its search procedure can still be a poor training signal for an autoregressive model. The paper shows that CoT supervision can teach the surface form of a solver trace without teaching the conditional logic behind it. For pretrain-posttrain work, the main lesson is practical: synthetic reasoning data should expose constraints that can be accumulated during generation, rather than serialize a posterior search process that depends on information unavailable to the model at each step.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses nine deterministic-generator reasoning tasks: Roman numerals, linear unit conversion, free fall, monoalphabetic substitution cipher, an 8-bit boolean program, two equation-induction families, and two cryptarithm families. Public and hidden splits are produced by the same generators, so a held-out slice of training data is a reliable proxy for test accuracy. The author reverse-engineers the generators into Python solvers, renders solver-grounded procedures as synthetic CoT with no value overlap with evaluation instances, and fine-tunes rank-32-or-smaller LoRA adapters on Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B, a 30B-parameter hybrid Mamba-2/MoE model with about 3.5B active parameters. Decoding is greedy with a 7680-token budget. When SFT saturates, the study escalates to RLVR/GRPO and STaR. The central analysis introduces faithful forward CoT: every emitted step should be derivable from the current prefix. Cryptarithm-style backtracking violates this property because the hidden mapping carries almost no local information before search resolution.
summary_en.experiments: Five tasks have Python solvers with at least 98% accuracy, but solver coverage does not predict distillation success. For four forward-computable tasks, the learned CoT model closely tracks solver performance. For cryptarithm, the learnability gap exceeds 0.65. The backtracking solver answers roughly 71% of instances, with the remaining cases being information-theoretically ambiguous, yet cryptarithm-deduce stays below 0.07 after eleven rounds of CoT engineering and three RL/self-training escalations. The diagnostics are sharp. A generate-and-verify reframing reaches hit@8=0.71, suggesting candidate generation and ranking are not the main bottleneck, while forward-derivation coverage is only 1/659. The hidden map has MI(digit; glyph)=0.021 nats, nearly zero. Line-level fidelity shows arithmetic lines are correct 97–100% of the time, but elimination verdicts have only 16–57% fidelity. The model learns verdict tokens as templates rather than computing their conditions. A controlled intervention that improves forward derivability lifts accuracy from 0.03 to 0.57, supporting the proposed mechanism. The practical workaround is to precompute the finite combinatorial core into a catalog and train the model to recall and verify, not to imitate search.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with attention to the mechanism sections; budget about 35–45 minutes. Start with the research questions and Figure 1 to understand the solvability-learnability gap. Then read the task and training setup to check why the train-test comparison is unusually clean. Focus on the verdict-as-token analysis, Table 3 with the independent diagnostic measurements, Figure 4 showing failed escalation through SFT/RL/self-training, and Table 7 with the forward-derivability intervention. The final section on memorizing the finite structure is also worth reading because it clarifies that the task is not impossible; the failed object is search-trace distillation.

recommendation.zh: 对“可验证即可学会”的 RLVR 直觉是有用的反例，setup 干净；只看 cryptarithm 相关表格与失败模式分析即可。
recommendation.en: A useful counterexample to the intuition that verifiability implies learnability in RLVR, with a clean setup; read only the tables around Cryptarithm and the failure-mode analysis.

paper.title: Where Does Social Reasoning Come From? Capability Provenance in Language Models
paper.abstract: We use training-data attribution as an interpretable tool for capability discovery, mapping which regions of the pretraining corpus support social-reasoning versus STEM-reasoning in OLMo3-7B. Training-data attribution measures how strongly each training document influences a model's predictions on a benchmark, but document-level scores are too noisy to identify which corpus regions support which capabilities, and prior work has emphasized factual knowledge rather than reasoning. We compute gradi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“哪些单篇训练文档重要”，而是更难也更有预训练意义的问题：一个开放大模型的不同能力，究竟主要由预训练语料中的哪些结构化区域支撑。作者把问题限定在 OLMo3-7B 与 Dolma3 开放生态里，重点区分 social reasoning、STEM reasoning，以及同域但不同能力类型的 social knowledge。核心挑战有两个：一是文档级 training-data attribution 噪声很大，难以直接读出能力来源；二是过去 attribution 更多用于事实记忆或知识追溯，较少用于 reasoning provenance。作者因此把 attribution 从 document level 提升到 taxonomy bin level，试图回答“能力在语料中的来源分布”而不是“若干高分样本长什么样”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在方法层，而不是直接给出新的训练 recipe。第一，它把 training-data attribution 从事后解释工具推进到可操作的 corpus auditing instrument：如果某类能力稳定依赖某些 topic×format 区域，那么数据配比、数据筛选、数据删除、持续预训练和 targeted unlearning 就有了更清晰的抓手。第二，它给出一个较干净的 2×2 设计，把 domain 与 capability type 分开看，这比常见“拿几个 benchmark 看 attribution 热点”的做法更接近因果辨析。第三，它说明 reasoning 也可以做 provenance 分析，而且 social reasoning 与 STEM reasoning 的来源区域确实不同，不只是知识题和推理题在 attribution 稀疏度上不同。量级上，这更像一篇为数据研究提供测量框架的工作：它不会直接改变主流预训练范式，但会影响人们如何做数据混合、能力定向增强和数据审计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三层。第一层是 corpus-scale gradient attribution。作者使用 Bergson/TrackStar 一类梯度式 TDA，在 Dolma3 去重语料上抽取一个分层 working set：总计 5,678,621 篇文档、约 10.5B tokens，并按 WebOrganizer taxonomy 做分桶。这个 taxonomy 把每篇文档映射到 24 个 topic 与 24 个 format 的笛卡尔积，共 576 个 bins；每个 bin 采样 10,000 篇文档。这样做的关键不是追求单文档 attribution 精度，而是利用大样本聚合降低噪声。第二层是 contrastive benchmark design。作者选了四个固定选项 benchmark，构成 domain（social vs. STEM）× capability type（reasoning vs. knowledge）的 2×2：SocialIQA、ARC-Challenge、MMLU Social Sciences、MMLU STEM。这个设计的价值在于可以比较“social reasoning vs. STEM reasoning”以及“social reasoning vs. social knowledge”，从而判断 attribution profile 到底主要按领域分化，还是按能力类型分化。第三层是 bin-level interpretation 与 validation。解释部分不是用 LLM 给 top-k 文档写总结，而是直接对高影响 bins 做 lexical profiling，包括代词密度、心理状态动词、对话指示词，以及 Empath 类词汇富集。验证部分则做 influence-targeted unlearning：删除或反向更新高 attribution bins，观察 aligned benchmark 是否比同 bin 随机对照更明显地下滑。这里的创新点不在 attribution 算法本身，而在“先 taxonomy 聚合，再做能力 provenance，再用 targeted unlearning 做外部验证”这一整套流程。与已有工作相比，它避免了 top-k exemplar 分析的偶然性，也比粗粒度 corpus card 更接近可干预的数据单元。
summary.experiments: 实验设置最关键的数字是 working set 规模和分桶方式：5.68M 文档、10.5B tokens、576 个 topic×format bins、每 bin 10k 文档；底层开放语料是去重后的 Dolma3，包含约 1.263B unique documents。结果层面，作者报告 social benchmarks 与 STEM benchmarks 的 attribution profile 有明显分离，而且这种分离在 reasoning pair 和 knowledge pair 上都能看到；同时，social reasoning 与 social-domain knowledge 虽然同属 social 域，但高影响 bins 并不相同，说明“领域相同”不足以解释 provenance。更细一点，social reasoning 的高影响 bins 呈现双峰 lexical signature：一类是短、强互动、代词和心理状态词密集的人际文本；另一类是较长的说明性或文档型文本。这一点很有意思，因为它暗示 social reasoning 不是只靠对话语料学出来，也依赖更结构化的长文本。验证实验里，targeted unlearning 高 attribution bins 会比同 bin 随机删除造成更大的 aligned benchmark 退化，而且跨 benchmark 的损伤不是完全均匀的，表现为可控的 selective damage，而不是简单的通用能力下降。摘要里没有给出大量具体百分比，全文重点也不在追求单一指标提升，而在证明 attribution 聚合后的区分度和可验证性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，把作者想回答的问题和 2×2 设计吃透；这是整篇最重要的 framing。然后直接看方法图和 taxonomy 说明，理解为什么要用 WebOrganizer 的 24×24 bins，而不是 top-k 文档分析。实验部分优先看三类图表：一类是四个 benchmark 的 bin-level attribution heatmap 或排名分布，用来判断 social 与 STEM 是否真的分离；一类是 social reasoning 与 social knowledge 的对比，检验 capability type 是否带来额外分化；一类是 targeted unlearning 结果，确认 attribution 不是纯相关性噪声。若时间有限，lexical profiling 可快速浏览，但建议留意作者如何把表层词汇特征与 provenance 解释连接起来，以及这种解释的边界。预计 30-45 分钟可以完成有效泛读。更值得深挖的点有两个：其一，bin aggregation 是否会掩盖 bin 内部异质性；其二，unlearning 验证到底证明了“必要性”还是只证明“相关区域更脆弱”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more useful question than standard document-level training-data attribution: where in the pretraining corpus do different capabilities actually come from? The focus is OLMo3-7B trained on Dolma3, with an emphasis on separating social reasoning, STEM reasoning, and social-domain knowledge. The main difficulty is that document-level attribution is noisy and hard to interpret at corpus scale, especially for reasoning tasks. The authors therefore move from individual documents to structured corpus regions, aiming to recover capability provenance at the level of topic-format bins rather than isolated influential examples.
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than recipe-changing. First, it turns training-data attribution into a more actionable corpus auditing tool: if a capability consistently depends on specific topic-format regions, those regions become candidates for reweighting, filtering, continued pretraining, or targeted unlearning. Second, the 2x2 design cleanly separates domain from capability type, which is more informative than the usual practice of inspecting attribution hotspots for a loose set of benchmarks. Third, it extends provenance analysis beyond factual recall into reasoning. The contribution is not a new pretraining method, but a measurement framework that could matter for data mixture design, capability steering, and open-corpus interpretability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three layers. First, the authors run corpus-scale gradient-based training-data attribution using Bergson/TrackStar over a stratified working set from deduplicated Dolma3. The working set contains 5,678,621 documents, about 10.5B tokens, organized using the WebOrganizer taxonomy. Each document is assigned to one of 24 topics and 24 formats, yielding 576 topic-format bins, with 10,000 sampled documents per bin. The point is not to trust any single document score, but to reduce noise through aggregation. Second, they use a controlled 2x2 benchmark design: domain (social vs. STEM) crossed with capability type (reasoning vs. knowledge), instantiated with SocialIQA, ARC-Challenge, MMLU Social Sciences, and MMLU STEM. This lets them ask whether attribution profiles separate mainly by domain, by capability type, or by both. Third, they interpret and validate the resulting bin-level signals. Interpretation is done through lexical profiling of influential bins, including pronoun density, mental-state verbs, dialogue indicators, and Empath-style enrichment, rather than post-hoc LLM summaries of top-k documents. Validation is done with influence-targeted unlearning: removing or counter-training on high-attribution bins and comparing the damage against within-bin random controls. The novelty is not a new attribution estimator, but the pipeline of taxonomy-first aggregation, capability provenance analysis, and unlearning-based external validation.
summary_en.experiments: The key setup numbers are the most important part of the experimental story: a 5.68M-document working set, 10.5B tokens, 576 topic-format bins, and 10k sampled documents per bin, drawn from deduplicated Dolma3 with about 1.263B unique documents overall. The main result is that social and STEM benchmarks show clearly different attribution profiles, and this separation appears both for the reasoning pair and the knowledge pair. At the same time, social reasoning and social-domain knowledge do not rely on the same high-influence bins, which means domain alone does not explain provenance. A notable qualitative finding is that social reasoning exhibits a bimodal lexical signature: one cluster of influential bins contains short, interpersonal, dialogue-like text rich in pronouns and mental-state language, while another contains longer, more document-like material. That suggests social reasoning is not learned only from conversational data. In the validation experiments, targeted unlearning of high-attribution bins hurts the aligned benchmark more than random removals from the same bin, and the damage pattern across benchmarks is selective rather than uniformly destructive. The paper is less about reporting a single headline metric and more about showing that aggregated attribution yields stable, interpretable, and partially causal signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and make sure the framing is clear: the paper is about capability provenance, not generic attribution. Then read the taxonomy and benchmark design carefully, because the 24x24 binning and the 2x2 benchmark structure are the core methodological choices. In the experiments, prioritize three kinds of figures: the bin-level attribution heatmaps or rankings for the four benchmarks, the direct comparison between social reasoning and social knowledge, and the targeted unlearning results. Those three pieces tell you whether the provenance signal is real, whether capability type matters beyond domain, and whether the signal survives intervention. The lexical profiling section can be skimmed, but it is worth noting how the authors connect surface features to provenance claims and where that interpretation may overreach. A useful deeper question is whether bin aggregation hides substantial within-bin heterogeneity. Another is what the unlearning result actually establishes: necessity, correlation, or just vulnerability of nearby regions.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得做数据配比的人细看：不是因果终局，但把“能力来源”从文档噪声提升到语料桶层面，足够指导内部 data ablation 设计，先看方法和 2×2 对照即可。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on data mixture: it is not causal closure, but moving from noisy document attribution to corpus-bin attribution is already actionable for internal ablations; focus on the method and the 2×2 contrasts.

paper.title: Pruning via Causal Attribution Preserves Reasoning Performance in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning but incur substantial inference cost. We introduce Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP), a training-free method that identifies critical attention heads by measuring their causal impact on reasoning tasks and uses these head-level scores to guide fine-grained weight pruning. For each attention head, CAP estimates the expected performance degradation when the head is masked during forward passes on a small calibration set of reasoning problem

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想在不训练的前提下，对 LLM 做更保留推理能力的稀疏剪枝，降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 它属于推理效率方向的实用改进：不是预训练方法创新，但对理解“哪些头真正支撑 reasoning”有一点启发。贡献类型是训练后压缩方法，而非基座训练范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Causal Attribution Pruning（CAP）。核心做法是：在一个小型 reasoning 校准集上，逐个遮蔽 attention head，测量该 head 被干预后对任务性能的期望下降，把这个因果归因分数映射为对应投影矩阵的权重重要性，再据此做细粒度剪枝。相比只看权重大小或激活统计，CAP 直接用干预式指标估计功能贡献。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct，在 GSM8K、StrategyQA、ARC-Challenge 上测试 10%、20%、50% 稀疏率。摘要声称在 20% sparsity、ARC-Challenge 上相对 Wanda 有最高 61% 的准确率增益。整体看是中等规模、后训练压缩设定，结论更像特定任务上的保真剪枝，而不是通用预训练 insight。

summary_en.core_problem: This work aims to prune LLMs in a training-free way while preserving reasoning performance better, thereby reducing inference cost.
summary_en.importance: It is a practical efficiency paper rather than a pretraining contribution. The main value for a foundation-model researcher is limited but nonzero: it offers some signal about which attention heads matter for reasoning under intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP). On a small reasoning calibration set, it masks each attention head and measures the expected performance drop caused by the intervention. These causal attribution scores are then converted into weight-level importance values for the corresponding projection matrices, enabling fine-grained pruning. Unlike magnitude- or activation-based criteria, CAP uses interventional estimates of functional contribution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge at 10%, 20%, and 50% sparsity. The abstract reports up to 61% relative accuracy gain over Wanda on ARC-Challenge at 20% sparsity. This is a moderate-scale post-training compression setup, more about preserving reasoning under pruning than about core pretraining insights.

recommendation.zh: 偏部署侧，和 pretrain 关系不深；只需看 head-level causal attribution 这一步，若你在做结构稀疏或机制分析，可拿来当一个更干净的重要性度量。
recommendation.en: Mostly an inference-side paper; only the head-level causal attribution is worth a look if you work on structured sparsity or mechanistic importance measures.

paper.title: VIMPO: Value-Implicit Policy Optimization for LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a central tool for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but current methods face a trade-off between simplicity and credit assignment. Group-relative methods such as GRPO avoid training a critic, but typically assign a trajectory-level advantage to every token. Actor-critic methods provide denser learning signals, but require a learned value function with its own training instability. We introduce VIMPO, a critic-free

summary.core_problem: VIMPO 处理的是 RLVR 里一个很现实的矛盾：GRPO 这类 critic-free 方法训练简单、稳定，但通常把同一个 trajectory-level advantage 广播给整条输出的所有 token，信用分配太粗；PPO / actor-critic 方法能给 token-level 信号，但需要单独训练 value function，容易出现 critic 失准、策略与价值网络共适应、训练不稳。作者试图证明，这个二选一并不是必须的：在 KL 正则化的自回归生成框架下，可以从策略本身和参考模型的 log-ratio 推出一个隐式 value recurrence，从而在不训练独立 critic 的情况下恢复更细粒度的 token-level credit assignment。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train，但和基座研究的接口很直接。它的价值不在于提出一个更复杂的 RL 管线，而在于重新整理了 KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR 里 policy、reference、reward、value 之间的关系。对做预训练和后训练接口的人来说，重要启发有两点。第一，reference model 不只是一个 KL 约束对象，它还可以成为构造内部学习信号的坐标系。第二，很多所谓 critic-free 方法之所以信用分配差，不是因为没有 value network 就必然做不到，而是因为没有把策略最优性条件用到位。VIMPO 给出了一种中间路线：保留 group rollout 的简单性，同时通过 policy-implied value 恢复 Bellman-consistent 的 token 级监督。这对长链推理、代码生成这类长序列 RL 很有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在一个标准但写得比较清楚的建模上：把自回归生成看成 deterministic-transition MDP，状态是 prompt 加上当前前缀，动作是下一个 token，终止时得到 outcome reward，并带有相对 frozen reference policy 的 KL 正则。

核心推导来自 KL-regularized 最优性条件。作者不是去学一个独立的 V(s)，而是利用策略与参考模型的 log-likelihood ratio，推导出一个隐式 value recurrence。直观上，若策略相对 reference 在某一步更愿意选择某个 token，这个偏离就携带了未来回报与 KL 代价平衡后的信息。再结合终止状态 V(s_T)=0 的边界条件，整条序列上的 value 可以被“闭合”起来。由于初始 value 仍需要和外部 outcome reward 对齐，作者用和 GRPO 类似的同 prompt 多 rollout Monte Carlo 估计来给出 trajectory-level target。

在此基础上，VIMPO 有两个训练部件。第一是 critic-free 的 value optimization objective：不是训练一个独立 critic 网络，而是让由 policy-reference log-ratio 诱导出的隐式 value 满足 Bellman consistency，并用平方误差去贴合 Monte Carlo 回报。第二是 actor update：由同样的推导可以得到 one-step temporal-difference advantage 的闭式表达，它完全由 policy 内部的 log-ratio 量构成，不需要额外 value head。作者还把它扩展成类似 GAE 的多步聚合版本，用于更平滑的 token-level advantage。

和 GRPO 的关键区别，是 advantage 不再整段共享，而是随 token 位置变化；和 PPO / VAPO 的关键区别，是没有单独训练 critic。和一些后处理式 token credit 方法相比，VIMPO 不是在 trajectory advantage 上再乘一个启发式权重，而是从 KL-regularized objective 的最优性条件直接推出来的，因此理论上更自洽。

从方法取舍看，VIMPO 仍然依赖 reference model 和 KL 框架，也仍然需要 group rollouts 来估计初始 value 或回报目标，所以它不是完全摆脱 RLVR 现有范式，而是在现有范式内把 credit assignment 做细。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的信息看，实验重点是和 GRPO 做对比，任务集中在需要可验证奖励的推理场景。作者的主结论有两条：一是 VIMPO 在调好超参后训练上升更快，验证准确率更高；二是在 reward noise 存在时，两者都会退化，但 VIMPO 更稳，说明 token-level、Bellman-consistent 的优势估计比整段广播更不容易被噪声放大。

摘要和正文片段没有给出完整数表，但实验设计逻辑比较明确：会比较训练曲线、最终验证性能，以及 noisy reward 条件下的鲁棒性。若正文中包含 GAE-style 聚合、KL 系数、group size、reference 冻结方式等消融，这些会比单一最终分数更重要，因为 VIMPO 的收益高度依赖 value recurrence 是否稳定、以及 token-level advantage 的方差是否可控。

从研究判断看，这篇的实验说服力主要取决于三点：第一，是否在长输出任务上明显优于 GRPO，而不是只在短答案任务上有小幅提升；第二，是否展示了无需 critic 仍能得到更合理的 token 级 credit，而不是仅靠更强超参；第三，噪声奖励实验是否覆盖不同噪声强度，而不是单点比较。若这些部分做得完整，方法就不只是一个理论改写。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按推导链条来读。

先看把 autoregressive generation 写成 deterministic MDP 的部分，以及 KL-regularized objective 的定义。这里决定了后面 value recurrence 的成立条件。若这一步没看清，后面的“implicit value”会显得像技巧而不是结构性结果。

然后重点看 value recurrence 和 terminal boundary condition V(s_T)=0 的推导。这是整篇最值得读的地方。要确认作者到底推导出了什么量、它和 soft value / standard value 的关系是什么、为什么不需要单独 critic 也能形成 Bellman-consistent 目标。

第三，看 actor update 那一节，尤其是 one-step TD advantage 和 GAE-style 扩展。这里决定它到底是不是一个可用的 RL 算法，而不只是一个 value identity。

最后再看实验。建议优先看训练曲线、reward noise 实验、以及和 GRPO 在长序列任务上的差异。如果时间有限，30 分钟可以抓住主要思想；若要判断是否值得复现，最好再花 20 分钟检查附录里的推导假设和实现细节，比如 KL 形式、group Monte Carlo 估计、以及 advantage 截断或归一化方式。

summary_en.core_problem: VIMPO targets a practical tension in RL with verifiable rewards for LLMs. Critic-free methods such as GRPO are simple and often stable, but they usually broadcast the same trajectory-level advantage to every token in a completion, which gives very coarse credit assignment. Actor-critic methods provide token-level learning signals, but they require a separately trained value function and inherit all the usual critic calibration and co-adaptation issues. The paper argues that this trade-off is not necessary: under KL-regularized autoregressive generation, one can derive a policy-implied value recurrence from policy/reference log-ratios and recover token-level credit assignment without learning an explicit critic.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it matters for foundation-model researchers because it reorganizes the relationship between policy, reference model, reward, and value in KL-regularized RLHF/RLVR. Two ideas stand out. First, the reference model is not only a KL anchor; it can also serve as the coordinate system from which internal training signals are derived. Second, poor credit assignment in critic-free RL is not an unavoidable consequence of removing the value network. It is partly a consequence of not fully exploiting the optimality structure of the KL-regularized objective. VIMPO offers a middle path: keep the simplicity of grouped rollouts, but recover Bellman-consistent token-level supervision through an implicit value construction. That is especially relevant for long-form reasoning and code generation, where sequence-level broadcasting is a poor fit.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper models autoregressive generation as a deterministic-transition MDP. The state is the prompt plus the generated prefix, the action is the next token, and the episode ends with an outcome reward, together with a KL penalty relative to a frozen reference policy.

The key derivation comes from the optimality conditions of KL-regularized policy optimization. Instead of learning a separate value function V(s), the method expresses a value recurrence in terms of the policy/reference log-likelihood ratio. Intuitively, the extent to which the current policy departs from the reference at a given token already encodes information about future reward versus KL cost. With the terminal boundary condition V(s_T)=0, the recurrence can be closed along the generated trajectory. Since the initial value still needs to be tied to external outcome rewards, the paper uses Monte Carlo estimates from grouped rollouts, similar in spirit to RLVR practice, to provide trajectory-level targets.

This leads to two training components. The first is a critic-free value optimization objective: not a separate critic network, but a Bellman-consistency loss that forces the policy-implied value to match Monte Carlo returns. The second is the actor update: the same derivation yields a closed-form one-step temporal-difference advantage expressed entirely through policy-internal log-ratio quantities. The paper further extends this with a GAE-style multi-step aggregation to reduce variance and provide smoother token-level advantages.

Relative to GRPO, the main difference is that the advantage is no longer constant across the whole trajectory. Relative to PPO or VAPO, the main difference is that there is no separately trained critic. Relative to heuristic token-credit methods layered on top of group-relative RL, VIMPO is derived directly from the KL-regularized objective rather than from a post hoc reweighting rule.

In terms of design trade-offs, VIMPO still lives inside the standard RLVR setup: it depends on a frozen reference model, a KL term, and grouped rollouts for Monte Carlo estimation. The novelty is not abandoning that framework, but making credit assignment much finer within it.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text content, the empirical focus is a comparison against GRPO on reasoning tasks with verifiable rewards. The headline claims are straightforward: with tuned hyperparameters, VIMPO improves faster during training and reaches higher validation accuracy; under noisy rewards, both methods degrade, but VIMPO degrades less, suggesting that Bellman-consistent token-level advantages are more robust than trajectory-wide broadcasting.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so the exact gains, model sizes, and benchmark details are not visible here. Still, the experimental logic is clear. The important evidence should include training curves, final validation performance, and robustness under reward corruption. If the full paper contains ablations on GAE-style aggregation, KL coefficient, group size, reference freezing, or advantage normalization, those are likely more informative than a single end metric because VIMPO’s practical value depends on whether the implicit recurrence remains numerically stable and whether token-level advantages have manageable variance.

The paper’s empirical strength therefore hinges on three questions. Does it show a clear advantage over GRPO on genuinely long outputs rather than only short-answer tasks? Does it demonstrate that the gain comes from better credit assignment rather than from heavier tuning? And does the noisy-reward study sweep multiple noise levels rather than report a single stress point? If those pieces are present, the method is more than a theoretical reformulation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of the derivation.

Start with the deterministic MDP formulation of autoregressive generation and the exact KL-regularized objective. Those assumptions determine what kind of value identity can be derived later. Without that setup, the implicit-value construction can look like a trick rather than a structural consequence.

Then focus on the value recurrence and the terminal boundary condition V(s_T)=0. This is the core of the paper. The main thing to verify is what value quantity is being represented, how it differs from soft-value formulations, and why Bellman consistency can be enforced without a separate critic network.

Next, read the actor-update section carefully, especially the one-step TD advantage and the GAE-style extension. That section determines whether the method is a usable RL algorithm or merely an interesting value identity.

Only after that should you inspect the experiments. Prioritize training curves, noisy-reward results, and comparisons with GRPO on long-sequence tasks. A 30-minute skim is enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to decide on reproduction, spend another 20 minutes on the appendix to check the derivation assumptions and implementation details such as the KL form, grouped Monte Carlo estimation, and any clipping or normalization used for the token-level advantage.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看推导和 ablation，不一定改写 RLVR 范式，但如果你在嫌 critic 不稳、又嫌 GRPO 太糙，至少应复现它的 value recurrence 看信号是否真更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and ablations: it may not redefine RLVR, but if you dislike unstable critics and find GRPO too coarse, this implicit value recurrence is worth reproducing to test whether the signal is actually cleaner.

paper.title: Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning; however, it faces a fundamental optimization instability: uniform token updates precipitate entropy collapse, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal strategies, whereas excessive Shannon Entropy maximization can cause entropy explosion, driving blind exploration toward incoherent reasoning chains. To resolve this dichotomy, we introduce the Independent Combinatorial Toke

summary.core_problem: RLVR（带可验证奖励的 RL）训练 LLM 推理时，对所有 token 均匀施加策略梯度容易造成熵塌缩到次优策略；而单纯用 Shannon entropy 做强探索又会导致熵爆炸和无方向的胡乱探索。问题在于只用一个标量熵值无法刻画哪些 token 才是真正决定推理分支的关键位置。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / RL 训练信号设计方向，但对理解“预训练后阶段里哪些 token 承载主要学习信号”有启发。核心观察是：token 层面的重要性不应该只用熵这个不确定性标量衡量，而要看 token 分布相对序列平均分布的偏离程度。这个视角与 reward hacking、credit assignment、稀疏有效更新等问题直接相关。更实际的意义是，他们报告只更新约 10% 的 token 就能匹配或超过全量更新，这对降低 RLVR 计算成本和稳定训练都有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ICT（Independent Combinatorial Tokens）框架。核心做法是：对每个 token 位置的 logit 分布，计算它与该序列上 token 分布的平均之间的 Jensen-Shannon divergence；JS 散度大的 token，代表其分布形态偏离整体，被视为关键分支点/unique token。训练时只对这些 top-k（如 top 10%）unique token 保留梯度，其余 token 的 policy gradient 被 mask 掉。这样梯度更新集中在真正决定推理路径分岔的位置，而不是对所有 token 一视同仁地推高或压低熵。论文从信息论直觉出发，证明这类分布独特的 token 对应关键 branching points，选择性更新能同时避免 entropy collapse 和 entropy explosion，实现隐式熵控。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5 系列 0.5B、1.5B、7B 上做数学/代码类 RLVR 实验，覆盖七个推理 benchmark。结果显示只更新 top 10% distributionally unique tokens，性能可以匹配或超过全参数/全 token 更新；相比 GRPO、20-Entropy、STAPO 等强基线，平均 pass@4 提升约 4.37%、4.98%、4.38%，最大增益达 14.9%。论文还做了消融说明 JS 散度选 token 优于直接用 Shannon entropy 选高熵 token：高熵 token 只代表不确定，不代表有明确的有效探索方向。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点看 logit 分布偏离的定义、为什么 JS 比 Shannon entropy 更适合选关键 token，以及稀疏梯度只更新 10% token 的实验设置和结果。图 1 关于“相同熵但分布形态不同”的示意值得看，方法部分和实验表格是核心。理论证明部分可粗读，重点抓直觉。预计阅读时间 25–40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL with verifiable rewards for LLM reasoning, applying policy gradients uniformly across all tokens often causes entropy collapse to suboptimal strategies, while indiscriminate Shannon-entropy-based exploration leads to entropy explosion and undirected search. A scalar entropy value is insufficient to identify which tokens actually determine critical reasoning branches.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL credit-assignment paper, but it bears on a broader pretrain-relevant question: which tokens carry the effective learning signal in late-stage policy optimization. The useful observation is that token importance should not be measured by entropy alone; distributional shape relative to surrounding tokens matters. The practical claim is also strong: updating only around 10% of tokens can match or exceed full updates, with implications for RLVR stability and compute efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ICT (Independent Combinatorial Tokens). For each token position, ICT computes the Jensen-Shannon divergence between that token’s logit distribution and the sequence-level average token distribution. Tokens with large JS divergence are treated as unique tokens, i.e., critical branching points. During policy optimization, gradients are retained only for these top-k tokens (e.g., top 10%), while other tokens are masked. This concentrates policy-gradient updates on decision points that steer reasoning trajectories, rather than uniformly pushing entropy up or down across all positions. The paper argues theoretically that these distributionally unique tokens encode directional exploration information, enabling implicit entropy control without directly regularizing Shannon entropy.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 7B across seven reasoning benchmarks. Updating only the top 10% distributionally unique tokens matches or outperforms full-gradient training. Against strong baselines including GRPO, 20-Entropy, and STAPO, ICT reports average pass@4 gains of 4.37%, 4.98%, and 4.38%, with maximum gains up to 14.9%. Ablations support the claim that JS-based token selection is more effective than selecting high-Shannon-entropy tokens, since high entropy indicates uncertainty but not necessarily useful exploration direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the token-selection idea and the sparse-update results. The most important sections are the motivation on why entropy is insufficient, the definition of distributional uniqueness via JS divergence, and the experiments showing strong performance with only 10% of token gradients. Figure 1 on equal-entropy but distributionally different logits is a useful intuition pump. Theoretical proofs can be read lightly. Estimated reading time: 25–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和熵分析部分；若实验 setup 干净，ICT 值得作为 RLVR token-level update 的内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method and entropy analysis; if the setup is clean, ICT is worth an internal ablation for token-level RLVR updates.

paper.title: DreamReasoner-8B: Block-Size Curriculum Learning for Diffusion Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Block diffusion language models accelerate decoding through parallel block-wise denoising, yet whether they can be reliably scaled for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning remains unresolved. To this end, we develop DreamReasoner-8B, an open-source block diffusion reasoning model, and conduct a systematic study of how training and inference block sizes affect long-CoT reasoning. Our analysis reveals a stark performance disparity: training with large block sizes yields remarkably poor reasoning,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 block diffusion language model 在长 CoT 推理中能否使用大 block 的问题。block diffusion 希望把跨 block 依赖做成自回归，把 block 内 token 用扩散去噪并行生成，以换取推理并行度。但大 block 会削弱逐步生成的细粒度约束，直接训练大 block 时推理能力明显下降。论文把 block size 从一个固定超参提升为训练和推理共同作用的尺度变量，研究训练 block size、推理 block size、解码策略三者如何影响长推理。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值在于，它给 diffusion LM 做长推理提供了一个较清晰的训练动态结论：并行生成的粒度不能只在推理阶段调大，训练阶段必须让模型逐步适应从细粒度到粗粒度的去噪条件。它不是单纯提出一个 diffusion 解码技巧，而是在 8B 规模上验证了 block size curriculum 可以缓解大 block 训练的脆弱性。对 AR 之外的语言建模范式来说，这是一个重要信号：推理能力不只来自模型规模和数据，也来自生成因子分解与训练课程之间的匹配。论文还指出，当前 block diffusion 的效率收益受 token-level confidence threshold 限制，说明推理并行度的瓶颈已经部分转移到 commit 策略，而不只是模型结构。
summary.technical_approach: 模型采用 block diffusion factorization：序列被切成连续 block，block 之间按自回归顺序建模，前面 block 保持 clean context；当前 block 从全 mask 状态开始，通过吸收态离散扩散过程迭代预测被 mask 的 token。训练目标可化为对 masked positions 的加权交叉熵，权重由噪声日程决定。这个设计保留了 AR 的长程顺序依赖，又允许 block 内 token 并行去噪。核心创新是 block-size curriculum learning。直接用大 block 训练时，模型需要在一个更宽的局部双向空间里同时恢复很多 token，局部约束变弱，长 CoT 中容易破坏中间推理步骤。课程学习先使用小 block，让模型在接近 AR 的细粒度条件下学会推理轨迹，再逐步过渡到大 block，使模型适应更粗粒度的并行去噪。与固定小 block 相比，它保留了大 block 推理的效率空间；与直接大 block 训练相比，它降低了训练不稳定和推理退化。论文还提出 RelaxedConfidence 作为分析性解码 probe：常规解码只在 token 置信度足够高时 commit，策略偏保守；RelaxedConfidence 检查高置信 token 的连续 span，允许被可靠邻域包围的 token 在较宽松阈值下更早 commit，用来估计 block diffusion 还能释放多少并行度。
summary.experiments: 论文训练并开源 DreamReasoner-8B，一个 8B 参数的 block diffusion reasoning model。主要实验围绕数学和代码推理 benchmark，比较不同训练 block size、推理 block size 和解码策略。关键发现是：直接使用大 block 训练会导致推理性能显著下降；小 block 训练能保持较好的长 CoT 推理；从小 block 到大 block 的 curriculum 可以恢复大 block 训练下丢失的推理能力，并让大 block 推理获得效率收益。论文称 DreamReasoner-8B 在数学和代码推理上达到与 Qwen3-8B-Thinking 接近的表现，并明显超过同规模既有 block diffusion 模型。效率分析中，RelaxedConfidence 在 thinking phase 和 answering phase 分别带来平均 TPF，即 tokens per forward pass，22.5% 和 54.5% 的提升，而且没有破坏推理正确性。这个结果说明，模型本身已经能在局部区域给出更宽的可靠并行生成信号，但默认 confidence threshold 没有充分利用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三处。第一是 block diffusion preliminaries 和训练目标部分，重点看它如何把 clean prefix、masked current block、absorbing corruption 和 weighted cross-entropy 组合起来；这决定了它与 full-sequence diffusion LM、纯 AR LM 的差异。第二是 block size 相关实验，尤其是训练 block size 与 inference block size 的交叉表或曲线；这里能看到大 block 失败不是单一解码问题，而是训练条件和推理条件不匹配。第三是 block-size curriculum 和 RelaxedConfidence。前者是主要训练贡献，值得关注 curriculum 的阶段设计、block size 迁移节奏、是否需要额外 compute；后者是推理瓶颈分析，建议看 TPF、正确率和不同推理阶段的拆分结果。需要留意的是，RelaxedConfidence 更像诊断工具，不一定等价于最终可部署解码算法；它的意义在于暴露保守 commit 阈值带来的并行度损失。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether block diffusion language models can use large blocks for long chain-of-thought reasoning without losing reasoning quality. Block diffusion keeps autoregressive dependencies across blocks and denoises tokens inside each block in parallel. This gives a path toward faster decoding, but large blocks weaken the fine-grained sequential constraints that long reasoning often relies on. The central question is how training block size, inference block size, and decoding policy interact at an 8B reasoning-model scale.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a training-dynamics result for diffusion-based language modeling: coarse parallel generation cannot be treated as an inference-only knob. A model trained directly with large blocks can lose reasoning ability, while a curriculum that moves from fine-grained to coarse-grained blocks can make large-block inference usable. This matters for pretraining research because it identifies block size as a scaling axis for non-AR language models, not merely a decoding hyperparameter. The paper also shows that the efficiency bottleneck is partly in token commitment rules. Conservative confidence thresholds leave parallelism unused even when the model assigns reliable local predictions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model uses a block diffusion factorization. A sequence is split into contiguous blocks. Previous blocks are kept clean and used as prefix context, while the current block is corrupted with an absorbing [MASK] process and denoised in parallel. The conditional distribution for each block is trained with a weighted cross-entropy over masked positions, with weights induced by the diffusion noise schedule. This design interpolates between AR generation and fully parallel diffusion. The main method is block-size curriculum learning. Training starts with small blocks, where the model sees a generation problem closer to AR and can learn coherent reasoning trajectories. It then gradually increases the block size so the model adapts to coarser parallel denoising. This differs from fixed small-block training, which limits inference parallelism, and from direct large-block training, which is brittle for reasoning. The paper also introduces RelaxedConfidence, an analytical decoding probe that commits contiguous spans of high-confidence tokens earlier under relaxed thresholds when neighboring tokens provide reliable support.
summary_en.experiments: The authors train DreamReasoner-8B, an open 8B-parameter block diffusion reasoning model. The experiments vary training block size, inference block size, and decoding strategy on math and code reasoning benchmarks. The key result is that naive large-block training substantially hurts reasoning, while small-block training preserves reasoning ability. A fine-to-coarse block-size curriculum recovers strong reasoning under larger blocks and enables efficiency gains during inference. The paper reports that DreamReasoner-8B is competitive with Qwen3-8B-Thinking on math and code reasoning and clearly improves over prior block diffusion models at comparable scale. RelaxedConfidence gives average tokens-per-forward-pass gains of 22.5% in the thinking phase and 54.5% in the answering phase without degrading reasoning fidelity, indicating that conservative token-level commitment is a real bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the block diffusion formulation first, especially how clean prefixes, masked target blocks, absorbing corruption, and weighted cross-entropy are combined. Then focus on the experiments that cross training block size with inference block size; these are the most important evidence that large-block failure is a training mismatch, not just a decoding issue. The curriculum section is the main technical contribution and is worth checking for schedule design, compute cost, and sensitivity to block-size transitions. The RelaxedConfidence analysis is useful for understanding the remaining inference bottleneck. It should be read as a diagnostic for unused parallelism rather than as a fully settled serving algorithm.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 diffusion LM 做 reasoning 的 prior：先别盯采样步数，先复现 block-size curriculum；若结论稳，训练粒度就是比解码并行度更关键的控制杆。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on diffusion reasoning: before obsessing over sampling steps, reproduce the block-size curriculum result—if it holds, training granularity is a more important lever than decoding parallelism.

paper.title: Beyond Reward Engineering: A Data Recipe for Long-Context Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning is an essential capability for large language models, particularly when they are deployed as autonomous agents that must reason over lengthy trajectories. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving this ability, yet existing work largely focuses on reward engineering while diverse training data remains scarce. We revisit this problem from a data-centric perspective and show that a simple yet effective data recipe alone, paired wit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：长上下文 RL 提升推理能力时，社区过度依赖 reward engineering，而忽视了训练数据配方本身可能是主要瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员，这篇的价值很直接。它不是纯后训练技巧堆叠，而是在 RL 场景里重新强调 data recipe 的决定性作用，且与 pretrain 的 data mixture 思路高度同构。若结论站得住，会改变“长上下文 RL 主要靠奖励设计”的先验，转而把注意力放到任务覆盖、样本结构和能力分解上。
