summary.technical_approach: 作者从数据中心视角构造长上下文 RL 训练集，围绕三类互补任务组织数据：retrieval、multi-evidence synthesis 和 reasoning，共整理 8 个数据集、约 14K 样本。训练上刻意保持简单，只配一个最小化的 outcome-based GRPO 设置，弱化复杂 reward shaping 的影响，以便把性能增益更多归因于数据配方本身。核心主张是：只要训练样本覆盖了长上下文能力的关键子结构，简单 RL 也能学到稳定收益。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 三个模型，在 7 个长上下文 benchmark 上分别取得平均 +7.2、+3.2、+6.4 分提升，并超过先前 RL 训练集。摘要还指出收益可迁移到更广泛的长上下文任务，而不只局限于训练分布内。虽然目前规模不算大，但 setup 相对干净：固定简单 RL 算法，突出数据因素。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学。Xu Han 在中文 NLP、知识与推理相关方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context RL gains are bottlenecked less by reward engineering and more by the training data recipe itself.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to pretraining-minded researchers because it reframes an RL problem in data-mixture terms. If the result holds, it weakens the prior that long-context RL progress mainly comes from reward design and shifts attention toward task coverage, sample structure, and capability decomposition.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors take a data-centric approach and build a long-context RL recipe spanning three complementary task families: retrieval, multi-evidence synthesis, and reasoning. They curate eight datasets totaling about 14K examples. On the optimization side, they intentionally keep training simple with a minimal outcome-based GRPO setup, reducing confounding from elaborate reward shaping so that gains can be attributed more cleanly to the data recipe.
summary_en.experiments: They train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B, reporting average gains of +7.2, +3.2, and +6.4 points across seven long-context benchmarks, outperforming prior RL training sets. The abstract also claims transfer beyond the exact training distribution. The scale is modest, but the setup is relatively clean because the RL algorithm is kept simple while the data factor is varied.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University. Xu Han is known for work around Chinese NLP, knowledge, and reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你对 long-context RL 的 prior：先别忙着雕 reward，先把任务分解和数据配方做干净；建议立刻在内部 RL recipe 上做同类 ablation。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on long-context RL: stop over-tuning rewards before cleaning up task decomposition and data recipe; worth reproducing as an internal RL-data ablation.

paper.title: Seeing Before Reasoning: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Shortcut-Resilient Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a model on its own rollouts and uses a frozen copy to provide dense token-level targets conditioned on a reference target. This works well for LLM reasoning, but a direct extension to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can create a shortcut: the privileged target may guide tokens mainly based on the text reference target rather than the image. We propose ViGOS, a visually grounded OPSD framework for MLLM post-training. The student first writes a vi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很容易被忽略的 MLLM post-training 问题：把文本 LLM 上有效的 on-policy self-distillation 直接搬到多模态场景时，教师端可见的参考答案会过早主导整条生成轨迹，导致模型在还没真正看图时，就已经沿着“与答案相容”的语言路径生成。结果不是简单的过拟合，而是视觉 grounding 被弱化：模型学会了写出看似合理的视觉推理文本，但这些中间步骤主要受答案提示驱动，而不是受图像证据约束。论文把这个问题形式化为 privileged answer leakage，并指出 vanilla OPSD 在 MLLM 上的风险不在于 dense supervision 本身，而在于同一个 privileged teacher 对‘感知—推理—作答’三个阶段使用了相同的信息条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有两点。第一，它说明 dense token-level distillation 在多模态场景里不是天然安全的；如果教师条件设计不对，训练信号会系统性鼓励 shortcut，而不是提升真实的视觉利用率。这对以后做 multimodal continual pretrain、reasoning post-train、以及 unified AR training 都有直接意义。第二，它给出了一种更一般的思路：不要只看 loss 形式，要看监督信号在生成轨迹不同阶段暴露了什么信息。对基座研究来说，这比单纯讨论是否用 RL、是否用 distillation 更关键。贡献量级上，它不是改写范式的工作，但属于那类把已有有效方法从 text-only 推向 multimodal 时，补上关键机制缺口的论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ViGOS，把学生输出显式拆成两个阶段：先写 visual description，再进行 reasoning 和 final answer。对应地，教师监督也被拆开。第一段描述由 image-only perception teacher 监督，这个教师只能看图像，不看参考答案，因此它给出的 token-level target 只能来自视觉证据。第二段推理与答案由 privileged reasoning teacher 监督，这个教师可以看参考答案，但它是在学生已经生成了视觉描述之后，基于同一 student prefix 提供后续 dense supervision。这样做的目的不是完全去掉答案条件，而是把答案条件限制在“已经完成感知 grounding 之后”的阶段，避免它反向污染早期视觉声明。

论文还引入 reference teacher 处理 invalid rollouts。这里的设计取舍很清楚：如果学生生成的轨迹在格式、结构或任务约束上已经失效，继续在该轨迹上做分段蒸馏意义不大，反而可能放大噪声，因此改用 reference teacher 把输出拉回目标格式。这个机制本质上是在 on-policy 和 training stability 之间做折中。

从全文描述看，作者并不只是提出 prompt engineering 式的“先描述再推理”，而是把它嵌入到 OPSD 的监督图里：不同 token span 由不同信息可见性的教师负责。论文前面还定义了 PALR（Privileged Answer Leakage Rate）来刻画在固定 student rollout 上，教师修正中有多少成分来自 privileged answer 而不是图像。这个指标的价值不在于绝对数值，而在于它把 shortcut 风险从直觉层面推进到可分析层面。相比 vanilla OPSD，ViGOS 的关键区别不是换了 loss，而是重新设计了 teacher context assignment；相比纯 outcome-level RL，它保留了 dense token supervision 的样本效率优势。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面比较广，重点不是单一 benchmark 冲分，而是验证“保留 OPSD 收益，同时减少 prior shortcut”。文中评测包含一般视觉语言能力、学术型多模态推理、视觉数学、空间 grounding，以及专门测试 language prior/shortcut 的 stress benchmarks。全文给出的主结论是：ViGOS 在常规 benchmark 上基本保留 vanilla OPSD 的提升，没有因为加入 perception-reasoning decoupling 而明显牺牲主任务性能；同时在 prior-sensitive 评测上更稳，说明它确实提高了模型对图像证据的依赖度，而不是只改变了输出风格。

从消融逻辑看，最值得注意的通常有三组：一是与 vanilla OPSD 的直接对比，用来验证 shortcut 是否真实存在；二是去掉 image-only perception teacher，只保留 privileged teacher，看性能是否回退；三是去掉显式 visual description 接口，检验“分段监督”是否必须依赖中间表示。论文摘要页没有给出具体参数量和提升数字，全文片段里也未出现完整表格，因此这里不能编造数值。但从作者组织实验的方式看，重点证据不是某个 benchmark 上的大幅增益，而是 robustness pattern 的变化：标准集不掉太多，prior-sensitive 集提升更明显，这与方法目标是一致的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法图，抓住一句话：问题不是 OPSD 无效，而是 privileged answer 在 MLLM 上泄漏得太早。然后看 Preliminaries 里对 vanilla OPSD 的形式化，以及 PALR 的定义，理解作者如何把 shortcut 风险写成可讨论的对象。方法部分重点看三类 teacher 的职责边界：perception teacher、reasoning teacher、reference teacher，各自看什么输入、监督哪些 token。实验部分建议优先看 prior-sensitive benchmark 的主表和对应消融，因为那部分最能说明 ViGOS 不是单纯增加了输出模板约束。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做 multimodal post-train 或者在研究 dense supervision 的信息泄漏问题，建议再细看 PALR 分析和 invalid rollout 处理策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode of extending on-policy self-distillation from text-only LLMs to multimodal LLMs. In vanilla OPSD, the frozen teacher is conditioned on a privileged reference answer and provides dense token-level supervision on the student’s own rollout. In MLLMs, this creates a shortcut: the teacher can steer the trajectory toward answer-compatible text before the model has actually grounded its response in the image. The result is not merely overfitting, but weakened visual grounding—plausible-looking rationales that are driven more by answer conditioning than by visual evidence. The paper frames this as privileged answer leakage and argues that the issue comes from using the same privileged teacher context across perception, reasoning, and answer generation.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretrain/post-train research is conceptual. First, it shows that dense token-level distillation is not automatically safe in multimodal settings; if teacher visibility is mis-specified, the training signal can systematically reinforce shortcuts instead of improving true image use. That matters for multimodal post-training, continual pretraining, and any unified autoregressive setup that mixes latent reasoning with grounded perception. Second, it highlights a broader design principle: when analyzing a training objective, one must inspect what information is exposed at each stage of the generated trajectory, not just the loss form. In terms of contribution scale, this is not a new foundation-model paradigm, but it does close an important mechanism gap in transferring a successful text-only recipe into multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ViGOS explicitly decomposes the student output into two stages: a visual description first, then reasoning plus final answer. The supervision is decomposed accordingly. The visual-description segment is supervised by an image-only perception teacher, which has access to the image but not the reference answer. This forces token-level targets in the early segment to be grounded in visual evidence. The later reasoning and answer segments are supervised by a privileged reasoning teacher that can see the reference answer, but only after the student has already produced the visual description. This preserves answer-guided dense supervision where it is useful, while preventing privileged information from directly shaping the early perceptual claims.

The method also uses a reference teacher for invalid rollouts. The rationale is practical: once the student trajectory has drifted into an invalid format or broken task constraints, continuing segmented on-policy supervision may amplify noise. The reference teacher is then used to restore output structure and reduce format drift. This is a stability-oriented compromise between strict on-policy learning and controllable supervision.

A notable aspect is that the paper does more than prompt the model to “describe before reasoning.” It changes the supervision graph of OPSD so that different token spans are scored by teachers with different information access. The paper also introduces PALR, the Privileged Answer Leakage Rate, to quantify how much of the teacher correction on a fixed student rollout is attributable to the privileged answer rather than the image. The point of PALR is not a single headline number, but a way to make shortcut risk analyzable. Relative to vanilla OPSD, the main innovation is teacher-context assignment rather than a new loss. Relative to sparse-reward RL, ViGOS keeps the sample-efficiency advantage of dense token-level supervision.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is broad and aligned with the paper’s claim: preserve the gains of OPSD on standard benchmarks while improving robustness to language-prior shortcuts. The benchmarks cover general vision-language ability, expert-level multimodal reasoning, visual mathematics, spatial grounding, and stress tests designed to expose reliance on textual priors. The central empirical result is that ViGOS largely retains the benchmark improvements of vanilla OPSD on standard tasks, while performing better on prior-sensitive evaluations where genuine image dependence matters.

The most informative ablations are the obvious ones. First, a direct comparison against vanilla OPSD tests whether the shortcut problem is real in practice. Second, removing the image-only perception teacher checks whether privileged supervision alone causes the model to regress toward weaker grounding. Third, removing the explicit visual-description interface probes whether the benefit comes from staged supervision or merely from output templating. The provided excerpt does not include full tables, parameter counts, or exact gains, so no precise numbers should be invented here. Still, the experimental pattern is clear: the method is not mainly about pushing one benchmark higher, but about changing the robustness profile—small or no loss on standard sets, better behavior on prior-sensitive ones—which is exactly what the method is designed to achieve.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the main method figure. The key takeaway is simple: OPSD itself is not the problem; early privileged-answer exposure is. Then read the preliminaries that formalize vanilla OPSD and the PALR definition, since that is where the shortcut concern becomes concrete rather than anecdotal. In the method section, focus on the boundary between the three teachers: perception teacher, reasoning teacher, and reference teacher—what each one sees and which token spans each one supervises. In the experiments, prioritize the prior-sensitive benchmarks and the ablations, because those best show that ViGOS is doing more than enforcing a response template. A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. If your work touches multimodal post-training or information leakage in dense supervision, the PALR analysis and invalid-rollout handling deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 MLLM 自蒸馏中容易出现的文本捷径问题，其解耦感知与推理的思路对多模态后训练数据合成有启发，可看其解耦设计的具体 loss。
recommendation.en: Identifies the text shortcut issue in MLLM self-distillation; its approach of decoupling perception and reasoning is inspiring for multimodal post-training data synthesis. Worth checking the specific loss design for decoupling.

paper.title: REVES: REvision and VErification--Augmented Training for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling via sequential revision has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, standard post-training methods primarily optimize single-shot objectives, creating a fundamental misalignment with multi-step inference dynamics. While recent work treats this as multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL), conventional approaches optimize over the multi-step trajectories directly, failing to further exploit the high-quality mistakes in intermediat

summary.core_problem: test-time scaling 下的多步修订推理与现有单步后训练目标不匹配，直接做 trajectory-level RL 又浪费了中间 near-miss 步骤的学习信号。
summary.importance: 提出一种把 revision 与 verification 解耦的数据增强+策略优化框架，属于 test-time scaling 训练方法类工作；方法上为 offline/off-policy 利用中间错误提供了一个具体 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段迭代：(1) 在线 rollout 生成成功恢复轨迹，把中间 near-miss 步骤解耦为独立的 revision prompt（从错到对的改写）和 verification prompt（定位错误）；(2) 用这些增广样本做策略优化，支持离策略数据复用，降低在线采样成本。框架反复在数据增广和策略优化之间交替。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token、baseline 与数值增益，仅描述了在推理任务上相对单步目标和直接 multi-turn RL 的效率与效果提升预期，实验细节不完整。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Zhaoran Wang、Mingyi Hong、Mohammad Ghavamzadeh 等，来自优化/RL 方向，无明确机构署名在给定信息中。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-shot post-training objectives mismatch multi-step revision-based test-time scaling, while naive multi-turn RL underuses learning signal from near-miss intermediate steps.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an iterative data augmentation plus policy optimization framework that decouples revision and verification supervision, offering a concrete recipe to exploit intermediate mistakes for test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage loop: (1) online rollouts of successful recovery trajectories; intermediate near-miss states are converted into decoupled revision prompts (error-to-correction transforms) and verification prompts (error identification); (2) policy optimization on these augmented samples enables off-policy data reuse and reduces sample cost, alternating between data augmentation and policy improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model sizes, training data, baselines, and quantitative gains; it only claims improved efficiency and performance over single-shot objectives and direct multi-turn RL on reasoning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Zhaoran Wang, Mingyi Hong, and Mohammad Ghavamzadeh from optimization/RL backgrounds; institutional affiliations are not fully specified in the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 想法不新（revision+verification 数据增广今年已很拥挤），摘要实验不完整，扫一眼数据构造方式即可，别当方法范式读。
recommendation.en: The revision-plus-verification augmentation idea is crowded this year and the abstract lacks concrete numbers; skim the data construction, do not treat it as a new paradigm.

paper.title: Sparsity Curse: Understanding RLVR Model Parameter Space from Model Merging
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm that surpasses Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in eliciting reasoning intelligence and resisting catastrophic forgetting. Recent studies further reveal that RLVR induces highly sparse and off-principal parameter updates compared to SFT. This naturally raises the question: does such sparsity make RLVR models more amenable to model merging? If so, model merging would offer a scalable, training-free p

summary.core_problem: RL with Verifiable Reward（RLVR）诱导出的参数更新比 SFT 更稀疏、更少落在主奇异方向上，一个自然猜想是这种稀疏性会让模型合并（model merging）更容易。论文研究 RLVR 模型在参数空间中的可合并性，并解释为什么答案恰好相反。
summary.importance: 对理解 pretrain→RL 的参数几何、post-training 对基座表示的改动方式、以及靠模型合并聚合能力的工程路线都有实际意义。论文给出的核心观察是：稀疏不等于正交可加；RLVR 的更新虽然只改少量参数，但在不同独立训练 run 中落在近乎正交的子空间，形成彼此干扰很强的“shortcut”，这解释了为什么直接平均或传统 task vector 合并对 R1 式推理模型容易失效。对基座研究者来说，这一现象也提示 RLVR 可能不是在共享的稠密主方向上微调，而是在高维空间里沿不同低维路径扩展能力，因而对初始化、随机种子和 reward 噪声更敏感。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从模型合并视角系统比较 SFT 与 RLVR 的更新结构。作者先分析 task vector 的稀疏度、逐层更新方向的正交性、以及激活密度几何，指出 RLVR 的独立更新彼此距离更远、重叠区域存在冲突；随后提出针对 RLVR 的 SAR-Merging：第一步用 Fisher 信息度量参数敏感性，在更新重叠区域解决冲突，优先保留对任务更敏感的参数；第二步对合并后的 task vector 做 magnitude-aware sparsification 与 rescaling，避免把稀疏更新混成稠密噪声，从而保留 RLVR 的稀疏推理通路。方法整体仍是训练-free 的合并 recipe，不是新的 RL 算法。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在数学和代码基准上比较多种标准合并方法（如平均、task arithmetic、现有 RL 合并方法）与 SAR-Merging。论文报告现有方法在 RLVR 模型上会出现严重性能退化，而 SAR-Merging 在单任务增强和多能力融合上明显更稳。需要注意的是，论文属于经验机制分析加针对性 recipe 设计，量级上是 post-training/merging 层面的改进，不是基座训练方法突破；实验重点在于揭示“sparse but orthogonal”的几何现象，而不是给出新的 sota 预训练结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看 Figure 1 关于 RLVR 合并失效的现象、参数更新稀疏性和正交性分析、以及 SAR-Merging 里“保稀疏、解冲突”的设计动机。若关心 R1 类 RL 训练对权重空间的影响，可重点读引言和机制分析部分；若只关心工程合并方法，直接看方法和实验表，预计 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: RL with Verifiable Reward produces parameter updates that are much sparser and more off-principal than those from SFT. The paper asks whether this sparsity makes RLVR models easier to merge, and shows that the opposite holds.
summary_en.importance: The finding is relevant to understanding the parameter-space geometry of post-training, especially R1-style reasoning RL. Sparsity does not imply compatibility: independently trained RLVR models modify small but near-orthogonal sets of directions, so naive merging destroys those pathways. This matters for pretraining–post-training interactions because it suggests RLVR does not simply refine a shared dense subspace, but can carve out fragile, run-specific shortcuts in low-curvature regions. It also explains a practical failure mode when trying to aggregate capabilities from multiple RL checkpoints without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first compares SFT and RLVR updates through the lens of model merging, measuring update sparsity, layer-wise orthogonality, and activation-density geometry. The main diagnosis is that RLVR updates are sparse but dispersed, creating strong interference when independently trained task vectors are combined. Building on this, the authors propose SAR-Merging (Sensitivity-aware Resolving Merging): Fisher information is used to resolve conflicts in overlapping update regions by preserving more task-sensitive parameters, followed by magnitude-aware sparsification and rescaling of the merged task vector so that the result remains sparse rather than collapsing into dense noise. The method remains training-free.
summary_en.experiments: On mathematical and coding benchmarks, standard merging methods that work reasonably well for SFT models cause severe degradation on RLVR models, while SAR-Merging gives substantially better results for both single-task improvement and multi-capability fusion. The main empirical contribution is the identification of the sparsity curse itself—sparse, off-principal, near-orthogonal RLVR updates rather than a dense shared update direction—while the proposed merging recipe is a targeted fix for that geometry.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this for the mechanistic picture of RLVR in weight space, not for a new pretraining algorithm. Prioritize the introduction, the motivating failure figure, the orthogonality/sparsity analyses, and the two design moves in SAR-Merging. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看参数空间分析和 merging 实验；它会修正“RLVR 更新稀疏所以好合并”的直觉，但需确认模型规模。
recommendation.en: Read the parameter-space and merging experiments; it corrects the intuition that sparse RLVR updates should merge well, but check the model scale.

paper.title: Small Initialization Matters for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models provide a tractable system for asking how intelligence itself emerges, rather than only how LLMs can be engineered. Although progress is usually attributed to scale, data and architecture, we show that parameter initialization is a gene-like determinant of training and, in particular, of model capacity. Reducing the initialization scale consistently improves pretraining, with the largest gains on reasoning-demanding tasks. We identify two widely used empirical settings that

summary.core_problem: 参数初始化长期被深度学习领域视为已有成熟启发式方案（Xavier/Kaiming）的固定环节，此前关于小初始化有助于推理与泛化的结论多来自小模型或合成任务，尚未在真实LLM预训练场景下完成系统验证：小初始化的收益是否随模型规模成立、为什么之前观察到收益随模型增大而衰减、初始化与现有通用架构组件存在何种交互、最优初始化尺度是多少，这些问题均缺少明确的实证答案。
summary.importance: 该工作将初始化尺度从默认的工程启发式选项，明确为可定量调控的预训练设计轴。研究指出两个被广泛使用的架构配置（RMSNorm的稳定性常数、原生注意力的sink效应）会系统性掩盖小初始化的收益，修正这两个配置可以几乎零额外成本获得稳定的预训练损失下降，且增益集中在推理类任务上。研究提出的γ=1初始化临界点提供了可直接落地的训练配置参考，同时将此前仅在小模型上观察到的权重凝聚训练动态推广到了真实LLM预训练场景，为理解大模型的特征学习过程提供了新的观测维度。
summary.technical_approach: 研究将每层权重矩阵初始化为零均值高斯分布，标准差设为d_in^{-γ}：其中γ=0.5对应主流使用的Xavier初始化尺度，γ越大初始权重的绝对值越小。首先通过控制变量实验，扫描0.1B到1.5B规模LLM在不同γ下的预训练表现，确认小初始化可降低验证损失但收益随模型增大快速衰减的现象。随后逐一定位压制小初始化收益的架构因素：第一，RMSNorm中的稳定性常数ε会在隐状态方差随小初始化降低到与ε同量级时进入饱和区间，此时归一化操作不再对权重尺度变化敏感，完全掩盖初始化带来的差异；第二，小初始化会加剧注意力sink现象（注意力权重过度集中在序列首位token），引入门控注意力结构可缓解这一问题。同时解除两个限制（将ε降低到合适量级、使用门控注意力）后，小初始化在大模型上的收益得以恢复，呈现更优的规模scaling趋势。研究进一步通过权重动态测量和token级损失分解，确认γ=1为最优初始化点——此时残差通路与恒等通路的贡献达到平衡；小初始化模型的训练轨迹呈现“先凝聚后展开”的特征：训练前期权重首先收敛到低维子空间，后期再逐步扩展到高维结构，损失增益集中在需要推理的高难度token上。
summary.experiments: 标准架构配置（ε=1e-5，原生注意力）下，γ=1（小初始化）相比γ=0.5（标准Xavier），0.1B模型验证损失降低约0.05，但1.5B模型上损失差仅为0.003，收益随模型增大显著衰减。针对RMSNorm ε的消融实验显示：1.5B模型、γ=1配置下，将ε从常用的1e-5降到1e-12，验证损失降低约0.038；同样的ε调整在γ=0.5配置下仅带来约0.001的损失变化，几乎无影响。定量计算验证了饱和效应的存在：隐层维度d=2048时，γ=0.5对应的隐状态方差为4.8e-4，远大于1e-5；γ=1对应的隐状态方差为2.4e-7，远小于1e-5，此时归一化完全由ε主导。两个修复措施（低ε、门控注意力）结合后，小初始化的收益随模型增大不再衰减，scaling曲线斜率优于标准配置，下游测试中推理类任务的增益最为显著。γ值扫描实验显示γ=1为性能最优点，平衡了训练稳定性和推理能力，进一步增大γ（初始化尺度过小）会引发训练不稳定。权重动态测量显示，γ=1初始化的模型训练中前期权重有效秩显著低于标准初始化模型，呈现明显的凝聚特征；token级损失分解显示，简单高频token上不同初始化的损失差异极小，主要收益来自高损失、语义复杂的推理类token。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注Result章节中RMSNorm ε饱和效应的定量推导与对应实验（Figure 1c/d/e），这部分是最易落地的结论——调整ε几乎无实现成本，却能解锁小初始化的潜在收益。其次关注初始化的γ参数化方案与γ=1平衡点的分析，这是对现有默认初始化配置的直接修正。目前公开版本内容在第二个障碍（注意力sink）的分析处截断，关于门控注意力的完整消融可跟进后续正式版本。值得深挖的方向包括：γ=1的最优设置在7B及更大规模模型、MoE/SSM等非Transformer架构上的迁移性，ε最优取值与隐层维度、初始化γ的定量关系，训练前期权重凝聚过程和下游推理能力的因果关联。

summary_en.core_problem: Parameter initialization has long been treated as a settled engineering heuristic in deep learning, with Xavier/Kaiming scaling as the de facto standard for LLM training. Prior work demonstrating benefits of small initialization for reasoning and generalization was largely limited to small models and synthetic tasks. It remains untested at production LLM scale whether these benefits hold, why observed gains diminish as model size grows, how initialization interacts with common architectural components, and what initialization scale is optimal for practical pretraining.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes initialization scale as an explicitly tunable design axis for LLM pretraining, rather than a fixed default. It shows that two ubiquitous architectural choices — the epsilon constant in RMSNorm, and vanilla attention prone to sink effects — systematically mask the benefits of small initialization. Adjusting these components delivers consistent pretraining loss improvements with near-zero implementation cost, with disproportionate gains on reasoning-intensive tasks. The identified γ=1 initialization point provides a concrete, actionable default for future training, and connects large-model training dynamics to the condensed feature learning regime previously documented only in small networks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Weights are parameterized as zero-mean Gaussian with standard deviation d_in^{-γ}, where γ=0.5 recovers standard Xavier initialization and larger γ corresponds to smaller initial weight scale. Controlled pretraining runs across model sizes from 0.1B to 1.5B first confirm that small initialization reduces validation loss, but gains decay sharply with model size. Two architectural factors suppressing these gains are isolated. First, the RMSNorm stability constant epsilon enters a saturation regime when hidden state variance drops below epsilon, making normalization invariant to weight scale and erasing initialization effects. Second, small initialization exacerbates the attention sink effect — over-concentration of attention weights on the first sequence token — which is mitigated by gated attention. Combining a reduced epsilon value with gated attention restores small initialization benefits across model scales, producing improved scaling behavior. Weight dynamics tracking and token-level loss decomposition identify γ=1 as a critical optimum, where residual and identity pathway contributions are balanced. Small initialization models follow a condense-then-expand trajectory: weights first collapse to a low-dimensional subspace in early training, then gradually expand to high-rank representations, with loss gains concentrated on difficult, reasoning-related tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Under standard architectural settings (epsilon=1e-5, vanilla attention), moving from γ=0.5 to γ=1 reduces validation loss by ~0.05 at 0.1B scale, but only by ~0.003 at 1.5B scale, showing clear gain decay with size. Ablations on epsilon show that for 1.5B models at γ=1, reducing epsilon from 1e-5 to 1e-12 lowers validation loss by ~0.038; the same epsilon change produces only ~0.001 loss reduction at γ=0.5. Quantitative analysis confirms the saturation effect: for hidden dimension d=2048, hidden state variance at γ=1 is 2.4e-7 (well below epsilon=1e-5), while variance at γ=0.5 is 4.8e-4 (well above saturation). Combining both architectural fixes eliminates gain decay across model sizes, producing a better scaling slope than standard initialization, with largest downstream gains on reasoning tasks. A sweep of γ identifies γ=1 as the optimal tradeoff between stability and performance, with higher γ introducing training instability. Weight dynamics measurements show that γ=1 models exhibit significantly lower effective weight rank (condensation) in early training compared to standard initialization; token-level loss decomposition shows negligible differences on simple high-frequency tokens, with gains concentrated on high-loss, semantically complex tokens requiring reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the analysis of RMSNorm epsilon saturation, including the quantitative derivation and Figure 1 panels c/d/e — this is the most immediately actionable finding, as epsilon adjustment requires no code complexity or overhead. The γ parameterization of initialization and the γ=1 critical point are also core contributions. The discussion of the attention sink barrier is truncated in the available preprint version; readers may refer to the final publication for complete ablations on gated attention. Promising follow-up directions include testing the transfer of γ=1 initialization to larger model scales and alternative architectures (MoE, SSM), deriving the quantitative relationship between optimal epsilon, hidden dimension, and initialization γ, and investigating the causal link between early-stage weight condensation and downstream reasoning performance.

recommendation.zh: 应在内部 pretrain ablation 复现小初始化；若尺度和 warmup 设置干净，这会改变初始化只是稳定性细节的 prior。
recommendation.en: Run an internal pretrain ablation on smaller init; if scale and warmup are clean, this changes the prior that initialization is only a stability detail.

paper.title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models (LLMs), yet its application to diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) remains unexplored. Existing OPSD methods are inherently autoregressive-centric. They inject privileged information via left-to-right prefix conditioning with token-level divergence supervision, a design that fundamentally conflicts with the arbitraryorder generation of dLLMs. We introduce d-OPSD, the first OPSD framework tailored for dLLMs. Our ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion LLM 的 on-policy self-distillation 如何定义的问题。AR 模型里的 OPSD 通常把 privileged information 放在 prefix 中，并做 token-level divergence；但 dLLM 是迭代去噪、任意顺序生成，这种左到右前缀条件和 token 级监督并不匹配。d-OPSD 的目标是在不引入更强外部 teacher 的情况下，让 dLLM 从自己的生成轨迹中获得更密集的自蒸馏信号。
summary.importance: 它对新型语言建模范式的 post-train 接口有参考意义。dLLM 近期已经能用 RLVR 做 reasoning post-training，但 RLVR 的 outcome reward 稀疏，SFT 又有 off-policy 和 exposure bias 问题。d-OPSD 提供了一种更贴合去噪生成过程的训练信号：用模型自己生成的答案作为 suffix privileged information，再用 step-level divergence 监督整个去噪转移。这把 AR post-training 中的 OPSD 思路迁移到 diffusion LM，但没有照搬 token-level objective。对研究 diffusion LM 的训练目标、推理过程和 reasoning 能力提升有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 核心有两处改动。第一，self-teacher 的构造不再把参考解或 privileged information 拼到 prompt 后面作为 prefix 条件，而是利用 dLLM 可做非自回归条件建模的特点，把模型自己生成的答案作为 suffix condition。这样 teacher 学到的是在已知“未来答案”时，对前面推理轨迹或中间内容的条件分布，可理解为从 self future-experience 中提供训练信号。第二，监督粒度从 token-level divergence 改为 step-level divergence。dLLM 每一步会对多个 masked tokens 同时预测，然后保留一部分、重新 mask 一部分；单个 token 的 next-token KL 并不能自然对应这个 Markov denoising transition。d-OPSD 因此在每个去噪 step 上比较 student transition 与 self-teacher transition，使蒸馏目标和 dLLM 的推理机制对齐。它和 RLVR 的区别是提供密集分布监督，而不是只依赖最终答案奖励；和 SFT 的区别是训练轨迹来自 student 自身，on-policy 程度更高。
summary.experiments: 论文在四个 reasoning 任务上比较 d-OPSD、RLVR 和 SFT。给定内容显示，d-OPSD 在 reasoning performance 和 sample efficiency 上稳定优于这些 baseline。实验还分析了不同设置对效果的影响，用来支持两个设计选择：suffix privileged conditioning 比把 privileged information 作为前缀更适合 dLLM；step-level divergence 比 token-level 监督更符合迭代去噪。给定内容未包含任务名称、模型规模、训练样本量、步数和具体分数，因此需要在实验表中重点核对提升幅度，以及是否在不同 denoising steps、不同采样策略、不同自生成答案质量下保持稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 AR-OPSD 与 dLLM 不匹配的两点分析：prefix conditioning 和 token-level divergence。然后看 Preliminaries，确认作者如何定义 dLLM 的 forward corruption、reverse denoising、masked token 保留与 remasking。方法部分重点看 self-teacher 的 suffix conditioning 形式，以及 step-level divergence 的具体计算对象。实验部分建议优先看四类结果：与 RLVR/SFT 的主结果，样本效率曲线，privileged information 放置方式的消融，token-level 与 step-level supervision 的消融。若要进一步判断价值，需要看它是否依赖高质量自生成答案筛选，以及额外推理成本是否会影响训练吞吐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how on-policy self-distillation should be formulated for diffusion LLMs. OPSD methods for autoregressive models usually inject privileged information through left-to-right prefix conditioning and apply token-level divergence. That design does not fit dLLMs, which generate by iterative denoising and can condition on arbitrary parts of the sequence. d-OPSD aims to give a dLLM dense self-distillation signals without requiring a stronger external teacher.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between alternative language modeling objectives and post-training. Recent dLLMs can benefit from RLVR, but outcome rewards are sparse, while SFT uses off-policy trajectories and can suffer from exposure bias. d-OPSD proposes a training signal that matches the denoising process more closely: use the model’s own generated answer as suffix privileged information, then distill at the denoising-step level. This is a useful direction for studying how reasoning training should differ between autoregressive LMs and diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method makes two main changes to AR-style OPSD. First, the self-teacher is built with suffix conditioning rather than prefix conditioning. Instead of appending a reference solution to the prompt in a left-to-right format, d-OPSD uses the model’s own generated answer as a future suffix condition. This exploits the bidirectional or arbitrary-order conditioning ability of dLLMs and keeps the data on-policy. Second, the divergence objective is moved from token level to step level. In a dLLM, each denoising step predicts many masked positions, commits to a subset, and may remask others. A next-token KL objective is therefore not the natural unit of supervision. d-OPSD compares the student and self-teacher denoising transitions at each step, aligning the distillation target with the Markov denoising process. Compared with RLVR, it provides dense distributional feedback. Compared with SFT, it trains on trajectories sampled from the student itself.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on four reasoning tasks, comparing d-OPSD with RLVR and SFT baselines. The provided content states that d-OPSD improves both reasoning performance and sample efficiency. The ablations are designed to test the two central choices: suffix-based privileged conditioning versus prefix-style conditioning, and step-level divergence versus token-level supervision. Exact task names, model sizes, training budgets, and score deltas are not available in the supplied text, so the experimental tables should be checked for the actual margins and for robustness across denoising step counts, sampling strategies, and different qualities of self-generated answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim should cover the main contribution. Start with the Introduction, especially the two failure modes of directly applying AR-OPSD to dLLMs: prefix conditioning and token-level divergence. Then read the preliminaries to verify the paper’s notation for forward corruption, reverse denoising, token commitment, and remasking. In the method section, focus on the suffix-conditioned self-teacher and the exact definition of step-level divergence. In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison with RLVR and SFT, the sample-efficiency curves, and the ablations on privileged-information placement and supervision granularity. For a deeper assessment, check whether the method depends on filtering high-quality self-generated answers and how much extra computation the self-teacher pass adds.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation 即可；它提醒 dLLM 后训练不能照搬 AR 的 prefix 教师信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; the useful point is that dLLM post-training cannot simply inherit AR prefix-based teacher signals.

paper.title: PowerOPD: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation with Bounded Power Transformation
paper.abstract: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) for large language models estimates the reverse-KL objective using student-sampled tokens, yielding an unbiased single-sample Monte Carlo estimator that avoids vocabulary-wide computation. However, we show that this estimator suffers from severe training pathologies in practice: sample inefficiency, unstable generation dynamics, and a substantial performance gap compared to exact full-vocabulary OPD. Reward-level diagnosis traces these pathologies to the log

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 on-policy distillation 的训练不稳定问题。标准 OPD 用 student 自己采样出的 token 来估计 reverse-KL，避免全词表计算，但单样本 Monte Carlo 估计会把每个 token 的更新权重变成 teacher-student 的 log-prob ratio。这个 reward 没有上下界，低概率 token 上的偶发事件会产生极大梯度，导致训练早期性能下降、生成长度震荡，以及收敛后仍明显落后于 full-vocabulary OPD。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于训练信号诊断，而不只是一个 post-training trick。它指出了一个常被忽略的问题：当语言模型训练目标从全分布 loss 变成采样轨迹上的 policy-gradient 形式后，目标的无偏性并不保证优化条件良好。对 RL pretrain、在线蒸馏、self-improvement 和 annealing 阶段都有参考意义。贡献量级主要体现在两点：一是把 vanilla OPD 的失败归因到 reward-level 的无界 log-ratio，而不是简单归因到学习率或 batch size；二是给出一个 bounded、sign-consistent 的替代 reward，在保持 sampled-token 低成本的同时接近甚至超过 full-vocabulary OPD。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 PowerOPD。核心做法是保留 OPD 中“teacher 分数减 student 分数”的结构，但把原来的 log p 换成 Box-Cox power transform。形式上使用 h(π_T) - h(π_θ)，其中 h 是严格单调函数，因此只要 teacher 对某个 token 的概率高于 student，reward 符号就仍然为正；反之为负。这保证了训练方向不反。标准 OPD 的 log-ratio 可以看作 α → 0 的极限；当 α > 0 时，reward 被限制在有限范围内，从源头上削掉低概率 token 造成的极端权重。这个设计和 reward clipping、tanh、z-score normalization 的区别在于：后处理方法是在 log-ratio 已经把信号扭曲之后再压缩，而 PowerOPD 直接改变 probability-to-reward mapping。代价是它不再是原始 reverse-KL 的简单单样本估计，而是一个更适合在线优化的有界 surrogate objective。论文也观察到 α 越大，越会压制 teacher 和 student 都认为低概率的 token，把学习信号集中到至少一方认为可能的 token 上。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在数学推理蒸馏。模型来自 Qwen3 family，包括 0.6B 和 1.7B student，以及 4B 和 8B teacher，共四组 teacher-student 配置，评测覆盖六个数学 benchmark。在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base student、Qwen3-4B teacher、MATH-500 的代表性设置中，vanilla OPD 收敛后只有 54.93% accuracy，比 full-vocabulary OPD 低 8.19 points；PowerOPD 相比 vanilla OPD 提升 9.6 points，并且用约 1/10 的训练步数达到相同 accuracy。完整评测中，PowerOPD 的 benchmark-averaged Avg@8 / Pass@8 相比 vanilla OPD 最高提升 +6.37 / +5.71；相比 clipping、tanh、z-score 等后处理稳定化方法最高提升 +3.01 / +3.54；相比 full-vocabulary OPD 最高提升 +2.59 / +8.90。单项 benchmark 的提升最高分别达到 +16.75 / +15.00、+8.43 / +7.50、+11.60 / +25.00。效率上，相比 full-vocabulary OPD，PowerOPD 每步 wall-clock time 降低 59.2%，peak GPU memory 降低 23.1%。训练动态分析显示，PowerOPD 的 gradient norm 比 vanilla OPD 初始 spike 低 3000 倍以上，response length 震荡也更小。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 reward-level diagnosis、Power transformation 的定义、α 的消融，以及 gradient/length dynamics 图。最值得注意的是它如何区分“无偏估计”和“可优化训练信号”：vanilla OPD 的 Monte Carlo 估计在目标上干净，但在 token-level reward 上病态。对做 RL pretrain 或在线蒸馏的人，α scaling 的实验比最终 accuracy 更有信息量，因为它说明低概率 token 的处理方式会直接改变生成分布的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why sampled-token on-policy distillation becomes unstable in LLM post-training. Vanilla OPD estimates a reverse-KL objective from student-sampled tokens, avoiding a full-vocabulary computation. The resulting policy-gradient weight is the teacher-student log-probability ratio. This reward is unbounded, so rare low-probability events can dominate the update, especially at early sequence positions. The observed symptoms are degraded validation accuracy at the beginning of training, large response-length oscillations, and a sizable gap to exact full-vocabulary OPD after convergence.
summary_en.importance: The useful part for pretraining and large-scale optimization is the training-signal diagnosis. The paper makes a concrete point: an unbiased sampled estimator of a distribution-level objective can still be a poor optimization signal once it is used on model-generated trajectories. This matters for online distillation, RL-style pretraining, self-improvement loops, and cooldown or annealing stages where the model trains on its own generations. The contribution is not just a stabilization heuristic. It identifies the unbounded log-ratio reward as the failure mode and replaces it with a bounded, direction-preserving reward that keeps the computational profile of sampled OPD.
summary_en.technical_approach: PowerOPD keeps the transform-then-subtract structure of OPD: h(π_T) - h(π_θ). If h is strictly increasing, the sign of the reward still matches the teacher-student probability gap. A token receives positive reward when the teacher assigns higher probability than the student, and negative reward in the opposite case. The paper instantiates h with a Box-Cox power transform. The usual log-ratio reward appears as the α → 0 limit; for any α > 0, the reward becomes bounded. This differs from clipping, tanh compression, or z-score normalization, which operate after the log-ratio has already produced extreme values. PowerOPD changes the probability-to-reward map itself. The tradeoff is that the method is better viewed as a bounded surrogate objective rather than a plain single-sample estimator of the original reverse-KL. Larger α suppresses tokens that both models assign low probability and concentrates learning on tokens considered plausible by either the teacher or the student.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use math-reasoning distillation with Qwen3-family teacher-student pairs: 0.6B and 1.7B students, and 4B and 8B teachers, evaluated on six math benchmarks. In the representative Qwen3-1.7B-Base student and Qwen3-4B teacher setting on MATH-500, vanilla OPD converges to 54.93% accuracy, 8.19 points below full-vocabulary OPD. PowerOPD improves over vanilla OPD by 9.6 points and reaches the same accuracy level with about 10× fewer training steps. Across the benchmark suite, the best averaged Avg@8 / Pass@8 gains are +6.37 / +5.71 over vanilla OPD, +3.01 / +3.54 over post-hoc reward stabilization, and +2.59 / +8.90 over full-vocabulary OPD. The largest single-benchmark gains reach +16.75 / +15.00, +8.43 / +7.50, and +11.60 / +25.00 under the corresponding comparisons. Compared with full-vocabulary OPD, PowerOPD reduces wall-clock time per step by 59.2% and peak GPU memory by 23.1%. Gradient tracking shows that its norms stay more than 3000× below the initial spike of vanilla OPD.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30 to 45 minutes. Read the reward diagnosis first, then the Box-Cox transformation, the α ablations, and the gradient and response-length dynamics. The most transferable lesson is the separation between estimator correctness and optimization quality. For readers working on RL pretraining or online distillation, the α-scaling results are more informative than the headline benchmark numbers, because they show how probability-to-reward shaping changes the stability of generated trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是“失稳根因在 reward 形状，不在采样器细节”；先读 reward 分析和 ablation，若 setup 干净，内部 RL/蒸馏都该试有界目标。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the claim that OPD instability comes from reward geometry, not just sampling noise; read the reward analysis and ablations first, then test bounded objectives in your own RL/distillation stack.

paper.title: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Post-training pipelines that combine supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) have emerged as the key recipe for transforming large language models (LLMs) into robust reasoners. We argue that this combined success is driven by compositional generalization, which we formalize through a hierarchical latent selection model. In this framework, reasoning traces are generated by a cascade of discrete latent selection variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules, including bo

summary.core_problem: SFT+RL 的后训练范式为何能大幅提升 LLM 的推理能力？具体而言，SFT 和 RL 在实现组合泛化（Compositional Generalization）中各自扮演了什么角色，应如何分配数据？
summary.importance: 提供了一个严谨的理论框架（层次潜变量选择模型）来解释 SFT 和 RL 的分工。不仅从机制上解释了 RL 为何能解决 SFT 导致的“统计纠缠”问题，还给出了极具实操价值的 SFT/RL 数据配比建议，对设计 Post-training 流程有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出“层次潜变量选择模型（Hierarchical Latent Selection Model）”。将推理轨迹视为由离散潜变量生成的序列，这些潜变量对应可复用的原子模块（包括局部操作的“技能”和决定信息流向的“路由”）。理论证明：SFT 提供了组合轨迹中的原始模块材料，但这些模块在 SFT 数据中往往是高度耦合的；RL 则通过奖励机制下的轨迹探索，将这些复合轨迹“解耦”成可独立复用的原子模块。基于此，提出 SFT 负责覆盖原子模块，RL 负责探索 SFT 分布外的新组合。
summary.experiments: 在合成字符串转换任务上进行控制变量实验。结果表明：1) 在复合轨迹上进行 RL 训练，其原子任务准确率能匹配直接使用原子数据监督训练的效果，且能泛化到未见过的组合。2) 组合能力必须从组合经验中学习：如果 RL 阶段缺失某个原子模块，只能通过注入包含该模块的组合数据来修复，单纯注入原子数据无效。3) 最佳的 OOD 泛化性能出现在：SFT 数据覆盖所有原子模块的组合，而 RL 数据专注于 SFT 支持集之外的新组合，且两者重叠最小化。
summary.reading_guide: 强烈建议精读。重点关注 Section 2 的理论建模（如何将推理抽象为技能和路由的组合），以及 Section 4 的控制实验设计（特别是 4.4 和 4.5 节关于数据配比的结论）。这篇论文对理解 RLHF/RLAIF 在推理任务中的作用机制极具启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Why does the SFT+RL post-training paradigm significantly improve LLM reasoning capabilities? Specifically, what are the distinct roles of SFT and RL in achieving compositional generalization, and how should data be allocated between them?
summary_en.importance: Provides a rigorous theoretical framework (Hierarchical Latent Selection Model) to explain the division of labor between SFT and RL. It not only mechanistically explains why RL resolves the 'statistical entanglement' caused by SFT but also offers highly actionable advice on SFT/RL data allocation, directly guiding post-training pipeline design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a 'Hierarchical Latent Selection Model'. Reasoning traces are modeled as sequences generated by discrete latent variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules (including 'skills' for local operations and 'routing' for information flow). Theoretically proves: SFT supplies the raw module materials in compositional traces, but these modules are often highly coupled in SFT data; RL, through reward-driven trajectory exploration, 'decouples' these compound traces into independently reusable atomic modules. Based on this, it proposes that SFT should cover atomic modules, while RL should explore novel compositions outside the SFT distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted controlled experiments on synthetic string transformation tasks. Results show: 1) RL on compound traces matches the atomic-task accuracy of direct atomic supervision and generalizes to unseen compositions. 2) Composability must be learned from composed experience: if an atomic module is missing during RL, it can only be repaired by injecting composed data containing it, not by isolated atomic data. 3) The strongest OOD generalization occurs when SFT covers all atomic modules in compositions, and RL focuses on novel compositions outside the SFT support, with minimal overlap.
summary_en.reading_guide: Highly recommended for deep reading. Focus on the theoretical modeling in Section 2 (how reasoning is abstracted into skills and routing) and the controlled experiment design in Section 4 (especially Sections 4.4 and 4.5 on data allocation). This paper is highly illuminating for understanding the mechanisms of RLHF/RLAIF in reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 应读理论设定和 controlled experiments；若 setup 干净，它会改变“RL 只是放大 SFT 行为”的简单 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the formal setup and controlled experiments; if clean, it weakens the simple prior that RL only amplifies behavior already present in SFT.

paper.title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
paper.abstract: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We argue that this single-axis sampling space is fundamentally limiting, and identify a second, fully deterministic and complementary axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollo

summary.core_problem: 推理时 scaling 当前仅依赖随机 token 采样单一维度，限制了 rollout 多样性；现有方法无法利用确定性机制产生互补的不同推理路径
summary.importance: 方法创新/范式扩展：首次将推理时 compute 扩展为 L×T 二维采样空间（确定性层跨度递归 × 随机温度采样），无需额外训练即可提升推理能力
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR)：在高不确定性 token 处重新应用模型顶层 L 层解码器，最多 K_max 次迭代直到下一词分布收敛；与 T 个温度样本组合形成笛卡尔采样空间；不同 L 选择自然产生不同 rollout，解决不同子集问题
summary.experiments: 在8个推理 benchmark 上进行评估；每层递归额外成本极小（仅顶层），每 rollout 成本几乎不变；不同 L 选择解决互不重叠的问题子集，显示互补性
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Martin Takac（Lehigh University，ML优化理论知名）和 Nils Lukas，机构信息从论文本身不易确定

summary_en.core_problem: Inference-time scaling currently relies on only one axis — stochastic token sampling — fundamentally limiting rollout diversity; no existing method exploits deterministic mechanisms for complementary rollouts
summary_en.importance: Method innovation / paradigm extension: first to expand inference-time compute into an L×T 2D sampling space (deterministic layer-span recursion × stochastic temperature sampling), requiring no additional training
summary_en.technical_approach: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR): at high-uncertainty tokens, re-apply the top-L decoder layers for at most K_max iterations until next-token distribution converges; combined with T temperature samples to form a Cartesian sampling space; different L choices naturally produce distinct rollouts solving different problem subsets
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 8 reasoning benchmarks; minimal extra cost per recursion (top layers only), near-constant per-rollout cost; different L values solve disjoint problem subsets, demonstrating complementarity
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Martin Takac (Lehigh University, known for ML optimization theory) and Nils Lukas; institutional affiliations not immediately clear from abstract alone

recommendation.zh: 推理时 scaling 的真正新维度——不依赖随机性的确定性层递归，设计空间干净，值得在内部 decoding 实验中复现
recommendation.en: A genuinely new dimension for inference-time scaling — deterministic layer recursion independent of stochasticity; clean design space, worth reproducing in internal decoding experiments.

paper.title: Multi-Turn Reflective Masking Elicits Reasoning in Mask Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: While reasoning on autoregressive (AR) models is often performed by chain-of-thought reasoning and reflection, their refinement of previous outputs still relies on fully sequential generation, even when only local edits are needed. In contrast, the masking mechanism in Mask Diffusion Models (MDMs) naturally supports explicit local edits on previous outputs, allowing selective refinement without discarding previous answers and generating another from scratch. While this property more closely alig

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 mask diffusion language/model family 里一个很核心但一直没被真正打开的能力缺口：模型虽然天生支持 masked token 的并行重采样，但现有解码基本还是单轮、被动、吸收式的，一旦某个 token 被“确认”，后面很难主动回头改。这样它并没有把 diffusion 范式相对 AR 的潜在优势用出来。作者要做的不是再造一个更强的 denoiser，而是让 MDM 学会在生成过程中自己判断哪里不可靠、哪里值得重遮盖，再做多轮局部修正，把 reasoning 从“向前续写”改成“对当前状态反复修订”。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇属于应当认真看的工作。原因有三点。第一，它抓住了 MDM 与 AR 最本质的机制差异：AR 的 test-time scaling 主要靠延长推理轨迹和重生成，MDM 则有机会把额外算力投到局部修正上。第二，它不是只在 decoding 上做启发式 remask，而是通过轻量 post-training 把 reflective masking 训练成模型内生能力，这对 diffusion LM 是否能形成独立 reasoning 路线很关键。第三，它提出的 History Reference 给了一个很实用的方向：MDM 缺少 AR 那种天然的“历史上下文串联”，于是需要显式保留去噪轨迹中的中间状态，给后续修正提供时间维度上的记忆。对 pretrain 研究员来说，这篇的意义不在于它已经给出最终答案，而在于它把“mask-based model 的 reasoning 应该如何定义和训练”讲清楚了。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两个主件。第一是 Reflective Masking。作者把每个位置、每个 denoising step 的动作定义成三选一：保留当前 token、把当前 token 重新 mask 掉等待重预测、或者对当前 mask 位置生成新 token。关键不是固定 remask 比例，而是根据模型当前的不确定性做逐位置决策，让模型能主动推翻先前已经 denoise 的内容。这样生成过程从单调收敛变成可逆的局部修订过程。第二是 History Reference。它不引入额外可学习参数，而是把先前若干步的中间预测状态聚合成 history-aware embedding，让模型在当前 step 不只看“现在的部分序列”，还看“这个位置之前被预测成过什么、改过几次、稳定不稳定”。这相当于给 MDM 补上一条 AR 模型天然拥有、但 diffusion 解码里通常缺失的时间记忆通道。

训练部分是全文最值得细看的地方。作者强调不能只靠推理时加规则，因为模型原本并没有学过多轮自发修订。于是他们设计了轻量 post-training，把 reflective masking 作为中心能力来训，并配套一个数据构造流程，生成与模型原生输出分布更对齐的训练样本。这里的关键取舍是：如果直接用人工构造错误或离分布 corruption，模型学到的可能只是修补特定噪声；作者更希望它学会在自身生成轨迹里识别不可靠 token 并修正，因此训练信号要贴近模型真实会犯的错。这个思路和很多 post-train reasoning 工作里“用模型自己的 rollout 造纠错数据”是同一脉络，但在 MDM 上更自然，因为 mask/re-mask 本来就是原生操作。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖图像编辑、Sudoku、文本生成三类任务，目的是证明这不是某个单一模态或强监督场景下的技巧。全文给出的主结论很稳定：Reflective Masking 在不同任务上都优于不具备多轮反思修订能力的基线 MDM；当任务需要模型自主探索、自己发现哪里错了时，History Reference 的增益更明显。图像编辑场景里，因为指令同时给了修改位置和修改目标，RM 主要体现为更稳定的局部编辑和更少的无关区域破坏；Sudoku 里，它体现为能反复定位冲突格并局部修正，而不是整盘重来；文本生成里，由于监督最弱、没有直接提示最终答案，RM 更能体现“通过迭代修订逼近正确输出”的能力。摘要和正文片段没有给出足够完整的数值表，因此不宜编造具体提升幅度；但从作者组织实验的方式看，重点不只是最终分数，而是证明 RM 带来的 test-time scaling 是一种不同于 AR CoT 的计算分配方式：额外步数主要用于 selective revision，而不是线性扩展输出长度。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇建议精读。先看 Introduction，抓住作者的核心立场：MDM 的 reasoning 优势不该理解为并行生成更快，而该理解为可以对中间状态做显式局部修订。然后直接读第 3 节 Reflective Masking，重点看三部分：逐位置 keep/re-mask/reveal 决策规则、History Reference 的构造方式、训练目标与训练样本如何生成。这里决定了方法是不是一个临时 decoding trick，还是一个可迁移的能力激活方案。接着看实验部分时，不要只盯最终指标，更要看不同任务中 RM 起作用的机制是否一致：是靠修正低置信 token，还是靠利用历史轨迹避免重复犯错。若时间有限，优先看方法图、算法描述、Sudoku 和文本任务结果，因为这两类最能体现 reasoning 与 self-correction。值得深挖的点有三个：一，反射式重遮盖是否能在更大语言模型上形成稳定 scaling；二，History Reference 能否与外部 memory 或 verifier 结合；三，这种 post-training 能力是否应前移到 pretraining，让 MDM 从一开始就学会可逆生成和局部修订。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central limitation of mask diffusion models: although they can resample masked positions in parallel, standard decoding is still largely one-pass and absorbing. Once a token is confidently denoised, it is effectively fixed, so the model cannot actively revisit earlier commitments. This prevents MDMs from exploiting their main structural advantage over autoregressive models. The paper’s goal is to turn generation from monotonic forward completion into iterative state refinement, where the model can decide which parts of its current output are unreliable and should be re-masked and revised.
summary_en.importance: For researchers interested in alternative language-modeling paradigms, this is one of the more meaningful directions. It matters for three reasons. First, it identifies a genuine mechanism-level distinction between AR and mask-based generation: AR test-time scaling mostly spends extra compute on longer trajectories or regeneration, whereas MDMs could spend it on local revision. Second, the paper does not stop at heuristic remasking during inference; it uses lightweight post-training to make reflective masking an internalized capability. That is important if diffusion-style LMs are to develop a reasoning path that is not just an imitation of AR CoT. Third, the proposed History Reference addresses a real weakness of MDMs: unlike AR models, they do not naturally carry an explicit temporal trace of prior intermediate generations, so revision can become myopic without some form of trajectory memory.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Reflective Masking (RM). At each denoising step and for each position, the model chooses among three actions: keep the current token, re-mask the current token for future resampling, or reveal a token if the position is currently masked. The key idea is that remasking is no longer a fixed heuristic based only on low confidence in still-masked positions; already denoised tokens can be actively reconsidered. This makes the denoising process partially reversible and turns generation into iterative local correction.

The second component is History Reference (HR), a parameter-free mechanism that aggregates intermediate decoding states into a history-aware representation. Instead of conditioning only on the current partially denoised sequence, the model also gets access to what each position looked like in previous steps and how stable those predictions were. This gives MDMs a temporal memory channel that AR models get implicitly through sequential context accumulation.

The training recipe is the most important part of the paper. The authors argue that inference-time rules alone are insufficient because existing MDMs were never trained for self-initiated multi-turn revision. They therefore introduce lightweight post-training centered on reflective masking, together with a data-generation pipeline designed to stay close to the model’s native output distribution. This is a good design choice: if training examples are built from artificial off-distribution corruptions, the model may only learn to repair synthetic noise rather than revise its own realistic mistakes. The paper instead tries to teach the model to detect and correct unreliable predictions arising from its own denoising dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans image editing, Sudoku, and text generation, which is a sensible way to test whether the method is tied to one modality or one supervision regime. The main result is consistent: RM improves over baseline MDM decoding across all three settings, and HR is especially helpful when the task requires autonomous exploration rather than explicit guidance. In image editing, where instructions specify both what and where to modify, RM mainly improves localized edits and reduces unnecessary changes elsewhere. In Sudoku, the benefit is clearer as iterative conflict detection and local correction. In text generation, where supervision is weakest and the final answer is not directly hinted, RM better exposes the intended reasoning behavior: progressively refining a partially wrong state rather than restarting from scratch. The provided excerpt does not include enough complete tables to quote reliable numeric gains, so the safe takeaway is qualitative but still important: the paper demonstrates a distinct form of test-time scaling for MDMs, where extra compute is spent on selective revision instead of forward token expansion.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction to understand the paper’s framing: the advantage of MDMs is not merely parallel generation speed, but explicit revisability of intermediate states. Then go straight to the Reflective Masking section and read three pieces closely: the per-position keep/re-mask/reveal decision rule, the construction of History Reference, and the post-training objective plus data pipeline. Those sections determine whether the method is just a decoding trick or a transferable capability-enabling recipe. In the experiments, do not only look at final metrics; check whether the mechanism is consistent across tasks. Sudoku and text generation are especially informative because they expose self-correction more directly than image editing. The deeper questions to keep in mind are whether reflective remasking scales to larger language models, whether HR can be combined with external memory or verifiers, and whether this capability should eventually be moved earlier into pretraining rather than added only in post-training.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和消融：它把 MDM 的“可局部改写”变成推理时计算，若成立会改变非 AR LM 的后训练设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: it turns MDM local rewriting into inference-time compute, which would change how non-AR LMs are post-trained if it holds up.

paper.title: Understanding Diversity Collapse in RLVR via the Lens of Overtraining
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a key approach for enhancing the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, RLVR often suffers from \emph{diversity collapse}: Pass@$1$ improves while high-$k$ Pass@$k$ degrades, which is viewed as a narrowing of the model's reasoning boundary. We formalize this diversity collapse through the lens of \emph{overtraining}: once a problem's contribution to the reference metric has effectively saturated, further updates no

summary.core_problem: 解释RLVR训练中常见的diversity collapse：Pass@1上升，但高k的Pass@k下降，模型可探索的推理边界变窄。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是RLVR训练动态分析，对预训练研究员重要，因为它直接关系到RL后训练是否真的扩展了base model的能力边界，还是只把概率质量集中到已会解的轨迹上。
summary.technical_approach: 用overtraining视角形式化diversity collapse：当某个题目对参考指标的贡献已经接近饱和后，继续更新不再扩大可解集合，只会强化on-policy采样中已经成功的轨迹；在每题rollout很少的标准设置下，一次成功样本就可能让该题对高k Pass@k进入近饱和区。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模、数据集、rollout数量或提升幅度，但明确分析指标包括Pass@1和高k Pass@k，并聚焦标准RLVR少rollout设置下的训练后期行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains diversity collapse in RLVR: Pass@1 improves while high-k Pass@k degrades, narrowing the model's reasoning boundary.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-dynamics analysis for RLVR. It matters for foundation-model researchers because it asks whether RL post-training expands the base model's capability boundary or merely reallocates probability mass toward trajectories the model can already sample.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formalizes diversity collapse as overtraining. Once a problem's contribution to the reference metric is effectively saturated, further updates no longer expand the solvable set and instead concentrate probability on on-policy successful trajectories. With few rollouts per problem, even one observed success can put the problem near saturation for high-k Pass@k.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, rollout counts, or numerical gains. It states that the analysis focuses on Pass@1 versus high-k Pass@k under standard RLVR setups with few rollouts per problem.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部RLVR曲线复查高k Pass@k；它把“RL扩能力”拆成边界扩张和概率重排两件事。
recommendation.en: Immediately recheck internal RLVR runs with high-k Pass@k; it separates true boundary expansion from probability-mass reshaping.

paper.title: STRIDE: Strategic Trajectory Reasoning via Discriminative Estimation for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on final-answer correctness to assign trajectory-level rewards, providing sparse supervision and treating all tokens uniformly regardless of their actual contribution to reasoning. Although recent studies introduce intermediate signals such as process rewards, high-entropy tokens, and sem

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 只用最终答案正确性给整条推理轨迹打分时，奖励稀疏且无法区分哪些局部推理模式真正有贡献的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练方法创新：STRIDE 试图从可验证结果中反推出细粒度策略监督，避免依赖不可验证的过程奖励、高熵 token 或语义不确定性信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 STRIDE，即 Strategic Trajectory Reasoning via Discriminative Estimation。它在同一响应组内对比成功轨迹和失败轨迹，估计每个 n-gram 或局部推理片段对最终结果的 outcome-discriminative preference，再把这些细粒度偏好用于 RLVR 更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集合、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的实验关注点应是与普通最终答案 RLVR、过程奖励类方法、高熵 token 加权和语义不确定性信号比较推理能力提升。

summary_en.core_problem: STRIDE addresses the sparsity of RLVR when final-answer correctness assigns a single reward to an entire reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training method contribution. The key idea is to derive fine-grained strategic supervision from verifiable outcomes, rather than relying on non-verifiable process rewards, entropy heuristics, or semantic uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: STRIDE contrasts successful and failed trajectories within each response group and estimates outcome-discriminative preferences for local n-grams or reasoning fragments. These preferences are then used as fine-grained supervision in RLVR.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements. The relevant comparisons would be against final-answer-only RLVR, process-reward variants, entropy-token methods, and uncertainty-based weighting.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；若组内成功/失败对比干净，这类 verifiable token credit 值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the success-failure grouping is clean, verifiable token credit assignment is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Localizing Credit at the Divergence: Path-Conditioned Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns a single scalar to each rollout, leaving token-level credit assignment underspecified in long reasoning traces. On-policy self-distillation addresses this by letting the same model act as a teacher conditioned on privileged information, producing a dense per-token signal. But the common choice of a ground-truth answer is only an endpoint cue: on terse-answer tasks, the teacher falls silent at the intermediate positions where path-level guida

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 在长推理轨迹中只有 rollout 级标量奖励、无法给中间 token 分配清晰 credit 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练中的 credit assignment 方法创新。它针对 reasoning RL 的核心瓶颈：终点 reward 稀疏、answer-conditioned self-distillation 对中间路径帮助有限。对理解 RL 信号如何反哺推理行为有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hindsight Self-Distillation。教师模型不只条件化在 ground-truth answer 上，而是条件化在同一训练组中成功的 peer rollout 上。这个成功轨迹来自当前策略的 success-conditioned sample，不需要额外 rollout。失败轨迹与成功 peer 在路径上的 divergence position 成为主要监督位置，从而把 token-level signal 聚焦到真正分叉的地方。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 上、面向可验证推理任务进行实验，并与常见的 endpoint answer 条件化 self-distillation/RLVR 设置对比。给定摘要未提供完整任务名、训练 token 量、baseline 数值和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses token-level credit assignment in long reasoning traces when RLVR provides only a scalar reward per rollout.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training credit-assignment method. It targets a central weakness of reasoning RL: sparse endpoint rewards and answer-conditioned self-distillation that provides little guidance at intermediate reasoning steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Hindsight Self-Distillation. Instead of conditioning the teacher only on the ground-truth answer, the teacher is conditioned on a successful peer rollout from the same current training group. This peer is a success-conditioned sample from the current policy and requires no extra rollouts. The dense signal concentrates near the divergence point between a failed rollout and the successful peer trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on verifiable reasoning tasks, comparing against common RLVR and endpoint-answer-conditioned self-distillation setups. The provided abstract does not include full task names, training budget, baseline numbers, or gains.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 divergence 分析；它把 RLVR 的 credit 从终点搬到分叉点，值得在内部数学 RL ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and divergence analysis; it moves RLVR credit from endpoints to path forks and is worth reproducing in internal math-RL ablations.

paper.title: ExpRL: Exploratory RL for LLM Mid-Training
paper.abstract: Sparse reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for improving LLM reasoning, but its success depends critically on the coverage present in the base model. In practice, models are often primed for RL through \emph{mid-training} on curated reasoning traces that teach useful primitive skills such as decomposition, verification, or self-correction. Although effective, this strategy requires manually specifying what the model should learn, and it remains unclear whether such prim

summary.core_problem: 稀疏奖励RL用于提升LLM推理能力的效果严重依赖基础模型已有的技能覆盖度；当前mid-training依赖人工指定应学习的推理原语，不确定是否足以组合出更复杂问题的解决方案策略。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出ExpRL，一种基于RL的自动mid-training方法，将参考答案用作奖励脚手架而非模仿目标。
summary.technical_approach: ExpRL不将参考解答视为模仿目标，而是将其隐藏并仅用于构建问题特定的评分标准(rubric)，以评估on-policy推理轨迹，从而在大量QA语料上进行探索性RL mid-training。
summary.experiments: 未见具体模型规模、数据集大小和基准对比数据，主要贡献为方法框架设计。
summary.authors_note: Violet Xiang (Stanford), Aviral Kumar (UC Berkeley/FAIR) - Aviral Kumar活跃于强化学习与LLM交叉研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Sparse-reward RL for LLM reasoning critically depends on skill coverage in the base model; current mid-training requires manual specification of reasoning primitives, and it is unclear if such coverage suffices for complex problems requiring skill composition.
summary_en.importance: Methodological: proposes ExpRL, an automated RL-based mid-training approach that uses references as reward scaffolds rather than imitation targets.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExpRL hides reference solutions from the policy and uses them only to construct problem-specific grading rubrics for evaluating on-policy reasoning traces, enabling exploratory RL mid-training over large QA corpora.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not detail model sizes, dataset sizes, or benchmark comparisons; contribution is primarily methodological framework.
summary_en.authors_note: Violet Xiang (Stanford), Aviral Kumar (UC Berkeley/FAIR) — Aviral Kumar is active in reinforcement learning and LLM research.

recommendation.zh: 对RL-mid-training范式提出了有趣的思路：把参考解答当reward scaffold而非模仿目标，值得看方法设计部分。但抽象缺实验数据，需要看正文验证效果是否真实。
recommendation.en: Provocative framing of mid-training as exploratory RL with references as reward scaffolds; worth reading the method design section, but abstract lacks experimental evidence—need main text to verify actual gains.

paper.title: Exploring Extrinsic and Intrinsic Properties for Effective Reasoning with Code Interpreter
paper.abstract: Reasoning with a Code Interpreter (CI) has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through executable computation and iterative verification. Despite its growing adoption, the behavioral properties underlying effective code reasoning remain largely underexplored. In this work, we investigate code reasoning from two distinct perspectives inspired by prior studies of natural language reasoning: extrinsic properties, represented by c

summary.core_problem: 解释“带 Code Interpreter 的推理”为什么更强，并把可观测的行为特征转化为可用的推理增强信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是行为分析+轻量提示/训练信号设计；对预训练本身不直接，但对“可执行验证/回溯”这类推理范式的训练信号有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把有效CI推理分解为两类属性：外在的“crucial tokens”（关键触发词/标记）与内在的代码推理行为（verification、backtracking、backward chaining等）；在推理时追加关键token做引导，并探索在训练阶段利用这些属性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型列表、数据集与提升幅度；仅声称跨多个LLM观察到强模型更频繁出现关键token与上述行为，并在推理时追加token可提升表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Understand why Code-Interpreter-assisted reasoning works and turn observable behavioral properties into usable signals for better reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Behavioral analysis plus lightweight prompting/training signals; not pretraining-centric, but relevant to training signals for executable verification and backtracking-style reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decompose effective CI reasoning into extrinsic 'crucial tokens' and intrinsic code-reasoning behaviors (verification, backtracking, backward chaining); use crucial tokens at inference and explore leveraging these properties during training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete model/dataset lists and effect sizes; it claims consistent correlations across multiple LLMs and gains from appending crucial tokens.

recommendation.zh: 当弱信号看：只需扫结论里“哪些行为与强CI相关”，但缺少干净因果与完整实验细节，别据此改训练配方。
recommendation.en: Treat as a weak signal: skim the behavior correlates of strong CI reasoning, but don’t change recipes without cleaner causality and full experimental details.

institutions: Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science and Technology
King Mongkut’s University of Technology Thonburi

paper.title: MARS: Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping for Parallel LLM Test-time Scaling
paper.abstract: Parallel test-time scaling samples many reasoning traces and majority-votes their answers, improving LLM accuracy but requiring traces to run to completion, incurring substantial computational overhead. We observe that probing partial traces at intermediate checkpoints can extract current answers without disrupting generation, revealing an evolving aggregate vote. Based on this observation, we introduce MARS, a margin-adversarial stopping rule that estimates which active traces are likely to cha

summary.core_problem: 降低 parallel test-time scaling 的计算浪费：多数投票采样通常要等所有 reasoning traces 完整生成，成本很高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 test-time scaling 的计算分配方法。它没有改变模型训练，但直接处理推理时多样本投票的停止准则，对理解 inference-time compute 如何转化为准确率有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MARS，即 Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping。方法在生成中间 checkpoint 探测 partial traces 的当前答案，维护动态投票边际；同时学习 trace-level switch probability，估计每条未完成轨迹改答案的概率。对于改答案后会落到哪里，方法使用由 warmup traces 校准的 adversarial bound，从而在保守风险控制下提前停止。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、采样数或节省比例。可确认的是：在真实 switch probability 已知时，MARS 对 early-stopped answer 提供高概率保证；实际版本用 warmup traces 校准边界，目标是在不明显损害多数投票结果的情况下降低完整生成开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces wasted compute in parallel test-time scaling, where many reasoning traces are sampled and majority-voted only after all traces finish.
summary_en.importance: This is a compute-allocation method for inference-time scaling. It does not change pretraining, but it is directly relevant to how extra test-time compute should be spent and when additional samples stop being worth their cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, MARS, is a Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping rule. It probes partial traces at intermediate checkpoints to extract current answers, tracks the evolving vote margin, learns trace-level switch probabilities, and handles the unknown destination of switched answers with an adversarial bound calibrated from warmup traces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, sampling budgets, or exact compute savings. It states that with true switch probabilities MARS gives a high-probability guarantee for the early-stopped answer, while the practical version uses warmup traces to calibrate conservative bounds and reduce the cost of full-trace majority voting.

recommendation.zh: 读 stopping rule 和风险界即可；它把 test-time scaling 从“多采样”推进到“何时停”的干净问题。
recommendation.en: Read the stopping rule and risk bound; it reframes test-time scaling from just sampling more traces to deciding when further compute is no longer justified.

paper.title: ReSum: Synergizing LLM Reasoning and Summarization with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a central technique for improving long-horizon reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods often encourage unnecessarily long reasoning rollouts, which can degrade reasoning coherence and exhaust the available context budget. Existing approaches to long-context organization often depend on external mechanisms to organize rollouts, rather than enabling the model to manage its own reasoning trajectory. To addres

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 训练长链推理时 rollout 过长、上下文预算被耗尽、错误前缀持续污染后续推理的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练方法创新：把推理过程中的自我摘要显式纳入 RLVR，让模型学习压缩和组织自己的推理轨迹。它对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个信号：长程推理不只需要更多上下文，也需要可训练的状态压缩机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReSum 框架。先通过 pilot study 观察到自我摘要会降低 token-level entropy，并且插入 summarization phrase 可缓解错误前缀传播；随后设计 summarization-aware adaptive rollout，用对比式机制鼓励模型在合适时机生成摘要、压缩中间轨迹，并继续完成可验证奖励任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向 RLVR 长程推理，并报告 pilot study 中自我摘要降低生成熵、缓解错误传播。给出的片段未包含模型规模、训练数据、任务集合、baseline 或最终提升幅度，需要读实验章节确认结论强度。
summary.authors_note: 标注信息显示该工作来自 Cohere。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses overly long RLVR reasoning rollouts, context-budget exhaustion, and error propagation from incorrect reasoning prefixes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method: it makes self-summarization part of the RLVR process so that the model learns to compress and organize its own reasoning trajectory. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that long-horizon reasoning may require trainable state compression, not only longer context windows.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReSum starts from pilot findings that self-summarization reduces token-level entropy and that adding a summarization phrase can mitigate errors inherited from a wrong prefix. It then introduces a summarization-aware adaptive rollout mechanism that contrastively encourages the model to summarize intermediate reasoning at useful points and continue solving verifiable tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports pilot evidence on entropy reduction and mitigation of prefix-error propagation under RLVR. The provided text does not include model size, data scale, baselines, or final performance numbers, so the empirical strength depends on the full experimental section.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is marked as a Cohere work.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 pilot study 和 rollout 设计；若结果干净，应在内部 RLVR 中复现“摘要作为状态压缩”的 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the pilot study and rollout design; if the setup is clean, reproduce the “summary as state compression” ablation in an internal RLVR stack.

paper.title: Reasoning as Pattern Matching: Shared Mechanisms in Human and LLM Everyday Reasoning
paper.abstract: When large language models (LLMs) fail to generalize or make haphazard errors in reasoning, it is often taken as evidence that LLMs are not truly reasoning, but rather performing a kind of pattern matching. The implication is that people's behavior does not exhibit the same types of failures because human reasoning uses principled and abstract world models. We evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on their ability to engage in common-sense reasoning about a variety of everyday situations and o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的是：LLM 在日常常识推理中的错误，究竟只是“模式匹配”失灵，还是反映了更抽象的世界模型推理；同时，人类在类似任务上是否真的遵循不同机制。
summary.importance: 它属于机制分析与认知对照研究。价值不在于提出新模型，而在于给出一个不太讨喜但值得认真看的判断：人类和 LLM 在 everyday reasoning 上可能共享更接近模式匹配的机制，而不是人类显著更依赖抽象世界模型。这会影响我们如何解释 CoT、generalization failure 和 attention-level circuitry。
summary.technical_approach: 作者同时测试人类参与者和 25 个 LLM 在一组日常情境常识推理任务上的表现，比较错误模式是否一致；随后定位驱动模型回答的注意力头，并将这些头解释为执行某种 pattern-matching 的机制，再用这些头去预测由看似无关提示细节引发的人类错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的是行为模式与机制定位结果，而非大规模训练实验。实验覆盖 25 个 LLM 和人类被试，核心发现是两者出现相似的错误分布；并且一组特定 attention heads 能解释模型输出，也能预测人类受无关 prompt 细节干扰时的错误。若正文做得扎实，这类“人-模同构错误 + 头级机制锚定”的证据比一般行为学对比更有分量。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 Zach Studdiford、Gary Lupyan。Gary Lupyan 以语言、认知与概念表征研究见长，这使论文更像认知科学与机制解释的交叉工作，而不是常规 LLM benchmark 论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether everyday reasoning errors in LLMs are merely failures of pattern matching or evidence against genuine reasoning, and whether humans actually rely on a different mechanism in similar tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic and cognitive-comparison paper. Its value is not in proposing a new model, but in making an uncomfortable claim worth checking carefully: human and LLM everyday reasoning may share a pattern-matching-like mechanism rather than humans relying much more on abstract world models. That matters for how we interpret CoT, generalization failures, and attention-level circuits.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on common-sense reasoning over everyday situations, compare their error patterns, then identify attention heads that drive model responses and interpret them as implementing a form of pattern matching. They further use these heads to predict human errors triggered by seemingly irrelevant prompt details.
summary_en.experiments: The contribution is behavioral and mechanistic rather than a large-scale training result. The study covers 25 LLMs plus human participants, with the main finding that both show similar error patterns; moreover, a specific set of attention heads explains model outputs and predicts human mistakes induced by irrelevant prompt details. If the full paper is careful, this combination of human-model error alignment and head-level anchoring is stronger than a typical behavioral comparison.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is by Zach Studdiford and Gary Lupyan. Gary Lupyan is known for work on language, cognition, and conceptual representation, which makes this more of a cognitive-science-meets-mechanistic-interpretability paper than a standard LLM benchmark paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“人类靠抽象规则、LLM 只是 pattern matching”的舒服叙事；先看 attention-head 证据链是否站得住，再决定要不要更新你对日常推理机制的 prior。
recommendation.en: This challenges the comforting story that humans use abstract rules while LLMs merely pattern-match; check whether the attention-head evidence really closes that loop before updating your prior.

paper.title: ARMOR-MAD: Adaptive Routing for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Debate in Large Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model reasoning, but fixed debate pipelines often waste computation and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents. We propose ARMOR-MAD, a training-free heterogeneous MAD framework that treats debate as conditional computation. ARMOR-MAD combines three components: Pre-debate Agreement Routing (PAR) decides whether independently generated Round-0 answers require debate; Early Agreement Stopping Evaluator (EASE) stops debate after conver

summary.core_problem: 固定轮数的多智能体辩论会浪费 test-time compute，并可能放大相似模型之间的相关错误。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个训练-free 的多智能体推理控制方法。它把辩论过程看作条件计算，尝试在准确率和推理成本之间做动态折中；对 test-time scaling 和 agentic reasoning 有参考意义，但不是基座预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ARMOR-MAD，由三个模块组成：PAR 在辩论前根据初始答案一致性决定是否需要进入辩论；EASE 在辩论过程中检测收敛并提前停止；SOD 在最终聚合时下调语义离群答案的权重。方法强调异构模型池，而不是同质模型反复采样。
summary.experiments: 在 MATH Level 5、GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro 上，相比固定轮数异构 debate 提升准确率或效率，报告分数分别为 65.5%、96.5%、90.0%、81.5%。摘要未给出模型池组成、调用成本、统计显著性和每个模块的消融细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Fixed-round multi-agent debate wastes test-time compute and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free control method for multi-agent reasoning. It treats debate as conditional computation and attempts to trade off accuracy and inference cost dynamically. This is relevant to test-time scaling and agentic reasoning, but not directly to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARMOR-MAD has three components: PAR decides before debate whether independent round-0 answers warrant discussion; EASE stops the debate once agreement is reached; SOD down-weights semantic outlier answers during final aggregation. The method emphasizes heterogeneous model pools rather than repeated sampling from homogeneous agents.
