summary_en.experiments: On MATH Level 5, GSM8K, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro, it improves over fixed-round heterogeneous debate and reports accuracies of 65.5%, 96.5%, 90.0%, and 81.5%, respectively. The abstract does not specify the model pool, inference cost, statistical significance, or full component ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只看 routing 和 early-stop 消融即可；这是 test-time compute 控制的小信号，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Read only the routing and early-stop ablations; this is a small signal on test-time compute control, not a pretraining prior changer.

paper.title: Verifiable Environments Are LEGO Bricks: Recursive Composition for Reasoning Generalization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable environments has emerged as a powerful approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). While prior research demonstrates that scaling environment quantity improves RL performance, existing manual or individual construction methods suffer from linear scaling limits, thereby hindering scalable reasoning generalization. This paper introduces RACES (\textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{A}utomated \textbf{C}omposition for \textbf{E}

summary.core_problem: 现有RL提升LLM推理能力的路径依赖人工逐个构造可验证环境，环境规模扩展受线性人力成本限制，阻碍跨任务推理泛化。
summary.importance: 提出可验证环境的递归组合框架，将环境视为可拼接的类型化组件，实现自动化规模扩展，突破人工构造的线性成本上限。
summary.technical_approach: 定义环境组合规则：当一个环境的输出类型与另一个的输入类型匹配时即可自动融合，实现顺序、并行等组合算子，基于300个基础环境递归生成新的复合环境。
summary.experiments: 基于300个基础环境递归构造大规模复合环境用于RL训练，模型推理泛化性能优于使用等量人工构造环境训练的基线。
summary.authors_note: 团队来自中科院软件所中文信息处理实验室，长期从事信息抽取、大模型推理相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL approaches for LLM reasoning rely on manual, per-task construction of verifiable environments, which scales linearly with human effort and limits cross-task reasoning generalization.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a recursive composition framework for verifiable environments, treating environments as typed composable building blocks to enable automated scaling beyond manual construction limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines composition rules: environments can be automatically fused if the codomain of one matches the domain of the other; implements sequential, parallel and other composition operators to recursively generate new composite environments from 300 base environments.
summary_en.experiments: RL training on recursively composed environments delivers better reasoning generalization than baselines trained on the same number of manually constructed environments.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from the Chinese Information Processing Laboratory at Institute of Software, CAS, with long-term work on information extraction and LLM reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 可验证环境自动组合的工程框架，未提出RL scaling新规律，看摘要了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering framework for automated verifiable environment composition with no novel RL scaling insights; abstract suffices.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
Chinese Information Processing Laboratory, Institute of Software, CAS
Chinese Information Processing Laboratory, Institute of Software

paper.title: Beyond representational alignment with brain-guided language models for robust reasoning
paper.abstract: The correspondence between large language models (LLMs) and the neural mechanisms underlying human higher-order cognition remains insufficiently characterized. Given that language and reasoning in the human brain appear dissociable, an open question is whether LLMs align with neural signals from reasoning-related regions and whether such signals can improve them. Here, focusing on deductive reasoning, we show that LLM internal representations are not only partially aligned with task-fMRI activit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关心两个相连的问题。第一，LLM 在做演绎推理时，内部表征是否真的和人脑中负责推理的神经活动存在可测的对应关系，而不只是和语言区对齐。第二，如果这种对应关系存在，脑信号能否不只用于解释模型，而是反过来作为干预信号，直接提升模型在推理任务上的鲁棒性，尤其是把原本会答错的样本拉回正确轨道。论文把问题限定在 deductive reasoning，并且刻意区分 aggregate-level alignment 与 reasoning-type-specific alignment，避免把总体相关性误读成机制层面的充分一致。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接影响不在于它给出了一条可立即规模化的预训练路线，而在于它提供了一个新的训练信号来源和一个新的机制分析视角。更具体地说，它说明 next-token 训练得到的表征已经部分进入了与人类推理网络相近的子空间，但这种对齐并不完整，且在细粒度推理类型上明显不足。这一点对“语言建模是否足以诱导稳健推理”这个老问题给了更细的证据。更有意思的是，作者没有把 brain alignment 当作终点，而是把它当作 intervention target：只在模型即将出错的区域做表征修正。这种思路和常见的 post-hoc probing 不同，也和直接加一个辅助 loss 的做法不同。对预训练研究员来说，启发主要有三点：一是可以把外部认知信号视作 representation regularizer；二是模型错误可能集中在某些可识别的表征方向上；三是“对齐”与“性能提升”不是同一个目标，后者更依赖局部、条件化的干预。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是测量 LLM 与人脑推理网络的表征对应。作者使用任务型 fMRI 数据，聚焦既往文献中与演绎推理相关的脑区，而不是泛化到整个 cortex。对多个开源 LLM，在处理推理题时抽取内部 hidden representations，再用 neural predictivity 指标评估这些表征对脑活动 explainable variance 的解释比例。这里有两个关键设计。其一，既看跨全部推理样本聚合后的 predictivity，也看按具体 reasoning type 切分后的 predictivity；前者高，后者低，说明模型学到的是较粗的共享结构，而不是稳定覆盖各类推理机制。其二，加入未训练模型和其他脑网络作为对照，验证这种对应不是随机几何相似，也不是对任何高层认知区都同样成立。

第二部分是利用脑信号做模型干预。作者提出两种方法。NARI 是 inference-time 的表征干预：先在 joint model-brain representational structure 中识别与“错误回答”相关、但可被脑信号校正的方向，然后在推理时对模型中间层表示做定向修正，把表示从错误区域推向更接近正确解答对应的区域。它更像 activation steering，但 steering vector 不是纯模型内生统计量，而是由脑活动和模型表征的对应结构共同确定。NARF 是 parameter-level 的微调版本：把这种 neural guidance 融入训练，对模型参数做小幅更新，使其更倾向于形成与正确推理相关的内部表示。两者的共同点是都不追求全局 brain imitation，而是只利用那些对纠错有用的神经约束。

从方法取舍看，这比直接把 fMRI 当监督标签去回归整段脑活动更克制。原因很清楚：脑信号噪声大、样本少、跨被试差异强，若做全局拟合，很容易学到与任务无关的个体差异。作者转而利用 joint subspace 和 error-correction framing，把问题变成“哪些脑相关方向能帮助纠错”，这更接近可用信号的上限。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的核心结果有四类。第一，表征对齐方面，LLM 在演绎推理相关脑区上的 aggregate neural predictivity 大约达到 explainable variance 的 76%，明显高于未训练模型对照；但在按具体 reasoning type 划分后，predictivity 只有约 27% 左右，说明细粒度机制对齐仍然有限。第二，选择性方面，这种对齐对 reasoning network 更强，而不是同样出现在 multiple-demand network 或 core language network，支持作者关于“并非单纯语言区对齐”的论点。第三，干预效果方面，NARI 和 NARF 都能把一部分原本错误的回答改成正确，说明脑信号不仅能解释模型，还能作为有效的纠错引导。摘要截断没有给出完整表格数字，但从正文叙述看，提升主要集中在困难样本和原始模型易错的推理类型上，而不是对所有样本平均抬升。第四，作者还做了若干控制实验，验证提升不是来自额外 test-time compute、提示模板变化或简单的 representation smoothing，而是与 brain-guided direction 的特异性有关。

值得注意的实验洞察是：总体高 predictivity 并不自动转化为高推理准确率，反过来，局部的 neural guidance 却能在错误样本上产生可见收益。这说明“像脑”不是单一标量目标，更像是某些关键子空间上的约束问题。对做预训练的人来说，这比单看相关系数更有信息量。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看引言和任务设定，确认作者讨论的是 deductive reasoning 的哪几类题，以及 fMRI 数据是如何采集和对齐到样本级别的。第二，看 neural predictivity 的定义、explainable variance 的估计方式、以及 reasoning network / MD network / language network 的对照设置；这是判断结果是否可信的关键。第三，看 NARI 和 NARF 的实现细节，尤其是干预发生在哪些层、如何识别“将要答错”的表示、以及 brain-model joint structure 是怎样构造的。

如果时间有限，优先看主文中的方法图、predictivity 主结果图、以及干预前后错误样本翻转的案例分析，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议重点检查附录里的被试间一致性、不同模型规模的差异、以及是否存在数据泄漏或题型偏置。真正值得追问的点有两个：一是这种 brain-guided direction 是否能迁移到未见题型；二是如果把脑信号替换成更便宜的行为信号或 verifier 信号，是否能复现类似收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles two linked questions. First, when LLMs perform deductive reasoning, do their internal representations align with neural activity in human reasoning-related regions, rather than merely with language areas? Second, if such alignment exists, can brain signals be used not only for analysis but also as an intervention signal to improve reasoning performance, especially on cases the model would otherwise answer incorrectly? The study is deliberately scoped to deductive reasoning and distinguishes aggregate alignment from reasoning-type-specific alignment, which is an important methodological choice.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is not that it offers an immediately scalable recipe, but that it introduces a different kind of training signal and a sharper way to think about representation quality. The results suggest that next-token-trained models already enter a subspace partially shared with human reasoning networks, yet this alignment is incomplete and much weaker at fine-grained reasoning-type resolution. That is a more informative answer to the long-running question of whether language modeling alone induces robust reasoning. The more interesting move is conceptual: brain alignment is treated as a means for targeted correction, not as an end in itself. For foundation-model work, the main takeaways are that external cognitive signals can act as representation regularizers, model errors may concentrate in steerable directions of hidden space, and global alignment metrics are not the same thing as performance-relevant local interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two parts. The first measures model-brain correspondence during deductive reasoning. Using task-fMRI data focused on brain regions previously associated with deductive reasoning, the authors extract hidden representations from several open-source LLMs while the models process reasoning problems. They then compute neural predictivity, asking how much explainable variance in the fMRI responses can be accounted for by model representations. Two design choices matter here. One is the separation between aggregate predictivity across all reasoning samples and predictivity within specific reasoning types; the former is much higher than the latter, indicating that the shared structure is coarse rather than mechanism-complete. The other is the use of controls, including untrained models and non-reasoning brain networks, to show that the effect is not a trivial artifact of generic high-dimensional similarity.

The second part uses neural data for intervention. The paper proposes Neural Activation guided Representation Intervention (NARI), an inference-time method, and Neural Activation guided Representation Fine-tuning (NARF), a parameter-update variant. NARI identifies directions in a joint model-brain representational structure that are associated with incorrect responses but can be corrected using neural guidance, then steers intermediate hidden states away from error-prone regions and toward representations associated with correct reasoning. This resembles activation steering, but the steering signal is not derived purely from model-internal statistics; it is constrained by the shared structure between model states and brain activity. NARF pushes the same idea into training by adjusting model parameters so that the model is more likely to form internally correct reasoning representations.

A notable methodological choice is that the authors do not try to regress full fMRI patterns as a global supervision target. Given the noise, limited sample size, and subject variability of fMRI, that would likely overfit irrelevant variance. Instead, they frame the problem as error correction in a shared subspace, which is a more realistic use of the available signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The main findings come in four groups. First, on representation alignment, LLM representations explain about 76% of the explainable variance in aggregate neural responses from deductive-reasoning regions, substantially above untrained-model controls. However, when evaluated within specific reasoning types, predictivity drops to roughly 27%, showing that fine-grained alignment remains limited. Second, the alignment is selective: it is stronger for the reasoning network than for the multiple-demand network or the core language network, supporting the claim that the effect is not reducible to generic language processing. Third, both NARI and NARF can convert a subset of previously incorrect model answers into correct ones, indicating that neural signals are useful not only descriptively but also operationally. The truncated abstract does not expose the full result tables, but the body text indicates that gains are concentrated on harder examples and on reasoning categories where the base model is brittle. Fourth, the paper includes controls suggesting that the improvements are not explained by extra test-time compute, prompt changes, or generic smoothing of hidden states.

One useful experimental lesson is that high global neural predictivity does not automatically imply high reasoning accuracy, whereas localized neural guidance can still improve error cases. That makes the paper more interesting than a pure correlation study.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the task setup carefully: what kinds of deductive reasoning problems are used, and how the fMRI data are aligned to item-level model processing. Second, inspect the neural predictivity definition, the estimation of explainable variance, and the controls involving reasoning, multiple-demand, and language networks; these determine whether the alignment claim is meaningful. Third, read the implementation details of NARI and NARF, especially which layers are intervened on, how likely error states are identified, and how the joint model-brain structure is constructed.

If time is limited, the main method figure, the predictivity result figure, and the intervention examples are enough to capture the paper in about 25 to 35 minutes. If reading more deeply, check the appendices for subject consistency, model-size effects, and possible confounds such as item bias or leakage. The two questions worth carrying forward are whether the learned brain-guided directions transfer to unseen reasoning formats, and whether cheaper signals, such as behavioral traces or verifier feedback, could substitute for fMRI while preserving the same intervention logic.

recommendation.zh: 机构强，但离 pretrain 很远；把它当 reasoning representation 的外部探针看，先看 predictivity 结果，干预部分先持保留。
recommendation.en: Strong institutions, but far from pretraining; treat it as an external probe of reasoning representations, and trust the predictivity analysis more than the intervention claims.

paper.title: The Role of Feedback Alignment in Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Conditioning a language model on additional context, such as feedback on a previous attempt, typically improves its response. Self-distillation trains the model to retain this improvement when the context is not present. The method works by matching the model's output distribution under two settings: a student that sees only the question, and a self-teacher that also sees the context. What the model learns therefore depends on what context the self-teacher receives, yet the design of this contex

summary.core_problem: 论文研究自蒸馏中的反馈形态如何影响学习信号。自蒸馏让同一个模型同时扮演 student 和 self-teacher：student 只看问题，self-teacher 看问题加额外上下文。训练目标是让 student 匹配 self-teacher 的输出分布。关键问题是：这个额外上下文应该是什么？论文把问题放在数学推理中，比较三种信号：GRPO 的二值最终奖励、参考解答、以及与模型自身推理轨迹逐步对齐的 critique。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把“反馈质量”和“反馈对齐”区分开。参考解答通常是完整且正确的，但它不一定沿着模型自己的推理轨迹展开，因此在自蒸馏中会产生较分散的 token-level 分布移动。逐步对齐的反馈虽然不直接给出强 teacher logits，也不需要训练过程奖励模型，却能把更新集中到错误附近的 token。对 reasoning post-training 来说，这提供了一条介于 RLVR 和过程监督之间的路径：保留 on-policy、自教师、无需外部 logits 的优点，同时获得比 rollout-level reward 更细的 credit assignment。
summary.technical_approach: 方法建立在 self-distillation objective 上。模型先在问题 x 上生成自己的推理轨迹 y。student 分布是 πθ(·|x,y<t)，self-teacher 分布是 πθ(·|x,c,y<t)，其中 c 是额外反馈上下文。训练最小化两者在每个 token 位置的 divergence，并对 teacher 分支 stop-gradient。已有分析表明，当 divergence 取 KL 类形式时，梯度可以写成类似 policy gradient 的形式，但 advantage 不再是 GRPO 那种整条 rollout 共享的标量，而是每个 token 一个 A_t^SD，用来衡量上下文 c 对下一 token 分布的局部影响。论文的核心设计是 StepAlignFB：冻结 critic 读取 solver 的实际推理轨迹，生成逐步对齐的 critique，指出哪一步出了问题、为什么错、应该如何修正。它不同于 RefSol。RefSol 给出标准解，但标准解和 solver 轨迹在表述、分解顺序、局部选择上经常不一致，即使 solver 的某些步骤是对的，teacher context 也可能推动分布向另一条解法迁移。StepAlignFB 则贴着 solver 的轨迹给反馈，使 self-teacher 的分布变化更容易落在真正需要修正的位置。
summary.experiments: 实验在数学推理场景中采用 solver-critic 设置，critic 冻结。比较对象包括：二值最终奖励的 GRPO、以参考解答作为上下文的 self-distillation、以及 StepAlignFB。论文报告 StepAlignFB 在所有 aggregation-style accuracy 指标上优于 GRPO 和 RefSol。更有信息量的是 per-token advantage 分析：StepAlignFB 的分布移动集中在错误相邻 token 附近，表现出类似过程监督的定位能力；RefSol 的信号更分散，因为参考解答与模型轨迹不对齐；GRPO 的 advantage 对同一 rollout 内所有 token 恒定，难以判断是哪一步导致最终错误。当前材料中没有给出具体参数规模、训练 token 数、数据规模和各 benchmark 的精确数值，因此不宜补写未确认数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Background 中 GRPO 与 self-distillation 梯度形式的推导，尤其是 rollout-level advantage 和 token-level self-distillation advantage 的对比。方法部分应重点看 StepAlignFB 的 prompt 结构、critic 输入输出格式、反馈如何与 solver trace 对齐。实验部分优先看 Section 4 的主结果表、aggregation accuracy 的定义、per-token advantage 可视化，以及 RefSol 失败案例。值得深挖的问题有三个：第一，StepAlignFB 的收益来自 critique 内容还是来自轨迹对齐；第二，critic 质量下降时信号是否仍然稳定；第三，不同 divergence 选择是否会改变 advantage 的稀疏度和更新强度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what kind of context should be used in self-distillation. In this setup, the same model is used twice: a student conditioned only on the question, and a self-teacher conditioned on the question plus extra context. The training objective matches the student distribution to the contextualized self-teacher distribution. The central question is whether the context should be a scalar reward, a reference solution, or feedback aligned to the model’s own reasoning trace.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is the separation between feedback quality and feedback alignment. A reference solution can be correct and complete, but it may follow a different trajectory from the model’s own rollout, which makes the induced token-level signal diffuse. Step-aligned critique produces a more localized update around the parts of the trace where the reasoning goes wrong. For reasoning post-training, this is a useful middle ground between RLVR and process supervision: it keeps the on-policy and teacher-free properties of self-distillation, avoids access to external teacher logits, and still yields token-level credit assignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on a standard self-distillation loss. The solver samples a reasoning trace y for a question x. The student distribution is πθ(·|x,y<t), while the self-teacher distribution is πθ(·|x,c,y<t), where c is additional context. The model minimizes a per-token divergence between these two distributions, with stop-gradient on the teacher branch. Prior analysis shows that, for KL-style divergences, the gradient resembles a policy-gradient update, but the advantage is token-specific rather than constant across the whole rollout as in GRPO. The proposed context, StepAlignFB, is generated by a frozen critic that reads the solver’s actual trace and produces step-by-step critique aligned to that trace. This differs from using a reference solution. A reference solution may be high quality, but it often diverges from the solver’s path in wording, decomposition, or intermediate choices. Step-aligned feedback instead addresses the rollout the model actually produced, so the contextual teacher shifts its distribution near the relevant errors.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted in mathematical reasoning with a solver-critic setup and a frozen critic. The paper compares three conditions: GRPO with a binary final reward, self-distillation using the reference solution as context, and self-distillation using step-aligned feedback. StepAlignFB is reported to outperform both GRPO and RefSol on all aggregation-style accuracy metrics. The more diagnostic result is the per-token advantage analysis: StepAlignFB concentrates distributional shifts around error-adjacent tokens, RefSol produces a broader and less localized signal, and GRPO assigns the same advantage to every token in a rollout. The supplied material does not include exact benchmark scores, model sizes, data scale, or token counts, so those numbers should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the background derivation carefully, especially the comparison between GRPO’s rollout-level advantage and the token-level advantage induced by self-distillation. Then focus on the construction of StepAlignFB: the critic prompt, the alignment between critique and solver trace, and how the feedback is inserted into the self-teacher context. In the results section, prioritize the main accuracy table, the definition of aggregation-style metrics, and the per-token advantage visualizations. The most useful questions to track are whether the gains come from critique content or trace alignment, how robust the method is to critic errors, and whether the choice of divergence changes the sparsity and strength of the update.

recommendation.zh: 非常干净的 ablation，证明了在自蒸馏/RL 中，与模型自身轨迹对齐的 step-by-step critique 远胜于给标准答案或标量 reward，对合成推理数据极具实操价值。
recommendation.en: A very clean ablation showing that in self-distillation/RL, step-by-step critique aligned with the model's own trace vastly outperforms reference solutions or scalar rewards; highly actionable for synthesizing reasoning data.

paper.title: Reasoning or Memorization? Direction-Aware Diversity Exploration in LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a key paradigm for eliciting reasoning abilities in large language models, where exploration is crucial for discovering effective solution trajectories. Existing exploration methods typically encourage diversity in semantic or gradient spaces, without distinguishing what drives this diversity. A trajectory may appear novel because it follows a new reasoning process, or because it varies memorized patterns and shortcuts. Rewarding both cases equally may steer exp

summary.core_problem: DiRL 关注的是推理 RL 中的探索质量：现有方法鼓励答案轨迹多样性，但没有区分这种多样性来自新的推理路径，还是来自对记忆模板、捷径和熟悉模式的变化。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-training 信号质量有启发。它把“探索是否有用”从语义距离或梯度距离，推进到“这个更新方向是否更接近推理行为”。如果这个方向可靠，它可以用于筛选 RL rollout、构造更好的合成推理数据，也可以作为分析模型记忆与推理模式的工具。需要谨慎的是，reasoning-memorization direction 的构造依赖模型内部表征和标注集合，泛化性需要看更多模型、任务和污染控制实验。
summary.technical_approach: DiRL 是对 GRPO 的增强，而不是替换优化器。标准 GRPO 仍然负责 group sampling、组内 reward 标准化、clipped surrogate 和 KL 约束。DiRL 改的是用于构造 advantage 的奖励。方法先在 policy 的 residual stream 中提取一个 reasoning-memorization direction，用它作为几何参照，判断 response 更偏向推理还是记忆。然后对每条 response 构造 direction-weighted gradient feature，也就是不仅看这条轨迹会带来什么梯度更新，还看这个更新在推理-记忆方向上的投影或加权特征。接着把 response 分成 reasoning-aligned 和 memorization-aligned 子组，并相对 reasoning-aligned 子组计算 exploration score。这样，奖励的不是一般意义上的新颖性，而是能扩展推理相关更新空间的新颖性。最后将该 exploration score 做 reward shaping，增强推理对齐 response，压制记忆对齐 response。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学和通用推理 benchmark 上评估 DiRL，指标包括 pass@1、maj@16 和 pass@16。结果描述为相对 GRPO 和通用 diversity exploration 方法有稳定提升。除准确率外，作者还报告 DiRL 提高了 reasoning-aligned rollout 的比例，在符号扰动测试下表现更好，并且只引入适度计算开销。由于给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格，具体提升幅度、模型规模和训练 token 规模无法可靠确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 reasoning-memorization direction 如何构造，以及 direction-weighted gradient feature 和 exploration score 的定义。实验部分优先看三个问题：方向构造的消融是否充分；相比 entropy、semantic diversity、gradient diversity 的收益是否稳定；符号扰动实验是否排除了模板记忆。若时间有限，读 introduction、method 的 direction extraction 和 reward shaping，再看主结果表与 ablation 即可。

summary_en.core_problem: DiRL studies exploration in RL for reasoning models. The key issue is that diversity-based exploration treats all novel trajectories as useful, even when the novelty comes from memorized templates or shortcuts rather than from genuinely different reasoning processes.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training signal design than to core pretraining. Its useful idea is to judge exploration by the direction of the induced policy update, not only by semantic distance or generic gradient diversity. If the proposed reasoning-versus-memorization direction is robust, it could help filter rollouts, shape synthetic reasoning data, or analyze when RL is amplifying memorization. The main caveat is that the direction itself depends on internal representations and the construction of reasoning and memorization examples, so its transferability across models and domains needs careful validation.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiRL is built on top of GRPO. It keeps the standard group-relative sampling setup, normalized group rewards, clipped surrogate objective, and KL regularization. The modification is in reward shaping. The method first extracts a reasoning-memorization direction from the policy residual stream. This vector is used as a geometric anchor for deciding whether a response is more reasoning-aligned or memorization-aligned. For each sampled response, DiRL builds a direction-weighted gradient feature, capturing how the response would update the policy along this internal direction. Responses are then partitioned into reasoning-aligned and memorization-aligned groups. The exploration score is computed relative to the reasoning-aligned group, so novelty is rewarded when it expands reasoning-related updates rather than memorization-related variation. This score is added to the reward used by GRPO.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates DiRL on math and general reasoning benchmarks using pass@1, maj@16, and pass@16. It reports consistent improvements over GRPO-style baselines and generic diversity exploration methods. Additional analyses show a higher proportion of reasoning-aligned rollouts, better robustness under symbolic perturbations, and modest extra compute cost. The provided manuscript excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact gains, model sizes, and training scale cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient for most pretraining researchers; allocate about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on how the reasoning-memorization direction is extracted, how the direction-weighted gradient feature is defined, and how the exploration score is injected into GRPO. In the experiments, check the ablations on direction construction, comparisons with entropy or gradient-diversity exploration, and the symbolic perturbation tests. The most important question is whether the direction measures transferable reasoning behavior or merely captures artifacts of the datasets used to define it.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法部分；它把“多样性奖励可能奖励记忆”说清楚，若实验干净，应复现在内部 RLVR ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method section; the useful prior shift is that diversity rewards may reward memorization, and a clean setup would be worth reproducing in RLVR ablations.

paper.title: SocraticPO: Policy Optimization via Interactive Guidance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models usually supervises reasoning with scalar outcome rewards, such as binary correctness. Such rewards provide an optimization direction but rarely explain how a model should revise its mistaken reasoning, which can encourage shortcut learning and brittle policies. We propose \textbf{SocraticPO} (Socratic Policy Optimization), a policy-optimization framework that augments RL rollouts with Socratic-style natural-language guidance. During rollout,

summary.core_problem: 在多步推理类 RL 后训练里，只有“最终对/错”这类标量 outcome reward 时，模型知道该强化哪些轨迹，但不知道错在何处、该怎么改，容易学到 verifier 友好的捷径而不是稳健推理。论文要解决的是：在不改变标准 policy-gradient 目标、也不做 teacher 分布匹配/蒸馏的前提下，把“可操作的纠错信号”注入 RL 训练过程，并避免模型形成“等老师提示”的依赖。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大（属于 post-train/RL 侧），但对“pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口”有两点实用启发：1）把语言形式的过程反馈当作 rollout 条件变量，而不是监督目标，可在不引入额外 imitation loss 的情况下改变采样分布与学习信号；2）用显式的 reward shaping（这里是随指导轮次衰减）来抑制训练时的策略投机，这类机制在用合成过程反馈/工具反馈做持续训练时也常见。整体属于可复用的 RL 训练范式小改造，而不是新算法族。
summary.technical_approach:
方法把一次 RL rollout 改成“可交互的多轮轨迹”。流程是：学生模型先独立作答；用 verifier 判错；若错误，则调用 teacher 读取学生的尝试（以及可选的侧信息，如参考解/知识）生成简短的 Socratic 式纠错指导（诊断错误点、给下一步提示，但不直接给最终答案）；把 teacher 文本追加到上下文里，学生在扩展上下文下继续作答，可重复多轮直到正确或达到上限。训练时仍用标准期望回报的 policy gradient（文中强调兼容 Reinforce++/GRPO 这类后端），teacher 只影响 rollout 分布，不作为要拟合的 target。
关键防投机机制是 reward decay：如果学生在第 r 轮指导后才答对，则给一个随 r 单调下降并饱和的奖励（而不是与“独立答对”同奖）。直觉是把“在更少帮助下更早答对”变成可优化目标，避免策略学会故意先错以换取提示。论文还讨论了归一化 advantage 下该衰减的性质（非负、单调、饱和），用来解释训练稳定性与不会把正确样本变成负优势。
summary.experiments: 论文在源自 SciKnowEval 的本科科学推理基准上评估（多为多步推理/计算/概念题）。对比对象包括：Reinforce++、GRPO，以及带自蒸馏味道的 SDPO。结论是 SocraticPO 平均成绩最好；消融显示两部分都必要：1）把 teacher 换成“盲重试/不给针对性诊断”会明显掉分，说明收益来自定向纠错而非多采样；2）去掉 reward decay 会出现对 teacher 依赖，训练后“有提示时对、无提示时不提升”更明显。文中还做了 teacher 侧信息、teacher-学生相似度等分析，核心信息是：方法不需要 teacher logits/分布匹配，黑盒强 teacher 也能用，但需要控制提示带来的投机空间。由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格与具体数值（提升幅度、轮次上限、衰减函数超参等），这里无法可靠复述精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1）先看 Introduction 里对“outcome reward 不足以修复推理”的问题刻画，以及为什么把 guidance 放在 rollout 而不是做蒸馏/OPD。
2）重点看方法部分对交互式轨迹定义、teacher 输入信息集合（G/I）的设定，以及 reward decay 的形式与性质证明（这决定了是否会鼓励等提示）。
3）实验部分优先看：无 reward decay 的退化现象、把 teacher guidance 替换成非定向信号的消融、以及 teacher 侧信息的敏感性——这些最能迁移到你自己的 RL 数据合成/过程反馈设置。
4）如果要复现或迁移，建议额外关注：每题最多指导轮次、teacher 提示长度约束、以及 verifier 的判错粒度（只判最终答案 vs 过程判分），这些往往决定训练信号质量。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-only RL for multi-step reasoning (e.g., binary correctness) provides a direction but not a repair mechanism: the model is not told what went wrong or how to fix it, which encourages shortcut policies that satisfy a verifier without learning robust reasoning. The paper targets a practical question: how to inject actionable, localized correction into RL rollouts while keeping a standard policy-gradient objective and avoiding teacher-dependence.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training/RL contribution rather than a pretraining one. Still, it offers two reusable ideas for the pretrain–posttrain loop: (1) treat natural-language process feedback as a rollout-conditioning variable (changing the trajectory distribution) instead of an imitation target; (2) use explicit reward shaping (decayed reward for assisted success) to prevent “training-time gaming” when external guidance/tools are available. It is best viewed as a rollout protocol + reward design that can be plugged into existing RL backends, not a new optimization family.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SocraticPO turns a single-turn RL rollout into an interactive multi-round trajectory. The student answers first; a verifier checks correctness; if wrong, a teacher reads the student attempt (and optionally side information such as reference solutions) and produces concise Socratic-style guidance (diagnosis + hint, not a full solution). The guidance is appended to the context and the student continues; this can repeat for multiple rounds. Training remains standard expected-reward policy gradient (compatible with Reinforce++/GRPO-style implementations); the teacher is not distilled and no teacher logits/distribution matching are required, enabling black-box teachers.
The key anti-exploitation mechanism is reward decay: if the student only becomes correct after r rounds of teacher intervention, the reward is reduced as a monotone, saturating function of r. This makes “solve correctly with less help, earlier” the optimized behavior and discourages policies that intentionally wait for hints. The paper also analyzes properties of the resulting normalized advantages (non-negativity, monotonicity, saturation) to argue the shaping does not destabilize learning by flipping correct trajectories into negative-advantage samples.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on undergraduate-level scientific reasoning benchmarks derived from SciKnowEval, compared against strong RL baselines (Reinforce++, GRPO) and a self-distillation-flavored method (SDPO). SocraticPO reports the best average performance. Ablations indicate both components matter: targeted teacher guidance beats blind retries, and removing reward decay increases reliance on teacher assistance (improving assisted accuracy without comparable gains in unassisted reasoning). The provided full-content excerpt does not include the main tables/figures with exact numeric deltas, dataset sizes, or hyperparameters, so precise numbers cannot be quoted reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the failure mode framing (outcome reward vs reasoning repair) and the design choice of “guidance in rollouts” rather than distillation/OPD.
- Focus on the method section that formalizes interactive trajectories and specifies what information the teacher can access.
- Pay extra attention to the reward-decay definition and its advantage properties; this is the core mechanism preventing help-seeking exploitation.
- In experiments, prioritize ablations: (i) no decay, (ii) non-targeted guidance / retry-only, (iii) teacher side-information sensitivity. These are the most transferable lessons if you plan to use process feedback or tool feedback in RL pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 思路自然：用语言引导替代纯标量奖励，reward decay 防止搭便车是关键设计；但机构非顶尖且未给出核心实验数字，可读方法部分评估其 RL 设计是否对 pretrain→RL 衔接有启发。
recommendation.en: Natural idea: replacing scalar rewards with language guidance; reward decay to prevent free-riding is the key design. Read the method section to assess if the RL design informs pretrain→RL transitions.

paper.title: N-GRPO: Embedding-Level Neighbor Mixing for Enhanced Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: The success of Large Language Models in mathematical reasoning relies heavily on the generation of diverse and valid solution paths during the rollout phase. However, current rollout techniques face a fundamental trade-off: token-level sampling often yields redundant trajectories that differ only in rephrasing, while embedding-level methods utilizing random noise frequently disrupt semantic consistency. To resolve this, we introduce N-GRPO, a novel exploration strategy integrated into the Group

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注 GRPO 类推理强化学习中的 rollout 探索问题。token 级采样常产生大量语义相近、推理路径几乎相同的样本；直接在 embedding 上加高斯噪声又容易把表示推离语义流形，导致轨迹失真。作者试图在二者之间找到一种更可控的连续空间探索方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练的直接关系不强，但对 RL post-train、reasoning data generation 和 rollout 多样性有参考价值。它把探索问题从采样温度、top-p 等离散解码策略，推进到输入 embedding 的局部语义扰动。这个方向值得关注的原因是：推理 RL 的收益越来越依赖多样而有效的解题轨迹，简单提高采样随机性往往只增加表述变化或错误率，而不一定增加可学习的推理分支。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 N-GRPO，核心是 Semantic Neighbor Mixing。生成每一步时，模型先根据当前 logits 选出最偏好的 anchor token，随后在 embedding 空间检索该 token 的近邻 token。不是直接采样某个离散近邻，也不是注入各向同性高斯噪声，而是根据当前步的模型分布对 anchor 及其语义近邻的 embedding 做加权混合，并把这个连续 mixed embedding 作为下一步输入。这样做的动机是利用 embedding 空间的局部结构：近邻 token 通常位于相近语义方向，混合后更可能留在有效语义区域内。与 HRPO 这类仍主要依赖离散 token 随机性的做法相比，N-GRPO 的扰动发生在连续输入表示上；与 Gaussian embedding noise 相比，它减少了语义漂移。GRPO 的目标函数本身不是主要创新，变化集中在 rollout 生成机制。
summary.experiments: 作者在数学推理 benchmark 上验证了 1.5B 和 7B 两个规模，报告 N-GRPO 在 Pass@16 和 Pass@32 上稳定优于强基线。文中还用一个小型先导实验说明随机 embedding 噪声的问题：对 10 个主要由数学符号和常见功能词组成的 token 注入各向同性高斯噪声，再解码到最近词表项，PCA 可视化显示扰动经常把表示推到无关 token 附近。摘要和给定正文片段没有列出具体 benchmark 名称和逐项提升数字，因此更适合把实验结论理解为趋势性证据，而不是完整的 scaling 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 anchor token、neighbor retrieval、mixing weight 的定义，以及混合 embedding 如何接入自回归解码和 GRPO rollout。实验部分重点看 Pass@16/Pass@32 的提升是否来自更多有效解法，而不是仅来自更高采样方差；消融部分应关注 neighbor 数量、混合强度、是否使用 argmax anchor、与 Gaussian noise/temperature sampling/HRPO 的对比。若要用于实际 RL 训练，还需要检查额外开销：近邻检索是否预计算、每步混合是否影响 KV cache、训练时 log-prob 与连续输入 rollout 的对应关系如何处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses rollout exploration in GRPO-style reasoning reinforcement learning. Token-level sampling often produces redundant trajectories that differ mostly in wording, while direct Gaussian perturbations in embedding space can break semantic consistency. The goal is to create a continuous-space exploration mechanism that is more diverse than discrete sampling but less destructive than random embedding noise.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to RL post-training than to base-model pretraining, but it is useful for researchers studying reasoning-data generation and policy optimization. Its main value is the framing of rollout diversity as a local semantic-geometry problem in the embedding space. For reasoning RL, better exploration is not just more randomness; useful trajectories need to remain semantically valid while reaching different reasoning paths.
summary_en.technical_approach: N-GRPO introduces Semantic Neighbor Mixing into the GRPO rollout process. At each generation step, the model selects the current argmax token as a semantic anchor, retrieves nearby tokens in the embedding space, and forms a weighted mixture of the anchor embedding and its nearest-neighbor embeddings using information from the current logits. This mixed continuous representation is fed as the next-step input. The design tries to keep perturbations near the local semantic manifold. Compared with standard token sampling, it explores continuous representations rather than only discrete alternatives. Compared with Gaussian embedding noise, it uses vocabulary-neighbor structure to avoid pushing the representation toward unrelated tokens. The GRPO objective is not the main novelty; the change is in how rollout trajectories are generated.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks at 1.5B and 7B scales, with consistent gains over strong baselines on Pass@16 and Pass@32. A preliminary diagnostic illustrates why naive embedding noise is problematic: after injecting isotropic Gaussian noise into embeddings of 10 sampled tokens, mostly mathematical symbols and function words, nearest-neighbor decoding and PCA visualization show that the perturbed vectors often move toward unrelated tokens. The provided text does not expose the full benchmark table or exact improvement numbers, so the experimental evidence is best read as support for the exploration mechanism rather than as a complete scaling study.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. The most important part is the method section defining the anchor token, nearest-neighbor retrieval, mixing weights, and how the mixed embedding is inserted into autoregressive rollout. In the experiments, focus on Pass@16 and Pass@32, but also check whether gains come from genuinely more valid solution paths rather than higher variance. The ablations to inspect are neighbor count, mixing strength, argmax-anchor choice, and comparisons with temperature sampling, Gaussian embedding noise, and HRPO-like methods. For practical use, the key implementation questions are nearest-neighbor retrieval cost, compatibility with KV caching, and how log-prob computation is handled when rollouts use continuous mixed inputs.

recommendation.zh: 看方法和最近邻构造细节即可；idea 合理但易被 embedding 邻居质量绑架，需等完整 ablation 再信收益。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and neighbor-construction details; the idea is plausible but hostage to embedding-neighbor quality, so trust it only after full ablations.

paper.title: Beyond Absolute Imitation: Anchored Residual Guidance for Privileged On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated strong empirical gains in enhancing complex reasoning in LLMs by aligning a student model with a teacher's predictive distribution over the student's own trajectories. An emerging variant, Privileged OPD, further strengthens this paradigm by employing a self-teacher model augmented with privileged information, such as oracle traces, to mitigate teacher-student capacity gaps while providing dense, answer-directed supervision. However, current methods

summary.core_problem: Privileged On-Policy Distillation（特权 OPD，如 OPSD、SDFT）用带 oracle trace / 完整解答等特权信息的自教师模型，在学生自己采样的轨迹上做稠密蒸馏；但现有方法把全视角的特权教师分布当作绝对模仿目标，没有区分学生当前前缀下因果可达的推理步骤和依赖未来上下文的后见之明信号，导致学生被迫匹配超出其局部预测支撑集的分布，出现特权信息泄漏、推理走捷径、长程推理不稳定等问题。
summary.importance: 指出了当前工业界广泛采用的特权 OPD 范式中一个被忽视的优化病理——全视角模仿的后验偏差；提出的双视角拆解思路（可达锚点 + 可控残差）为特权蒸馏类后训练方法提供了更稳的目标构造方式，对数学/代码/长程推理的 SFT+RL 混合流水线有直接工程价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation（AR-OPD）。核心是把特权监督拆成两个可控制分量：(1) Anchor：用仅含部分特权信息的教师（例如只看到到当前步为止的中间正确状态，而非完整解答），提供因果可达的局部模仿目标，把学生与后见之明的答案隔离开；(2) Residual：把全视角教师的前瞻信息以 λ 缩放的 log-probability 增量形式叠加到 Anchor 上，只注入方向级的目的地引导，不强求匹配完整分布。这样把原本的绝对模仿转化为「以可达分布为基点、以全视角前瞻为受控修正」的 log-space 残差更新，避免学生分布漂移到不可达的后验区域。
summary.experiments: 在多类推理基准上的平均得分：相对基座模型提升 12.1 分，相对全视角特权 OPD 基线提升 2.3 分。机制分析上，用 Top-k Disagreement 和 Support Gap 量化了全视角教师在 rollout 尾部与学生局部支撑的偏离，且偏离随特权上下文长度增加而加剧；AR-OPD 将 shortcut / 特权信息泄漏事件降低了 21.7%，并在长程推理场景下比全视角模仿更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对「后见之明偏差导致不可达目标」的问题定义，以及图 1 对特权信息泄漏的直观示意；Section 4 的诊断指标（Top-k Disagreement、Support Gap）是很好的分析工具，可以直接借用到自己的蒸馏实验排查中；AR-OPD 的目标函数构造和 λ 系数的消融是方法核心。对做后训练 recipe 的同学，重点关注 Anchor 信息粒度如何选取——这是该方法能否泛化到其他任务的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: Privileged On-Policy Distillation (e.g. OPSD, SDFT) uses a self-teacher augmented with privileged information such as oracle traces or full solutions to provide dense supervision on the student’s own sampled trajectories. Existing methods treat the full-view privileged teacher distribution as an absolute imitation target, failing to separate causally reachable reasoning steps at the current prefix from future-conditioned hindsight signals. This forces the student to match a distribution outside its local predictive support, leading to privileged-information leakage, reasoning shortcuts, and instability in long-horizon reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a previously under-diagnosed optimization pathology in the privileged OPD paradigm now widely used in industry pipelines—hindsight bias from full-view imitation producing unreachable targets. The proposed two-view decomposition (reachable anchor + controlled residual) gives a more stable target construction for privileged distillation, and is directly useful for mixed SFT+RL post-training recipes targeting math, code, and long-horizon reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation (AR-OPD) decomposes privileged supervision into two controllable components. (1) Anchor: a partially privileged teacher that only sees intermediate correct states up to the current step (not the full solution), providing a causally reachable local imitation target that shields the student from hindsight-biased answers. (2) Residual: the forward-looking signal from the full-view teacher, injected as a λ-scaled log-probability update on top of the Anchor. This transfers destination-directed foresight without forcing the student to match the full hindsight-biased distribution. Absolute imitation is thus replaced by a log-space residual update anchored to a reachable distribution, preventing the student policy from drifting into unreachable hindsight regions.
summary_en.experiments: Across a diverse set of reasoning benchmarks, AR-OPD improves the average score by 12.1 points over the base model and 2.3 points over full-view privileged OPD. Mechanistically, Top-k Disagreement and Support Gap diagnostics quantify that full-view teacher misalignment with the student’s local support grows toward the tail of rollouts and worsens as privileged-context length increases. AR-OPD reduces shortcut / privileged-information-leakage events by 21.7%, and exhibits better stability than full-view imitation on long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, roughly 30 minutes. Focus on the Introduction for the precise framing of unreachable targets caused by hindsight bias, and Figure 1 for a concrete illustration of privileged-information leakage. The diagnostic metrics in Section 4 (Top-k Disagreement, Support Gap) are useful analysis tools that can be borrowed directly to debug distillation runs. The core of the method lies in the AR-OPD objective construction and the λ-coefficient ablations. For engineers building post-training recipes, how to choose the information granularity of the Anchor is the key variable that determines whether the approach generalizes beyond the tested tasks.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法部分：它指出 privileged trace 蒸馏会制造局部不可达目标，这个坑应在内部 reasoning SFT/RL 数据里检查。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: the useful point is that privileged-trace distillation can create locally unreachable targets, a failure mode worth checking in internal reasoning SFT/RL data.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Generation and Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as a pivotal research direction for enhancing model performance by dynamically allocating computational resources during inference. Recent advancements have adapted this paradigm to Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs), unlocking their potential in multimodal reasoning and generation. Despite rapid progress, the field lacks a systematic survey and unified theoretical framework to delineate the developmental landscape of multimodal TTS. To bridge this gap, we pr

summary.core_problem: 梳理多模态基础模型中的 test-time scaling 方法，回答推理时如何动态分配额外计算以提升生成与推理能力。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题与当前 inference-time compute、search、feedback、sampling 的研究主线直接相关；对预训练研究员的价值在于建立问题地图，而不是提供新证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个统一分类框架，将多模态 TTS 方法分为 sampling-based、feedback-based、search-based 三类，并整理其在多模态生成与推理中的应用场景、常用 benchmark 以及开放问题。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，不提供新的模型规模、训练数据或基准突破；实验部分主要是对已有工作和评测资产的归纳，而非原创实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys test-time scaling in multimodal foundation models, asking how extra inference compute can be allocated to improve generation and reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is directly tied to current work on inference-time compute, search, feedback, and sampling. Its value to pretraining researchers is in organizing the space, not in providing new evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified taxonomy that groups multimodal TTS methods into sampling-based, feedback-based, and search-based approaches, and reviews their applications, benchmarks, and open challenges in multimodal generation and reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not introduce new model scales, training data, or benchmark gains. The empirical content is a synthesis of prior methods and evaluation assets rather than original experimentation.

recommendation.zh: 综述价值大于研究价值；如果你在想 pretrain 与 inference-time compute 的接口，只看 taxonomy 和 benchmark 表即可，不必通读。
recommendation.en: More useful as a map than as research; if you're thinking about the pretrain ↔ inference-time compute interface, the taxonomy and benchmark tables are enough.

paper.title: Back on Track: Aligning Rewards and States for Reasoning in Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds immense promise for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of diffusion large language models (dLLMs). However, progress is fundamentally constrained by a dual misalignment between authentic generation trajectory and the gradient update process: (i) Process-reward misalignment. Sparse, terminal rewards are indiscriminately assigned to all intermediate steps of the generation process, failing to provide discriminative credit assignment. (ii) State-trajectory misali

summary.core_problem: PAPO 解决的是 diffusion LLM 做 RL 训练时的轨迹错位问题。现有方法常把最终答案 reward 粗略分配给任意中间去噪步，并用随机 mask 最终答案构造训练状态；这些状态不一定来自真实生成轨迹，导致 credit assignment 粗、梯度利用低，推理和训练过程不一致。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的价值在于，它把 RL 信号如何接入非自回归语言模型讲得更具体。AR 模型的 policy trajectory 天然是 token-by-token，GRPO/PPO 类方法可以直接沿生成序列分配 log-prob 和 reward。masked diffusion LM 的生成过程是多步去噪和重 mask，训练状态不是线性 token 前缀，因此不能直接照搬 AR RL。PAPO 的贡献是把 reward 和 update state 都对齐到真实 denoising trajectory，这对 LLaDA、MDLM、SEDD 一类模型后训练和 reasoning tuning 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
PAPO 包含两个核心组件。

第一是 Step-Aware Process Rewards，简称 SPR。它不把最终 outcome reward 直接广播给所有中间步，而是基于单步 denoising prediction 为每个中间步骤计算即时 reward，再与最终答案 reward 组合成训练信号。这样做的目标是区分哪些去噪步骤真正改善了答案，哪些步骤只是被最终正确答案“顺带奖励”。对于 diffusion LM，这一点很关键，因为一次 denoising 可能同时改变多个 token，错误来源不一定能按 AR 的 token 顺序拆开。

第二是 Entropy-Guided Historical Re-enactment，简称 EHR。它不再通过随机 mask 最终 completion 来构造人工状态，而是记录自然 rollout 过程中出现过的真实历史状态，并在训练时重放这些状态。选择哪些状态更新时，EHR 用 entropy 作为采样信号，优先训练模型不确定性高的步骤，少把梯度花在已经稳定的 token 或低信息状态上。

整体上，PAPO 可以看作是面向 masked diffusion LM 的 GRPO 式改造：保留 group-relative advantage 的思想，但把 log-prob、reward 和状态采样都重新绑定到 denoising 轨迹上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理和规划任务。数学任务包括 GSM8K 和 MATH500，PAPO 相对已有 dLLM RL 方法分别带来最高 4.5% 和 4.8% 的提升，数学任务平均提升最高 4.7%。规划任务包括 Countdown 和 Sudoku，提升更明显：Countdown 最高绝对提升 42.2%，Sudoku 最高绝对提升 16.1%，规划任务平均提升最高 29.2%。这些结果说明，轨迹对齐在需要多步修正和全局一致性的任务上更有收益。规划任务的提升幅度也提示，随机人工 mask 状态可能严重偏离 dLLM 真正容易出错的去噪阶段。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Figure 1，对比真实 denoising trajectory、已有 RL 更新方式和 PAPO 更新方式，这是理解论文的关键。然后看 Preliminaries 中 masked dLLM 和 GRPO 的形式化，确认为什么 AR 的序列 log-likelihood 不能直接迁移。方法部分重点看 SPR 如何构造 step-specific reward，以及 EHR 如何记录并按 entropy 选择历史状态。实验部分重点看 planning tasks 和消融实验，因为这些结果更能说明 process reward 与 authentic state selection 的作用。

summary_en.core_problem: PAPO addresses trajectory misalignment in RL for diffusion LLMs. Existing methods often assign a terminal reward to arbitrary denoising steps and train on artificial states produced by randomly masking the final completion. These states may not belong to the model’s actual generation trajectory, leading to weak credit assignment and inefficient policy updates.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for understanding how RL should be adapted to non-autoregressive language models. In AR models, the policy trajectory is naturally token-by-token, so PPO- or GRPO-style objectives can attach log-probabilities and rewards along the generated sequence. In masked diffusion LMs, generation is an iterative denoising and remasking process, not a left-to-right prefix expansion. PAPO makes the RL update follow the real denoising trajectory, which is relevant for post-training reasoning-capable dLLMs such as LLaDA-like or MDLM-like models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PAPO has two main components.

Step-Aware Process Rewards, or SPR, avoids broadcasting the final outcome reward to all intermediate denoising steps. Instead, it computes an immediate reward for each intermediate step based on a single denoising-step prediction, then combines this signal with the final outcome reward. This gives the optimizer a more step-specific learning signal. The design matters because one diffusion denoising step can update many masked positions in parallel, so token-level credit cannot be inherited from AR generation.

Entropy-Guided Historical Re-enactment, or EHR, replaces artificial randomly masked states with real historical states captured during natural rollouts. During training, the method re-enacts these states and samples them according to model uncertainty, using entropy to focus updates on high-information moments. This avoids spending gradients on already settled decisions and keeps the training states faithful to the model’s actual generation process.

At a high level, PAPO is a GRPO-style policy optimization framework adapted to masked diffusion LMs. The key change is not the group-relative reward idea itself, but the alignment of rewards, log-probability evaluation, and state selection with the denoising trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers math reasoning and planning. On GSM8K and MATH500, PAPO reports gains of up to 4.5% and 4.8%, with an average math improvement up to 4.7% over strong dLLM RL baselines. On planning tasks, the gains are larger: up to 42.2% absolute improvement on Countdown and 16.1% on Sudoku, with an average planning improvement up to 29.2%. The stronger gains on planning suggest that trajectory-faithful state selection and step-specific rewards are especially helpful when the model must maintain global consistency across multiple denoising steps.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with Figure 1 in the introduction, which shows the difference between the real denoising trajectory, prior RL updates, and PAPO. Then read the preliminaries on masked dLLMs and GRPO to see why AR-style likelihood and reward assignment do not transfer directly. In the method section, focus on how SPR builds step-specific rewards and how EHR stores and samples historical rollout states using entropy. In the experiments, the planning tasks and ablations are the most informative parts, because they isolate the effect of process rewards and authentic state selection.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的人应当看：它指出 RL 里最容易被忽略的不是 reward sparse，而是 update 不在真实轨迹上；先看 PAPO 两个失配定义，数字反而是次要的。
recommendation.en: If you work on diffusion LMs, read this for the diagnosis: the real RL bug is not just sparse reward but updating off the authentic trajectory; the two misalignment definitions matter more than the headline numbers.

paper.title: Reasoning without Gold Standards: A Proxy-Judge Theory of Autoformalization
paper.abstract: Complex reasoning tasks increasingly require systems to produce outputs whose correctness cannot be judged by exact match against a single reference. Autoformalization (AF) is a representative example; it asks a model to translate informal mathematical or logical reasoning into a formally checkable object, yet expert-validated formalizations do not scale beyond toy cases and a single informal argument can admit many valid formal renderings. Progress therefore depends on whether partial, structur

summary.core_problem: 自动形式化等复杂推理任务的输出正确性无法通过与单一参考答案精确匹配来判定，而专家验证的形式化数据无法规模化。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出无需参考标准的proxy-judge评测框架，用结构化代理检查替代gold-standard匹配。
summary.technical_approach: 沿三个结构维度（全局、子模块内部、跨域与源文本对齐）组织代理检查，汇总为判决向量；该向量驱动改进循环以迭代优化模型输出。
summary.experiments: 未详述具体数据集规模和SOTA对比，重点在框架设计和理论论证。
summary.authors_note: 曼彻斯特大学等机构，无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Complex reasoning tasks like autoformalization produce outputs whose correctness cannot be judged by exact match to a single reference; expert-validated formalizations do not scale.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: first reference-free proxy-judge evaluation framework that replaces gold-standard matching with structured per-axis property checks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proxy organized along three structural scopes (global, per-module internal, cross-domain alignment with source), aggregated into a verdict vector that drives iterative refinement of model outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Dataset size and SOTA comparison not detailed in abstract; emphasis on framework design and theoretical argument.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Manchester and others; no notably famous authors.

recommendation.zh: 无需gold standard的评测框架对推理任务评估有启发，skim §3框架设计部分即可。
recommendation.en: Reference-free evaluation framework for reasoning tasks is conceptually interesting; skim §3 on framework design.

paper.title: Post-training is (Massive) Supervised Learning
paper.abstract: The prevailing paradigm for training LLMs has evolved to rely on a massive post-training phase consisting of SFT and RL. In this position paper, we argue that this methodology effectively marks a reversion to the ``pre-train then fine-tune'' approach of the BERT era, explicitly tailoring models to the desired behaviors and specific benchmarks on which they are evaluated. We begin with a historical overview of LLMs, describing the different phases of the LLM evolution. We argue that the current l

summary.core_problem: 这篇 position paper 讨论一个对基座训练很关键的问题：现代 LLM 的能力到底有多少来自预训练获得的通用表示，多少来自大规模 post-training 对目标任务分布的直接拟合。作者的结论很明确：当前 SFT/RL 已经不只是轻量对齐阶段，而是一个大规模监督学习阶段。它把评测任务和期望行为显式拉进训练分布，使当前范式在许多方面回到了 BERT/GPT-1 时代的“预训练后微调”。
summary.importance: 这篇文章的价值不在新算法，而在于重新校准 pretrain 与 post-train 的贡献边界。它提醒预训练研究员，不能只看最终模型在数学、代码、指令遵循 benchmark 上的分数来判断预训练质量，因为大规模 post-training 可能已经覆盖了相当多的目标分布。对 scaling law、数据配比、benchmark 设计、持续预训练和 annealing recipe 都有影响：如果 post-training 能用较少但高度集中的数据获得非平凡能力，那么预训练的评估应更重视 out-of-distribution transfer、学习效率、可迁移表示和对新任务的适应速度，而不是只看被 post-train 强化过的静态任务。
summary.technical_approach: 论文采用历史分析加诊断实验，而不是提出新训练方法。历史部分把 LLM 发展分成几个阶段：早期的 supervised task training；ELMo/BERT/GPT-1 之后的 self-supervised pretrain + task fine-tune；GPT-3 强调 few-shot 和 in-context learning；随后 RLHF、SFT、RLVR 等 post-training 逐渐扩大，直到消耗数百亿到数千亿 token。实验部分试图隔离预训练的作用。作者比较两类模型：一类是正常预训练模型，另一类是完全随机初始化、只在现代 reasoning SFT 数据上训练的模型。如果 post-training 只是释放预训练中已有的知识，随机初始化模型应当几乎失败；如果 post-training 是强分布拟合，那么随机初始化模型应能取得可观分数。作者还加入极小规模预训练设置，用不到原始预训练 0.1% 的 compute，观察它能弥合多少随机初始化与完整预训练之间的差距。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理和竞赛编程 benchmark，并在不同参数规模上比较无预训练、少量预训练和完整预训练模型。关键结果是，完全没有传统预训练、只依靠 SFT 数据训练的模型，在困难 benchmark 上仍有非平凡表现：14B 模型在 LiveCodeBench V5 上达到 51%，7B 模型在 AIME-24 上达到 43%。完整预训练模型仍然更强，领先约 8–20 个百分点；这个差距与早期 BERT/GPT-1 时代预训练相对纯监督 baseline 的优势量级相近。另一个重要结果是，使用不到原始预训练 compute 0.1% 的最小预训练，可以弥合剩余性能差距的最高约一半。这说明预训练仍有价值，但当前许多 reasoning benchmark 的高分并不必然需要完整大规模预训练才能获得。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和实验设计部分。Introduction 给出了核心论点：post-training 正在从对齐阶段变成大规模监督分布拟合。历史回顾部分可以较快阅读，重点是作者如何定义几个阶段之间的差异。实验部分最值得细看：随机初始化模型的训练设置、SFT 数据来源、参数规模、训练 token 数、评测 benchmark 是否与训练分布接近，以及无预训练、少量预训练、完整预训练三组之间的差距。读表时不要只看最高分，更应关注两个量：随机初始化模型能达到多少绝对性能，以及极小预训练能弥合多少 gap。这两个量直接关系到预训练研究该如何设计评估协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a central question for foundation-model training: how much of current LLM performance comes from general capabilities acquired during pretraining, and how much comes from large-scale post-training that directly fits the target task distribution. Its main claim is that modern SFT/RL is no longer a light alignment stage. It has become a massive supervised-learning phase that pulls desired behaviors and benchmark-like tasks into the training distribution, making the current pipeline resemble the BERT/GPT-1-era pretrain-then-finetune recipe.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is conceptual and diagnostic rather than algorithmic. It sharpens the boundary between pretraining and post-training. For pretraining researchers, the main implication is that final benchmark scores on math, coding, or instruction-following tasks are not clean measurements of pretraining quality when the post-training phase is large and targeted. This affects how scaling laws, data mixtures, continual pretraining, annealing, and evaluation protocols should be interpreted. If highly concentrated SFT data can produce strong nontrivial reasoning performance from scratch, pretraining should be evaluated more on out-of-distribution transfer, sample efficiency, reusable representations, and adaptation to genuinely new tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper combines a historical argument with controlled diagnostic experiments. The historical part traces the shift from classical supervised task training, to self-supervised pretraining plus task finetuning in ELMo/BERT/GPT-1, to GPT-3-style in-context learning, and then to modern pipelines where SFT, RLHF, and RLVR can consume tens to hundreds of billions of tokens. The empirical part isolates the role of pretraining by comparing normally pretrained models with randomly initialized models trained only on modern reasoning SFT data. The logic is simple: if post-training merely unlocks knowledge already acquired during pretraining, the randomly initialized models should fail; if post-training is strong distribution fitting, they should achieve meaningful performance. The paper also studies a minimal-pretraining condition using less than 0.1% of the original pretraining compute to estimate how much of the gap can be closed with a small amount of self-supervised exposure.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate mathematical reasoning and competitive programming across multiple parameter scales. The key result is that models trained from random initialization only on SFT data still reach meaningful scores on difficult benchmarks. A 14B model obtains 51% on LiveCodeBench V5, and a 7B model obtains 43% on AIME-24. Fully pretrained counterparts remain better, with an 8–20 point advantage. The size of this gap is comparable to the advantage pretrained models had over supervised-only baselines in the BERT/GPT-1 period. A second important result is that a minimal pretraining setup, using less than 0.1% of the original pretraining compute, can close up to about half of the remaining gap between non-pretrained and fully pretrained models. This indicates that pretraining still matters, but strong performance on many current reasoning benchmarks does not necessarily require full-scale pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction and experimental design carefully. The introduction contains the main framing: post-training has shifted from alignment into large-scale supervised distribution fitting. The historical sections can be read quickly; focus on how the authors distinguish the training regimes. The experimental sections are the most important. Check the random-initialization setup, SFT data composition, parameter scales, token budgets, benchmark choices, and the gap between no pretraining, minimal pretraining, and full pretraining. The most informative numbers are not only the best scores, but the absolute performance of scratch-trained models and the fraction of the pretraining gap closed by minimal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接碰你对“能力来自 pretrain、post-train 只做对齐”的 prior；先看实验设定是否把 token budget、data overlap 和 optimization fairness 控干净，再决定信不信。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the prior that capability comes from pretraining while post-training only aligns; inspect token budget, data overlap, and optimization fairness before buying the claim.

paper.title: The Easy, the Hard, and the Learnable: Confidence and Difficulty-Adaptive Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: RL with verifiable rewards can substantially improve LLM reasoning, yet standard GRPO-style training often treats easy, hard, and learnable questions alike through uniform sampling and weighting, leading to inefficient compute allocation. We study GRPO by tracking token log-probabilities, group-normalized advantages, and the induced token-level update weights. This reveals three recurring dynamics as training proceeds: (1) confidence inflation, (2) advantage contraction, and (3) hierarchical con

summary.core_problem: 在基于可验证奖励的 LLM 推理 RL 训练（如 GRPO）中，如何避免对简单、困难和可学习问题进行均匀采样和加权导致的计算资源浪费？
summary.importance: 深入分析了 GRPO 训练中的动态过程（置信度膨胀、优势收缩、分层收敛），并提出了一种基于置信度和难度的自适应策略优化方法 (CoDaPO)，显著提高了 RL 训练的样本效率和计算分配效率。
summary.technical_approach: 通过跟踪 token 对数概率、组归一化优势和诱导的 token 级更新权重，揭示了训练动态。提出 CoDaPO，根据 rollout 置信度和经验难度为每个问题分配一个有界值，用该值重新加权策略更新，并在 mini-batch 内重新采样高价值的可学习问题。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详细说明具体模型和数据集，但强调了在发现可学习问题和提高计算效率方面的优势。
summary.authors_note: UIUC, MBZUAI, University of Sydney 等机构合作。Sanmi Koyejo 和 Bo Han 为知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to avoid compute waste caused by uniform sampling and weighting of easy, hard, and learnable questions in RL training with verifiable rewards (e.g., GRPO) for LLM reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Provides an in-depth analysis of GRPO training dynamics (confidence inflation, advantage contraction, hierarchical convergence) and proposes CoDaPO, a confidence and difficulty-adaptive policy optimization method that significantly improves sample efficiency and compute allocation in RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reveals training dynamics by tracking token log-probabilities, group-normalized advantages, and induced token-level update weights. Proposes CoDaPO, which assigns a bounded value to each question based on rollout confidence and empirical difficulty, uses this value to reweight policy updates, and resamples high-value learnable questions within mini-batches.
summary_en.experiments: Specific models and datasets are not detailed in the abstract, but the emphasis is on the advantages in discovering learnable questions and improving compute efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration among UIUC, MBZUAI, University of Sydney, etc. Sanmi Koyejo and Bo Han are notable scholars.

recommendation.zh: 对 GRPO 训练动态（置信度膨胀、优势收缩）的分析非常到位，提出的基于难度和置信度的重加权/重采样策略是提升 RL 样本效率的务实方向，做 RLHF/RLVR 的同学必读。
recommendation.en: The analysis of GRPO training dynamics (confidence inflation, advantage contraction) is spot on. The proposed reweighting/resampling strategy based on difficulty and confidence is a pragmatic direction for improving RL sample efficiency; a must-read for RLHF/RLVR practitioners.

paper.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
paper.abstract: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers f

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM自演进方法要么依赖大量人工/教师生成的训练数据，要么在无监督生成时用困难度启发式奖励generator，而困难度不一定真正提升solver。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出influence-guided自演进框架INFUSER，首次使用optimizer-aware influence score来奖励数据generator，使生成的问题真正有助于改进solver；同时提出DuGRPO dual-normalization适配连续噪声奖励信号。
summary.technical_approach: 两角色协同训练框架：Generator从非结构化文档中生成问题和参考答案；Solver通过标准正确性奖励在生成数据上训练。Generator的奖励信号是optimizer-aware influence score——衡量每个生成问题是否真正改善solver在目标分布上的表现。针对连续噪声的influence score不适合标准GRPO，提出DuGRPO（dual-normalization GRPO）。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，完整实验结果未给出。核心创新在方法设计和理论基础。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括普林斯顿大学的Jose Blanchee（统计/ML知名学者）、Zhuoran Yang（普林斯顿/DeepMind）、Tianhao Wang（普林斯顿）。属于知名学术团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM self-evolution methods either rely on extensively curated/teacher-generated training data, or reward the generator by a difficulty heuristic that does not necessarily improve the solver when run unsupervised.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes INFUSER, an influence-guided self-evolution framework using optimizer-aware influence scores to reward the data generator such that generated questions actually improve the solver. Also proposes DuGRPO, a dual-normalization GRPO variant for continuous noisy reward signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-role co-training framework: Generator drafts questions and reference golden answers from unstructured documents; Solver improves by training on them with standard correctness rewards. The generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score measuring whether each question actually improves the solver on the target distribution. Proposes DuGRPO (dual-normalization GRPO) since standard GRPO is poorly suited for continuous noisy influence scores.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, full experimental results not provided. Core innovation is in methodology and theoretical foundation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Jose Blanchet (Princeton, prominent statistics/ML researcher), Zhuoran Yang (Princeton/DeepMind), and Tianhao Wang (Princeton). Work from a well-known academic group.

recommendation.zh: 自演进+influence function奖励数据生成是有理论深度的方向，与R1-Zero范式相关，但属于后训练数据合成，对基座预训练有间接启示。重点看influence score设计和DuGRPO部分。
recommendation.en: Self-evolution with influence-function reward for data generation is a theoretically grounded direction related to the R1-Zero paradigm, but belongs to post-training data synthesis; indirect relevance to pre-training. Focus on the influence score design and DuGRPO sections.

paper.title: Reasoning Arena: Trace Tournaments When Verifiable Rewards Fall Short
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a leading paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models through outcome-based supervision. However, verifiable rewards frequently become uninformative at the group level: when all sampled traces of a given prompt receive identical rewards, group-relative advantage estimation provides no gradient signal, even though the traces may differ substantially in reasoning quality. We propose Reasoning Arena, an adapt

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 中一个常被忽略的问题：当同一 prompt 下采样出的多条 reasoning trace 获得相同可验证奖励时，group-relative advantage 没有梯度，导致大量潜在有用的训练样本被浪费。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段 reward shaping / judge-based supervision 的方法创新。它对预训练研究员有价值，因为它直接触及 reasoning 数据的监督粒度问题：最终答案相同不代表轨迹质量相同，训练信号若只看 outcome 会系统性丢失过程信息。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Reasoning Arena。核心机制是把 reward 不分化的 trace group 路由给 judge 系统，而不是丢弃；judge 不只看 final answer，而是做 trace tournament，让不同推理轨迹两两对比，得到更细的相对偏好信号。为控制成本，作者没有做全对全比较，而是让新轨迹只和一个动态维护的小型 reference pool 比较，从而近似构造排序与相对奖励。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和具体 benchmark，但方法面向 reasoning RLVR 训练。关键 baseline 应包括标准 group-relative advantage / outcome-only RLVR。论文的可信度主要取决于两点：一是 judge 对 trace 质量的判别是否稳定，二是 tournament 近似是否会引入 ranking bias。若正文实验干净，这会是一个很实用的 RL 数据利用率改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Laurence Aitchison、Anna Korhonen、Albert Q. Jiang，属于做推理与学习理论/语言模型训练交叉问题的学者；从题目和方法看，重点是 reasoning RL 的训练信号设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a neglected RLVR failure mode: when all sampled reasoning traces for a prompt receive the same verifiable reward, group-relative advantage provides no gradient and many potentially useful samples are wasted.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training reward-shaping / judge-based supervision contribution. It matters to pretraining researchers because it directly targets supervision granularity for reasoning: identical final answers do not imply identical trace quality, and outcome-only training systematically discards process information.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reasoning Arena routes reward-nondiverse trace groups to a judge system instead of dropping them. The judge does not only inspect the final answer; it runs trace tournaments, comparing reasoning traces head-to-head to derive finer relative preferences. To reduce cost, it avoids exhaustive pairwise comparisons and compares each new trace against a dynamically maintained small reference pool.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose model sizes or exact benchmarks, but the method targets reasoning RLVR training. The natural baselines are standard group-relative advantage and outcome-only RLVR. The main credibility checks are whether the judge is stable on trace quality and whether the tournament approximation introduces ranking bias. If the setup is clean, this is a practical improvement in RL data efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Laurence Aitchison, Anna Korhonen, and Albert Q. Jiang, researchers working at the intersection of reasoning, language models, and learning theory. The focus is training-signal design for reasoning RL.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是它点破了 RLVR 的零梯度死角；先看 trace tournament 设计和 judge 成本曲线，若偏差控制住，能直接改你现有 reasoning RL pipeline。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the explicit zero-gradient blind spot in RLVR; read the trace-tournament design and judge-cost curves first, and adopt it only if ranking bias is well controlled.

paper.title: Diverse Thinking Schemata Elicit Better Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have attracted increasing attention for their ability to solve complex mathematical problems by generating extended reasoning chains. In this work, we focus on two critical yet underexplored aspects of the reasoning process: reasoning transitions capturing the distinct transitions between reasoning steps and answer candidates reflecting the variety of solution paths produced by the model. We collectively define these two aspects as thinking schemata. We observe a co

summary.core_problem: 解决大语言推理模型在长链推理中思路单一、路径塌缩的问题，尝试用“thinking schemata”的多样性提升数学推理表现。
summary.importance: 这是后训练方向的推理增强工作，贡献点不在新 benchmark，而在把 reasoning transition 和 answer candidate diversity 明确建模，并用 RL 直接优化。对研究 pretrain↔post-train 接口、推理数据与奖励设计的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiScO（Diverse Schemata Policy Optimization）。先让模型具备 schemata awareness，显式感知推理步骤之间的转移模式和候选答案路径；再通过强化学习鼓励 reasoning schemata 的多样性；最后在推理时进一步促进多样化思考，以提高找到正确解路径的概率。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在多个数学推理 benchmark 上验证有效，但未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量、基线和提升幅度。可确定的 baseline 应包括常规 CoT、self-consistency 或已有 RL 推理增强方法，重点观察 diversity 与准确率的相关性及 RL 带来的增益。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses path collapse in long-chain reasoning by increasing the diversity of 'thinking schemata' in large reasoning models.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper for reasoning enhancement. Its contribution is not a new benchmark but an explicit treatment of reasoning transitions and answer-candidate diversity, optimized with RL. That makes it relevant to researchers interested in the pretrain↔post-train interface, reasoning data, and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DiScO (Diverse Schemata Policy Optimization). It first equips the model with schemata awareness, explicitly modeling transition patterns between reasoning steps and diversity among answer candidates. It then uses reinforcement learning to encourage diverse reasoning schemata, and further promotes diversity at inference time to increase the chance of discovering a correct solution path.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, but does not provide model sizes, training data volume, baselines, or exact margins. Likely baselines include standard CoT, self-consistency, and prior RL-based reasoning methods, with the key analysis focusing on the correlation between diversity and accuracy and the gains from RL.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型 post-train 信号设计论文，不改 pretrain 范式；但若你在做 reasoning RL，值得看它如何把“多样性”从采样技巧变成奖励对象。
recommendation.en: This is a post-training signal-design paper rather than a pretraining one, but it is worth reading if you work on reasoning RL and want to turn diversity from a sampling trick into an explicit reward target.

paper.title: The Hidden Bias of Process Reward Models:PRISM for Rewarding the Right Reasoning
paper.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) improve credit assignment for reasoning by providing step-level feedback. However, we identify a hidden bias in PRMs caused by severe imbalance in step-level training data. Standard cross-entropy training amplifies this bias, causing PRMs to overcredit plausible but incorrect steps and produce high false-positive rates. We show that these false positives have an asymmetric downstream effect: false negatives mainly slow exploration, whereas false positives actively st

summary.core_problem: 解决 Process Reward Model 在步骤级训练数据严重失衡下产生系统性高假阳性，从而误奖错误推理步骤的问题。
summary.importance: 这项工作重要在于它不是再做一个更强 PRM，而是指出 PRM 训练目标本身有偏：点式交叉熵会把“看起来合理但实际错误”的步骤打高分。对 RL、Best-of-N、guided decoding 乃至 RFT 的训练信号质量都有直接影响，属于 post-train 里很值得预训练研究员关注的接口问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PRISM，把 PRM 训练从点式标签拟合改成相对排序学习。核心做法包括：构造步骤级对比样本；用 temporal lookahead 生成 hard negatives；引入 difficulty-aware curriculum；并强调 policy-aware 训练，使 PRM 更关注会真实影响搜索与优化的误判类型，尤其压低 false positives。
summary.experiments: 论文比较标准 cross-entropy PRM 与 PRISM 在步骤判别、Best-of-N 选择、guided decoding 和策略优化中的差异。关键结论是 false positive 比 false negative 更伤下游，因为前者会主动把搜索和优化推向错误轨迹；PRISM 在不增加人工标注的前提下改善这一点。摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据量，需看正文确认 setup clean 不 clean。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a hidden bias in Process Reward Models: severe step-level label imbalance makes PRMs over-reward plausible but incorrect reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: The value here is not just a stronger PRM, but a critique of the standard PRM objective itself. If pointwise cross-entropy systematically inflates false positives, then the reward signal used in Best-of-N, guided decoding, and policy optimization is misaligned. That matters directly for the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRISM replaces pointwise label fitting with relative ranking. The method builds contrastive step-level comparisons, mines hard negatives with temporal lookahead, applies a difficulty-aware curriculum, and trains the PRM in a policy-aware way so it focuses on the mistakes that actually distort downstream search and optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares standard CE-trained PRMs against PRISM on step scoring and downstream use cases such as Best-of-N selection, guided decoding, and policy optimization. The key empirical claim is that false positives are much more damaging than false negatives because they actively steer search toward flawed trajectories. The abstract does not expose model scale or dataset size, so the cleanliness of the setup needs checking in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看，因为它把 PRM 问题从“分数准不准”改成“错奖会不会把策略带沟里”；先看 false positive 非对称伤害那组实验，再决定要不要复现 PRISM。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it reframes PRMs from raw accuracy to whether false positives actively poison search; read the asymmetric false-positive analysis first, then decide if PRISM is worth reproducing.

paper.title: From Shortcuts to Reasoning: Robust Post-Training of Theory of Mind with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) is a must-acquire skill for modern foundation model systems to operate effectively and safely in the real world. Recent works have explored honing ToM via post-training; however, we show that such progress is confounded by a pervasive "shortcut" issue: tasks can reach up to 99% accuracy by simply exploiting spurious causal correlations, leading to a false sense of ToM. Motivated by this, we first develop a framework to systematically examine ToM datasets for shortcuts and pr

summary.core_problem: 研究 Theory of Mind 后训练结果是否被数据集 shortcut 混淆，以及 RL 式 post-training 是否真的学到超越状态跟踪的推理能力。
summary.importance: 这篇的价值不在 ToM 这个题材本身，而在它把“后训练提升”拆成了数据 shortcut 与真实能力两部分。对做 reasoning post-train、合成数据、verifiable reward 的人很有参考意义，因为很多看似能力提升的结果可能只是 exploit dataset bias。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先提出一个系统化框架检查 ToM 数据集中的 shortcut，区分容易被纯 state tracking 解决的 belief 类问题和更需要真实心智推断的 intention 类问题。随后在四个去 shortcut 的数据集上，比较带可验证奖励和显式 reasoning chain 的 Thinking-RFT 与 SFT，考察 RL 后训练是否带来更稳健的 ToM 推理。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类 ToM 场景、四个 shortcut-free 数据集，并报告原有数据集上可通过 spurious correlation 达到极高准确率，说明先前结论可能被高估。核心比较是 SFT vs RFT，在去 shortcut 设定下看 RL 是否仍有优势。摘要未给出模型规模、基座或提升幅度，需看正文判断结论是否依赖特定数据构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether post-training gains on Theory of Mind are real or mostly artifacts of dataset shortcuts, and whether RL-based post-training truly learns reasoning beyond state tracking.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about ToM as a topic and more about disentangling apparent post-training gains into shortcut exploitation versus genuine capability. That is directly relevant to reasoning post-training, synthetic data design, and verifiable-reward setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first build a framework to diagnose shortcuts in ToM datasets, distinguishing belief-style questions that can often be solved by state tracking from intention-style questions that require deeper mental-state reasoning. They then compare SFT with Thinking-RFT—reinforcement fine-tuning with verifiable rewards and explicit reasoning chains—on four shortcut-free datasets across three ToM contexts.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span four shortcut-free datasets and show that some existing ToM tasks can be solved at extremely high accuracy via spurious correlations, suggesting prior gains were overstated. The main comparison is SFT versus RFT under de-shortcutted settings. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains, so the robustness of the conclusion depends on the full setup.

recommendation.zh: 题目是 ToM，但真正值得看的是它对 shortcut 的拆解；如果你在做 reasoning RL 或合成评测集，这篇会提醒你先审数据，再谈能力提升。
recommendation.en: The ToM framing is secondary; the real value is the shortcut audit. If you work on reasoning RL or synthetic evaluations, this is a good reminder to audit the data before claiming capability gains.

paper.title: ConSteer-RL: Steering Reasoning Capabilities in Large Language Models via Confidence-Aware Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently become a key paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it remains limited by sparse binary rewards and its ignorance of model-internal uncertainty. In this paper, we propose ConSteer-RL, a simple yet effective framework that integrates token-level confidence signals derived from model log-probabilities into RLVR training. Specifically, building upon the Group Relative Policy Optimization

summary.core_problem: RLVR用稀疏二值奖励忽略模型内部不确定性，限制推理能力训练效果。
summary.importance: 首次在GRPO框架中引入token级别置信度信号用于奖励塑形，惩罚过度自信错误、奖励自信且正确的推理。
summary.technical_approach: 从token log概率聚合为标量置信度分数，构造置信度感知奖励函数，在GRPO中结合使用。
summary.experiments: 不同模型规模下较GRPO基线平均提升2.3%-4.0%。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR suffers from sparse binary rewards and ignores model-internal uncertainty, limiting reasoning capability training.
summary_en.importance: First to integrate token-level confidence signals into GRPO for reward shaping; penalizes overconfident errors while reinforcing confident correct reasoning.
