summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 test-time scaling 里一个很具体但常被分开处理的问题：一方面，额外算力应该投给哪些题；另一方面，投进去的算力是否还在从同一个固定分布里重复采样。作者认为现有方法大多只解决前者，最多按题目难度自适应分配 sample 数，但生成分布 p(y|x) 基本不变，导致难题上继续加 sample 很快收益递减。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在不做复杂搜索或额外优化的前提下，同时自适应地分配测试时算力，并让生成分布随着测试过程演化。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / inference-time reasoning 方法。但对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，它把 test-time compute 的收益拆成两个来源：算力分配和分布重塑，这个拆分很清楚，也有助于理解为什么单纯 best-of-N 会很快饱和。第二，它展示了一个轻量级的 inference loop：利用测试集自身已经解决的问题构造 evolving in-context demonstrations，逐步改变后续题目的条件分布。这对研究 ICL 机制、推理时自举、以及 pretrain 与 in-context adaptation 的接口有参考价值。不过它不是预训练范式论文，更多是一个实用的 test-time adaptation 策略。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两阶段。第一阶段是 warm-up：给每个测试样本一个小而固定的预算，先跑少量生成。这个阶段有两个目的，一是尽早解决简单题，二是从测试集自身收集一批 question-response pairs，形成初始 demonstration pool。第二阶段是 adaptive phase：只把后续预算投给尚未解决的问题，但关键不只是继续采样，而是先从 demonstration pool 中按语义相似度检索若干已成功样例，把这些样例作为 ICL demonstrations 拼到当前问题前面，再在这个新条件分布下生成。随着更多问题被解决，pool 持续增长，后续题目的生成分布也持续变化。这样，compute allocation 和 distribution adaptation 被放进同一个闭环。和已有方法相比，它不需要为每个 query 单独做搜索，也不依赖额外训练 verifier 或 policy；和纯 difficulty-based allocation 相比，它不是只决定 sample 数，而是试图提高每次 sample 的命中率。论文里还把问题形式化为 coverage 优化：只要某题生成集合里至少有一个正确答案，就算该题被解决，因此目标是用有限预算最大化被覆盖的问题数。
summary.experiments: 作者在 MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench、MinervaMath 上做实验，比较对象包括 uniform allocation baseline 和只按难度分配预算的 adaptive allocation baseline。文中强调两点结果：一是在多个随机种子和多轮评测下，方法都能在更低 compute budget 下取得更高性能；二是收益主要出现在 test-time scaling 的早期阶段，说明改进来自更有效的预算使用和更好的条件分布，而不是后期暴力堆 sample。由于给出的全文片段没有完整结果表，无法准确摘出提升百分比、预算大小、每题 sample 上限、检索 demonstration 数量等关键数字。阅读时需要重点确认三类消融：只做 allocation、不做 evolving ICL；只做 ICL、不做 allocation；以及 demonstration 检索策略和 pool 质量对结果的影响。如果这些消融充分，论文的主要价值就在于证明“动态演化的 ICL 上下文”确实能改变 test-time scaling 的收益曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Problem Setting 和 Methods。前者把 coverage 目标和 sequential allocation 形式化得比较清楚，能快速看出它与 best-of-N 的区别。后者重点看 warm-up pool、语义检索、以及 evolving demonstrations 如何嵌入生成流程。实验部分不必逐题细看，先抓预算-性能曲线，确认收益是否稳定出现在低预算区间，再看消融判断改进来自哪里。预计 20-30 分钟可完成泛读。最值得留意的风险点有三个：一是测试集内样本互相当 demonstration，是否会引入 benchmark-specific leakage 风险；二是语义相似检索在数学、代码、科学问答上是否真的对应可迁移解法；三是随着 pool 扩大，错误示例是否会污染后续生成分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific limitation in test-time scaling. Existing methods usually decide where to spend extra inference compute, but they keep sampling from essentially the same conditional distribution for each query. Even adaptive allocation methods often only vary the number of samples per question while leaving p(y|x) unchanged. That leads to diminishing returns on hard problems when correct solutions have low probability under the base model. The core problem here is how to adapt both compute allocation and the generation distribution itself during inference, without expensive per-query search or additional optimization.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it sits closer to post-training and inference-time reasoning. Still, it has two useful implications for foundation-model research. First, it cleanly separates the gains from test-time compute into allocation effects and distribution-shaping effects, which helps explain why plain best-of-N saturates quickly. Second, it offers a lightweight self-bootstrapping inference loop where solved test examples become evolving in-context demonstrations for unsolved ones. That is relevant to researchers interested in in-context learning dynamics, self-adaptation at inference time, and the interface between pretrained priors and test-time conditioning. The contribution is practical rather than paradigm-shifting.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. In the warm-up stage, every test query receives a small fixed budget. This serves two purposes: it resolves easy questions early and collects an initial pool of question-response pairs from the test set itself. In the adaptive stage, additional compute is focused only on unresolved queries. The key step is that the model no longer simply resamples from the original distribution. Instead, it retrieves semantically similar solved examples from the evolving pool and prepends them as in-context demonstrations before generating new responses. As more questions are solved, the pool grows, and the effective conditional distribution for later generations changes over time. This creates a single loop that couples compute allocation with distribution adaptation. Relative to prior work, the method avoids per-query search procedures and does not require a separately trained verifier or policy. Relative to difficulty-based allocation alone, it aims to improve the quality of each additional sample, not just the quantity. The paper formalizes the objective using coverage: a question is counted as solved if at least one generated response is correct, so the goal is to maximize solved questions under a fixed budget.
summary_en.experiments: The reported evaluations are on MATH-500, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench, and MinervaMath, with comparisons against a uniform allocation baseline and an adaptive allocation baseline that does not evolve the generation distribution. The main empirical claims are that the proposed method consistently achieves better performance at lower compute budgets across multiple random seeds and evaluation rounds, and that the gains appear early in the scaling curve rather than only after heavy oversampling. That pattern supports the paper's argument that the benefit comes from better budget use and a better conditional distribution, not just more samples. However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the full result tables, so key numbers such as exact gains, budget sizes, maximum samples per query, and the number of retrieved demonstrations are missing. When reading, the most important ablations to check are: allocation only versus evolving ICL only, retrieval strategy choices, and sensitivity to demonstration pool quality. If those are well executed, the paper's main value is showing that dynamically evolving ICL context can materially change the efficiency curve of test-time scaling.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the Problem Setting and Methods sections. The former gives a clean formulation of coverage-based sequential allocation and makes the distinction from best-of-N explicit. The latter is where the actual idea lives: warm-up pool construction, semantic retrieval, and how evolving demonstrations are injected into generation. In the experiments, prioritize budget-performance curves over per-benchmark details. The main question is whether the gains are stable in the low-budget regime, and whether the ablations isolate the source of improvement. A 20-30 minute skim should be enough. Three caveats are worth checking carefully: whether using solved test examples as demonstrations creates benchmark-specific leakage concerns, whether semantic similarity really transfers solution patterns in math, coding, and science QA, and whether incorrect examples in the growing pool can poison later generations.

recommendation.zh: Test-time compute 的一种新玩法，通过动态构建 ICL 样本池来引导难样本的生成，思路巧妙，值得关注其在推理加速和性能提升上的 trade-off，看 §3 方法设计即可。
recommendation.en: A novel approach to test-time compute that guides hard query generation by dynamically building an ICL sample pool; the trade-off between inference acceleration and performance is worth noting. Read §3 for the method design.

paper.title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
paper.abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research pu

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 chart QA 主要停留在单图场景、无法衡量多图联合理解能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark/data。对做原生多模态预训练的人有一点参考价值，因为它暴露了现有 MLLM 在跨图结构组合、真实人工问题上的明显短板，但不直接提出新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolyChartQA，多图表问答数据集，包含来自计算机科学论文的 534 张 multi-chart 图像、共 2,297 个子图和 2,694 个 QA 对；并设计按问题类型、难度、问题来源和图表结构特征的细粒度评测，同时给出一个 prompting 改进。
summary.experiments: 评测了 9 个现有多模态语言模型。关键结果是：在人类撰写问题上，相比模型生成问题，准确率下降 27.4%；作者的 prompting 方法带来 5.39% 的 L-Accuracy 提升。数据规模中等，结论更适合作为能力缺口诊断，而非训练结论。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。工作是多图表理解 benchmark，适合做 VLM 评测集补充，但不是范式级多模态预训练研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of evaluation for question answering over multiple related charts, beyond the standard single-chart setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark/dataset. It has some value for native multimodal pretraining researchers because it exposes clear weaknesses of current MLLMs on cross-chart composition and human-authored questions, but it does not introduce a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces PolyChartQA, a multi-chart QA dataset with 534 multi-chart images from computer science papers, 2,297 sub-charts, and 2,694 QA pairs. The benchmark supports fine-grained analysis by question type, difficulty, source, and structural chart properties, and includes a prompting improvement.
summary_en.experiments: Nine state-of-the-art multimodal language models are evaluated. The key findings are a 27.4% accuracy drop on human-authored questions relative to model-generated ones, and a 5.39% L-Accuracy gain from the proposed prompting method. The dataset is mid-scale and more diagnostic than training-oriented.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University. This is a benchmark for multi-chart understanding, useful as an additional VLM evaluation set but not a paradigm-level multimodal pretraining paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练论文，但可当 VLM 诊断集备查；只看数据构成和 human-vs-synthetic 的 27.4% gap，能提醒你别拿合成题高估模型。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but a useful VLM diagnostic benchmark; just read the dataset design and the 27.4% human-vs-synthetic gap to avoid overestimating models on synthetic QA.

paper.title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
paper.abstract: Reasoning LLMs often spend substantial tokens on long intermediate reasoning traces (e.g., chain-of-thought) when solving new problems. We propose to summarize and store reusable reasoning skills distilled from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, and to retrieve these skills at inference time to guide future reasoning. Unlike the prevailing \emph{reasoning from scratch} paradigm, our approach first recalls relevant skills for each query, helping the model avoid redundant deto

summary.core_problem: 减少推理模型在新问题上从零展开长链式思考的 token 开销，同时尽量提升准确率。
summary.importance: 这是后训练/推理时策略层面的工作，不是预训练范式创新。价值在于把“可复用 reasoning skill”显式缓存并检索，说明部分 CoT 可以被压缩成可迁移的技能单元。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先通过大量 deliberation 和 trial-and-error 提炼出可复用的 reasoning skills，再在推理时为当前 query 检索相关技能，用这些技能引导后续求解，而不是每次都从头生成完整长推理链。整体属于 skill distillation + retrieval-guided reasoning。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖 coding 和数学推理任务。摘要声称同时减少 reasoning tokens 并提升总体性能，带来更低单次请求成本，但未在摘要中给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。更像 inference-time reasoning policy 优化，而非 clean 的能力提升证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the token cost of reasoning models that otherwise solve each new problem from scratch with long intermediate chains of thought, while maintaining or improving accuracy.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/inference-strategy paper rather than a pretraining advance. Its main value is the explicit treatment of reusable reasoning skills as retrievable units, suggesting that some CoT can be compressed into transferable skills.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first distills reusable reasoning skills from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, then retrieves relevant skills at inference time to guide problem solving instead of generating a full long reasoning trace from scratch every time. Conceptually, it is skill distillation plus retrieval-guided reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers coding and math reasoning tasks. The abstract claims both fewer reasoning tokens and better overall performance, implying lower per-request cost, but it does not provide model sizes, training data, baselines, or effect sizes. This looks more like an inference-time reasoning policy optimization than a clean demonstration of improved underlying capability.

recommendation.zh: 想看“CoT 能否被压成可检索技能”可以扫一眼；但这更像推理成本工程，先看实验表里 token 降幅和是否有 retrieval leakage。
recommendation.en: Skim it only if you care whether CoT can be compressed into retrievable skills; the key is the token reduction table and whether retrieval leakage contaminates the gains.

paper.title: Reasoning Primitives in Hybrid and Non-Hybrid LLMs
paper.abstract: Reasoning in large language models is often treated as a monolithic capability, but its observed gains may arise from more basic operations. We study reasoning through two such primitives, recall and state-tracking, and ask whether hybrid architectures that combine attention-based retrieval with recurrent state updates are better suited than attention-only models for tasks that jointly require both. Using matched Olmo3 transformer and hybrid models in instruction-tuned and reasoning-augmented va

summary.core_problem: 把“推理能力”拆成更基础的 recall 与 state-tracking 两种原语，检验混合架构是否比纯 Transformer 更适合同时依赖两者的任务。
summary.importance: 价值主要在分析框架而非新模型。它试图避免把 reasoning 当成单一黑箱能力，而是用可控任务分解出不同计算需求，对理解架构差异和后训练增益来源有一定帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用匹配的 Olmo3 transformer 与 hybrid 模型，并比较 instruction-tuned 与 reasoning-augmented 版本。在一组受控任务上构造 state-based recall 场景，分别考察模型在回忆信息与持续状态更新同时存在时的表现。核心不是提出新训练算法，而是通过任务设计和架构对照分析 reasoning primitive。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出参数规模，但强调是 matched 模型对比。主要发现有两点：一是 reasoning augmentation 带来最大整体增益，显著扩展模型可处理的难度范围；二是在 sequential dependence 增强时，hybrid reasoning model 在某些任务上更稳健，而 transformer reasoning model 更早退化。是否有说服力取决于任务构造是否足够干净，以及匹配设置是否真正控制了容量与训练差异。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Bonn、Lamarr Institute 等。不是顶级实验室的大规模训练报告，更像一篇受控分析论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper decomposes reasoning into two primitives, recall and state-tracking, and asks whether hybrid architectures outperform pure Transformers on tasks that require both at once.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly analytical rather than architectural. Instead of treating reasoning as a monolithic black-box capability, it uses controlled tasks to isolate different computational demands, which can inform how we interpret architecture effects and post-training gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare matched Olmo3 Transformer and hybrid models, each in instruction-tuned and reasoning-augmented variants. They design controlled tasks involving state-based recall, where successful performance requires both remembering information and updating latent state over time. The contribution is not a new training algorithm but a cleaner task-and-architecture comparison around reasoning primitives.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, but it emphasizes matched-model comparisons. Two main findings are reported: reasoning augmentation gives the largest overall gain and extends the difficulty range over which models remain effective; and under stronger sequential dependence, the hybrid reasoning model is more robust on some tasks, while the Transformer reasoning model degrades earlier. The credibility depends on how cleanly the tasks isolate the intended primitives and how well the matching controls for capacity and training differences.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from the University of Bonn and the Lamarr Institute. It reads more like a controlled analysis paper than a top-lab large-scale training report.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改写路线图的论文，但若你在想“推理增强到底补了什么”，可只看任务构造和 sequential dependence 结果，别过度解读成架构定论。
recommendation.en: This will not rewrite your roadmap, but if you want to know what reasoning augmentation is actually buying, read the task design and the sequential-dependence results—just do not overread them as a final verdict on architecture.

institutions: Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
Lamarr Institute for ML and AI

paper.title: Process Supervision via Verbal Critique Improves Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Inference-time scaling for LLM reasoning has focused on three axes: chain depth, sample breadth, and learned step-scorers (PRMs). We introduce a fourth axis, granularity of external verbal supervision, via Verbal Process Supervision (VPS), a training-free framework that uses structured natural-language critique from a stronger supervisor to guide an iterative generate-critique-refine loop up to a round budget R. Across GPQA Diamond, AIME 2025, and LiveCodeBench V6 (covering both closed and open

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理时缩放仅关注链深度、采样宽度、步骤打分器三个维度，忽略了外部监督粒度对推理效果的提升作用
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出将口头批评粒度作为推理缩放的第四轴，设计了免训练的言语过程监督(VPS)框架
summary.technical_approach: VPS采用迭代生成-批评-优化循环，用更强 supervisor 输出的结构化自然语言批评引导弱模型迭代优化，直到达到预设轮次上限R
summary.experiments: GPQA Diamond上GPT-5.4 R=4时准确率达94.9%，超过现有最优结果；AIME 2025上弱模型分数从11.7-26.7%提升至63.3-90%；同等算力下比Reflexion高8.5-12.1分，比Self-Consistency@5高5-8.3个百分点
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Mindify AI Research

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference-time scaling only focuses on three dimensions: chain depth, sample breadth, step scorer, ignoring the improvement effect of external supervision granularity on reasoning performance
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first proposes verbal critique granularity as the fourth axis of reasoning scaling, designs the training-free Verbal Process Supervision (VPS) framework
summary_en.technical_approach: VPS adopts an iterative generate-critique-refine loop, uses structured natural language critique from a stronger supervisor to guide the weak model to iteratively optimize until reaching the preset round limit R
summary_en.experiments: GPT-5.4 achieves 94.9% accuracy on GPQA Diamond at R=4, surpassing existing SOTA; weak model scores on AIME 2025 increase from 11.7-26.7% to 63.3-90%; outperforms Reflexion by 8.5-12.1 points and Self-Consistency@5 by 5-8.3 pp under matched compute
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Mindify AI Research

recommendation.zh: 验证了细粒度口头批评对推理的提升作用，可作为后训练过程监督数据设计的参考，仅看摘要结论即可
recommendation.en: Verifies the improvement of fine-grained verbal critique on reasoning, can be referenced for process supervision data design in post-training, only read abstract conclusion

paper.title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framewo

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多智能体 LLM 系统中的通信接口是否应被学习，而不是固定为自然语言消息传递；核心问题是如何把 latent communication 与多轮协作推理联合优化。
summary.importance: 贡献在 agent 范式而非基座预训练。它有一点方法新意：把 agent 间通信从显式文本协议改成可训练的潜表示交换，并做参数高效监督训练。对研究内部表征、KV 级通信和 test-time collaboration 的人有参考价值，但离预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DiffMAS，把多智能体交互中的 latent trajectory 作为训练对象，允许 agent 通过内部表示如 KV cache 进行通信，并通过参数高效监督训练联合学习“如何编码信息”和“如何解释信息”。目标不是单个 agent 更强，而是让通信协议本身适配协作推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在数学推理、科学问答、代码生成和常识任务上，相比单 agent 推理、文本通信基线和其他 latent communication 方法，DiffMAS 在准确率和解码稳定性上都有提升。未见大规模预训练设置，实验更偏系统方法验证。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper asks whether communication in multi-agent LLM systems should be learned rather than fixed as natural-language message passing; the core problem is how to jointly optimize latent communication and collaborative reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in agent methodology rather than foundation-model pretraining. The main novelty is to replace explicit text-based protocols with trainable latent communication and optimize it with parameter-efficient supervision. It is relevant if you care about internal representations, KV-level communication, or test-time collaboration, but it is not central to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose DiffMAS, which treats multi-agent latent trajectories as the training target. Agents communicate through internal representations such as KV caches, and parameter-efficient supervised training jointly learns how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. The goal is to adapt the communication protocol itself to collaborative reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, DiffMAS improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based communication baselines, and prior latent-communication approaches on math reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks. There is no indication of large-scale pretraining; this is mainly a systems/method validation paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

recommendation.zh: 想看 agent 新接口可以扫一眼，但别把它误读成 pretrain 方法；只需看 latent trajectory 训练目标和与 text protocol 的对比表，判断是否真有信息带宽优势。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look if you care about new agent interfaces, but do not mistake it for a pretraining paper; read the latent-trajectory objective and the comparison against text protocols to judge whether there is real bandwidth gain.

paper.title: Efficient Test-Time Inference via Deterministic Exploration of Truncated Decoding Trees
paper.abstract: Self-consistency boosts inference-time performance by sampling multiple reasoning traces in parallel and voting. However, in constrained domains like math and code, this strategy is compute-inefficient because it samples with replacement, repeatedly revisiting the same high-probability prefixes and duplicate completions. We propose Distinct Leaf Enumeration (DLE), a deterministic decoding method that treats truncated sampling as traversal of a pruned decoding tree and systematically enumerates d

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 test-time scaling 里一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：self-consistency 通过并行采样多条推理链来换准确率，但在数学、代码这类可行解空间很窄的任务上，采样会反复落到相同高概率前缀和重复完成，导致算力花在“重复探索”上，而不是“扩大有效覆盖”。作者要解决的不是如何做更强的搜索，也不是训练一个额外的 verifier，而是在给定截断采样规则和固定 token 预算下，怎样系统地枚举更多互不重复、且仍然位于高概率区域的候选解。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练目标，而在推理时 compute allocation 的设计。它给出一个清楚的判断：当后训练模型分布变尖、top-p/min-p 截断后有效分支数很小，随机采样并不是高效的 test-time compute 使用方式。DLE 把“多采样”改成“确定性覆盖截断树中的不同叶子”，说明在 constrained reasoning 场景里，覆盖率比采样独立性更关键。这个结论对后续做 inference-time scaling、reasoning search、prefix reuse、以及训练时是否要鼓励更平滑或更可探索的分布，都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把截断采样后的生成过程显式看成一棵被剪枝的解码树。每个前缀节点只保留满足截断规则的 active set，例如 top-p、min-p、epsilon-sampling 下留下的 token；整条序列在这个截断分布下有一个路径概率。传统 self-consistency 是在这棵树上“有放回”采样，所以会重复访问同一前缀甚至同一叶子。DLE 改成确定性地枚举 distinct leaves：每次选择尚未访问的高优先级分支，保证不会生成重复完整轨迹。

从机制上看，它和 beam search 不一样。beam search 在每一步维护多个部分序列，目标是局部保留高分前缀，容易出现低多样性和大 beam 退化；DLE 不追求逐步保留一组 beam，而是直接在截断树上做叶子级枚举。它也不同于 without-replacement sampling，因为目标不是逼近某个采样分布，而是提高固定预算下的搜索空间覆盖。和 tree-of-thought 类方法相比，它不引入额外评估器、反思步骤或额外 LM 调用，仍然是单模型解码，只是改变了分支遍历顺序。

论文里另一个重要点是 prefix reuse。因为 DLE 在树上扩展而不是独立重采样，它不会重复生成已经出现过的共享前缀。系统实现上可以缓存前缀状态，只为新分支生成新增 token。这样带来两层收益：算法层面，更多预算用于未探索分支；系统层面，减少重复 token 生成，尤其在 memory-bound 推理环境下更容易转成实际延迟收益。作者还把 coverage 作为中间分析指标，强调更高的截断树概率质量覆盖与更好的最终任务表现相关，这比只报 pass@k 或 accuracy 更能解释方法为何有效。
summary.experiments:
实验重点围绕三件事：覆盖率、任务表现、以及 token/时间效率。文中先用代码生成前缀统计说明重复问题确实存在：多条采样轨迹中约 20% 的 prefix tokens 是重复的，且示例里 5 条生成有 3 条完全相同、4 条共享前缀，说明 self-consistency 的预算有相当部分浪费在重复路径上。

在算法分析上，作者比较了 DLE 与随机 self-consistency 在相同 token 预算下对截断搜索空间的覆盖。结论是 DLE 能覆盖更多未访问的高概率叶子，因此在相同预算下拿到更高的 probability mass coverage。论文把这件事和下游性能联系起来：覆盖越高，数学与代码任务上的最终正确率越好。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但主结论很明确：DLE 在 equal token budget 下优于随机多采样；如果按相同候选数比较，它还能用更少新生成 token 达到相近或更好的效果。

系统层面，作者强调 DLE 的优势在 memory-constrained 条件下更明显。原因不是单步算子更快，而是共享前缀减少了重复 decode，能在同样预算下完成更多完整序列，或者在相同性能下减少总生成 token。这个点对大模型 serving 很实际：当瓶颈在 KV cache 和带宽而不是纯算力时，prefix reuse 的收益会比理论 FLOPs 节省更容易兑现。

从实验设计看，论文不是在证明 DLE 绝对优于所有搜索方法，而是在一个更窄但常见的设定里证明：若你本来就会用 top-p/min-p 之类截断采样做 self-consistency，那么把“随机有放回采样”换成“确定性无重复叶子枚举”通常更划算。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三部分。第一，看 Introduction 和前两张图，理解作者为什么把问题表述成“重复访问截断树的高概率前缀”，这是整篇文章最关键的建模视角。第二，看方法部分里 truncated distribution、coverage 定义和 DLE 枚举策略，重点想清楚它为何不等同于 beam search，也不等同于 without-replacement sampling。第三，看实验中 coverage 与任务准确率的关系，以及 token efficiency / latency 的结果，这决定了方法是否只是一个搜索技巧，还是确实改变了 test-time compute 的利用方式。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想判断是否值得复现，优先看算法伪代码、prefix reuse 的实现说明，以及 math/code 两类任务上的主表。若想深一点，可以追问两个问题：一是 DLE 的收益是否依赖后训练模型分布过尖；二是当模型温度更高、有效分支更多时，确定性枚举是否仍优于随机采样。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific inefficiency in test-time scaling: self-consistency improves reasoning by sampling multiple traces, but in narrow-solution domains such as math and code, many samples collapse onto the same high-probability prefixes and even identical completions. The real problem is not lack of search depth, but wasted budget from sampling with replacement. The paper asks how to explore more useful candidates under a fixed token budget when decoding already uses a truncated distribution such as top-p or min-p.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not in pretraining per se, but in how it reframes inference-time compute allocation. The main takeaway is that once post-trained models become sharp and truncation leaves only a small active set at each step, random multi-sampling is often a poor use of extra compute. Deterministic coverage of distinct leaves can be better than stochastic independence. That matters for reasoning-time scaling, search over model outputs, prefix-sharing systems, and even for thinking about whether post-training is making distributions too peaky for efficient exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Distinct Leaf Enumeration (DLE), treats truncated decoding as traversal of a pruned generation tree. At each prefix, only tokens surviving a truncation rule remain in the active set. A full completion corresponds to a leaf with probability given by the product of truncated conditional probabilities along the path. Standard self-consistency samples from this tree with replacement, so it repeatedly revisits the same prefixes and leaves. DLE instead deterministically enumerates distinct leaves, prioritizing unexplored high-probability branches and guaranteeing no duplicate full traces.

This is importantly different from several nearby ideas. It is not beam search: beam search keeps multiple partial hypotheses at every step and is known to suffer from degeneration and low diversity as beam width grows. DLE does not optimize a beam frontier; it enumerates leaf-level completions in the truncated tree. It is also not sampling without replacement in the probabilistic sense, because it does not aim to preserve a target sampling distribution. And unlike tree-of-thought style methods, it does not add verifier calls, reflection steps, or extra model evaluations. It remains a single-model decoding procedure with a different traversal policy.

A second key contribution is prefix reuse. Because DLE expands a shared tree rather than independently resampling complete traces, it never regenerates an already explored prefix. This gives both an algorithmic gain and a systems gain: more of the budget goes to novel branches, and fewer new tokens need to be decoded for the same number of candidate completions. The paper also introduces coverage of the truncated search space as an analysis metric, arguing that better probability-mass coverage explains downstream gains more directly than raw sample count.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three claims: DLE increases coverage, improves downstream performance under equal budget, and reduces redundant generation. The paper first establishes that redundancy is real. In code generation, around 20% of prefix tokens are repeated across sampled traces, and qualitative examples show multiple identical completions among only a handful of samples.

On the algorithmic side, DLE is compared against stochastic self-consistency under matched token budgets. The central result is that DLE covers more of the truncated search space, especially previously unvisited high-probability branches. That increased coverage is then linked to better task outcomes on constrained reasoning tasks such as math and code. The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, but the paper’s main empirical claim is clear: at equal token budgets, deterministic distinct-leaf exploration outperforms repeated stochastic sampling.

On the systems side, DLE generates fewer new tokens because shared prefixes are reused rather than regenerated. This matters most in memory-bound settings, where avoiding repeated decode over common prefixes can translate into lower latency or more completed candidates under the same serving budget. The paper is careful not to claim universal superiority over all search methods; the claim is narrower and more practical: if one already uses truncated sampling for self-consistency, replacing random sampling-with-replacement by deterministic distinct-leaf enumeration is often a better use of inference compute.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the motivating figures carefully; the paper’s main contribution is the reframing of repeated sampling as redundant traversal of a truncated decoding tree. Second, read the method section around the truncated distribution, the definition of coverage, and the DLE procedure. The important question is why this is neither beam search nor standard without-replacement sampling. Third, inspect the experiments that connect coverage to task accuracy and the ones reporting token efficiency or latency.

Estimated reading time is 20 to 30 minutes. If deciding whether to reproduce it, prioritize the algorithm description, the implementation details for prefix reuse, and the main math/code result tables. Two useful follow-up questions while reading are: how much the gains depend on post-trained models being overconfident, and whether deterministic enumeration still helps when temperature is higher and the effective branching factor grows.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改一点你对 self-consistency 的默认做法：别再把重复采样当成天然基线，先看树遍历 formulation 和 prefix reuse 的系统收益，再决定要不要内化到推理栈里。
recommendation.en: This should update your default on self-consistency: repeated sampling is a weak baseline once you view decoding as tree traversal; read the formulation and the prefix-reuse results before locking in your inference stack.

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

paper.title: GRPO-VPS: Enhancing Group Relative Policy Optimization with Verifiable Process Supervision for Effective Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by leveraging direct outcome verification instead of learned reward models. Building on this paradigm, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) eliminates the need for critic models but suffers from indiscriminate credit assignment for intermediate steps, which limits its ability to identify effective reasoning strategies and incurs overthinking. In this work, we introdu

summary.core_problem: RLVR范式下的GRPO算法无需训练critic模型，但对推理轨迹的中间步骤采用无差别信用分配，将轨迹级优势均匀传递给所有token，导致样本效率偏低，模型易出现过度思考，无法有效学习最优推理策略。
summary.importance: 为RL推理对齐提供了低 overhead 的细粒度过程监督方案，无需引入额外辅助奖励模型或蒙特卡洛采样，仅用模型自身对正确答案的置信度变化即可生成过程监督信号，可降低RL训练 pipeline 复杂度，提升样本效率。
summary.technical_approach: 首先采用自适应熵切分策略，在推理轨迹的高不确定性token位置做切分，将整条轨迹拆分为多个语义连贯的推理段；随后在每个段的边界拼接正确答案，计算模型对正确答案的条件概率，用相邻段的概率差值作为每个推理段的贡献度信号，与原有轨迹级优势融合为混合优势信号，用于GRPO的策略更新。
summary.experiments: 数学推理基准上，相比原生GRPO，在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上Pass@1最高提升2.6个点，7B版本提升1.1个点，同时推理长度减少11.0%~13.7%，表现优于依赖蒙特卡洛rollout的GRPO变种；通用推理基准上，MMLUPro提升1.8个点，TheoremQA提升2.4个点。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法框架和核心实验结果表，无需深究切分策略的参数细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) under the RLVR paradigm removes the need for critic models, but applies indiscriminate trajectory-level credit assignment to all intermediate reasoning tokens. This leads to low sample efficiency, overthinking behaviors, and limited ability to learn optimal reasoning strategies.
summary_en.importance: It provides a low-overhead fine-grained process supervision solution for RL reasoning alignment. No auxiliary reward models or Monte Carlo rollouts are required, as supervision signals are derived purely from the model's own confidence change on the correct answer, reducing RL pipeline complexity and improving sample efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, an adaptive entropy-based cutpoint partition strategy splits the full reasoning trajectory into semantically coherent segments at high-uncertainty token positions. Then the ground-truth answer is appended at the end of each segment to calculate the model's conditional probability of the correct answer. Probability differences between adjacent segments are used as segment-wise contribution signals, which are fused with original trajectory-level advantages to form hybrid advantages for GRPO policy updates.
summary_en.experiments: On math reasoning benchmarks, it achieves up to 2.6 Pass@1 improvement on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 1.1 improvement on the 7B variant over vanilla GRPO, while reducing reasoning length by 11.0% to 13.7%, outperforming GRPO variants relying on Monte Carlo rollouts. On general reasoning benchmarks, it gains 1.8 points on MMLUPro and 2.4 points on TheoremQA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (methodology framework) and core experiment result tables. No need to dig into minor parameter details of the segmentation strategy. Expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 免标注过程监督的GRPO改进方案可直接复现用于内部推理对齐实验，重点阅读第3章信用分配实现细节
recommendation.en: This annotation-free process supervision enhanced GRPO can be directly replicated for internal reasoning alignment experiments, focus on the credit assignment implementation in Section 3

paper.title: Differentiable Conformal Training for LLM Reasoning Factuality
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently hallucinate, limiting their reliability in critical applications. Conformal Prediction (CP) addresses this by calibrating error rates on held-out data to provide statistically valid confidence guarantees. Recent work extends CP to LLM factuality to filter out risky claims, ensuring that hallucination rates remain below a user-specified level (e.g., 10%). While prior methods treat claims independently, Coherent Factuality extends to multi-step reasoning by

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 多步推理中的事实性校准问题：如何在保持统计可靠性保证的同时，避免现有 conformal factuality 方法过度过滤正确结论。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与可靠性方向的方法改进。价值不在于提升预训练本身，而在于把不可微的推理事实性校准变成可学习目标，给“训练信号如何与可靠性约束结合”提供了一个较干净的例子。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 Coherent Factuality 出发，把基于依赖图的联合事实性验证做成可微松弛，提出 Differentiable Coherent Factuality（DCF）。核心点是：在保留原有 conformal guarantee 的前提下，让 claim scorer 可以端到端学习，而不是依赖手工设计打分器；同时显式建模推理链中 claim 与祖先 claim 的依赖关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在两个推理事实性基准上验证，重点结果是相较不可微方法，在高可靠性约束下减少对真实 claim 的误杀。未见模型参数量、训练数据规模和主 baseline 细节；从预训练研究员角度，更值得看的是 calibration-utility tradeoff，而不是绝对分数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses factuality calibration for multi-step LLM reasoning: how to retain statistical reliability guarantees without discarding too many true claims.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training reliability paper rather than a pretraining one. Its value lies in turning a non-differentiable conformal factuality procedure into a learnable objective, which is relevant if you care about how training signals interact with reliability constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from Coherent Factuality, the paper proposes Differentiable Coherent Factuality (DCF), a differentiable relaxation of dependency-graph-based factuality validation. The key idea is to preserve the original conformal guarantees while enabling end-to-end learning of claim scorers instead of relying on hand-crafted scoring rules, and to model dependencies between claims and their logical ancestors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on two reasoning factuality benchmarks, with the main gain being fewer true claims filtered out under high-reliability settings compared with the non-differentiable baseline. Model size, data scale, and baseline details are not visible here; for a pretraining researcher, the calibration-utility tradeoff is the main thing to inspect.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“可靠性约束”做成可微训练信号这件事值得记住；只看方法定义和高置信区间下的保真率曲线。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move from hard reliability filtering to a differentiable training signal is worth noting; read the method and the high-confidence retention curves.

paper.title: Where Reasoning Breaks: Logic-Aware Path Selection by Controlling Logical Connectives in LLMs Reasoning Chains
paper.abstract: While LLMs demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities, they remain fragile in multi-step logical deduction, where a single transition error can propagate through the entire reasoning chain, leading to unstable performance. In this work, we identify logical connectives as primary points of this structural fragility. Through empirical analysis, we show that connective tokens function as high entropy forking points, at which models frequently struggle to determine the correct logical direction.

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在多步逻辑推理中为何容易在局部转折处出错，并尝试定位 reasoning chain 中最脆弱的逻辑连接点。
summary.importance: 这属于推理机制与干预研究。价值不在于提出新的基座训练范式，而在于把 reasoning failure 具体落到 logical connectives 这一类 token 上，给后续训练信号设计或过程监督提供更细粒度的切入点。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先做经验分析，认为逻辑连接词是高熵分叉点，模型在这些位置更容易选错推理方向；随后提出多层干预框架，包括基于梯度的 logical steering，将内部表示推向更有效的推理子空间，以及 localized branching control 等局部路径选择机制，专门在逻辑关键节点上施加控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、任务集、提升幅度和对照基线，只能确认其评估重点是多步逻辑推理稳定性与路径选择正确率。由于缺少 clean setup 细节，当前更适合作为现象假说而非强证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLMs fail in multi-step logical reasoning and tries to localize the fragile points in reasoning chains to logical connectives.
summary_en.importance: This is a reasoning-mechanism and intervention paper. Its value is not a new foundation-model training paradigm, but a more granular hypothesis: reasoning failures may concentrate at connective tokens, which could inform future process supervision or training-signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first presents an empirical analysis arguing that logical connectives are high-entropy branching points where models often choose the wrong logical direction. It then proposes a multi-layer intervention framework, including gradient-based logical steering toward valid reasoning subspaces and localized branching control at logic-critical junctions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, gain magnitudes, or strong baselines. So at this stage it is better treated as a hypothesis-generating paper than a high-confidence empirical result.

recommendation.zh: 把 reasoning failure 归因到 connective token 这个角度有点意思，但证据看起来还薄；只看现象分析部分，别急着接受干预方法的因果解释。
recommendation.en: The connective-token hypothesis is interesting, but the evidence looks thin; read it for the failure analysis, not for a strong causal claim about the intervention.

paper.title: AgentV-RL: Scaling Reward Modeling with Agentic Verifier
paper.abstract: Verifiers have been demonstrated to enhance LLM reasoning via test-time scaling (TTS). Yet, they face significant challenges in complex domains. Error propagation from incorrect intermediate reasoning can lead to false positives for seemingly plausible solutions, while lacking external grounding makes verifiers unreliable on computation or knowledge-intensive tasks. To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Verifier, a framework that transforms reward modeling into a multi-turn, tool-augme

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 verifier 在复杂推理任务中容易被错误中间步骤误导、且缺乏外部 grounding 导致奖励信号不可靠的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作重要之处不在于又做了一个 verifier，而是把 reward modeling 从单步打分器改成了多轮、可调用工具、前后向交叉核验的 agentic 过程；对 RL 信号质量、test-time scaling、以及 post-train 反哺 pretrain 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic Verifier：由 forward agent 从前提追踪到结论，backward agent 从结论反查前提，形成双向 deliberation；同时允许工具调用来处理计算和知识密集型验证。进一步提出 AgentV-RL，通过主动探索和强化学习，让 verifier 学会在内部推理与外部工具之间自主切换。核心创新是把 verifier 训练成一个带策略的过程，而非静态 reward model。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整参数规模与基线细节，但聚焦复杂推理场景下 verifier 的可靠性提升，目标是增强 test-time scaling 的收益。实验应包含与传统 reward model / verifier 的比较，以及工具增强和双向核验的消融。由于摘要信息有限，具体提升幅度仍需看正文表格判断结论强度。
summary.authors_note: 复旦、华中科大与字节 Seed 联合工作。字节 Seed 近年在推理、agent、后训练和多模态方向持续有系统性投入。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the unreliability of current verifiers on hard reasoning tasks, where wrong intermediate steps can look plausible and missing external grounding weakens reward signals.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not just another verifier, but a shift from static reward scoring to a multi-turn, tool-augmented, bidirectional verification process. That matters for reward quality, test-time scaling, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes an Agentic Verifier with complementary forward and backward agents: one traces reasoning from premises to conclusions, while the other checks conclusions back against premises. It also supports tool use for computation- and knowledge-heavy verification. AgentV-RL then trains this verifier via proactive exploration and reinforcement learning so it can decide when to reason internally versus invoke tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full model sizes or exact baselines, but the evaluation is aimed at complex reasoning settings where verifier reliability matters for test-time scaling. The key comparisons likely include standard reward models/verifiers and ablations on bidirectional checking and tool use. Exact effect sizes need the main tables to assess credibility.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration among Fudan, HUST, and ByteDance Seed. ByteDance Seed has been consistently active in reasoning, agentic systems, post-training, and multimodal foundation work.

recommendation.zh: 把 verifier 从“打分头”改成“会查证的策略体”这个方向是对的；先看方法图和 RL 训练细节，若 credit assignment 写得含糊，结论就当中等强度信号。
recommendation.en: The useful shift is treating the verifier as a policy that can investigate, not a scalar head; read the method figure and RL credit-assignment details first, or treat the gains as medium-strength evidence.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
ByteDance Seed 5 Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University
Shanghai Key Laboratory of Multimodal Embodied AI

paper.title: Beyond Distribution Sharpening: The Importance of Task Rewards
paper.abstract: Frontier models have demonstrated exceptional capabilities following the integration of task-reward-based reinforcement learning (RL) into their training pipelines, enabling systems to evolve from pure reasoning models into sophisticated agents. However, debate persists regarding whether RL genuinely instills new skills within a base model or merely sharpens its existing distribution to elicit latent capabilities. To address this dichotomy, we present an explicit comparison between distribution

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：LLM 的 RL post-training 到底是在学习新的任务行为，还是只是在把基座模型原本就有的高概率输出进一步“压尖”。作者没有停留在概念争论，而是把两种机制放进同一个 KL-regularized RL 框架里做可控比较：一类目标只做 distribution sharpening，另一类目标直接优化 task reward，再加上两者混合。核心问题不是“RL 有没有用”，而是“task reward 这个训练信号是否提供了超出分布重加权的增益，以及这种增益在什么条件下出现”。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的意义很直接。若 RL 的收益主要来自 sharpening，那么能力上限更多由 pretrain 分布决定，后训练只是做 mode selection；若 task reward 能稳定带来额外收益，那么 reward design、credit assignment 和探索机制就仍然是能力扩展的关键。全文给出的结论偏向后者：在基座模型本身成功率较低、任务更难的区域，单纯 sharpening 很快触顶，甚至会因为把概率质量压到错误模式上而变得不稳定；而 reward optimization 能把策略推向 base model 低概率但高回报的区域。这对理解“RL 是否真的创造新能力”很有帮助，也解释了为什么一些推理增强不能被简单归结为 inference-time reranking。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上的优点是控制变量做得比较干净。作者从标准的 KL 正则 RL 目标出发：一项是对采样输出的任务奖励，另一项是相对 reference policy 的 KL 约束。这个框架下，改变 reward 的定义和权重，就能得到三类训练目标。第一类是纯 task-reward optimization，直接用任务成败或正确性信号驱动策略更新；第二类是 distribution sharpening，把“更像 reference model 的高置信输出”当作优化对象，本质是对已有分布做温度收缩或重加权；第三类是两者结合。论文的重要点不只是实验比较，还给了一个一阶原理层面的分析：sharpening 的最优解依赖 base distribution 的模式位置，如果 base model 把大量概率放在系统性错误但自洽的解上，sharpening 会进一步放大这种偏差；而且该目标对初始分布形状很敏感，容易出现不利最优点和训练不稳定。相对地，task reward 的最优策略由外部任务信号定义，不必受限于 reference policy 的主模态，只要 KL 系数不过强，就有机会把概率质量迁移到原本低概率但正确的轨道上。作者还强调，两种方法都通过同一种 RL 优化器实现，因此差异主要来自目标本身，而不是 PPO/GRPO 一类算法细节。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，实验主要放在数学推理任务，并且刻意覆盖不同难度区间，用来观察 base performance 高低对两类目标的影响。结论很清楚：简单任务上，sharpening 有时能拿到一定收益，因为正确解本来就在高概率区域；但任务一旦变难、基座模型初始成功率下降，reward-based RL 会持续超过 sharpening，而且差距会扩大。作者还把训练式 sharpening 与 inference-time sharpening baseline 做了对照，说明“只靠把分布压尖”很难替代显式任务奖励。消融层面，关键变量是 KL 强度、reward 与 sharpening 的混合比例、任务难度，以及是否使用纯 reward 或纯 sharpening。虽然当前给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模，无法可靠复述具体百分点提升，但实验叙事已经足够支持一个判断：收益不是来自统一训练框架，而是来自 task reward 改变了最优策略所在的位置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Background，重点抓住作者如何把“distribution sharpening”和“task-reward RL”写成同一目标族。然后直接看理论分析部分，尤其是关于 sharpening 最优点为何可能不利、为何会不稳定的推导，这部分决定了整篇文章是否成立。实验部分建议优先看按任务难度分组的主结果图，以及 KL 系数和目标混合比例的消融。阅读时要特别留意两点：一是作者如何定义 sharpening 对应的 reward/目标，避免把它和普通 entropy reduction 混为一谈；二是实验是否真正控制了优化器、采样和 reference model，确保比较公平。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；若关心 RL 是否能带来“超出 pretrain 分布”的能力迁移，再花时间细看理论推导。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: when RL post-training improves an LLM, is it actually learning task-relevant behavior, or merely sharpening the model’s existing distribution and making latent preferences more confident? Instead of treating this as a philosophical debate, the authors place both views inside the same KL-regularized RL framework and compare them under matched optimization. The real target is to isolate whether task reward provides a signal beyond distribution reweighting, and when that extra signal matters.
summary_en.importance: This matters for the pretrain–post-train interface. If most gains come from sharpening, then post-training is largely mode selection on top of a fixed pretrained distribution, and capability ceilings are mostly set by pretraining. If explicit task reward consistently helps beyond sharpening, then reward design, exploration, and credit assignment remain central to capability growth. The paper argues for the latter, especially on harder tasks where the base model is weak. In those regimes, sharpening tends to saturate or even amplify wrong modes, while reward optimization can move probability mass toward low-likelihood but high-reward behaviors. That is a useful correction to the view that RL gains are just inference-time confidence amplification.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main strength is the controlled setup. Starting from the standard KL-regularized RL objective for LLM fine-tuning, the authors vary the optimized signal while keeping the training machinery fixed. This yields three regimes: pure task-reward optimization, pure distribution sharpening, and a hybrid of the two. The sharpening objective is framed as concentrating mass around outputs already preferred by the reference or base policy, while the reward objective is anchored in external task success. The paper also provides a first-principles analysis of why sharpening can fail: its optimum is tied to the geometry of the base distribution, so if the model already assigns high mass to coherent but wrong solutions, sharpening reinforces that error. The objective can also be unstable because small distributional biases get amplified. By contrast, task reward defines an optimum that is not restricted to the dominant modes of the reference policy. As long as the KL penalty is not too strong, RL can shift mass toward trajectories that were initially unlikely but correct. An important methodological point is that both paradigms are optimized with the same RL pipeline, so the observed differences are attributed to the objective, not to optimizer choice or training recipe.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full text, the experiments focus on mathematical reasoning tasks with varying difficulty, specifically to test how the two objectives behave as base-model success rate drops. The qualitative result is consistent: on easier tasks, sharpening can help because correct solutions already lie in relatively high-probability regions; on harder tasks, reward-based RL outperforms sharpening by a growing margin. The paper also compares training-based sharpening against inference-time sharpening baselines, showing that simply concentrating probability mass is not enough to match explicit task-reward optimization. The key ablations appear to vary KL strength, the mixture between reward and sharpening terms, and task difficulty. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, model sizes, or dataset scales, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains. Still, the experimental pattern is clear enough: the benefit comes from changing the target optimum through task reward, not from the shared RL training loop itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, start with the Introduction and Background to understand how the paper formalizes sharpening and task-reward RL within one objective family. Then go straight to the theoretical section explaining why sharpening can have unfavorable optima and why it may be unstable; that section carries most of the paper’s conceptual weight. In the experiments, prioritize the main results broken down by task difficulty, then the ablations over KL coefficient and objective mixing. Two details deserve close attention: how exactly the paper operationalizes “distribution sharpening,” and whether the comparison truly controls for optimizer, sampling, and reference policy. A solid skim should take about 25–35 minutes. If your interest is whether RL can move a model beyond its pretrained distribution rather than just expose latent competence, the theory section is the part to read carefully.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它正面拆“RL 只是把 base model 采样变尖”这个偷懒解释；先看理论部分和对照表，若控制变量做得干净，会直接影响你怎么看 R1 类训练信号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it directly tests the lazy prior that RL only sharpens sampling; read the theory section and the main comparison table first—if the controls are clean, it changes how you interpret R1-style reward signals.

paper.title: Transformer Layers as Painters
paper.abstract:
ML, Biotech, Hardware, and Coordination Problems. Sometimes I write about hard problems and how to solve them.

summary.core_problem: 文章讨论一个很具体但不寻常的问题：Transformer 的不同层是否承担了相对稳定的功能分工，以及能否利用这种分工，在不训练、不改权重的前提下直接改造模型能力。作者从 Base64 输入也能完成推理这一现象出发，提出早层负责“读入/翻译”、中层负责抽象推理、晚层负责“写出/重编码”的三段式假设，并据此做层复制实验。
summary.key_insights: 最有信息量的部分不是榜单结果本身，而是“中层可重复、前后层不可乱动”这个结构性观察。作者在 Qwen2-72B 上复制一段中间 7 层后，声称无需训练就能显著提升综合评测表现；这说明部分 Transformer 层更像可重复应用的迭代计算，而不是严格一次性的深度堆叠。对基座研究的启发在于：层的功能并不均匀，深度可能存在可重参数化空间，模型容量与推理步数之间的边界也许比常规架构设定更松。
summary.limits: 证据主要来自作者自建探针、少量基准和 leaderboard 结果，缺少系统 ablation、训练时对照和更严格的统计验证。榜单提升也可能混入评测选择、解码设置或特定模型家族偶然结构。作为机制假说很有意思，但离“普适规律”还有距离。

summary_en.core_problem: This post asks whether transformer layers have a stable functional anatomy, and whether that structure can be exploited to improve a model without any training or weight updates. Starting from the odd observation that older LLMs can reason through Base64 inputs, the author proposes a three-phase view: early layers parse surface form, middle layers operate on abstract meaning, and late layers render outputs back into token space.
summary_en.key_insights: The main takeaway is not the leaderboard anecdote but the structural claim: duplicating a specific middle-layer block helps, while tampering with early or late layers does not. On Qwen2-72B, repeating seven middle layers reportedly improved benchmark performance with zero retraining. For pretraining researchers, the interesting implication is that depth may contain reusable iterative computation, and layer roles are not uniformly distributed across the stack.
summary_en.limits: The evidence is still blog-level: custom probes, limited benchmarks, and no fully controlled experimental package. It is unclear how much of the gain is robust across model families, decoding settings, and evaluation suites. Useful as a hypothesis generator, not yet as a settled architectural result.
