recommendation.zh: 会改变我对RLVR更新应落在哪些token的prior：用熵定位“分叉点”并重加权很可复现，建议立刻在内部GRPO跑同款诊断图。
recommendation.en: This shifts my prior on where RLVR gradients should land: entropy pinpoints branching tokens and reweighting is easy to reproduce—worth immediately replicating their diagnostic plots on your GRPO runs.

paper.title: Learning from Contrasts: Synthesizing Reasoning Paths from Diverse Search Trajectories

summary.core_problem: 现有基于 MCTS 的自动推理数据挖掘/监督提取大多采用“筛选式”范式：只保留最高奖励（正确）的单条轨迹用于训练（如 RFT），把大量被探索过但失败/次优的轨迹直接丢弃，导致对“为什么错、错在哪里、成功与失败的关键分岔点是什么”的结构性信息利用不足，数据与算力效率低。
summary.importance: 推理能力提升高度依赖高质量 CoT 数据规模，但人工标注昂贵；MCTS 能自动探索解空间，却在监督提取阶段浪费了绝大多数探索信号。若能把失败轨迹转化为可学习的“反例对比信号”，就可能在更小数据量下获得同等甚至更强的泛化，并减少搜索与训练成本。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 CRPS（Contrastive Reasoning Path Synthesis），把监督提取从“过滤”改为“合成”。核心是解耦的 explorer-analyst 架构：
1) Explorer（专门的推理模型）在 MCTS 中为每个问题生成多条完整轨迹集合，并对终止答案给二值奖励 r(τ)∈{0,1}；同时保留搜索统计量（尤其是 visit count N(s)/N(τ)）。
2) 正例锚点选择：从正确轨迹集合中选“最具代表性的高效推理”作为 τ+，优先最短长度 |τ|，若并列则选最大节点 Q-value（期望成功率）最高者，体现 explorer 内部最自信/最优的推理路径。
3) 负例采样（对比信号）：不把所有错误一视同仁，而是利用 MCTS 的访问次数分布挑选“hard negatives”——那些虽然错误但被 explorer 反复探索、visit count 高的轨迹，代表系统性偏差与易错模式；以 N(τ) 加权采样 τ−，让对比集中在模型真正“容易走偏”的分支。
4) 对比反思与显式化：Analyst（更强模型）对 (τ+, τ−) 做结构化对比，语言化总结成功的关键策略转折点（strategic pivots）与失败的局部错误模式（local failure modes），形成可复用的元认知提示/规则。
5) 推理链合成：Analyst 在上述洞见条件下，综合成功模式并显式规避失败模式，生成新的高质量 CoT 训练样本（不是简单复制 τ+，而是“吸收优点+避坑”的合成链）。
整体上，CRPS 把“多轨迹探索”转化为“密集监督”：同一题的多条轨迹差异被压缩为可学习的对比解释与更鲁棒的合成推理链。
summary.experiments: 论文在引言中给出关键结论：用 60K 条 CRPS 合成样本微调即可达到与 590K 条 rejection-sampled（仅保留最优轨迹）样本相当的效果，约 20× 数据量缩减；并观察到 CRPS 训练模型在 out-of-domain 基准上泛化更好。作者还声称跨多种 base model 验证，并且不仅在数学推理有效，也扩展到代码生成与常识推理任务（具体基准与数值细节需结合正文实验部分与图表）。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 先看 Introduction：把握“从过滤到合成”的问题定义与贡献点，以及 Figure 1/3（范式对比与数据效率结论）。
- 再看 Method 段落中三件事：正例锚点选择规则、基于 visit count 的 hard negative 采样、analyst 的对比反思→合成链路（Figure 2）。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读 Method：
  1) MCTS 统计量如何用于“信息量最大”的负例选择（N(s)/N(τ) 的含义、采样分布、为何能捕捉系统性偏差而非随机错）。
  2) τ+ 的“最短+最高 Q”准则对合成质量/偏差的影响（是否会偏向短链、是否牺牲可解释性）。
  3) Analyst 的结构化反思模板：如何定义 strategic pivots 与 local failure modes、输出如何条件化到最终合成 CoT。
- 对照 Figure 2（完整 pipeline）逐步核对：输入/输出、哪些信息从 explorer 传给 analyst、哪些是可训练监督。
- 重点关注实验中：
  1) 60K vs 590K 的对齐设置（同算力/同预算/同 base model？）与消融（去掉对比、去掉 visit-count hard negatives、只用 τ+ 等）。
  2) OOD 泛化提升来自哪里（是否因“避坑规则”更抽象、是否减少过拟合到单一路径）。
- 创新点抓手：把“失败轨迹”从噪声变成可解释的对比监督；用搜索分布（visit count）定义 hard negatives；explorer-analyst 解耦以兼顾探索效率与反思质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：MCTS 的价值不应止于找到一条正确路径，而在于它生成了大量“看似合理但错误”的对照样本；通过显式对比与反思，可以把这些对照压缩成更高密度、更可迁移的监督信号，从而显著降低所需训练数据量并提升跨域泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: Most MCTS-based reasoning data pipelines extract supervision via a selection/filtering paradigm: keep only the single best (highest-reward) trajectory (e.g., RFT) and discard the many explored but failed/suboptimal paths. This wastes the structural information contained in how successful strategies differ from plausible-but-wrong alternatives, leading to poor data/compute efficiency.
summary_en.importance: Reasoning performance scales strongly with high-quality CoT data, but human annotation is costly. While MCTS can explore solution spaces automatically, current extraction discards most exploration signals. Turning failures into contrastive, learnable signals can reduce required data and improve transfer/generalization while saving search/training cost.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CRPS (Contrastive Reasoning Path Synthesis) reframes supervision extraction from filtering to synthesis via a decoupled explorer–analyst design:
1) Explorer (a specialized reasoning model) runs MCTS to generate a set of complete trajectories per question, assigns binary terminal reward r(τ)∈{0,1}, and retains search statistics (notably visit counts N(s)/N(τ)).
2) Positive anchor selection: choose τ+ from correct trajectories to represent efficient reasoning—prefer minimal length |τ|; break ties by highest max node Q-value (expected success), reflecting the explorer’s strongest internal confidence.
3) Negative sampling for contrast: sample τ− from incorrect trajectories proportional to accumulated visit count N(τ), yielding hard negatives that the explorer was strongly attracted to (systematic biases), rather than random mistakes.
4) Contrastive reflection: a stronger Analyst model compares (τ+, τ−) to explicitly verbalize why τ+ succeeds and τ− fails, extracting strategic pivots and local failure modes.
5) Reasoning-chain synthesis: conditioned on these insights, the Analyst synthesizes a refined CoT that incorporates success patterns while explicitly avoiding identified pitfalls—producing dense, higher-quality training supervision than simply copying τ+.
summary_en.experiments: Key reported result (from the paper’s overview): fine-tuning on 60K CRPS-synthesized examples matches performance of training on 590K rejection-sampled examples (~20× dataset reduction). The authors also report better out-of-domain generalization, and claim robustness across multiple base models and beyond math (e.g., code generation and commonsense reasoning). Exact benchmark details and ablations should be verified in the full experimental section and figures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read Introduction for the motivation (“filtering → synthesis”), contributions, and Figure 1/3 (paradigm + data-efficiency headline).
- Read Method focusing on: τ+ selection rule, visit-count-based hard negative sampling, and the analyst reflection→synthesis pipeline (Figure 2).

【must_read】
- Deep-read Method:
  1) How MCTS statistics define informative contrasts (why N(τ) targets systematic failure modes).
  2) Implications of the “shortest + highest-Q” τ+ criterion (bias toward short chains, effect on quality).
  3) The structured reflection format: how pivots/failure modes are operationalized and fed into synthesis.
- Walk through Figure 2 step-by-step to track information flow from explorer to analyst and the final supervision artifact.
- In Experiments, prioritize: (i) fairness of the 60K vs 590K comparison (budget/model parity), (ii) ablations removing contrast, removing visit-count hard negatives, using only τ+, etc., and (iii) where OOD gains come from (more abstract ‘avoidance rules’ vs reduced overfitting).
- Innovation checklist: leveraging failures as explicit contrastive supervision; using search distribution (visit counts) to mine hard negatives; explorer–analyst decoupling for efficiency + high-quality introspection.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that MCTS is valuable not only for finding a correct path but for generating many compelling wrong paths; by explicitly contrasting success vs failure and synthesizing improved reasoning chains, one can obtain denser, more transferable supervision with far less data.

recommendation.zh: 看“失败轨迹如何转成对比监督”的构造细节：如果真能从 MCTS 的垃圾轨迹里榨出信号，你们的数据挖掘就该从筛选改为对比学习。
recommendation.en: Skim the construction turning failed search traces into contrastive supervision: if it reliably extracts signal from ‘trash’ MCTS trajectories, it’s a strong cue to shift mining from filtering to contrastive learning.

paper.title: TInR: Exploring Tool-Internalized Reasoning in Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 现有 Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) 依赖在推理时把工具文档塞进上下文：导致工具掌握困难（文档异构）、工具规模受限（context window 不够）、推理/调用低效（prompt 过长）。论文提出 Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR)：让模型在不提供外部文档的情况下完成带工具的推理与调用。
summary.importance: 如果工具知识能被“内化”到模型参数中，推理时无需携带冗长文档，可显著降低延迟与成本，并支持更大规模工具集合；同时减少检索-使用错配风险，使面向真实应用的工具调用更稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TInR-U：统一推理与工具使用的工具内化框架，三阶段训练管线：1) 工具内化（Tool internalization）：用“专用工具 token”承载每个工具，并用双向知识对齐让模型既能从文档映射到工具 token，也能从 token 反向回忆文档内容；同时加入工具使用训练以学习参数约束、调用格式等规则。2) TInR SFT warm-up：通过拒绝采样与格式化构造高可靠标注推理数据，对模型进行监督微调，使其学会在无外部文档条件下进行工具选择与调用编排。3) TInR RL：设计针对工具 token 的奖励，强化探索性工具推理与“推理-调用”协同，从而更深度融合工具使用能力与模型固有推理能力。整体交互形式为：每步先生成自然语言推理 r_j，必要时生成工具动作 a_j（选择工具 t 与参数 p），执行得到 o_j 并进入下一步。
summary.experiments: 在 in-domain 与 out-of-domain 两类设置评测 TInR 能力；论文报告在 out-of-domain 工具调用上相对提升 18.13%，并在两类设置均达到 SOTA。建议在实验部分重点核对：工具集合规模 N、是否与 TIR（带文档）在同等推理预算/上下文长度下对比、成功率/格式正确率/参数合法率等指标，以及 RL 奖励设计与消融（仅内化/仅 SFT/仅 RL）。
summary.reading_guide: skim（泛读）建议：1) Introduction + Figure 1：理解 TIR vs TInR 的差异与三大痛点；2) Methodology 总览：三阶段训练流程与“工具 token”机制；3) 实验主表：看 in/out-of-domain 的总体收益。must_read（精读）建议：1) 工具内化的双向对齐细节：token 设计、对齐目标、如何处理异构文档与规则（参数约束/调用格式）；2) SFT 数据构造：拒绝采样标准、格式模板、如何保证轨迹可靠且贴近 TInR；3) RL：奖励在工具 token 上如何定义（正确工具选择、参数合法、调用时机、最终任务成功等）、训练稳定性与探索策略；4) OOD 设定：新工具/新组合/新任务的划分方式，避免数据泄漏；5) 失败案例分析：工具幻觉、参数越界、过度/不足调用等。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调把“工具知识”从上下文外置（文档提示）转为参数内化（工具 token + 对齐训练），以解决可扩展性与效率问题；并通过 SFT+RL 让模型学会在推理过程中自然地触发与编排工具调用，从而实现无需文档的统一推理与工具使用。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) methods require tool documentation in-context during inference, which makes tool mastery hard (heterogeneous docs), limits tool-set size (context window), and increases latency/cost (long prompts). The paper studies Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR): enabling tool use without external documentation at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Internalizing tool knowledge into model parameters can reduce inference overhead, scale to larger tool sets, and avoid retrieval–usage mismatch, improving reliability for real-world tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: TInR-U is a unified framework for reasoning and tool usage with a three-phase training pipeline: (1) Tool internalization: assign dedicated tool tokens and perform bidirectional knowledge alignment—map documentation to tool tokens and reconstruct documentation from tokens—plus tool-usage training to learn strict calling rules (formats, parameter constraints). (2) TInR SFT warm-up: build reliable annotated reasoning trajectories via rejection sampling and formatting, then supervised fine-tune to use internalized tool knowledge during reasoning. (3) TInR RL: reinforcement learning with rewards designed on tool tokens to encourage exploratory tool reasoning and tighter coordination between reasoning and tool calls. The interaction alternates natural-language reasoning steps r_j and tool actions a_j (tool t with parameters p), consuming tool outputs o_j in subsequent steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings; the paper reports state-of-the-art results and a relative 18.13% improvement on out-of-domain tool calling. Readers should verify tool-set size, fairness of comparisons against TIR (with docs) under matched context/budget, metrics such as success rate/format correctness/parameter validity, and ablations for internalization vs SFT vs RL and reward design.
summary_en.reading_guide: skim: (1) Introduction + Figure 1 for TIR vs TInR framing; (2) Methodology overview for the three-stage pipeline and tool-token mechanism; (3) main results tables for in-/out-of-domain gains. must_read: (1) bidirectional alignment details (token design, objectives, handling heterogeneous docs and strict rules); (2) SFT data construction (rejection criteria, templates, reliability controls); (3) RL reward definition on tool tokens (tool choice, parameter legality, timing, final success) and training stability; (4) OOD protocol (new tools/tasks/compositions) and leakage checks; (5) failure analysis (tool hallucination, invalid params, over/under-calling).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ key idea is to move tool knowledge from external prompts into model parameters via dedicated tool tokens and alignment training, then use SFT+RL to make tool usage naturally coordinated with reasoning—achieving documentation-free tool reasoning at inference.

recommendation.zh: 只看工具规模扩展与去文档上下文的对比：若内化后仍能稳调用，动作项是把你们的工具说明从prompt迁到参数；否则就是记忆化噱头。
recommendation.en: Skim the scaling-to-many-tools and no-doc-context comparisons: if tool calls stay reliable, the action is moving tool specs from prompts into weights; otherwise it’s mostly memorization theater.

paper.title: Think in Sentences: Explicit Sentence Boundaries Enhance Language Model's Capabilities

summary.core_problem: 如何用极低成本的输入结构改造（显式句子边界）提升LLM推理与任务表现，并让模型更“按句处理”。
summary.importance: 方法创新/训练配方类工作：把“句子结构”作为可控的上下文与监督信号，属于对prompt与SFT数据格式的系统性改造；若结果稳定，可影响后训练数据构造与推理时格式规范。
summary.technical_approach: 在输入中显式插入句子边界分隔符（delimiter），提出两种落地方式：①in-context learning时对上下文按句切分并插入边界；②监督微调时用带句界的格式进行训练，使模型形成sentence-by-sentence的处理习惯（本质是结构化dummy token，但利用自然语言句法边界）。
summary.experiments: 覆盖7B模型到600B级DeepSeek-V3；在多任务上报告一致提升，GSM8K最高+7.7%，DROP最高+12.5%（摘要未给出更完整基线、训练步数与统计显著性细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether a minimal, low-cost input-format intervention—explicit sentence boundaries—can systematically improve language-model reasoning and task performance by encouraging sentence-by-sentence processing.
summary_en.importance: Suggests a simple, broadly applicable formatting/training recipe that treats sentence structure as a controllable context and supervision signal, with implications for prompt design and supervised fine-tuning data formatting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Insert explicit sentence-boundary delimiters: (1) in-context learning by segmenting demonstrations into sentences and adding boundary tokens; (2) supervised fine-tuning on boundary-marked text so the model learns to process and generate in sentence-aligned units.
summary_en.experiments: Reports consistent gains from 7B to 600B-scale models (including DeepSeek-V3), with up to +7.7% on GSM8K and +12.5% on DROP; the abstract provides limited details on training setup, baselines, and significance testing.

recommendation.zh: 像数据/格式配方：显式句界若真稳，最直接动作是改SFT模板与推理输出约束；但容易被评测prompt泄漏，知道结论即可，不必深挖正文。
recommendation.en: Feels like a formatting recipe: if explicit sentence boundaries are robust, the immediate action is to tweak SFT templates and decoding constraints; but it’s prone to eval/prompt confounds, so don’t deep-read.

paper.title: FACT-E: Causality-Inspired Evaluation for Trustworthy Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是CoT推理“看起来合理但过程不可信”的评估难题，尤其是链内不忠实（intra-chain unfaithfulness）：相邻推理步骤之间缺乏真实的逻辑依赖、夹杂错误内容，但模型/评审仍可能给出高分。作者指出传统LLM-as-judge容易受自我肯定等偏置影响，导致对链内因果依赖的判断出现伪相关。
summary.importance:
如果无法可靠区分“真正依赖的推理链”与“表面连贯的幻觉链”，那么：
- 选择/投票/自一致性等后处理会被不忠实链污染；
- 用CoT做可解释性或安全审计会产生误导；
- 用高质量链做in-context exemplars也会降低迁移与鲁棒性。
因此需要更稳健的CoT质量度量，既看答案一致性，也看步骤间的真实依赖。
summary.technical_approach:
must_read级别（详细技术分析）：
1) 目标分解：作者把“可信CoT”拆成两个维度联合评估：
- CoT-to-Answer Consistency：该推理链是否支持/蕴含最终答案（强调结果一致性）。
- Intra-Chain Faithfulness：链内相邻片段/步骤之间是否存在真实的依赖关系（强调过程忠实）。
2) 因果视角（SCM）：作者用结构因果模型来刻画“模型对链内忠实度的打分”会受到未观测偏置（如自我肯定、表面流畅度启发式）的影响，从而使“评估分数”与“真实依赖”之间出现混杂。
3) 工具变量思想（Instrumental Variable）：为削弱偏置带来的伪相关，FACT-E引入外部噪声/受控扰动作为工具信号，通过对比式设计来分离“真正的步骤依赖”与“偏置驱动的稳定高分”。直观上：如果两个相邻步骤确有因果/逻辑依赖，那么对前一步做特定扰动应系统性影响后一步的合理性/可支持性；若只是偏置（例如总觉得自己写得对），扰动前后评分变化会呈现不同模式。
4) 框架实现：FACT-E由两模块组成并联合打分，用于从候选CoT池中筛选：
- 一致性模块负责验证链对答案的支持程度；
- 链内忠实模块用“带噪对照/干预”的方式让LLM评审更关注step-to-step蕴含关系，而非整体观感。
（精读时应落到：扰动如何构造、评审提示如何写、分数如何聚合、以及与PNS/反事实类方法的差异。）
summary.experiments:
作者在数学与常识推理任务上验证FACT-E，实验围绕三类用途：
1) 通过选择更高FACT-E分数的推理链提升最终答题准确率（作为reranking/selection器）。
2) 用筛出的高质量链作为in-context exemplars，提升ICL效果。
3) 在噪声/缺陷注入条件下检测过程级失败（识别被污染或逻辑断裂的链），展示鲁棒性与可控性提升。
总体结论是FACT-E相对强基线具有竞争力，并能更好识别链内断裂而非只看答案。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：重点章节/图表/创新点）：
- Introduction：抓住问题定义（intra-chain unfaithfulness）与“闭环反馈谬误/自评偏置”的动机。
- Task Formulation with a Causal View：这是全文关键，理解SCM里哪些变量代表“真实依赖”、哪些代表“评审偏置”、工具变量如何进入。
- 方法细节章节（FACT-E两模块）：重点看扰动/噪声的构造方式、对比评估流程、以及最终分数的组合策略（联合考虑faithfulness与consistency）。
- 实验部分：优先看三类实验设置各自的指标定义与消融（没有工具变量/没有一致性模块/不同噪声强度）。
- 图表：重点看展示“传统自评无法区分CoT1/CoT2但FACT-E可以”的示例图（文中Figure 1提到的案例），以及噪声鲁棒性曲线。
- 创新点抓手：用工具变量式的外部噪声来对抗LLM评审偏置，把链内忠实度评估从“主观打分”变成“受控扰动下的依赖检验”。

skim（泛读建议）：
- 读Introduction + 方法总览段，记住FACT-E=一致性+链内忠实（带扰动的因果式评估）。
- 快速扫因果建模段落，理解他们为何需要外部噪声来破除自评偏置。
- 直接看实验主表：选择CoT提升准确率、ICL提升、噪声检测三块结果即可。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调：仅用“答案是否一致/是否正确”来评估CoT会忽视链内逻辑依赖；而让LLM自评又会被偏置污染。FACT-E的设计哲学是用受控扰动提供外生信号，迫使评估关注步骤间的真实影响关系，并与答案一致性联合，来筛选更可信的推理轨迹。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the evaluation of Chain-of-Thought reasoning when explanations look coherent but are process-unreliable. The key failure mode is intra-chain unfaithfulness: successive steps do not genuinely entail or depend on each other, yet LLM-based judges may still rate them highly due to biases (e.g., self-affirmation, fluency heuristics).
summary_en.importance: Without a reliable way to detect unfaithful chains, post-hoc selection (reranking, self-consistency), interpretability/safety auditing via CoT, and using CoTs as in-context exemplars can all be misled by persuasive-but-broken rationales. A trustworthy metric should assess both answer support and step-to-step dependence.
summary_en.technical_approach:
must_read (detailed technical analysis):
1) Two-dimensional quality: FACT-E evaluates CoT quality via (i) CoT-to-Answer Consistency (does the chain support the final answer?) and (ii) Intra-Chain Faithfulness (are adjacent segments truly dependent/entailed?).
2) Causal framing (SCM): the authors model the judge score as influenced by an unobserved bias/confounder, which can induce spurious correlation between “high score” and “true faithfulness.”
3) Instrumental-variable idea: FACT-E introduces external noise / controlled perturbations as an instrumental signal in a contrastive design to separate genuine step-to-step dependence from bias-driven artifacts. Intuition: if step B truly depends on step A, perturbing A should systematically affect the judged validity/support of B; if the judge is dominated by bias, scores remain artificially stable or change in a non-causal pattern.
4) Practical framework: FACT-E implements two modules and combines their scores to select trustworthy trajectories from a candidate pool. For deep reading, focus on how perturbations are constructed, how the judge prompts are designed, and how scores are aggregated and ablated.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans math and commonsense reasoning tasks and tests three use cases: (1) improving final answer accuracy by selecting higher FACT-E-scored chains; (2) improving in-context learning by using selected chains as exemplars; (3) detecting process-level failures under noisy/perturbed conditions, demonstrating robustness. Results indicate FACT-E is competitive with strong baselines and better at identifying step-to-step breaks beyond answer-centric checks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep reading):
- Introduction: motivation around intra-chain unfaithfulness and judge bias / closed-loop fallacy.
- Task Formulation with a Causal View: the core section—understand the SCM variables, where bias enters, and how the instrumental noise is used.
- Method details (two modules): focus on perturbation/noise design, contrastive evaluation procedure, and score combination.
- Experiments: prioritize metrics and ablations (no IV/no consistency module/noise strength variations).
- Figures: the illustrative example where standard self-eval fails but FACT-E succeeds (the Figure 1 case), plus robustness curves under noise.
- Key novelty: using IV-style external perturbations to counteract LLM judge bias, turning faithfulness scoring into a controlled dependence test.

skim (quick pass):
- Read Introduction + method overview to remember FACT-E = consistency + perturbation-based intra-chain faithfulness.
- Skim the causal section for the rationale of external noise.
- Jump to the main result tables for the three experimental settings.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ main message is that answer-centric evaluation misses broken internal dependencies, while LLM self-judging is biased. FACT-E injects exogenous signals via controlled perturbations to make faithfulness assessment more causally grounded, and combines it with answer consistency to select more trustworthy reasoning trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 想评CoT“步骤真依赖”而非顺口胡编时可参考，但因果味评测也容易被任务分布影响；只看评测协议与对LLM-judge偏置的对照实验。
recommendation.en: If you care about whether CoT steps actually depend on each other (not just sound coherent), this is a useful eval idea, though distribution effects may dominate; read the protocol and the judge-bias controls.

paper.title: When More Thinking Hurts: Overthinking in LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling

summary.core_problem: 论文质疑“推理越长越好”的默认假设，系统研究在测试时计算（test-time compute）随推理token预算增加时，额外推理的边际收益如何变化，并重点刻画一种反直觉现象：推理变长反而把原本正确的答案“想错了”（overthinking）。
summary.importance: 该问题直接影响推理型LLM的部署成本与可靠性：1）长链推理显著增加推理成本（例如8k token相对500 token是数量级差异）；2）若存在高预算下性能回落，则“统一给足预算”的评测与产品策略会同时浪费算力并降低准确率；3）需要新的、成本感知的评测方式与自适应停止策略来同时优化准确率-成本前沿（efficiency frontier）。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上围绕“边际效用 + 翻转事件（flip）追踪”建立分析框架。1）预算控制：用budget forcing强制模型在指定token预算t下输出（若提前结束则追加‘Wait’类token，达到预算后强制结束思考分隔符），在[500,16000]、步长500上扫描。2）边际效用MU(t)：定义为Acc(t+Δt)-Acc(t)（Δt=500），MU>0表示多想有益，MU<0表示多想有害（过度思考）。3）逐题轨迹追踪：对每题记录不同预算下的预测答案ŷ_i(t)，定义相邻预算间答案变化为flip，并区分错误→正确（positive flip）与正确→错误（negative flip）。用flip ratio（负翻/正翻）衡量在某预算区间“想多了更可能变坏还是变好”，flip ratio>1提示过度思考占主导。4）过度思考信号：从推理文本与token级logprob构造可观测指标，包括犹豫标记（wait/but/actually等）、中间结论振荡（答案多次改口）、置信度轨迹（上升/下降/波动），用于早停或风险提示的启发式依据。5）成本感知评测：主张除准确率曲线外报告效率前沿（在给定成本下的最优准确率），并强调“何时停止思考”应成为核心评测维度。
summary.experiments: 模型：DeepSeek-R1-32B与s1-32B（同为32B，便于对比训练差异）。数据：AIME 2024/2025（共60题）、MATH-500（带Level 1-5难度标注，用于难度分层）、GPQA Diamond（198题，检验数学外泛化）。设置：预算500到16000、每500一个点（每题32个预算点），temperature=0确定性输出；记录最终答案、正确性、完整推理trace、token级logprob；vLLM在4×H100上运行。主要发现：1）显著边际收益递减：早期预算段MU为正且较大，预算升高后MU趋近0并在高预算（文中提到12K后）转负；2）难度决定最优思考长度：易题（Level 1-2）在约1.5K token附近达到峰值，难题（Level 5）可受益到约8K，说明统一预算分配明显次优；3）在GPQA上两模型准确率随预算先升后降，峰值约在10K附近，之后因过度思考回落；4）flip事件分析揭示性能回落来自“正确→错误”的负翻增多（模型放弃原本正确答案），而非仅仅是收益饱和。
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Introduction：抓住论文要推翻的隐含单调性假设，以及为何成本与可靠性使‘停止规则’成为核心问题；(2) Methods：重点精读MU(t)定义、budget forcing细节、flip event分类与flip ratio含义——这是全文贡献的度量骨架；(3) 实验结果中关于‘高预算转负’与‘难度分层最优预算不同’的部分：优先看Table 1（边际效用分段统计）与Figure 1（按难度的最优预算/曲线差异）；(4) GPQA对比（Figure 3）：理解“非数学任务也出现先升后降”的外推证据；(5) 过度思考信号：关注作者如何从文本犹豫/振荡与置信度轨迹提出可操作的早停线索。skim（泛读）：(1) 先读Introduction+Methods的MU/flip定义；(2) 直接看AIME/MATH难度分层结论与GPQA曲线（Table 1、Figure 1、Figure 3）；(3) 最后扫一遍成本感知评测与效率前沿的主张，理解论文对后续评测范式的建议。
summary.authors_note: 作者核心立场是：测试时计算扩展并非单调收益，存在可量化的‘过度思考’区间；因此研究与产品应从“给更多token”转向“按题自适应分配预算并及时停止”，并在报告中加入成本-准确率效率前沿与flip驱动的诊断分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper challenges the implicit assumption that longer chains-of-thought always improve reasoning. It systematically studies how the marginal utility of additional reasoning tokens changes with larger test-time compute budgets, and characterizes an “overthinking” regime where extended reasoning makes models abandon previously correct answers.
summary_en.importance: This matters for both cost and reliability in deployment: (1) long reasoning traces are expensive (e.g., 8k vs 500 tokens is an order-of-magnitude cost gap); (2) if accuracy peaks and then declines, uniform large budgets waste compute and can reduce accuracy; (3) evaluation should become cost-aware and focus on adaptive stopping policies and accuracy–cost efficiency frontiers, not just accuracy-at-max-budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis is built on “marginal utility + flip-event tracking.” (1) Budget control via budget forcing: if the model tries to stop early, append ‘Wait’-style tokens; once the budget is reached, force-decode the end-of-thinking delimiter. Budgets are swept from 500 to 16,000 tokens in 500-token steps. (2) Marginal utility MU(t)=Acc(t+Δt)−Acc(t) with Δt=500; MU>0 means extra thinking helps, MU<0 indicates harmful overthinking. (3) Per-problem trajectory tracking: record predicted answer ŷ_i(t) at each budget; define flips between consecutive budgets and classify them as positive (incorrect→correct) or negative (correct→incorrect). The flip ratio (negative/positive) diagnoses whether additional compute is more likely to hurt than help at a given budget (ratio>1 suggests overthinking dominates). (4) Overthinking indicators from traces: hesitation markers (“wait”, “but”, “actually”, “reconsider”), answer oscillations (intermediate conclusion changes), and confidence trajectories derived from token-level log-probabilities—intended as signals for early stopping. (5) Cost-aware evaluation: the paper argues for reporting efficiency frontiers (best achievable accuracy at a given cost) alongside standard accuracy curves.
summary_en.experiments: Models: DeepSeek-R1-32B and s1-32B (both 32B, enabling controlled comparison). Benchmarks: AIME 2024/2025 (60 problems), MATH-500 with difficulty Levels 1–5, and GPQA Diamond (198) for non-math generalization. Protocol: budgets 500–16,000 with 500-step increments (32 points per problem), temperature=0; log final answers, correctness, full traces, and token-level logprobs; run with vLLM on 4×H100. Key findings: (1) strong diminishing returns—early budgets yield sizable gains, but MU approaches zero and becomes negative at high budgets (noted beyond ~12k); (2) optimal thinking length depends on difficulty—easy problems peak around ~1.5k tokens while hardest ones benefit up to ~8k, making uniform allocation suboptimal; (3) on GPQA, accuracy also peaks (~10k) then declines, showing overthinking beyond math; (4) flip analysis attributes the decline to increased correct→incorrect flips (models “talk themselves out” of correct answers), not merely saturation.
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep): (1) Introduction for the non-monotonicity thesis and why stopping rules matter; (2) Methods for MU(t), budget forcing, flip definitions, and flip ratio—this is the paper’s measurement backbone; (3) Results on where MU turns negative and how difficulty shifts the optimum—prioritize Table 1 (marginal utility by budget ranges) and Figure 1 (difficulty-stratified curves/optima); (4) GPQA comparison (Figure 3) for cross-domain evidence of peak-then-drop; (5) Overthinking signals section for actionable early-stopping cues (hesitation/oscillation/confidence). skim (quick): (1) Read Introduction + the MU/flip definitions; (2) Jump to the main plots/tables (Table 1, Figure 1, Figure 3) to internalize the peak-and-decline pattern and difficulty dependence; (3) Skim the cost-aware evaluation/efficiency frontier recommendation to capture the paper’s evaluation takeaway.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ main message is that test-time compute scaling is not monotonic: there is a measurable overthinking regime. Therefore, research and practice should shift from “more tokens” to “adaptive per-problem budgeting and early stopping,” and report cost–accuracy efficiency frontiers plus flip-based diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 把“给更多test-time compute就更好”这个默认策略打碎：高预算会把正确答案想歪；只看性能-预算曲线与overthinking案例，便于制定自适应停机策略。
recommendation.en: It punctures the default ‘more test-time compute helps’ heuristic: higher budgets can reason you out of correct answers; skim the accuracy-vs-budget curves and the overthinking examples to motivate adaptive stopping.

paper.title: Your Model Diversity, Not Method, Determines Reasoning Strategy

summary.core_problem: 论文研究推理计算扩展中“广度（并行探索多条解法）vs 深度（对少数候选进行迭代精炼/树搜索）”的预算分配问题，并提出核心观点：决定最优推理策略的不是你用的具体方法名（并行采样、树搜索、MCTS式 refinement 等），而是目标模型自身的“多样性画像（diversity profile）”——概率质量在不同高层解法路径上的分布形态。
summary.importance: 该观点直接挑战当前常见研究范式：提出一个探索/搜索策略→只在1-2个模型上验证→宣称方法更好。作者指出这会把“模型差异”误当成“方法优势”。若不先刻画模型的多样性画像，就无法原则性地选择 breadth 或 depth，导致策略迁移失败、复现实验不稳定、以及训练/推理算力分配不合理。
summary.technical_approach: 论文给出一个分解推理不确定性的理论框架，并在抽象MCTS预算分配下推导“何时深度精炼优于纯并行采样”的条件。1）轨迹与‘解法簇’建模：对问题q，模型p_ϕ生成推理轨迹τ；将所有轨迹集合𝒯划分为m个不交集合𝒜_i，每个𝒜_i代表一种高层解法/思路（approach）。定义可行解法集合𝒱（包含至少一条正确轨迹的approach）。2）引入理想模型ϕ*及其在approach上的最优分布π(ϕ*)，用以刻画“正确解法应被分配的概率质量”。3）不确定性三分解： (i) Aleatoric不确定性U_alea(q)=H[A|ϕ*]：问题本身导致的不可约难度；(ii) Epistemic breadth U_epi^breadth(ϕ)=DKL(π(ϕ*)||π(ϕ))：模型在‘选哪种思路’上的分布与理想分布的偏差，需通过更广的探索与重加权选择来降低；(iii) Epistemic depth U_epi^depth(ϕ,B)=∑_{i∈𝒱} π_i(ϕ*) DKL(Bern(θ_i(ϕ*,B))||Bern(θ_i(ϕ,B)))：在给定思路内把解做对的能力差距，强调通过反馈/迭代精炼降低。4）MCTS式预算分配：总预算N条轨迹，分αN用于探索（发现不同approach），(1-α)N用于对最优approach i*做深度精炼。定义每个approach的单次精炼价值c_i=-log(1-θ_i)，随机采样的价值c_rand=-log(1-θ̄)，以及最优approach相对随机的质量比R=c_{i*}/c_rand。推导： (a) 在“能识别最优approach”的理想条件下，MCTS分配优于纯随机并行采样当且仅当α ≤ 1-1/R；(b) 为了以≥1-η概率在探索阶段发现i*，需要α ≥ α_min(η)（与N及π_{i*}相关，π_{i*}越小则需要更大探索比例）。5）核心解释：模型多样性画像决定π_{i*}（最优思路的先验质量）与R（精炼收益），从而决定最优α区间；因此“同一策略”在不同模型上会跨越不同的制度区间（regime）而表现相反。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个模型家族上验证理论边界：Qwen-3 4B 与 Olmo-3 7B。实验目标不是证明某个搜索算法普适更强，而是展示：当模型处于不同多样性制度（例如概率质量更集中/更分散、最优思路先验更大/更小）时，理论预测的“并行采样更合适”或“深度精炼更合适”的分界能被观察到；并且把某类方法搬到‘不匹配的制度’会显著变差，从而支持“先刻画多样性画像再选策略”的主张。（注：你提供的全文片段在实验细节处截断，具体任务/指标/图表编号未完整出现；但论文意图与验证对象在摘要与引言中已明确。）
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Framework（§2）是全文核心：先精读轨迹分区𝒜_i/可行集合𝒱/理想分布π(ϕ*)的建模假设；(2) 三类不确定性分解：理解U_epi^breadth与U_epi^depth分别对应‘找对思路’与‘把思路做对’，以及它们如何映射到breadth vs depth；(3) MCTS Allocation推导：重点看α ≤ 1-1/R与α ≥ α_min(η)这两个不等式如何共同夹出可行区间，并理解π_{i*}与R如何由模型多样性画像决定；(4) 实证部分：按作者主张去读——不要只看总体平均提升，而要看“跨模型家族时策略排序是否翻转/是否符合理论制度边界”。skim（泛读）：(1) 读Introduction抓住主张：方法效果由模型多样性决定；(2) 快速浏览Framework里对breadth/depth的形式化与两个关键条件（α上界/下界）；(3) 直接看实验结论段落：作者如何用Qwen-3与Olmo-3展示制度差异与策略迁移失败案例。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调：在推理计算扩展中，‘先验多样性’是第一性变量。任何探索/搜索策略都应先测量并报告目标模型的多样性画像与所处制度区间，再谈breadth-depth分配与方法优劣；否则容易把模型特性误归因于方法创新。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to allocate a fixed reasoning compute budget between breadth (sampling diverse solution approaches) and depth (iteratively refining a promising approach, e.g., tree/MCTS-style). Its central claim is that the best reasoning strategy is determined primarily by the target model’s diversity profile—the distribution of probability mass across distinct high-level solution approaches—rather than by the named method itself.
summary_en.importance: This challenges a common evaluation pattern: propose a search/exploration method, test on 1–2 models, and attribute gains to the method. The authors argue that such results often confound method effects with model-specific diversity regimes, causing poor transfer, unstable reproduction, and suboptimal compute allocation if diversity is not characterized first.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a theory that decomposes reasoning uncertainty and derives conditions under which depth refinement beats pure parallel sampling. (1) Trajectories and approach partition: for a query q, a model p_ϕ generates trajectories τ; the trajectory space 𝒯 is partitioned into disjoint sets 𝒜_i, each representing a high-level approach. Viable approaches 𝒱 are those containing at least one correct trajectory. (2) An ideal model ϕ* induces an optimal approach distribution π(ϕ*). (3) Uncertainty decomposition: (i) Aleatoric uncertainty U_alea(q)=H[A|ϕ*], irreducible problem difficulty; (ii) Epistemic breadth U_epi^breadth(ϕ)=DKL(π(ϕ*)||π(ϕ)), mismatch in selecting approaches, reducible via broader exploration and reweighting/selection; (iii) Epistemic depth U_epi^depth(ϕ,B)=∑_{i∈𝒱} π_i(ϕ*) DKL(Bern(θ_i(ϕ*,B))||Bern(θ_i(ϕ,B))), within-approach execution gap, reducible via feedback and iterative refinement. (4) MCTS-style allocation: with N trajectories, allocate N_e=αN to exploration and N_f=(1-α)N to refining the best discovered approach i*. Define per-sample refinement value c_i=-log(1-θ_i), random sampling value c_rand=-log(1-θ̄), and quality ratio R=c_{i*}/c_rand. Under oracle identification of i*: (a) MCTS allocation outperforms i.i.d. sampling iff α ≤ 1-1/R; (b) to discover i* with probability ≥1-η during exploration, α must satisfy α ≥ α_min(η) (depends on N and π_{i*}; smaller π_{i*} requires more exploration). (5) Key implication: the diversity profile determines π_{i*} and R, hence the feasible/optimal α regime; the same method can succeed or fail depending on the model’s regime.
summary_en.experiments: The theory is validated across two model families: Qwen-3 4B and Olmo-3 7B. The goal is to show regime dependence rather than universal superiority: when models exhibit different diversity profiles (e.g., more/less concentrated mass on the best approach), the empirically optimal breadth–depth trade-off shifts in line with the derived boundaries, and strategies degrade when applied outside their matching regime. (Note: the provided full-text excerpt is truncated before complete experimental details/figures; the validation targets and intent are clearly stated in the abstract/introduction.)
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep): (1) Framework (§2) is the core—carefully parse the approach partition 𝒜_i, viable set 𝒱, and ideal distribution π(ϕ*); (2) Understand how U_epi^breadth vs U_epi^depth map to ‘finding the right approach’ vs ‘executing it correctly’; (3) Focus on the two key inequalities α ≤ 1-1/R and α ≥ α_min(η) and how π_{i*} and R (driven by diversity) determine the regime; (4) In experiments, look specifically for cross-model reversals and regime boundary consistency rather than average gains. skim (quick): (1) Read the Introduction for the main claim about diversity; (2) Skim the framework to capture the breadth–depth formalization and the two conditions; (3) Jump to the experimental conclusions showing regime shifts across Qwen-3 vs Olmo-3.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that diversity is the first-order variable in compute-scaled reasoning. Any exploration/search strategy should first measure and report the target model’s diversity profile and regime, then choose breadth–depth allocation; otherwise, method claims risk misattributing model properties to algorithmic novelty.

paper.title: Tracing the Thought of a Grandmaster-level Chess-Playing Transformer

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：对于达到特级大师水平的棋类 Transformer（以 Leela Chess Zero, LC0 为代表），如何在全模型尺度上“追踪其内部思考过程”，把注意力与 MLP 的计算从叠加/超位置（superposition）中分解出来，形成可检验、可干预的推理路径（reasoning pathways），从而解释其战术判断与并行推理结构。
summary.importance:
棋类模型是高强度推理系统的典型代表，但其内部计算长期缺乏全局可追踪的解释框架。若能把 LC0 的关键计算分解为稀疏、可解释的特征并串联成路径，就能：
- 以“机制级证据”解释具体战术选择（而非仅靠相关性可视化）；
- 通过因果干预验证解释的真实性；
- 量化模型是否存在并行推理、信息如何在层间汇聚，进而为更一般的推理型 Transformer 提供可解释性方法学。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出一个“稀疏分解 + 替换层 + 因果路径构建”的框架，覆盖 Transformer 的 MLP 与注意力两大计算模块。
1) 稀疏替换层（replacement layers）：
- 对 MLP：使用 Transcoder，将 MLP 的非线性计算近似为“稀疏特征激活（Top-K）+ 线性解码重构”的形式，从而得到可单独分析/干预的 feature。
- 对注意力：使用 Lorsa（Low-Rank Sparse Attention），把注意力头在叠加中的输出分解为稀疏的 rank-1 OV（output-value）特征（文中称为 Lorsa features），同样便于解释与干预。
2) reasoning pathways 构建：在给定棋局与目标候选走法的条件下，作者用 feature steering（对特征进行定向激活/抑制的因果干预思想）来识别并串联“对该走法决策最关键”的跨层特征链路，形成路径级解释对象。
3) 可视化与验证：提供特征检查界面，并对部分可解释特征做基于规则的验证（将特征与棋理概念对齐并可经验检验）。
4) 并行性度量：提出三项指标刻画不同候选走法的路径并行/耦合结构：path overlap（平均重叠度 Ō）、path cohesion（内聚度 C_oh）、path coupling（耦合度 C_up），并分析层间信息如何逐步收敛到与 policy head 架构一致的“起始格/目标格”表征。
summary.experiments:
论文以 LC0（BT4）为对象做深入案例研究（case study）：
- 通过 Transcoder+Lorsa 的全模型稀疏分解，抽取可解释计算特征，并展示部分特征与战术概念的对应关系（含规则化验证）。
- 构建特定局面下针对候选走法的 reasoning pathways，展示路径中出现的“战术考虑”特征（例如进攻信息的传递、对手防守覆盖的评估等），并用定向干预验证这些特征对走法偏好/评估的因果影响。
- 诊断一个“病理性推理状态”：模型在某局面中出现歧义/误判，可追溯到对防守依赖关系的过度评估，并通过干预支持该解释。
- 定量分析：用三项路径指标展示不同走法的推理在模型内部呈现并行、分布式的结构；并观察到跨层关键表征逐步聚合到走法的源/目标格，符合 LC0 policy head 的归纳偏置。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读：详细技术分析 + 建议）
- 重点读：Preliminaries（Transcoder 与 Lorsa 的数学形式、Top-K 稀疏机制、为何能作为替换层）、方法章节中“reasoning pathways 的构建流程”（如何用 feature steering/因果干预选出路径）、Case Study（逐步解释一个具体战术局面并用干预验证）、Metrics 章节（Ō、C_oh、C_up 的定义与它们如何支持“并行推理”结论）。
- 重点看图表：稀疏分解后的特征可视化示例、某个局面下不同候选走法的路径对比图、干预前后策略/评估变化图、跨层“源格/目标格”收敛趋势图，以及三项指标随层变化/随走法变化的统计图。
- 创新点抓手：①首次（作者声称）同时对注意力与 MLP 做无监督稀疏字典分解并用于全模型回路级分析；②用 feature steering 构建可因果检验的“推理路径”；③提出路径并行性度量并与 policy head 架构归纳偏置对齐。

skim（泛读：方法概述 + 建议）
- 先读：Introduction（动机与贡献列表）、Preliminaries 的高层描述（Transcoder/Lorsa 是什么）、Case Study 的结论段（展示能解释哪些战术现象）、Metrics 的结论图（并行推理与源/目标格收敛）。
- 快速看：一两个最直观的路径可视化与干预结果图，用来把握“路径=可解释且可干预的计算骨架”这一主张。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调：单点神经元/单个注意力头不足以解释 LC0 的全局推理，因为计算高度叠加。通过稀疏替换层把计算分解为可解释特征，并用因果干预把这些特征串成路径，才能在全模型尺度上追踪“从棋盘输入到走法输出”的关键计算过程；同时，路径度量揭示 LC0 的推理是并行且分布式的，并与其 policy head 的结构性归纳偏置一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to trace the internal computation (“thought process”) of a grandmaster-level chess-playing Transformer, focusing on Leela Chess Zero (LC0). The goal is to obtain a global, model-wide interpretability method that decomposes both MLP and attention computations into sparse, interpretable units and then links them into empirically verifiable, causally testable reasoning pathways for specific positions and candidate moves.
summary_en.importance: Chess Transformers are strong reasoning systems, yet their internal computation is largely opaque. A full-model tracing framework can (i) provide mechanistic explanations for concrete tactical choices, (ii) validate explanations via causal interventions rather than correlations, and (iii) quantify whether the model performs parallel, distributed reasoning and how decision-critical information aggregates across layers—insights that may generalize to other reasoning-centric Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose a “sparse decomposition + replacement layers + causal pathway construction” framework spanning both major Transformer components:
1) Replacement layers via sparse decomposition:
- MLPs: Transcoders approximate each MLP as sparse feature activations (Top-K) followed by linear decoding/reconstruction, yielding analyzable/intervenable features.
- Attention: Lorsa (Low-Rank Sparse Attention) decomposes attention outputs into a sparse dictionary of rank-1 OV features (called Lorsa features), addressing attention superposition.
2) Reasoning pathways: for a given chess position and a target move, they use a feature-steering-based causal intervention framework to identify and connect the most decision-critical features across layers into pathways that represent the model’s primary computation.
3) Visualization and validation: they provide an interface for inspecting features and perform rule-based verification for a subset of interpretable features.
4) Quantifying parallelism: they introduce three metrics—path overlap (Ō), path cohesion (C_oh), and path coupling (C_up)—to characterize how pathways for different candidate moves are parallel/distributed and how representations converge in a way consistent with LC0’s policy head inductive bias (source/target squares).
summary_en.experiments:
Using LC0 (BT4), they conduct an in-depth case study:
- Perform full-model sparse decomposition (Transcoder + Lorsa) to extract interpretable computational features, with rule-based validation for some.
- Construct reasoning pathways for specific positions/moves, revealing tactical considerations (e.g., propagating offensive information, evaluating opponent defensive coverage) and validate them with targeted interventions.
- Diagnose a pathological reasoning state in an ambiguous position, attributing it to over-weighting defensive dependencies, supported by interventions.
- Provide quantitative evidence via Ō/C_oh/C_up that LC0 exhibits parallel, distributed reasoning across candidate moves, and show that decision-critical representations progressively converge to the move’s source and target squares across layers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical + how to read)
- Focus sections: Preliminaries (math of Transcoder/Lorsa and Top-K sparsity), the pathway-construction method (feature steering + causal selection), the detailed case study (mechanistic narrative + intervention evidence), and the metrics section (definitions/interpretation of Ō, C_oh, C_up).
- Key figures/tables: feature visualizations from the sparse decomposition, pathway diagrams comparing candidate moves, intervention effect plots, layerwise convergence to source/target squares, and metric plots supporting parallel reasoning.
- Innovations to track: (i) decomposing both MLP and attention with unsupervised sparse dictionaries for full-model circuit analysis, (ii) constructing causally testable reasoning pathways via feature steering, (iii) pathway-parallelism metrics tied to policy-head inductive bias.

skim (high-level + what to read)
- Read: Introduction (motivation/contributions), high-level Preliminaries summary, the case-study takeaway paragraphs, and the main metrics results.
- Skim: one or two pathway visualizations plus the corresponding intervention results to grasp the core claim: pathways form an interpretable, causal “skeleton” of computation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that neuron/head-level analyses are insufficient due to heavy superposition. By replacing MLP and attention with sparse decompositions, they obtain feature-level units that can be causally manipulated and chained into reasoning pathways, enabling model-wide tracing of how LC0 computes tactical decisions. Their metrics further suggest LC0’s reasoning is parallel and distributed, with representations converging toward move source/target squares in line with the policy head’s inductive bias.

paper.title: Human-like Working Memory Interference in Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 解释为何Transformer/LLM在具备全上下文注意力的情况下仍表现出工作记忆限制，并刻画其与人类相似的干扰效应。
summary.importance: 机制与行为分析贡献：发现预训练LLM在工作记忆任务上呈现与人类一致的干扰特征（负载上升退化、近因偏置、受刺激统计影响），并给出“工作记忆能力与通用能力相关”的跨模型关联，为理解LLM推理瓶颈与评测设计提供依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构造/采用工作记忆任务范式，对比“可从零训练的小Transformer可完美解决”与“多种预训练LLM仍受限”的差异；分析干扰签名（memory load、recency、stimulus statistics）并做跨模型相关性分析，将工作记忆容量与标准基准能力联系起来。
summary.experiments: 报告包含：一个两层Transformer可训练到完美解；并评测“多种预训练LLM”在工作记忆任务上的系统性退化与偏置模式；同时做跨模型相关性（工作记忆更强→标准benchmark更强）。摘要未给出具体模型列表、参数规模、任务细节与数值提升/相关系数。

summary_en.core_problem: Why Transformers/LLMs exhibit working-memory limitations and interference effects despite having full-context attention, and whether these limitations resemble human working-memory interference signatures.
summary_en.importance: Shows that pretrained LLMs display human-like interference patterns (load-dependent degradation, recency bias, sensitivity to stimulus statistics) and that working-memory capacity correlates with broader benchmark performance, informing both mechanistic understanding and evaluation design for reasoning limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses working-memory task paradigms to contrast (i) small Transformers trained from scratch that can solve the tasks perfectly with (ii) multiple pretrained LLMs that remain capacity-limited; characterizes interference signatures (memory load, recency, stimulus statistics) and performs cross-model correlation analyses linking working-memory measures to standard benchmark scores.
summary_en.experiments: Finds a two-layer Transformer can be trained to perfect performance, whereas various pretrained LLMs show systematic degradation and biases on the same paradigms; additionally reports that models with stronger working-memory performance tend to score higher on standard benchmarks (specific models, task parameters, and effect sizes not provided in the summary).

recommendation.zh: 把 LLM 的“工作记忆像人类一样会被干扰”量化得不错；只看干扰范式与跨模型相关性，能启发你设计更不易被近因偏置污染的评测。
recommendation.en: Nice quantification of human-like interference—read the interference paradigms and cross-model correlations to design evals less dominated by recency/overload artifacts.

paper.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Looped Reasoning Language Models

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“循环推理/深度递归（looped）”Transformer 与标准前馈 Transformer 在内部计算动力学上的差异：当把一段共享权重的层在潜空间中反复应用时，残差流（latent states）会如何演化？它是否仍呈现前馈模型中常见的“分阶段推理（stages of inference）”结构？以及循环结构带来的性能收益对应了怎样的可解释机制。
summary.importance: 循环层（recurrent-in-depth / cyclic recurrence）被视为提升推理能力、扩展测试时计算（test-time compute）的重要架构路线，但其机制不清会直接影响：1）我们如何选择循环步数与结构超参；2）循环是否真的在“做更多推理”，还是在重复/退化；3）如何设计更稳定、更可控的 looped LLM（例如是否需要 input injection、sandwich 结构等）。本文用“固定点/极限环（cycle）”的动力学视角给出可检验的解释框架，并指出某些行为甚至在未训练随机初始化的 Transformer 中也会涌现，暗示其与架构归纳偏置强相关。
summary.technical_approach:
（must_read 级别：详细技术分析）
1）对象与记号：将 Transformer 表示为对残差流 X∈R^{T×D} 的映射。定义标准 block：Attn+MLP+残差+可选 norm。定义 k-stacked block S_k = B_k∘…∘B_1。
2）循环结构（cyclic recurrence）：把一段固定序列的 k 个层重复 l 次，记为 (k⊗l)-Recurrent block；整体模型可含 prelude/coda（sandwich），记为 (p,k,c) 或具体步数 (p,k⊗l,c)。
3）Input injection：每次 recurrence 开始时将原始输入 X 与当前隐状态 Z 拼接后线性投影再进入循环块（一次 recurrence 注入一次），形成 (p,k⊗l,c)_I。该设计用于缓解“循环后期丢失输入信息/漂移”。
4）核心动力学命题（论文主线）：反复应用共享的循环块会逼近某种稳态。作者从“固定点/收敛”出发，指出在循环递推下长期行为必然落入两类之一：
   - 渐近消失（vanishing contribution）：循环中各组件 block 的有效更新趋近于 0，模型后期几乎不再改变残差流（等价于计算饱和/停止）。
   - 常数循环轨道（constant cyclic trajectory）：不是收敛到单一固定点，而是形成长度为 k 的极限环：同一 recurrence 内的第 i 层会收敛到其“层特定固定点”（layer-wise fixed point），整个循环块在潜空间中沿着稳定的 k 周期轨道运行。
5）经验结论：作者实证发现，在满足某些架构条件时（论文强调“循环层序列 + 结构设置”），第二种“稳定 k-周期”在真实训练的 looped 模型中出现；更强的是，这种行为也能在随机初始化、未训练的 Transformer 中出现，说明它可能是 Transformer 结构本身诱导的涌现动力学，而非仅由训练塑造。
6）与 stages of inference 的关系：作者用“按层/按 recurrence 分组”的可视化与度量，比较前馈模型的分阶段推理现象与 looped 模型在有效深度上的阶段组织方式，讨论循环是否在重复同一阶段、还是在不同 recurrence 中推进不同阶段（论文的分析框架是把循环视作扩展有效深度，但其内部可能进入稳态/极限环，从而改变阶段划分）。
summary.experiments:
（skim 级别可读）论文主要做机制分析而非追求 SOTA：
- 对多种 looped Transformer 变体进行残差流轨迹分析：包含 cyclic recurrence、不同 (p,k,c) sandwich 结构、以及是否使用 input injection。
- 关键观测是“层内固定点/极限环”的收敛行为：在很多被研究的模型里，循环中的每一层在跨 recurrence 的演化会收敛到稳定状态；并且不是所有层收敛到同一点，而是形成 k 个不同的层特定稳态，从而构成稳定的周期轨道。
- 对照：前馈模型（无权重共享）与 looped 模型（共享循环块）在“分阶段推理”指标/可视化上的差异；以及训练模型 vs 随机初始化模型的对比，用以支持“涌现自架构”的论点。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
- 重点章节：
  1）Introduction：把问题明确到“stages of inference + 固定点/循环轨道”两条线索，并给出二分结论（消失 vs 周期轨道）的研究动机。
  2）Preliminaries：务必精读 (p,k,c)、(k⊗l)、input injection 的精确定义；后文所有图的横轴分组（no grouping / by recurrence 等）都依赖这里。
  3）核心机制分析章节（通常在方法/分析/结果部分）：寻找作者如何定义“收敛”“固定点”“层特定固定点”“循环轨道”，以及用于判定的度量（例如跨 recurrence 的距离/相似度曲线、按层聚类等）。
- 重点图表（按内容类型而非编号）：
  1）展示“按 recurrence 分组”的隐状态演化曲线：看是否出现每层收敛到不同平台（plateau），以及平台之间是否构成稳定 k 周期。
  2）训练 vs 随机初始化对比图：这是“涌现自架构”最关键的证据链。
  3）对比前馈 stages-of-inference 与 looped 的阶段对齐/错位图：用于理解循环是否在做“新计算”。
- 创新点抓手：
  1）把 looped LLM 的内部行为用动力系统的“固定点/极限环”刻画，并给出“必然二分”的解释框架；
  2）提出并验证“层特定固定点 → 稳定周期轨道”的现象；
  3）指出该现象在随机初始化也出现，强调 Transformer 架构归纳偏置。

skim（泛读建议）
- 先读 Introduction + Preliminaries，搞清 (p,k,c) 与 input injection。
- 直接跳到主要实验/结果图：优先看“是否收敛到固定点/周期轨道”的证据图，再看与 stages-of-inference 的对照讨论。
- 结论/讨论部分关注：作者对 looped 推理收益的解释、对架构设计（是否需要 injection、如何选 k 与 l）的启示。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：looped 推理并不只是“把同一层多跑几次”这么简单；共享循环块会诱导特定的潜空间动力学。只要出现稳态行为，就会落入“更新消失”或“稳定周期轨道”两类；而实证上常见的是后者（每层收敛到不同固定点，形成一致的 k 周期）。更重要的是，这种结构化循环在未训练模型中也能出现，提示其与 Transformer 结构本身强相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how looped (recurrent-in-depth) Transformers differ mechanistically from standard feedforward Transformers. When a shared-weight block is applied repeatedly in latent space, how do residual-stream states evolve? Do looped models exhibit the same “stages of inference” seen in feedforward models, or do they enter qualitatively different dynamical regimes that explain their reasoning gains and limitations?
summary_en.importance: Looping layers is a prominent route to increase test-time compute and improve reasoning without scaling parameters, but its internal dynamics are poorly understood. This matters for (1) choosing loop depth/steps, (2) diagnosing whether extra steps add new computation or merely repeat/saturate, and (3) architectural design choices such as sandwich (prelude/coda) structure and input injection. The paper provides a dynamical-systems lens—fixed points vs limit cycles—and argues some behaviors emerge from the Transformer architecture itself, even at random initialization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(must_read: detailed technical analysis)
1) Setup/notation: a Transformer maps residual-stream matrices X∈R^{T×D} through attention+MLP blocks with residual connections and optional norms. Define a k-stacked block S_k = B_k∘…∘B_1.
2) Cyclic recurrence: repeat a fixed sequence of k layers for l recurrences, denoted (k⊗l). Full models may include non-tied prelude and coda stacks (sandwich), denoted (p,k,c) and instantiated as (p,k⊗l,c).
3) Input injection: at the start of each recurrence, concatenate the original input X with the current latent Z and project back to D before applying the k-layer stack, yielding (p,k⊗l,c)_I. Injection is intended to prevent drift / loss of input signal across many recurrences.
4) Core dynamical claim: repeated application of a shared recurrent block tends toward a steady-state behavior. The authors argue this implies one of two asymptotic regimes:
   - Vanishing contributions: updates from component blocks go to ~0, so later recurrences barely change the residual stream (compute saturates).
   - Constant cyclic trajectory (limit cycle): instead of converging to a single fixed point, the k layers converge to k distinct layer-specific fixed points, producing a stable k-period orbit in latent space.
5) Empirical finding: under certain architectural conditions, the stable k-cycle arises in practice in trained looped models; strikingly, similar cyclic behavior can also appear in randomly initialized (untrained) Transformers, suggesting an architectural inductive bias.
6) Connection to stages of inference: by visualizing/quantifying hidden-state evolution “by layer” and “by recurrence,” the paper compares how feedforward stage structure maps (or fails to map) onto looped effective depth, clarifying whether looping advances computation or replays a stable cycle.
summary_en.experiments:
The work is primarily mechanistic rather than SOTA-driven:
- Analyze multiple looped Transformer variants (cyclic recurrence, different (p,k,c) sandwich layouts, with/without input injection) via residual-stream trajectory measurements.
- Key evidence: convergence patterns showing layer-wise stabilization across recurrences; in many cases, each layer converges to a distinct state, collectively forming a stable k-period orbit.
- Comparisons: feedforward vs looped models under “stages of inference” analyses; trained vs random-initialization comparisons to support the “emergent from architecture” claim.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read)
- Key sections:
  1) Introduction: frames the problem via stages-of-inference and fixed-point/limit-cycle dynamics; highlights the dichotomy (vanishing vs cyclic trajectory).
  2) Preliminaries: carefully learn the (p,k,c), (k⊗l), and input-injection definitions; later plots and grouping conventions depend on this.
  3) Main analysis/results: focus on how convergence, layer-specific fixed points, and cyclic trajectories are defined and measured.
- Key figures (by content):
  1) Hidden-state evolution grouped by recurrence showing per-layer plateaus and a stable k-cycle.
  2) Trained vs random-init comparisons (central to the “architectural emergence” argument).
  3) Feedforward stages-of-inference vs looped alignment/misalignment visualizations.
- Main contributions to track:
  (i) dynamical-systems framing with an asymptotic dichotomy; (ii) empirical discovery of layer-specific fixed points forming a stable k-cycle; (iii) evidence that the phenomenon can appear without training.

skim (quick read)
- Read Introduction + Preliminaries to understand the looped architecture and injection.
- Jump to the main results figures demonstrating fixed-point vs limit-cycle behavior.
- Skim the discussion/conclusion for implications on when looping adds computation and how to choose k/l and injection.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that looped reasoning is not merely “running the same layers longer.” Shared-weight recurrence induces structured latent dynamics: if a steady state emerges, it must look like either saturated/vanishing updates or a stable k-period orbit. Empirically, the latter often occurs—each layer converges to a distinct layer-specific fixed point—sometimes even at random initialization, pointing to a strong architectural inductive bias.

recommendation.zh: 把looped depth当动力系统看固定点/极限环很有用，但不少现象随机初始化也出现需降权；只读动力学诊断那节和关键相图/轨迹图即可。
recommendation.en: The fixed-point/limit-cycle lens is useful for looped-in-depth models, but the fact that some behaviors appear at random init weakens causal claims; skim the dynamics diagnostics section and the main phase/trajectory plots.

paper.title: Decomposing the Delta: What Do Models Actually Learn from Preference Pairs?

summary.core_problem: 偏好优化（DPO/KTO）在推理模型对齐中广泛使用，但“偏好对（chosen/rejected）到底通过什么信号带来推理能力提升”缺乏机制性理解。本文聚焦 delta learning：不是绝对质量而是 chosen 与 rejected 的质量差（delta）驱动学习，并进一步追问：delta 的来源（生成器层面 vs 样本层面）分别起什么作用？样本层面的哪些推理维度差异最关键？结果是否依赖最终答案正确性？
summary.importance: 这直接影响偏好数据构造与筛选策略：如果提升主要来自某些过程性质量维度（如步骤连贯性）而非结果正确性，那么可以用更便宜的生成器、更少的数据、甚至不依赖 outcome verification 来获得可观增益；同时也解释了为何“弱模型对的差异”能提升强学生，并为可验证推理（数学/STEM/代码）场景的对齐数据工程提供可操作的选择准则。
summary.technical_approach: 提出并形式化两类 delta： (1) generator-level delta：chosen 与 rejected 由不同能力的生成模型产生，其能力差即 delta（数据构造层面的设计变量）。(2) sample-level delta：同一对样本内部的质量差，沿可解释推理维度度量。论文用校准的 LLM-as-a-judge 将每条 CoT 轨迹分解评估为五个维度：factuality、strategy coherence、step coherence、computational precision、signal-to-noise ratio，并据此计算 chosen-rejected 的维度差异；通过控制生成器配对与对样本按“高 delta”维度筛选，分析哪些维度的差异最能带来下游泛化增益。同时系统检验“正确性是否主导信号”：构造四种正确性组合（C/I、C/C、I/I、I/C）分别做 DPO，对比其对域内与域外任务的影响。
summary.experiments: 三段式实验： (1) 迁移与尺度：在可验证推理任务上复现 delta learning，并用两大家族生成器（Nemotron-4B–49B、s1-3B–32B）构造偏好对；发现用 s1-7B vs s1-3B 的弱模型对、且不做 ground-truth verification，也能达到与“用 DeepSeek-R1 且带 outcome verification 的 DPO”相当的效果。进一步增大 generator-level delta（chosen 生成器更强）时：域内数学提升基本不随之变化，但域外 STEM/代码稳步提升。作者将其归因于 sample-level delta 随 chosen 变强而在五个维度上整体拉大，从而驱动域外增益。 (2) 正确性消融：在四种正确性配对上训练，发现域内表现对正确性标签基本不敏感，甚至 I/C（rejected 正确、chosen 错误）也能带来超过基座的增益，否定“结果正确性是主信号”。 (3) 维度分解与数据选择：按五个维度分别挑选 sample-level delta 最大的子集，发现 step coherence 是最稳定有效的选择准则；仅用约 5k 高-delta 样本即可匹配或超过全量 16.5k 的效果，说明精筛可替代扩大数据或扩大生成器差距。
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Introduction + “Decomposing the Delta”定义：弄清 generator-level vs sample-level 的因果链条（生成器选择→诱导的样本维度差异→下游增益）。(2) §4（尤其是 generator-level delta 扩展实验）：重点看“域内不变、域外上升”的分叉现象及其解释。 (3) §5.1 正确性四象限实验：这是推翻常识假设（正确性主导）的关键证据。 (4) §5.2 维度分解：关注五维度的 judge 标定方式、按维度筛选的对照结果，以及 step coherence 为何最稳健。 (5) 数据效率结论：5k 高-delta≈16.5k 全量的实验设置与统计显著性。skim（泛读）：先读 Introduction + 两类 delta 定义；再快速看三条主结论图表：generator-level 扩展的域内/域外曲线、正确性四组合对比、以及按维度筛选（step coherence 最优）与 5k 子集结果；最后读结论获取对偏好数据构造的建议。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：偏好对带来的推理提升主要来自“过程质量差异”的学习，而非最终答案正确性；generator-level delta 之所以在域外更有效，是因为它扩大了样本层面在多种推理维度上的差距。实践上，与其盲目扩大生成器或数据量，不如用可解释维度（尤其 step coherence）做高-delta 筛选，以更少数据获得相当或更好收益。

summary_en.core_problem: Preference optimization (e.g., DPO/KTO) is widely used to align reasoning models, but it is unclear what signal in preference pairs actually drives downstream reasoning gains. Building on the delta learning hypothesis, the paper asks which notion of “delta” matters—capability gaps between generators vs within-pair quality gaps—and which specific reasoning-quality dimensions in the chosen/rejected traces are responsible. It also tests whether final-answer correctness is the dominant driver.
summary_en.importance: This directly informs how to construct and filter preference data for verifiable reasoning (math/STEM/code). If improvements come mainly from process-level quality differences (e.g., step coherence) rather than outcome correctness, then one can use cheaper generators, fewer pairs, and even avoid outcome verification while still improving strong students—turning alignment into a more data-efficient, mechanism-driven pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes two deltas: (1) Generator-level delta: the capability gap between the models producing chosen vs rejected responses (a data-construction knob). (2) Sample-level delta: the within-pair quality difference measured along interpretable reasoning dimensions. Using a calibrated LLM-as-a-judge, each chain-of-thought trace is scored on five axes—factuality, strategy coherence, step coherence, computational precision, and signal-to-noise ratio—and deltas are computed per dimension. The authors then (a) vary generator pairings to study how generator-level delta translates into sample-level deltas and downstream gains, (b) construct preference pairs across four correctness combinations (C/I, C/C, I/I, I/C) to test whether correctness drives learning, and (c) select subsets with the largest sample-level deltas per dimension to identify which dimensions are most causally useful.
summary_en.experiments: Three main experimental blocks: (1) Transfer + scaling: delta learning holds for verifiable reasoning. Preference pairs from two generator families (Nemotron-4B–49B and s1-3B–32B) show that training on weak-model deltas (e.g., s1-7B vs s1-3B) without ground-truth verification can match DPO trained on DeepSeek-R1 data with outcome verification. Increasing generator-level delta yields little change on in-domain math but steady gains on out-of-domain STEM/code; this is explained by widening sample-level deltas across all five judged dimensions as the chosen generator scales. (2) Correctness ablations: training on each correctness pairing shows in-domain performance is largely invariant to correctness labels; even I/C pairs can improve over the base model, ruling out outcome correctness as the dominant signal. (3) Dimension decomposition + data selection: selecting pairs with the largest deltas in each dimension reveals step coherence as the most consistently effective criterion; ~5k high-delta pairs can match or exceed training on the full 16.5k set, demonstrating strong data-efficiency via sample-level selection.
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep): (1) Introduction + the delta definitions section to understand the generator→sample signal pathway. (2) §4 generator-level scaling results, especially the in-domain invariance vs out-of-domain improvement split. (3) §5.1 correctness-quadrant experiments—the key evidence against “correctness is the main signal.” (4) §5.2 dimension-based selection: judge calibration, per-dimension filtering, and why step coherence dominates. (5) The 5k-vs-16.5k efficiency result details. skim (fast): read the two delta definitions; then focus on the headline figures/tables for (i) generator scaling (math vs STEM/code), (ii) correctness combinations, and (iii) per-dimension selection + 5k subset; finish with the conclusion for actionable guidance on preference data construction.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s central claim is that preference optimization for reasoning learns primarily from process-quality deltas rather than final-answer correctness. Generator-level delta matters insofar as it induces larger sample-level deltas, which particularly improves out-of-domain generalization. Practically, targeted selection by interpretable dimensions—especially step coherence—can replace brute-force scaling of generators or dataset size.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对偏好对“学到什么”的 prior：增益更像来自 delta 的过程质量而非答案对错；应按文中分解维度重做内部数据筛选/采样策略。
recommendation.en: Shifts my prior on what preference pairs teach: gains track delta in process quality more than final correctness; you should redo internal data filtering/sampling using their delta decomposition axes.

paper.title: SUPERNOVA: Eliciting General Reasoning in LLMs with Reinforcement Learning on Natural Instructions

summary.core_problem: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）在数学/代码等“形式化领域”显著提升推理，但对因果、时间、常识、语用等“通用推理（general reasoning）”提升有限；根因在于缺少覆盖多种推理技能、且可自动验证的高质量训练数据。现有把 RLVR 扩展到更多“知识领域”的做法（如从网页抽取 QA）并不等价于提升通用推理技能，且验证困难、噪声大。
summary.importance: 通用推理是现实任务与 BBEH/BBH 等基准的核心能力，但仅靠 STEM RLVR 甚至会出现“数学更强、通用推理更弱”的负迁移现象（文中举例 OpenReasoner/OpenThinker 在 AIME 大幅提升但 BBEH 下降）。因此，如何系统性构建“可验证 + 多技能覆盖 + 低成本”的 RLVR 数据，是把 RLVR 从 STEM 推向通用推理的关键瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SuperNova：面向通用推理 RLVR 的数据策展框架，核心洞见是“高质量指令微调数据（如 SuperNI/FLAN）里包含专家标注的 ground-truth 与隐含推理模式”，可被系统改造为 RLVR 可验证样本。整体是多阶段 pipeline（论文图 2）：(1) 源任务筛选：从 SuperNI 候选任务出发，评估其对 BBEH 23 个子任务的推理能力迁移；并将部分开放式任务重格式化为可验证形式（例如改为多选）。结论：源任务选择对下游 pass@k 影响极大。(2) 任务混合策略：比较 macro mixing（全子任务共享一组平均最优任务）与 micro mixing（针对每个 BBEH 子任务分别选最优源任务）。结论：micro mixing 稳定优于 macro mixing，暗示不同推理技能需要不同“数据来源任务”来触发/训练。(3) 合成干预（数据增强）评估：尝试引入长上下文依赖等合成改写，但在固定训练预算下并未带来收益，说明“更复杂的合成扰动”不必然等价于更高 RLVR 数据质量。(4) 基于上述决策构建 SuperNova 数据集：约 25K 条 RLVR 样本，用于训练 Qwen3 0.6B–4B 等不同规模模型，并强调 test-time compute（多次尝试）带来的探索收益。
summary.experiments: 作者进行了 100+ 次 compute-matched RL 实验系统比较数据设计决策。最终在 BBEH-test 上，SuperNova-4B 相对提升 pass@1 约 29.4%、pass@8 约 42.9%，并显示从 1 次到 8 次尝试性能显著上升（更好的推理探索）。值得注意的是，SuperNova-4B 在通用推理 pass@8 上超过更大的 Qwen3-8B 约 8.2%，体现“更小模型 + 更好数据/训练范式”可胜过更大基座。并在 BBH、MMLU-Pro、Zebralogic 等额外基准上表现出跨任务泛化提升（文中提到如相对提升 12.3% 等）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：1) Introduction：重点看“STEM 提升不迁移甚至负迁移到 BBEH”的动机与问题定义（general reasoning 的边界）。2) Figure 2（pipeline 总览）：把每个阶段的输入/输出、可验证化改写、以及与 RLVR 训练闭环对应起来。3) §3.1（源任务选择与可验证化）：这是论文最关键的“数据为何有效”的证据来源，关注哪些 SuperNI 任务被证明能触发 BBEH 子技能，以及开放式→可验证的具体改写原则。4) mixing 实验（macro vs micro）：理解“按子技能定制数据配方”的结论与其对通用推理的含义。5) 合成干预无效的消融：关注作者如何控制训练预算、为何增强不增益（对后续复现/扩展很重要）。6) §6 主结果与 scaling（0.6B–4B、pass@1 vs pass@8）：理解 test-time compute 与训练数据之间的交互。
skim（泛读）：1) 直接看 Figure 2 + 数据集规模（25K）与关键结论（micro mixing 更好、合成增强无效）。2) 看 BBEH 主表（pass@1/pass@8）与“4B 超 8B”的对比结论。3) 快速扫额外基准（BBH/MMLU-Pro/Zebralogic）确认泛化趋势。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心主张是：通用推理 RLVR 的瓶颈不在“再找更多领域知识题”，而在“能否从高质量指令任务中策展出可验证、能覆盖多种推理技能的训练分布”；并且数据配方需要按子技能细粒度定制（micro mixing），而不是用单一平均最优配方（macro mixing）。同时，直觉上更强的合成增强在固定预算下未必有效，提示应优先投资于源任务选择与可验证化设计。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards) has boosted reasoning in formal domains (math/code), but it still struggles with general reasoning skills such as causal and temporal inference. The fundamental bottleneck is the lack of high-quality, automatically verifiable training data that spans diverse general-reasoning skills. Prior attempts to scale RLVR by harvesting domain QA from the web are noisy and hard to verify, and “more domains” does not necessarily translate to better general reasoning.
summary_en.importance: General reasoning is central to real-world problem solving and benchmarks like BBEH/BBH. The paper highlights negative transfer: STEM-focused RLVR can improve math dramatically while degrading general reasoning. Therefore, building verifiable, skill-diverse, low-cost RLVR data is a key step to extend RLVR beyond STEM.
summary_en.technical_approach: SuperNova is a data curation framework for general-reasoning RLVR. Key insight: instruction-tuning datasets (e.g., SuperNI/FLAN) contain expert-annotated ground truth and rich latent reasoning patterns that can be systematically adapted into verifiable RLVR samples. The multi-stage pipeline (Fig. 2) includes: (1) Source task selection from SuperNI, evaluating which tasks best elicit BBEH’s 23 sub-skills; and reformulating open-ended tasks into verifiable formats (e.g., multiple-choice). Result: source task choice has a large impact on downstream pass@k. (2) Task mixing strategies: macro mixing (one shared set of top tasks by average performance) vs micro mixing (per-BBEH-subtask top tasks). Result: micro mixing consistently wins, implying different reasoning skills benefit from different source tasks. (3) Synthetic interventions (e.g., injecting long-context dependencies) are tested but do not help under a fixed training budget. (4) Using these findings, the authors build the SuperNova dataset (~25K RLVR samples) and train Qwen3 models (0.6B–4B), emphasizing gains with increased test-time compute (pass@1→pass@8).
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports 100+ compute-matched RL experiments to isolate data design choices. On BBEH-test, SuperNova-4B achieves relative gains of ~29.4% (pass@1) and ~42.9% (pass@8), with strong improvements as the number of attempts increases (better exploration). Notably, SuperNova-4B outperforms a larger Qwen3-8B by ~8.2% on pass@8 for general reasoning. The models also generalize to BBH, MMLU-Pro, and Zebralogic with consistent gains (e.g., a cited ~12.3% relative improvement).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive): 1) Introduction for the problem framing and the STEM→general negative transfer motivation. 2) Fig. 2 for the end-to-end curation-to-RLVR training loop. 3) §3.1 on source task selection and “open-ended → verifiable” reformulations (core of why the data works). 4) The macro vs micro mixing study to understand skill-specific data recipes. 5) The synthetic intervention ablation to learn what *doesn’t* help under fixed budgets. 6) §6 main results and scaling (0.6B–4B, pass@1 vs pass@8) to see how training data interacts with test-time compute.
skim (high-level): 1) Fig. 2 + the key takeaways (micro mixing > macro; synthetic augmentation not helpful). 2) The main BBEH table (pass@1/pass@8) and the “4B beats 8B” highlight. 3) Quick scan of the extra benchmarks (BBH/MMLU-Pro/Zebralogic) for generalization trends.
summary_en.authors_note: The central claim is that the main barrier for general-reasoning RLVR is not collecting more domain knowledge QA, but curating verifiable, skill-covering training distributions from high-quality instruction datasets. The paper argues for skill-specific data mixtures (micro mixing) and shows that intuitive synthetic augmentations may not pay off under fixed compute—prioritizing source task selection and verifiability design instead.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对“RLVR=只适合 STEM”的 prior：用自然指令做可验证训练来拉通用推理；建议立刻复现其数据生成/验证管线，看负迁移是否真被压住。
recommendation.en: Shifts the prior that RLVR is mostly STEM-only by making natural-instruction verification work for general reasoning; worth immediately reproducing the data+verifier pipeline and checking if it truly avoids negative transfer.

paper.title: Skip-Connected Policy Optimization for Implicit Advantage

summary.core_problem: 在 RLVR 中，GRPO 这类“仅看最终结果(outcome-only)”的方法稳定有效，但理论上更强的“细粒度 dense reward/advantage（按推理步骤/token）”在实际采样预算下反而更差。论文指出关键原因：用 Monte Carlo（从中间前缀采样多条续写并用最终对错回传）估计早期 token 的 advantage 时方差极高且符号经常出错（sign-inconsistent），导致训练方向不稳定，最终不如直接把 outcome reward 广播给所有 token 的 GRPO。
summary.importance: 这揭示了 RLVR 走向更细粒度信用分配（credit assignment）的结构性矛盾：细粒度信号上限更高，但在可承受的推理采样预算下难以可靠估计，导致“理论更好、实践更差”。解决该矛盾对提升推理过程质量、减少无效思维链、并在相同预算下获得更强性能至关重要。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SKPO（Skip-Connected Policy Optimization），把一次推理分解为 upstream（上游，早期推理段）与 downstream（下游，后续推理段）两阶段，并只在一个中间位置实例化 Monte Carlo 采样，从而在不爆炸采样成本的情况下给上游提供相对细粒度的学习信号。关键设计：1) Upstream：生成“早停”的推理片段 s，并用从该位置继续采样得到的 downstream 结果的 outcome reward 聚合成对 s 的 MC 奖励；上游采用 single-stream optimization 来降低细粒度信号的不稳定性（通过更低的每 prompt 样本需求、以及用历史样本估计更稳定 baseline）。2) Downstream：仍用 GRPO 式组内相对优势（group-relative）做 outcome 级优化，但引入 skip connection，把输入从仅 q 变为 [s, q]（将上游片段与原问题拼接），使模型既能利用有帮助的上游推理，又保留一定探索自由度。3) 工程优化：通过 single-pass rollout 让总体计算量与 GRPO 近似持平。论文还提出“implicit advantage”现象：即使最终对错相同，SKPO 训练出的轨迹中间步骤质量更高，这是由优化结构自发涌现而非额外监督。
summary.experiments: 实验在数学推理基准上展示 SKPO 相对 GRPO 的显著提升，并强调在 OOD（分布外）上也更稳健。分析部分用图 1 等展示：在现实采样预算下，MC + group-relative 的早期 token advantage 高方差且频繁符号翻转，从而解释 dense reward 方案为何会稳定落后于 outcome-only GRPO。进一步分析显示 SKPO 产生更高的中间步骤质量（implicit advantage），说明其在“过程优化”上确实改善了信用分配。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：1) Figure 1：理解作者的核心反直觉发现（早期 token advantage 的高方差与 sign error）以及它如何直接导致 dense 方法不如 GRPO。2) Methodology/§3.1：重点看 token-level MC 奖励的形式化、为何 t 越靠后 MC 越收敛到 outcome（从而 GRPO 可视为极限情形），以及“只在单一中间点采样”的动机。3) Figure 2（算法框架）：把 upstream/downstream、single-stream、skip connection [s,q]、以及 single-pass rollout 的计算复用关系彻底读懂。4) §3.2（目标函数）：对照两阶段各自的 policy gradient 目标，理解为何上游不用 group-relative、下游保留 group-relative。5) 实验与消融：关注在相同采样/计算预算下与 GRPO 的对比，以及 implicit advantage 的度量方式（如何评估中间步骤质量）。
skim（泛读）：1) 先看 Introduction + Figure 1 把问题抓住：dense MC 在早期不可靠。2) 看 Figure 2 + 方法小结把 SKPO 的两阶段与 [s,q] skip connection 记住。3) 快速看主结果表确认“同预算优于 GRPO + OOD 更稳”。
summary.authors_note: 作者的关键贡献不是“发明更复杂的奖励模型”，而是指出 dense MC credit assignment 在有限采样下的统计失败模式（高方差+符号错），并用结构化两阶段优化把 MC 采样放到一个中间点：上游用更稳的单流优化吃细粒度信号，下游继续用 GRPO 的稳定相对优势；skip connection 让下游既继承上游优点又不被其锁死，从而在计算不增的前提下获得更好的过程质量与最终性能。

summary_en.core_problem: In RLVR, outcome-only methods like GRPO are stable and strong, while theoretically appealing dense, fine-grained rewards/advantages (token- or step-level) often underperform in practice. The paper identifies why: Monte Carlo (MC) estimation of early-token advantages—by sampling multiple continuations from a prefix and averaging outcome rewards—has very high variance and frequent sign inconsistencies under realistic sampling budgets, making optimization unstable and worse than simply broadcasting the final outcome reward (GRPO).
summary_en.importance: This exposes a structural dilemma in RLVR credit assignment: fine-grained signals have a higher theoretical ceiling, but are statistically unreliable at feasible inference budgets. Resolving this is important for improving reasoning-process quality (not just final correctness) and achieving better performance under the same compute constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: SKPO (Skip-Connected Policy Optimization) decomposes reasoning into an upstream phase and a downstream phase, and instantiates MC sampling at a single intermediate position to provide denser learning signals without exploding sampling cost. Key components: (1) Upstream: generate an early-stopped reasoning segment s; compute its MC reward by sampling downstream continuations and aggregating their outcome rewards; optimize upstream with single-stream optimization to reduce instability (lower per-prompt sample needs and more stable baselines from historical samples). (2) Downstream: keep GRPO-style group-relative optimization at the outcome level, but add a skip connection by feeding [s, q] (upstream segment concatenated with the original question), allowing the model to leverage helpful upstream reasoning while preserving exploration freedom. (3) Engineering: a single-pass rollout reuses samples to achieve compute parity with GRPO. The method also yields an “implicit advantage”: even when final correctness is matched, SKPO-trained trajectories exhibit higher intermediate-step quality, emerging from the optimization structure rather than extra supervision.
summary_en.experiments: On math reasoning benchmarks, SKPO shows substantial gains over GRPO and improved OOD robustness. The analysis (e.g., Fig. 1) demonstrates that MC + group-relative advantage estimation produces high-variance, sign-flipping advantages for early tokens under practical budgets, explaining why dense approaches can be stably worse than outcome-only GRPO. Additional analysis reports higher intermediate-step quality (implicit advantage) for SKPO-trained models.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive): 1) Fig. 1 to internalize the core empirical finding: early-token MC advantages are noisy and sign-inconsistent. 2) Methodology/§3.1 for the formal token-level MC reward definition, the convergence-to-outcome property near the end of trajectories (motivating GRPO as a limiting case), and why sampling at a single intermediate point helps. 3) Fig. 2 to fully understand the upstream/downstream split, single-stream optimization, the [s,q] skip connection, and the single-pass rollout reuse. 4) §3.2 objectives to see why upstream avoids group-relative estimation while downstream retains it. 5) Experiments/ablations focusing on compute-matched comparisons and how intermediate-step quality is measured.
skim (high-level): 1) Read Introduction + Fig. 1 for the problem. 2) Read Fig. 2 + method summary for the SKPO recipe. 3) Skim main results tables for “better than GRPO under the same budget + stronger OOD”.
summary_en.authors_note: The main contribution is not a new reward model, but a diagnosis of why dense MC credit assignment fails statistically under limited sampling (high variance + sign errors), and a structural fix: two-phase optimization with MC applied at a single intermediate point—stable single-stream learning for upstream and GRPO-style stability for downstream—connected via [s,q] to transfer useful upstream reasoning without over-constraining exploration, all at roughly GRPO-level compute.

recommendation.zh: 把 dense advantage 在预算内“符号经常估错”这点讲透了，解释为何 GRPO 反而稳；应按文中方差/符号一致性诊断先做 internal ablation 再谈细粒度 CA。
recommendation.en: Clarifies why dense advantage can be worse under realistic budgets (sign errors/variance), explaining GRPO’s robustness; run their variance/sign-consistency diagnostics internally before investing in finer-grained CA.

paper.title: Bridging SFT and RL: Dynamic Policy Optimization for Robust Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 统一后训练中如何同时利用 SFT 的稳定低方差与 RL 的探索低偏差，但避免两者梯度信号在统计上“高偏差 vs 高方差”的结构性冲突；以及如何处理不同难度样本在统一目标下学习信号可靠性差异巨大（易样本饱和、难样本奖励稀疏、中等样本最有效）。
summary.importance: 该问题直接决定推理类 LLM 后训练的稳定性、样本效率与 OOD 泛化：简单 loss 加权会被 RL 方差拖垮或被 SFT 偏差锁死，导致训练不稳、探索不足、以及 SFT→RL 顺序管线的偏差传播与算力浪费。若能在统一框架内结构性化解偏差-方差矛盾，可显著提升复杂推理任务的鲁棒性与泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
DYPO（Dynamic Policy Optimization）用“实例级路由 + 分治优化”替代全局加权：
1) 动态难度分级（Dynamic Difficulty Grading）：对每个 query 做 group rollout，根据组内结果（成功/失败/不一致）将样本划分为 Hard/Mid（以及隐含的 Easy/饱和区），并据此选择优化分支。核心思想是：Hard 的 RL 信号极稀疏且方差大，应回退到稳定监督；Mid 同时具备奖励可分辨性与暴露失败模式，适合用 RL 探索。
2) Hard 分支的偏差校正（Bias Correction for SFT）：对 Hard 样本触发多教师蒸馏（Multi-Teacher Distillation），聚合不同 teacher 的多样推理路径以减轻单一 CoT 数据/单教师带来的拟合偏差与路径依赖，从而在“用 SFT 注入能力”的同时降低偏差。
3) Mid 分支的方差降低（Variance Reduction for RL）：引入 Group Alignment Loss（GAL），利用组内“赢家/输家”动态进行对齐：强化 winning 轨迹、抑制 losing 轨迹，相比标准成对偏好/或 GRPO 类目标显著降低梯度方差。论文宣称 GAL 可将方差相对 GRPO 降低数量级。
4) 理论主线：形式化 SFT（低方差高偏差）与 RL（低偏差高方差）的梯度统计冲突；证明动态分级路由在总体上最小化方差（通过把高方差且低收益的样本从 RL 中剔除）；证明多教师对 Hard 的偏差可线性下降；证明 GAL 对 Mid 的梯度方差显著小于 GRPO。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 DYPO 在复杂推理基准上带来约 5–10% 的性能提升，并强调在训练稳定性与鲁棒性上优于“二值切换/软加权”的统一优化基线。实验重点应包括：不同难度路由比例与性能关系、Hard 分支多教师蒸馏的消融、Mid 分支 GAL vs GRPO 的方差/稳定性对比，以及对 OOD/更难任务的泛化表现。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读 Introduction：把握“统一 SFT+RL 不是加权而是统计冲突”的问题定义与 DYPO 三组件。
- 读方法总览图/算法伪码（若有）：看清实例级路由如何触发 Hard→SFT、Mid→RL。
- 读实验主表：确认 5–10% 增益来自哪些任务；再快速看消融表（去掉分级/多教师/GAL）。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读理论分析章节：
  (a) SFT/RL 梯度偏差-方差的形式化定义与推导；
  (b) 动态难度分级“最小化总体方差”的证明条件（依赖 reward 反馈与分组统计的假设）；
  (c) 多教师蒸馏“线性降偏差”的推导（偏差度量、teacher 多样性假设）；
  (d) GAL 相对 GRPO 的方差界/数量级结论（关键不等式与独立性/同分布假设）。
- 精读方法细节：难度判据如何由 group rollout outcome 计算（阈值、组大小、成功定义），以及路由后两分支的损失如何组合/调度。
- 精读关键消融：
  1) 仅加权 vs 路由；2) Hard 用单教师 vs 多教师；3) Mid 用 GRPO vs GAL；4) 不同 group size/阈值对稳定性与方差的影响。
- 重点图表建议：训练曲线（方差/奖励/成功率）、梯度方差估计对比图、难度分桶后各桶收益贡献图（若有）。
- 创新点抓手：实例级“结构化分治”解决统计冲突（不是 heuristic 加权）、Hard 偏差校正与 Mid 方差降低的针对性设计、以及对 unified SFT-RL 的理论化解释框架。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：SFT 与 RL 的矛盾不是“权重没调好”，而是梯度统计属性天然冲突；因此需要结构性机制（路由/分治）把不同难度样本分配给最合适的学习信号，并分别做偏差校正与方差降低，从而在统一训练中同时获得稳定性与探索性。

summary_en.core_problem: How to unify SFT and RL in post-training for reasoning LLMs without suffering from their statistical gradient conflict—SFT being low-variance but high-bias, RL being low-bias but high-variance—and how to handle the fact that learning-signal reliability varies drastically across instance difficulty (easy saturated, hard sparse-reward, mid most informative).
summary_en.importance: This directly impacts training stability, sample efficiency, and OOD generalization for reasoning. Naive loss weighting can either destabilize training due to RL variance or over-constrain exploration due to SFT bias, while the sequential SFT→RL pipeline incurs bias propagation and extra compute. A structural solution can improve robustness and generalization on complex reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DYPO (Dynamic Policy Optimization) replaces global mixing with instance-level routing and specialized objectives:
1) Dynamic Difficulty Grading: perform group rollouts per query and categorize instances by outcome patterns (e.g., consistent failures vs inconsistent attempts). Route Hard cases to SFT (stable learning) and Mid cases to RL (reward is discriminative and exploration is useful).
2) Bias correction for Hard (SFT branch): Multi-Teacher Distillation aggregates diverse reasoning paths from multiple teacher models to reduce SFT fitting bias and path dependence.
3) Variance reduction for Mid (RL branch): Group Alignment Loss (GAL) leverages within-group winner/loser dynamics to reinforce winning trajectories and suppress losing ones, yielding much lower gradient variance than standard pairwise/GRPO-style objectives (claimed orders-of-magnitude reduction vs GRPO).
4) Theory: formalizes the bias–variance trade-off in SFT–RL fusion; shows difficulty-based routing minimizes overall variance by avoiding high-variance low-yield RL updates on hard instances; argues multi-teacher distillation reduces bias linearly; and provides variance reduction guarantees for GAL relative to GRPO.
summary_en.experiments: Reported gains are ~5–10% on complex reasoning benchmarks, with improved stability/robustness over unified baselines (binary switching or soft weighting). Key empirical evidence should include: routing distribution vs performance, ablations for difficulty grading / multi-teacher distillation / GAL, and variance or stability diagnostics comparing GAL to GRPO, plus OOD or harder-split generalization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
[skim]
- Introduction: problem framing as a statistical gradient conflict, and DYPO’s three components.
- Method overview figure/algorithm: how instance-level routing triggers Hard→SFT and Mid→RL.
- Main results table + quick ablations: confirm where the 5–10% comes from.

[must_read]
- Theory sections: (i) formal bias/variance definitions for SFT vs RL gradients; (ii) proof/conditions that routing minimizes overall variance; (iii) assumptions behind “linear bias reduction” from multi-teacher distillation; (iv) the key variance bound showing GAL ≪ GRPO.
- Implementation details: exact grading criteria from group rollouts (thresholds, group size, success definition) and how the two branch losses are scheduled/combined.
- Critical ablations: routing vs weighting; single-teacher vs multi-teacher on Hard; GRPO vs GAL on Mid; sensitivity to group size/thresholds.
- Figures to focus on: training stability curves, gradient-variance estimates, and per-difficulty bucket contribution plots (if provided).
- Claimed innovations: structural (instance-level) conflict resolution rather than heuristic weighting; targeted bias correction for Hard and variance reduction for Mid; a theory-backed unified SFT–RL framework.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that SFT–RL unification fails not because of poor weighting but because their gradients have inherently conflicting statistics. DYPO resolves this structurally via instance-level routing plus branch-specific bias correction (Hard/SFT) and variance reduction (Mid/RL), aiming to achieve both stability and exploration in a single training framework.

recommendation.zh: 想解决 SFT 偏差锁死 vs RL 方差爆炸的统一训练，这篇值得对照你们现有 schedule；只看其动态权重/样本难度分桶策略与 OOD 曲线，别被大一统叙事带跑。
recommendation.en: If you’re fighting SFT bias lock-in vs RL variance blow-ups, this is worth benchmarking against your current schedule; skim the dynamic weighting + difficulty bucketing and the OOD curves, ignore the grand unification narrative.

paper.title: Distributionally Robust Token Optimization in RLHF

summary.core_problem: 现有 RLHF（PPO/DPO 及其变体）在训练分布与部署分布存在轻微偏移（措辞、格式、符号、语言等）时，容易出现性能大幅波动，尤其在多步数学推理中表现为不稳定与鲁棒性不足。即便是 token-level 的对齐方法（如 RTO）改善了 credit assignment，也仍会受 reward 噪声与 minibatch 组成影响，导致更新不稳、对分布移位敏感。
summary.importance: 鲁棒性是 RLHF 走向真实部署的关键瓶颈：线上输入不可控且分布持续漂移，若对齐方法对“表面扰动”高度敏感，会造成一致性差、可靠性不足与潜在安全风险。该工作把 DRO 的最坏情形思想引入 on-policy、token-level 的 actor 更新，在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下提升跨分布一致性，属于“工程可落地 + 理论可解释”的改进方向。
summary.technical_approach:
方法：Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO)。以 RTO 为基座（PPO 风格 actor 更新 + 从偏好学习得到的 token-wise reward），在 actor loss 上引入基于 f-divergence 的分布鲁棒优化：对一个 loss minibatch 构造“歧义集”(ambiguity set)，在该集合内最大化（最坏情况）token/trajectory 级损失，从而得到更保守但更稳定的更新。

关键建模：不是对全数据分布做 DRO，而是对每个 minibatch 的经验分布做局部 DRO（minibatch-level ambiguity set），直接作用于 on-policy policy-gradient 更新，目标是“抑制 minibatch 偶然性 + 强化对高损样本/轨迹的关注”，以提升分布移位下的一致性。

两种实现（对应两类 f-divergence）：
1) KL-DRTO：使用 KL 散度定义歧义集，得到对高损轨迹进行指数倾斜（exponential tilting）的熵风险/对数和指数形式的鲁棒目标；直观上等价于在 minibatch 内对高 loss 样本赋予更大权重，但权重是平滑的、由温度/半径控制。
2) χ²-DRTO：使用 χ² 散度，得到可计算的方差敏感（variance-sensitive）代理目标，可写成 minibatch 均值 + 与标准差相关的惩罚/上界形式；直观上鼓励降低“平均损失”同时压低“损失波动”，从而稳定梯度。

与相关工作差异：不同于 DrDPO/χ²-PO 等主要面向 offline 偏好优化的鲁棒重加权，DRTO 直接鲁棒化 on-policy、token-level 的 actor loss；也不同于需要额外保守约束或显著算力开销的 robust PPO/DPO 变体，DRTO 复用 RTO 流水线，额外开销很小。
summary.experiments: 实验聚焦数学推理分布移位鲁棒性：在多套基准上评估语言/符号/表述变化下的一致性与准确率。论文报告 DRTO 在保持 in-domain 强性能的同时，显著提升 shift 场景表现：例如 GSM8K 提升约 9.17%，另一个基准提升约 2.49%；跨五个 benchmark 的相对准确率提升最高可达 +11.83%（相对标准 RTO）。同时通过消融验证：KL 与 χ² 两种实现均能带来更稳定更新，且训练管线与标准 RTO 基本一致、几乎不增加运行时/计算成本。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读 Introduction：抓住问题定义（prompt 轻微变化导致失败）与核心主张（把 DRO 引入 token-level RLHF）。
- 读贡献点列表：明确“minibatch-level DRO + 两种 f-divergence 实现 + 低开销”。
- 重点看 Figure 1（若文中给出）：快速确认在多基准 shift 下的总体收益幅度。
